CW.about: Curaçao, officially the Country of Curaçao, is a constituent country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands. It is an island country located in the southern Caribbean Sea, specifically the Dutch Caribbean region, about 65 km (40 mi) north of Venezuela and 80 km (50 mi) southeast of Aruba.
CW.img: Facades of Handelskade, Willemstad, Curaçao - February 2020.jpg

BN.name: Brunei
BN.desc: sovereign country and sultanate on the island of Borneo in south-east Asia, member of the Commonwealth of Nations
BN.about: Brunei, officially Brunei Darussalam, is a country in Southeast Asia, situated on the northern coast of the island of Borneo. Apart from its coastline on the South China Sea, it is completely surrounded by the Malaysian state of Sarawak, with its territory bifurcated by the Sarawak district of Limbang.

TZ.name: Tanzania
TZ.about: Tanzania, officially the United Republic of Tanzania, is a country in East Africa within the African Great Lakes region. It is bordered by Uganda to the northwest, Kenya to the northeast, the Indian Ocean to the east, Mozambique and Malawi to the south, Zambia to the southwest, and Rwanda, Burundi, and the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the west.
TZ.img: Scene at Nyerere Square, Dodoma City.jpg

SH.name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
SH.desc: British overseas territory in the southern Atlantic Ocean
SH.about: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha is a British Overseas Territory located in the South Atlantic and consisting of the island of Saint Helena, Ascension Island, and the archipelago of Tristan da Cunha (including Gough Island). Its name was Saint Helena and Dependencies until 1 September 2009, when a new constitution came into force, giving the three islands equal status as three territories, with a grouping under the Crown.
SH.wiki: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

HK.name: Hong Kong
HK.desc: city and special administrative region of China
HK.about: Hong Kong is a special administrative region of China. Situated on China's southern coast just south of Shenzhen, it consists of Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, and the New Territories.

PF.name: French Polynesia
PF.desc: French overseas country in the southern Pacific Ocean
PF.about: French Polynesia (  POL-ih-NEE-zhə; French: Polynésie française [pɔlinezi fʁɑ̃sɛːz] ; Tahitian: Pōrīnetia farāni) is an overseas collectivity of France and its sole overseas country; it is classified as a non-self-governing territory by the United Nations. It comprises 121 geographically dispersed islands and atolls stretching over more than 2,000 kilometres (1,200 mi) in the South Pacific Ocean.

NF.name: Norfolk Island
NF.desc: external territory of Australia in the South Pacific Ocean, consisting of the island of the same name plus neighbouring islands
NF.about: Norfolk Island (, NOR-fək or locally , NOR-fohk; Norf'k Ailen) is an  external territory of Australia located in the Pacific Ocean between New Zealand and New Caledonia, 1,412 kilometres (877 mi) directly east of Australia's Evans Head and about 900 kilometres (560 mi) from Lord Howe Island. Together with the neighbouring Phillip Island and Nepean Island, the three islands collectively form the Territory of Norfolk Island.

PH.name: Philippines
PH.about: The Philippines, officially the Republic of the Philippines, is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia. Located in the western Pacific Ocean, it consists of about 7,641 islands, with a total area of about 300,000 square kilometers.
PH.img: Manila Bay, Roxas Boulevard buildings with navy fleet (Ermita and Malate, Manila)(2017-12-31).jpg

VG.name: British Virgin Islands
VG.desc: British overseas territory in the Caribbean
VG.about: The British Virgin Islands (BVI), officially the Virgin Islands, is a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean, to the east of Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands and north-west of Anguilla. The islands are geographically part of the Virgin Islands archipelago and are located in the Leeward Islands of the Lesser Antilles and part of the West Indies.

BL.name: Saint Barthélemy
BL.desc: overseas collectivity of France, island of the Little Antilles
BL.about: Saint Barthélemy, officially the Territorial Collectivity of Saint Barthélemy, also known as St. Barts and St.

SX.name: Sint Maarten
SX.desc: country on the Caribbean island of Saint Martin, part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
SX.about: Sint Maarten, officially the Country of Sint Maarten, is a constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands located in the Caribbean region of North America. With a population of 58,477 as of June 2023 on an area of 34 km2 (13 sq mi), it encompasses the southern 44% of the divided island of Saint Martin, while the northern 56% of the island constitutes the French overseas collectivity of Saint Martin.
SX.img: Philipsburg and the Great Bay, Sint Maarten, Caribbean.jpg

PS.name: Palestine
PS.desc: political entity that enjoys incomplete recognition as a state, located in West Asia
PS.about: Palestine, officially the State of Palestine, is a country in the Southern Levant region of West Asia. Situated between the Mediterranean Sea and Jordan River, it comprises the territories of the West Bank and the Gaza Strip, both of which are under occupation by Israel.

Q79840.name: Ardahan Province
Q79840.about: Ardahan Province (Turkish: Ardahan ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Erdêxanê, Georgian: არტაანის რეგიონი, romanized: art'aanis regioni) is a province in the north-east of Turkey, bordering Georgia and Armenia. Its area is 4,934 km2, and its population is 92,481 (2022).

Q80051.name: Ağrı Province
Q80051.about: Ağrı Province (Turkish: Ağrı ili, Armenian: Արարատ մարզ, Kurdish: Parêzgeha Agirîyê) is located in eastern Turkey, bordering Iran to the east and the provinces of Kars to the north, Erzurum to the northwest, Muş and Bitlis to the southwest, Van to the south, and Iğdır to the northeast. Its area is 11,099 km2, and its population is 511,238 (2023).

Q752.name: Groningen
Q752.about: Groningen ( GROH-ning-ən, UK also  GRON-ing-ən; Dutch: [ˈɣroːnɪŋə(n)] ; Gronings: Grunn; West Frisian: Grinslân [ˈɡrẽːslɔ̃ːn]) is the northeasternmost province of the Netherlands. It borders on Friesland to the west, Drenthe to the south, the German state of Lower Saxony to the east, and the Wadden Sea to the north.
Q752.img: Plattegrond van de stad Groningen in 1575.jpg

Q772.name: Drenthe
Q772.about: Drenthe (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈdrɛntə] ) is a province of the Netherlands located in the northeastern part of the country. It is bordered by Overijssel to the south, Friesland to the west, Groningen to the north, and the German state of Lower Saxony to the east.

Q773.name: Overijssel
Q773.about: Overijssel (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌoːvərˈɛisəl] ; Dutch Low Saxon: Oaveriessel [ˌɒːvərˈiːsl̩]; German: Oberyssel; lit. 'Across IJssel') is a province of the Netherlands located in the eastern part of the country. The province borders Drenthe to the north, Friesland to the north-west, Flevoland (and a small part of the IJsselmeer) to the west, Gelderland to the south and west, and Germany's states of Lower Saxony and North Rhine-Westphalia to the east.

Q80550.name: Van Province
Q80550.about: Van Province (Turkish: Van ili, Kurdish: Parezgêha Wanê, Armenian: Վանի մարզ) is a province and metropolitan municipality in the Eastern Anatolian region of Turkey, between Lake Van and the Iranian border. Its area is 20,921 km2, and its population is 1,128,749 (2022).

Q93209.name: Hakkâri Province
Q93209.about: Hakkâri Province (pronounced [hacːaːɾi], Turkish: Hakkâri ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Colemêrg), is a province in the southeast of Turkey. It borders Van Province to the north, and Şırnak Province to the west.

Q103093.name: Västra Götaland County
Q103093.about:
Västra Götaland County (Swedish: Västra Götalands län [ˈvɛ̂stra ˈjøːtaˌlɑːnds lɛn]) is a county or län on the western coast of Sweden.
The county is the second most populous of Sweden's counties and it comprises 49 municipalities (kommuner).

Q103679.name: Jämtland County
Q103679.about: Jämtland County (Swedish: Jämtlands län, pronounced [ˈjɛmtlɑnds ˈlɛːn]; Southern Sami: Jiemthen leene, pronounced [ˈjiemten ˈleːne]) is a county or län in Sweden. It consists of the provinces of Jämtland and Härjedalen, along with minor parts of Hälsingland and Ångermanland, plus two small strips of Lapland and Dalarna.

Q103686.name: Norrbotten County
Q103686.about: Norrbotten County is the northernmost county or län of Sweden. It is also the largest county by land area, almost a quarter of Sweden's total area.
Q103686.img: Vuojatädno river from a bridge along the Padjelantaleden in Stora Sjöfallet National Park (DSCF0941).jpg

Q1237.name: Trentino-South Tyrol
Q1237.about: Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol (Italian: Trentino-Alto Adige [trenˈtiːno ˈalto ˈaːdidʒe]; Austrian German: Trentino-Südtirol; Ladin: Trentin-Südtirol), often known in English as Trentino-South Tyrol or by its Italian name Trentino-Alto Adige, is an autonomous region of Italy, located in the northern part of the country. The region has a population of nearly 1.1 million, of whom 62% speak Italian as their mother tongue (in areas where the local languages are transition dialects between Eastern Lombard and Venetian), 30% speak German (around 93% of whom are fluent in the local South Tyrolean dialect of Bavarian), and the remaining are minority speakers of Ladin, Mòcheno or Cimbrian and immigrant communities speaking several foreign languages.

Q1899.name: Kyiv
Q1899.desc: capital and largest city of Ukraine
Q1899.about: Kyiv, also spelt Kiev, is the capital and most populous city of Ukraine. Located in the north-central part of the country, it straddles both banks of the Dnieper River.

Q207413.name: Tacna Department
Q207413.about: Tacna (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈtaɣna]; Aymara and Quechua: Taqna) is a department of Peru. It is the southernmost department of the country, bordering Chile and Bolivia.

Q207795.name: Dornod Province
Q207795.about: Dornod (Mongolian: Дорнод, [ˈtɔrnɞt]; lit. 'East') is the easternmost of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia. Its capital is Choibalsan.

Q208284.name: Grevenmacher District
Q208284.desc: one of three former districts of Luxembourg
Q208284.about:
The District of Grevenmacher (1843 – 3 Oct 2015) was one of three districts of Luxembourg. It contained three cantons divided into 25 communes:

Beaufort

It bordered the districts of Luxembourg to the west and Diekirch to the north, the German Länder of Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland to the east, and the French département of Moselle, Grand Est to the south.

Q208747.name: Diekirch District
Q208747.about:
The District of Diekirch was one of three districts of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg. Immediately prior to its abolition on 3 October 2015, it contained five cantons divided into 43 communes:

To its west, the district of Diekirch bordered the Belgian province of Luxembourg in the region of Wallonia, whilst to its north was the Belgian providence of Liège.

Q210896.name: Madre de Dios Department
Q210896.about: Madre de Dios (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmaðɾe ðe ˈðjos] , English: Mother of God) is a department of Peru. Located in the country's southeast, it borders Brazil, Bolivia, and the Peruvian departments of Puno, Cusco, and Ucayali, in the Amazon Basin.

Q213189.name: Erbil Governorate
Q213189.about: Erbil Governorate (Kurdish: پارێزگای ھەولێر, romanized: Parêzgeha Hewlêr; Arabic: محافظة أربيل, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Arbīl) is a governorate of Iraq in the semi-autonomous Kurdistan Region. Its administrative centre is Erbil, which is its most important city.

Q275744.name: Aghstafa District
Q275744.about: Aghstafa District (Azerbaijani: Ağstafa rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the northwest of the country, it belongs to the Gazakh-Tovuz Economic Region.

Q276200.name: Bayankhongor Province
Q276200.about: The Bayankhongor Province or Bayanhongor Aimag is one of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia. It is located in the southwest of the country and, at 116,000 square kilometers, it is one of the largest aimags.

Q282471.name: Bakool
Q282471.about: Bakool (Somali: Bakool, Maay: Bokool, Arabic: بكول) is a region (gobol) in southwestern Somalia.

Q283979.name: Dikhil Region
Q283979.about: The Dikhil Region (Arabic: إقليم دخيل, Somali: Gobolka Dikhil, Afar: Rakaakay Dikhil) is a region in southern Djibouti. It is bordered by the Regions of Tadjoura  to the north, Arta to the northeast, Ali Sabieh to the east.

Q319632.name: Beqaa Governorate
Q319632.about: Beqaa Governorate (Arabic: مقاطعة البقاع, romanized: Muqāṭaʿat al-Biqāʿ) is a governorate in Lebanon and one of the nine governorates of the country. It is located in the eastern part of Lebanon and borders Syria.

Q319979.name: Western Equatoria
Q319979.about: Western Equatoria is a state in South Sudan. It has an area of 79,343 square kilometres (30,635 sq mi).
Q319979.img: Children in Yambio, Western Equatoria, South Sudan (28 05 2009).jpg

Q213272.name: Dornogovi Province
Q213272.about:
Dornogovi (Mongolian: Дорноговь, East Gobi) is one of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia, located in the southeast of the country, bordering China's autonomous region of Inner Mongolia.
Dornogovi is located in the Gobi Desert, and frequent sand- and snow storms amplify the hard weather conditions of Mongolia.

Q214094.name: Homs Governorate
Q214094.about: Homs Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة حمص, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Ḥimṣ) is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is situated in central Syria.
Q214094.img: On the top of Krak des Chevaliers - panoramio.jpg

Q217242.name: Katanga Province
Q217242.desc: former province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q217242.about:
Katanga was one of the four large provinces created in the Belgian Congo in 1914.
It was one of the eleven provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo between 1966 and 2015, when it was split into the Tanganyika, Haut-Lomami, Lualaba, and Haut-Katanga provinces.
Q217242.img: Downtown Lubumbashi, Democratic Republic of the Congo - 20061130.jpg

Q103732.name: Dalarna County
Q103732.about: Dalarna County (Swedish: Dalarnas län, pronounced [ˈdɑːlarnas lɛn]) is a landlocked county or län in central Sweden (Svealand). It borders on the counties of Uppsala, Jämtland, Gävleborg, Västmanland, Örebro and Värmland.

Q104877.name: Västerbotten County
Q104877.about: Västerbotten County (Swedish: Västerbottens län, pronounced [ˈvɛstɛrˌbɔtːɛns ˈlɛːn]; Northern Sami: Västerbottena leatna, pronounced [ˈvɛstɛrˌbɔtːɛna ˈleat̪na]), sometimes called Westrobothnia, is a county or län in the north of Sweden. It shares borders with the counties of Västernorrland, Jämtland, and Norrbotten, as well as the Norwegian county of Nordland and the Gulf of Bothnia.

Q106789.name: Värmland County
Q106789.about: Värmland County (Swedish: Värmlands län, pronounced [ˈvɛrmlandˌs lɛːn]) is a county or län in west central Sweden. It borders the Swedish counties of Dalarna, Örebro and Västra Götaland, as well as the Norwegian counties of Østfold, Akershus and Innlandet to the west.

Q107397.name: County Leitrim
Q107397.about: County Leitrim ( LEE-trəm; Irish: Contae Liatroma) is a county in Ireland. It is in the province of Connacht and is part of the Northern and Western Region.

Q125506.name: Iğdır Province
Q125506.about: Iğdır Province (Turkish: Iğdır ili, Kurdish: Parêzgeha Îdirê, Azerbaijani: İğdır ili, Armenian: Իգդիրի մարզ, romanized: Igdiri marz) is a province in eastern Turkey, located along the borders with Armenia, Azerbaijan (the area of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic), and Iran. Its adjacent provinces are Kars to the northwest and Ağrı to the west and south.

Q126125.name: Saint-Martin
Q126125.desc: French overseas collectivity, part of the island of Saint Martin in the Lesser Antilles
Q126125.about: The Collectivity of Saint Martin (French: Collectivité de Saint-Martin), commonly known as simply Saint Martin (Saint-Martin, [sɛ̃ maʁtɛ̃] ), is an overseas collectivity of France in the West Indies in the Caribbean, on the northern half of the island of Saint Martin, as well as some smaller adjacent islands. Saint Martin is separated from the island of Anguilla by the Anguilla Channel.

Q132418.name: Northern Cape
Q132418.about:
The Northern Cape (Afrikaans: Noord-Kaap [ˈnuərtkɑːp]; Tswana: Kapa Bokone; Xhosa: eMntla-Kapa; Khoekhoe: Nama!hub) is one of the 9 provinces in South Africa. 
The Northern Cape is the largest province accounting for 30.5% of the country's overall land area while being the most sparsely populated province in South Africa.
Q132418.img: Envisat captures the Orange River ESA230174.jpg

Q134411.name: West Azerbaijan Province
Q134411.about:
West Azerbaijan province (Persian: استان آذربایجان غربی) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran, whose capital and largest city is Urmia.
It is in the northwest of the country, bordered by Turkey (Ağrı, Hakkâri, Iğdır and Van Provinces), Iraq (Erbil and Sulaymaniyah Governorates) and Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, as well as the Iranian provinces of East Azerbaijan, Zanjan, and Kurdistan.

Q388081.name: Shahbuz District
Q388081.desc: district of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic in Azerbaijan
Q388081.about: Shahbuz District (Azerbaijani: Şahbuz rayonu) is one of the 7 districts of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The district borders the districts of Julfa, Babek, and the Syunik and Vayots Dzor provinces of Armenia.

Q388980.name: Tovuz District
Q388980.about: Tovuz District (Azerbaijani: Tovuz rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the north-west of the country and belongs to the Gazakh-Tovuz Economic Region.

Q389381.name: Gazakh District
Q389381.about: Qazax District (Gazakh District; Azerbaijani: Qazax rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the northwest of the country, it belongs to the Gazakh-Tovuz Economic Region.

Q389777.name: Tangier-Tetouan
Q389777.about: Tangier-Tétouan (Arabic: طنجة تطوان) was formerly one of the sixteen regions of Morocco from 1997 to 2015. It covered an area of 11,570 km2 and had a population of 3,157,075.
Q389777.img: 20141218 - Marocco Mediterrane Coast (West Side) - Air Photo by sebaso.jpg

Q390267.name: North Governorate
Q390267.about: North Governorate (Arabic: الشمال, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat ash-Shamāl) is one of the governorates of Lebanon and one of the two governorates of North Lebanon. Its capital is Tripoli.

Q390820.name: Sharur District
Q390820.desc: district of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic in Azerbaijan
Q390820.about: Sharur District (Azerbaijani: Şərur rayonu) is one of the 7 districts of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The district borders the districts of Kangarli, Sadarak, as well as the Vayots Dzor and Ararat provinces of Armenia and the West Azerbaijan Province of Iran.

Q474876.name: Namangan Region
Q474876.about: Namangan Region (Uzbek: Namangan viloyati/Наманган вилояти, نمنگن ولايتى; Russian: Наманганская область, Namanganskaya oblast) is one of the regions of Uzbekistan, located in the southern part of the Fergana Valley in far eastern part of the country. It is on the right bank of Syr Darya River and borders with Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Tashkent Region, Fergana Region, and Andijan Region.
Q474876.img: Nursery in Uychi district, Namangan province, Uzbekistan.JPG

Q475207.name: Klaipėda County
Q475207.about: Klaipėda County (Lithuanian: Klaipėdos apskritis) is one of ten counties in Lithuania, bordering Tauragė County to the southeast, Telšiai County to the northeast, Kurzeme in Latvia to the north, and Kaliningrad Oblast in Russia to the south. To the west is the Baltic Sea.

Q486370.name: Chuy Region
Q486370.about: Chüy is the northernmost region of Kyrgyzstan, surrounding the national capital Bishkek. It is bounded on the north by Kazakhstan, and clockwise, Issyk-Kul Region, Naryn Region, Jalal-Abad Region, and Talas Region.

Q486375.name: Naryn Region
Q486375.about: Naryn Region is the largest region of Kyrgyzstan. It is located in the east of the country and borders with Chüy Region in the north, Issyk-Kul Region in the northeast, Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region of China in the southeast, Osh Region in the southwest, and Jalal-Abad Region in the west.

Q223643.name: South Governorate
Q223643.desc: one of the six governorates of Lebanon
Q223643.about: South Governorate (Arabic: محافظة الجنوب, romanized: muḥāfaẓat al-Janūb, or simply الجنوب) is one of the governorates of Lebanon, with a population of 590,000 inhabitants and an area of 929.6 km2. The capital is Sidon.

Q228811.name: Lankaran
Q228811.about: Lankaran (Azerbaijani: Lənkəran, ) is a city in Azerbaijan, on the coast of the Caspian Sea, near the southern border with Iran. As of 2021, the city had a population of 89,300.

Q231896.name: Kukës County
Q231896.about: Kukës County (Albanian pronunciation: [kuːkəs]; Albanian: Qarku i Kukësit) is a landlocked county in northeastern Albania, with the capital in Kukës. The county spans 2,374 square kilometres (917 sq mi) and had a total population of 61,998 people as of 2021.

Q232382.name: Tartus Governorate
Q232382.about: Tartus Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة طرطوس, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Ṭarṭūs), officially known as Tartous Governorate, is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is situated in western Syria, bordering Latakia Governorate to the north, Homs and Hama Governorates to the east, Lebanon to the south, and the Mediterranean Sea to the west.

Q167859.name: Volyn Oblast
Q167859.about: Volyn Oblast (Ukrainian: Волинська область, romanized: Volynska oblast) or simply Volyn (Ukrainian: Волинь), is an oblast (province) in northwestern Ukraine. It borders Rivne Oblast to the east, Lviv Oblast to the south, Poland to the west and Belarus to the north.

Q167874.name: Chernihiv Oblast
Q167874.about: Chernihiv Oblast (Ukrainian: Чернігівська область, romanized: Chernihivska oblast), also referred to as Chernihivshchyna (Ukrainian: Чернігівщина), is an oblast (province) in northern Ukraine. The administrative center of the oblast is the city of Chernihiv.

Q168648.name: Sopron
Q168648.about: Sopron (Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈʃopron]; German: Ödenburg, German pronunciation: [ˈøːdn̩ˌbʊʁk] ) is a city in Hungary on the Austrian border, near Lake Neusiedl/Fertő.

Q1200.name: Rhineland-Palatinate
Q1200.about: Rhineland-Palatinate (German: Rheinland-Pfalz [ˌʁaɪnlant ˈpfalts] ; Palatine German: Rhoilond-Palz) is a landlocked state in western Germany. It covers 19,846 km2 (7,663 sq mi) and has about 4.05 million residents.

Q1201.name: Saarland
Q1201.desc: state of the Federal Republic of Germany
Q1201.about: Saarland (German: [ˈzaːɐ̯lant] ) is a landlocked federal state of Germany in the southwest of the country. With an area of 2,570 km2 (990 sq mi) and a population of 1 million in 2024, it is the smallest German state in area apart from the city-states of Berlin, Bremen, and Hamburg, and the smallest in population apart from Bremen.

Q785896.name: Kratié Province
Q785896.about: Kratié (Khmer: ក្រចេះ, Krâchéh [krɑˈceh]; lit. 'Naringi crenulata'), alternatively spelled Kracheh, is a province of Cambodia located in the northeast. It borders Stung Treng to the north, Mondulkiri to the east, Kampong Thom and Kampong Cham to the west, and Tboung Khmum, and the country of Vietnam to the south.

Q815330.name: Turkistan Region
Q815330.about: Turkistan Region, formerly known as South Kazakhstan Region from 1992 to 2018 and Chimkent Region from 1963 to 1991, is the southernmost region of Kazakhstan, bordering Uzbekistan. It had a population of 2,088,510 as of the 2022 Kazakhstan census.

Q818739.name: Laâyoune-Boujdour-Sakia El Hamra
Q818739.about: Laâyoune-Boujdour-Sakia El Hamra (Arabic: العيون بوجدور الساقية الحمراء) was one of the sixteen regions of Morocco from 1997 to 2015. It was mainly located in the disputed territory of Western Sahara, covered an area of 139,480 square kilometres (53,850 sq mi) and had a population of 301,744 as of the 2004 census.

Q821008.name: Ali Sabieh Region
Q821008.about: Ali Sabieh Region (Arabic: إقليم على صبيح, Somali: Gobolka Cali Sabiix) is a region in southern Djibouti. With a mainland area of 2,400 square kilometres (900 sq mi), it lies along the national border with Somalia and Ethiopia, bordering also the Dikhil Region to the west and the Arta Region to the north.

Q823810.name: Eastern Province
Q823810.about: Eastern Province is one of Zambia's ten provinces. The province lies between the Luangwa River and borders with Malawi to the east and Mozambique to the south, from Isoka in the northeast to the north of Luangwa in the south.

Q1202.name: Saxony
Q1202.about: Saxony, officially the Free State of Saxony, is a landlocked state of Germany, bordering the states of Brandenburg, Saxony-Anhalt, Thuringia, and Bavaria, as well as the countries of the Czech Republic and Poland. Its capital is Dresden, and its largest city is Leipzig.

Q2032.name: Luxembourg District
Q2032.desc: one of three former districts of the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, abolished with the two others in 2015
Q2032.about: The District of Luxembourg was one of three districts of the Grand-Duchy of Luxembourg. It contained four cantons divided into 44 communes.

Q2109.name: Arica y Parinacota Region
Q2109.about: The Arica y Parinacota Region (Spanish: Región de Arica y Parinacota pronounced [aˈɾikaj paɾinaˈkota]) is the northernmost of Chile's 16 first order administrative divisions. It comprises two provinces, Arica and Parinacota.

Q1127.name: Liege
Q1127.about:
Liège ( lee-EZH, lee-AYZH; French: [ljɛʒ] ; Walloon: Lîdje [liːtʃ]; Dutch: Luik [lœyk] ; German: Lüttich [ˈlʏtɪç] ) is the easternmost province of Wallonia, the primarily French-speaking region of Belgium.
Liège Province is the only Belgian province that has borders with three countries.

Q1129.name: Hainaut
Q1129.about:
Hainaut, historically also known as Heynault in English, is the westernmost province of Wallonia, the French-speaking region of Belgium.
To its south lies the French department of Nord, while within Belgium it borders (clockwise from the north) on the Flemish provinces of West Flanders, East Flanders, Flemish Brabant and the Walloon provinces of Walloon Brabant and Namur.
Q1129.img: 0 Mons - Panorama vu du Mont Héribus (1).JPG

Q1162.name: Arunachal Pradesh
Q1162.desc: region administered by India as a state
Q1162.about: Arunachal Pradesh (; lit. 'Dawn-Lit Mountain Province') is a state in northeast India. It was known as the North-East Frontier Agency until 1972, after which it became a union territory under the name Arunachal Pradesh.

Q487413.name: Issyk-Kul Region
Q487413.about: Issyk-Kul is one of the regions of Kyrgyzstan. Its capital is Karakol.
Q487413.img: Bringing the sheep home, on the southern shore of Issyk-Kul (3968109583).jpg

Q487585.name: Tashkent Region
Q487585.about: Tashkent Region (Uzbek: Toshkent viloyati, Тошкент вилояти) is a viloyat (region) of Uzbekistan, located in the northeastern part of the country, between the Syr Darya River and the Tian Shan Mountains. It borders Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Sirdaryo Region and Namangan Region, as well as the city of Tashkent which is a region in its own right, forming an enclave entirely encircled by the territory of Tashkent Region.

Q487631.name: Batken Region
Q487631.about: Batken is a region of Kyrgyzstan. Its capital is Batken.

Q487640.name: Jalal-Abad Region
Q487640.about: Jalal-Abad (; Kyrgyz: [dʒɑˌɫɑɫɑˈbɑt]) is a region (oblus) of Kyrgyzstan. Its capital is Manas.

Q775.name: Gelderland
Q775.about: Gelderland ( GHEL-dər-lənd, Dutch: [ˈɣɛldərlɑnt] ), also known as Guelders ( GHEL-dərz) in English, is a province of the Netherlands, located in the centre-east of the country. With a total area of 5,136 km2 (1,983 sq mi) of which 176 km2 (68 sq mi) is water, it is the largest province of the Netherlands by land area, and second by total area.

Q834.name: Canton of Valais
Q834.about: Valais (UK:  VAL-ay, US:  val-AY; French: [valɛ] ), more formally, the Canton of Valais or Wallis, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of thirteen districts and its capital and largest city is Sion.
Q834.img: Château de Valère et Haut de Cry - juillet 2022.jpg

Q1194.name: Schleswig-Holstein
Q1194.about: Schleswig-Holstein () is a coastal state that is the northernmost of the sixteen states of Germany, comprising most of the historical Duchy of Holstein and the southern part of the former Duchy of Schleswig. It borders Denmark, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Lower Saxony and the city-state of Hamburg.

Q169674.name: Kakheti
Q169674.about: Kakheti (; Georgian: კახეთი K’akheti [kʼaχetʰi]) is a region of Georgia. Telavi is its administrative center.

Q170024.name: Ras Al Khaimah
Q170024.desc: One of the seven emirates of the United Arab Emirates
Q170024.about: The Emirate of Ras Al Khaimah is the northernmost of the seven emirates that make up the United Arab Emirates. The city of Ras Al Khaimah, abbreviated to RAK or RAK City, is the capital of the emirate and home to most of the emirate's residents.
Q170024.img: Ras al-Khaimah December 2015 by Vincent Eisfeld.jpg

Q170213.name: Zakarpattia Oblast
Q170213.about: Zakarpattia Oblast (Ukrainian: Закарпатська область, romanized: Zakarpats'ka Oblast'), also referred to as simply Zakarpattia (Ukrainian: Закарпаття; Hungarian: Kárpátalja), Subcarpathia, or Transcarpathia in English, is an oblast located in the Carpathian Mountains in western Ukraine, mostly coterminous with the historical region of Carpathian Ruthenia. Its administrative centre is the city of Uzhhorod.

Q980.name: Bavaria
Q980.desc: federated state in the south of Germany
Q980.about: Bavaria, officially the Free State of Bavaria, is a landlocked state of Germany. It borders the states of Baden-Württemberg to the west, Hesse to the north-west, and Thuringia and Saxony to the north, as well as the countries of Switzerland and Austria to the south and the Czech Republic to the east.

Q1113.name: West Flanders
Q1113.about: West Flanders is the westernmost province of the Flemish Region, in Belgium. It is the only coastal Belgian province, facing the North Sea to the northwest.

Q1125.name: Namur
Q1125.about: Namur (French: [namyʁ] ; Walloon: Nameur; Dutch: Namen [ˈnaːmə(n)] ) is a province of Wallonia, one of the three regions of Belgium. It borders (clockwise from the West) on the Walloon provinces of Hainaut, Walloon Brabant, Liège and Luxembourg in Belgium, and the French department of Ardennes.
Q1125.img: Vue de la Meuse depuis la Citadelle.jpg

Q457494.name: Dashkasan District
Q457494.about: Dashkasan District (Azerbaijani: Daşkəsən rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country and belongs to the Ganja-Dashkasan Economic Region.

Q457513.name: Kalbajar District
Q457513.about: Kalbajar District (Azerbaijani: Kəlbəcər rayonu) is one of the 67 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country and belongs to the East Zangezur Economic Region.

Q458382.name: Mbeya Region
Q458382.about: Mbeya Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Mbeya) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers an area of 35,954 km2 (13,882 sq mi).

Q458417.name: Nabatieh Governorate
Q458417.about: Nabatieh Governorate (Arabic: محافظة النبطية, Muḥāfaẓat an-Nabaṭiyyah) is one of the nine governorates of Lebanon. The area of this governorate is 1,058 km2.

Q463242.name: Bumthang District
Q463242.about: Bumthang District (Dzongkha: བུམ་ཐང་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Bum-thang rzong-khag) is one of the 20 dzongkhag (districts) comprising Bhutan. It contains numerous temples and Buddhist sacred sites.

Q465961.name: Udomsai
Q465961.about: Oudomxay (alternates: Oudômxai or Moung Xai; Lao: ອຸດົມໄຊ, pronounced [ʔú.dòm.sáj]) is a province of Laos, located in the northwest of the country. Its capital is Muang Xai.

Q466031.name: Kandal Province
Q466031.about: Kandal (Khmer: កណ្ដាល, Kândal [kɑnˈɗaːl]; lit. 'middle') is a province of Cambodia which completely surrounds the Cambodian capital of Phnom Penh. Located in the country's southeast, it borders the provinces of Kampong Speu and Takéo to the west, Kampong Chhnang and Kampong Cham to the north, Prey Veng to the east, and shares an international border with Vietnam (An Giang and Đồng Tháp).

Q179424.name: County Donegal
Q179424.about: County Donegal ( DUN-ig-AWL, DON-ig-AWL; Irish: Contae Dhún na nGall) is a county in the Republic of Ireland. It is in the province of Ulster and is the northernmost county on the island of Ireland.

Q179559.name: Arad County
Q179559.about: Arad County (Romanian pronunciation: [aˈrad] ) is an administrative division (județ) of Romania roughly translated into county in the western part of the country on the border with Hungary, mostly in the region of Crișana and a few villages in Banat. The administrative center of the county lies in the city of Arad.

Q179588.name: Bihor County
Q179588.about: Bihor County (Romanian pronunciation: [biˈhor] , Hungarian: Bihar megye) is a county (județ) in western Romania. With a total area of 7,544 km2 (2,913 sq mi), Bihor is Romania's 6th largest county geographically and the main county in the historical region of Crișana.

Q180484.name: Epirus Region
Q180484.desc: one of the 13 regions of Greece
Q180484.about: Epirus ( ih-PY-rəs; Greek: Ήπειρος, romanized: Ípiros, [ˈi.pi.ros]) is a traditional geographic and modern administrative region in northwestern Greece. It borders the regions of Western Macedonia and Thessaly to the east, West Greece to the south, the Ionian Sea and Ionian Islands to the west and Albania to the north.

Q3093.name: Aisne
Q3093.about: Aisne ( ayn, US also  en; French: [ɛːn] ; Picard: Ainne) is a French department in the Hauts-de-France region of northern France. It is named after the river Aisne.
Q3093.img: Laon Blick auf die Ville Basse 18.jpg

Q3164.name: Ardennes
Q3164.about: Ardennes (French: [aʁdɛn] ) is a department in the Grand Est region of northeastern France named after the broader Ardennes. Its prefecture is the town Charleville-Mézières.

Q232399.name: Rif Dimashq Governorate
Q232399.about: Rif Dimashq Governorate (Arabic: محافظة ريف دمشق, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Rīf Dimašq, lit. 'Damascus Countryside') is one of the fourteen governorates (provinces) of Syria. It is situated in the southwestern part of the country.

Q235579.name: Province of Umnugobi
Q235579.about: Ömnögovi (Mongolian: Өмнөговь [ɵ́mn.ʁœw̜]) or South Gobi Province is the southernmost and largest province of Mongolia, located in the Gobi Desert. Its capital is Dalanzadgad.

Q238079.name: Potosí Department
Q238079.about: Potosí (Spanish pronunciation: [potoˈsi]; Quechua: P'utuqsi; Aymara: Putusi) is a department in southwestern Bolivia. Its area is 118,218 km2 (45,644 sq mi) and its population is 856,419 (2024 census).
Q238079.img: Alrededores de la Laguna Colorada - Bolivia.jpg

Q244804.name: Sükhbaatar Province
Q244804.about: Sükhbaatar (Mongolian: Сүхбаатар, lit. Axe Hero) is one of the 21 aimags of Mongolia, located in the east of the country.

Q249252.name: Zangilan District
Q249252.about: Zangilan District (Azerbaijani: Zəngilan rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the south-west of the country and belongs to the East Zangezur Economic Region.

Q272784.name: La Paz Department
Q272784.about: The La Paz Department of Bolivia comprises 133,985 square kilometres (51,732 sq mi) with a 2024 census population of 3,022,566 inhabitants. It is situated at the western border of Bolivia, sharing Lake Titicaca with the neighboring Peru.

Q142258.name: Kampong Cham Province
Q142258.about: Kampong Cham Province (Khmer: ខេត្តកំពង់ចាម, Khaêt Kâmpǒng Cham; [kɑm.pɔŋ caːm]) is a province of Cambodia located on the central lowlands of the Mekong River. It borders the provinces of Kampong Chhnang to the west, Kampong Thom and Kratié to the north, Tboung Khmum to the east, and Prey Veng and Kandal to the south.

Q153329.name: Rukwa Region
Q153329.about: Rukwa Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Rukwa) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions  The region covers a land area of 27,765 km2 (10,720 sq mi), which is comparable in size to the combined land area of the nation state of Haiti. Rukwa Region is bordered to the north by Katavi Region, to the east by Songwe Region, to the south by the nation of Zambia and to the west by Lake Tanganyika, which forms a border between Tanzania and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Q165408.name: Western Macedonia Region
Q165408.desc: one of the 13 administrative regions of Greece
Q165408.about: Western Macedonia (Greek: Δυτική Μακεδονία, romanized: Ditikí Makedonía, Greek pronunciation: [ðitiˈki makeðoˈnia]) is one of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece, consisting of the western part of Macedonia. Located in north-western Greece, it is divided into the regional units of Florina, Grevena, Kastoria, and Kozani.

Q165459.name: Satu Mare County
Q165459.about: Satu Mare County (Romanian: Județul Satu Mare, pronounced [ˌsatu ˈmare], Hungarian: Szatmár megye) is a county (județ) of Romania, on the border with Hungary and Ukraine. The capital city is Satu Mare.

Q327045.name: Tataouine Governorate
Q327045.about: Tataouine (Tunisian Arabic: ولاية تطاوين Wilāyat Taṭāwīn; French: Gouvernorat de Tataouine) is the southernmost of the twenty-four governorates of Tunisia, the only one to border both Algeria and Libya. It is also the largest, covering an area of 38,889 km2.

Q327087.name: Medenine Governorate
Q327087.about: Medenine (Arabic: مدنين Mednīn; French: Médenine) is one of the 24 governorates (provinces) of Tunisia, it had a population of 537,255 (2024 census) situated in the south-east, it includes the island of Djerba and borders Libya to the east. The capital is Mednine.

Q330749.name: Gadabay District
Q330749.about: Gadabay District (Azerbaijani: Gədəbəy rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country and belongs to the Gazakh-Tovuz Economic Region.

Q332095.name: Western Bahr el Ghazal
Q332095.about: Western Bahr el Ghazal is a state in South Sudan. It has an area of 93,900 km2 (36,255 sq mi) and as of 2020 has estimated 600,000 in population.

Q334868.name: Phongsaly Province
Q334868.about: Phongsaly province (Lao ຜົ້ງສາລີ), also spelled Phôngsali, is a province of Laos in the extreme north of the country. The capital of the province is the city of Phôngsali.

Q372144.name: Musandam Governorate
Q372144.about: The Musandam Governorate (Arabic: مُحَافَظَة مُسَنْدَم, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Musandam) is a governorate of Oman. Except for the exclave of Madha, it is located on the Musandam Peninsula, which juts into the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow entry into the Persian Gulf, from the Arabian Peninsula.

Q373808.name: Khujand
Q373808.about:
Khujand, sometimes spelled Khodjent and formerly known as Leninabad from 1936 to 1991, is the second-largest city of Tajikistan and the capital of its northernmost Sughd province.
Khujand is one of the oldest cities in Central Asia, dating back about 2,500 years to the Persian Empire.

Q185368.name: Hajdú-Bihar County
Q185368.about: Hajdú–Bihar (Hungarian: Hajdú-Bihar megye, pronounced [ˈhɒjduː ˈbihɒr]) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) in eastern Hungary, on the border with Romania. It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg, Borsod–Abaúj–Zemplén, Jász–Nagykun–Szolnok and Békés.

Q185586.name: Timiș County
Q185586.about: Timiș (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈtimiʃ]) is a county (județ) of western Romania on the border with Hungary and Serbia, in the historical region of Banat, with the county seat at Timișoara. It is the westernmost and the largest county in Romania in terms of land area.

Q185700.name: Vitebsk Region
Q185700.about: Vitebsk region, also known as Vitebsk oblast or Vitsyebsk voblasts, is one of the regions of Belarus. Its administrative center is Vitebsk.

Q185845.name: Haifa District
Q185845.desc: administrative district of Israel, centered on Haifa
Q185845.about: Haifa District (Hebrew: מחוז חיפה; Arabic: منطقة حيفا) is an administrative district surrounding the city of Haifa in Israel. The district is one of the seven administrative districts of Israel, and its capital is Haifa.

Q2114.name: Tarapacá Region
Q2114.about: The Tarapacá Region (Spanish: Región de Tarapacá, pronounced [taɾapaˈka]) is one of Chile's 16 first-order administrative divisions. It comprises two provinces, Iquique and Tamarugal.

Q2118.name: Antofagasta Region
Q2118.about: The Antofagasta Region (Spanish: Región de Antofagasta, pronounced [antofaˈɣasta]) is one of Chile's sixteen first-order administrative divisions.  Being the second-largest region of Chile in area, it comprises three provinces, Antofagasta, El Loa and Tocopilla.

Q2218.name: Pskov Oblast
Q2218.about: Pskov Oblast (Russian: Пско́вская о́бласть, romanized: Pskovskaja oblast), also referred to as Pskovshchina (Russian: Псковщина, romanized: Pskovščina) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), located in the west of the country. Its administrative center is the city of Pskov.

Q853948.name: Marijampolė County
Q853948.about: Marijampolė County (Lithuanian: Marijampolės apskritis) is one of the ten counties in Lithuania. It is in the southwest of the country and roughly corresponds to the historical region of Sudovia.

Q856719.name: Gedo
Q856719.about: Gedo (Somali: Gedo, Maay: Gethy, Arabic: جيذو, Italian: Ghedo or Ghedu) is an administrative region (gobol) in Jubaland, southern Somalia. Its regional capital is Garbahaarreey.

Q856788.name: Prey Veng Province
Q856788.about: Prey Veng (Khmer: ព្រៃវែង [prɨj.ʋɛːŋ]; lit. 'High Forest') is a province (khaet) of Cambodia. The capital is Prey Veng.

Q863554.name: Likouala Department
Q863554.desc: department of the Republic of the Congo
Q863554.about: Likouala is a department of the Republic of the Congo in the northern part of the country. It borders the departments of Cuvette and Sangha, and internationally, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Central African Republic.

Q864647.name: Pool Department
Q864647.desc: department of the Republic of the Congo
Q864647.about: Pool (Kongo: Mpumbu, Nsundi, Mbula Ntangu) is a department of the Republic of the Congo in the southeastern part of the country. It borders the departments of Bouenza, Lékoumou, and Plateaux.

Q865658.name: Aknīste Municipality
Q865658.about: Aknīste Municipality (Latvian: Aknīstes novads) was a municipality in Selonia, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Aknīste town with its countryside territory, Asare Parish and Gārsene Parish of the former Jēkabpils district.

Q868520.name: Kindia Region
Q868520.about: Kindia Region (Pular: 𞤁𞤭𞥅𞤱𞤢𞤤 𞤑𞤭𞤲𞤣𞤭𞤴𞤢𞥄) is a region located in western Guinea. It is bordered by the country of Sierra Leone and the Guinean regions of Conakry, Labé, Mamou, and Boké.

Q868778.name: Kasungu District
Q868778.about: Kasungu is a district in the Central Region of Malawi. The capital is Kasungu.

Q868792.name: Mchinji District
Q868792.about: Mchinji is a district in the Central Region of Malawi. The capital is Mchinji.

Q108037.name: Valmiera
Q108037.desc: state city of Latvia and capital of Valmiera Municipality
Q108037.about: Valmiera () is the second largest city of the historical Vidzeme region, Latvia, with a total area of 19.35 square kilometres (7 square miles). As of 2002, Valmiera had a population of 27,323, and in 2020, it was at 24,879.
Q108037.img: Church of Saint Simon in Valmiera (1).jpg

Q109342.name: North Hwanghae Province
Q109342.about: North Hwanghae Province (Hwanghaebuk-to; Korean pronunciation: [ɸwa̠ŋ.ɦɛ.buk̚.t͈o̞], lit. "north Yellow Sea province") is a province of North Korea.

Q109838.name: Talas Region
Q109838.about: Talas (Kyrgyz: Талас облусу, romanized: Talas oblusu; Russian: Таласская область, romanized: Talasskaya oblast) is a region (oblast) of Kyrgyzstan. Its capital is Talas.

Q115318.name: Ruvuma Region
Q115318.about: Ruvuma Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Ruvuma) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers a land area of 63,669 km2 (24,583 sq mi), comparable in size to the nation state of Latvia.

Q183539.name: County Louth
Q183539.about: County Louth ( LOWDH; Irish: Contae Lú) is a coastal county in the Eastern and Midland Region of Ireland, within the province of Leinster. Louth is bordered by the counties of Meath to the south, Monaghan to the west, Armagh to the north and Down to the north-east, across Carlingford Lough.

Q184228.name: Žilina region
Q184228.about: The Žilina Region (Slovak: Žilinský kraj; Polish: Kraj żyliński; Hungarian: Zsolnai kerület) is one of the eight Slovak administrative regions and consists of 11 districts (okresy) and 315 municipalities, from which 18 have a town status. The region was established in 1923, however, in its present borders exists from 1996.

Q184760.name: County Monaghan
Q184760.about: County Monaghan ( MON-ə-hən; Irish: Contae Mhuineacháin) is a county in the Republic of Ireland. It is in the province of Ulster and is part of Border strategic planning area of the Northern and Western Region.

Q185036.name: Pärnu County
Q185036.about: Pärnu County (Estonian: Pärnu maakond or Pärnumaa; German: Kreis Pernau) is one of 15 counties of Estonia. It is located in the southwestern part of the country, on the coast of the Gulf of Riga, and it borders Lääne and Rapla counties to the north, Järva and Viljandi counties to the east, and Latvia to the south.

Q5118.name: Dagestan
Q5118.about: Dagestan, officially the Republic of Dagestan, is a republic of Russia situated in the North Caucasus of Eastern Europe, along the Caspian Sea. It is located north of the Greater Caucasus, and is a part of the North Caucasian Federal District.

Q5187.name: Chechnya
Q5187.desc: federal subject of Russia, republic of Russia
Q5187.about: Chechnya ( CHETCH-nee-ə),  officially the Chechen Republic, is a republic of Russia. It is situated in the North Caucasus of Eastern Europe, between the Caspian Sea and Black Sea.

Q5328.name: Karachay-Cherkessia
Q5328.about: Karachay-Cherkessia, officially the Karachay-Cherkess Republic, is a republic of Russia located in the North Caucasus. It is administratively part of the North Caucasian Federal District.

Q5700.name: Lapland
Q5700.about: Lapland is the largest and northernmost region of Finland. The 21 municipalities in the region cooperate in a Regional Council.

Q3367.name: Aosta
Q3367.about: Aosta (official French: Aoste; Valdôtain: Aoûta) is the capital and largest city of the Aosta Valley, a bilingual region in the Alps, 110 km (68 mi) north-northwest of Turin in Italy. It is situated near the Italian entrance of the Mont Blanc Tunnel and the Great St Bernard Tunnel, at the confluence of the Buthier and the Dora Baltea, and at the junction of the Great and Little St Bernard Pass routes.

Q1198.name: North Rhine-Westphalia
Q1198.about: North Rhine-Westphalia or North-Rhine/Westphalia (German: Nordrhein-Westfalen [ˌnɔɐtʁaɪn vɛstˈfaːlən] ), commonly shortened to NRW, is a landlocked state (Land) in Western Germany. With more than 18 million inhabitants, it is the most populous state in Germany.

Q1197.name: Lower Saxony
Q1197.about: Lower Saxony is a coastal state (Land) in northwestern Germany. It is the second-largest state by land area, with 47,614 km2 (18,384 sq mi), and fourth-largest in population (8 million in 2021) among the 16 Länder of the Federal Republic of Germany.

Q16603.name: Artigas Department
Q16603.about: Artigas Department (Spanish: Departamento de Artigas) is the northernmost department of Uruguay. Its capital is the city of Artigas, which borders the Brazilian city of Quaraí.

Q17269.name: Tibet Autonomous Region
Q17269.about: The Tibet Autonomous Region (TAR), often shortened in English to Tibet and sometimes to Xizang, is an autonomous region of the People's Republic of China. It was established in 1965 to replace the Tibet Area, a former administrative division of the Republic of China.

Q19039.name: Samtskhe–Javakheti
Q19039.about: Samtskhe–Javakheti (Georgian: სამცხე-ჯავახეთი, [s̪ämt̪͡s̪ʰχe̞ d͡ʒäväχet̪ʰi], Armenian: Սամցխե-Ջավախեթի, romanized: Samts’khe-Javakhet’i) is a region (mkhare) in southern Georgia with a population of 147,400 (2023) and an area of 6,413 km2 (2,476 sq mi). The region has Akhaltsikhe as its administrative center.

Q5823.name: Ceuta
Q5823.desc: Spanish autonomous city in northwestern Africa
Q5823.about: Ceuta (UK: , US: ; Spanish: [ˈθewta, ˈsewta] ; Moroccan Arabic: سَبْتَة, romanized: Sabtah) is an autonomous city of Spain on the North African coast. Bordered by Morocco, it lies between the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean.
Q5823.img: Panorámica de Ceuta desde el mirador de Isabel II.jpg

Q5971.name: Altai Republic
Q5971.desc: republic of Russia, federal subject of Russia
Q5971.about: The Altai Republic, also known as the Gorno-Altai Republic, is a republic of Russia located in southern Siberia. The republic borders Kemerovo Oblast to the north, Khakassia to the northeast, Tuva to the east, Altai Krai to the west, as well as three countries: Mongolia (Bayan-Ölgii) to the southeast, China (Xinjiang) to the south and Kazakhstan (East Kazakhstan Region) to the southwest.

Q11925.name: Canton of the Grisons
Q11925.about: The Grisons (; French: [ɡʁizɔ̃]) or Graubünden (Swiss Standard German: [ɡraʊˈbʏndn̩] ), more formally the Canton Grisons, is one of the twenty-six cantons of Switzerland. It has eleven districts, and its capital is Chur.

Q680382.name: Pomeroon-Supenaam
Q680382.desc: Region N.2 according to the administrative political division controlled by Guyana and claimed by Venezuela
Q680382.about: Pomeroon-Supenaam (Region 2)  is a region of Guyana. Its capital is Anna Regina.

Q705941.name: Arta Region
Q705941.about: Arta Region (Arabic: إقليم عرتا, Somali: Gobolka Carta) is one of the six regions of Djibouti. It was officially created in 2003 by the regrouping of sub-prefectures of the regions of Dikhil and Djibouti.

Q728155.name: Río San Juan Department
Q728155.about: Río San Juan (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈri.o saŋ ˈxwan]) is an administrative division and department in Nicaragua. It covers an area of 7,473 km2 (2,885 sq mi) and has a population of 140,786 as of the 2023 estimate.

Q729170.name: Bari
Q729170.desc: administrative region in Puntland bordered by Waqooyi-bari state to the west
Q729170.about: Bari (Somali: Bari, Arabic: بري) is an administrative region (gobol) in northeastern Somalia that consists of six districts: Qandala, Iskushuban, Alula, Bosaso, Bandarbeyla, and Qardho. The port city of Bosaso is the capital of the region and the largest city in Bari.

Q613345.name: Takéo Province
Q613345.about: Takéo (Khmer: តាកែវ, [taːkaew], lit. 'The Grandpa Keo') is a province of Cambodia. Located in the south of Cambodia to the west of Bassac River, Takéo borders the provinces of Kampot to the west, Kampong Speu to the northwest and Kandal to the north and east.

Q623142.name: Guéckédou Prefecture
Q623142.about: Guéckédou is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Guéckédou.

Q623295.name: Mamou Prefecture
Q623295.about: Mamou (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤃𞤢𞥄𞤥𞤵𞤲) is a prefecture located in the Mamou Region of Guinea. The capital is Mamou.

Q633490.name: Districts under Central Government Jurisdiction
Q633490.about: Districts under Central Government Jurisdiction, also translated as Districts under Republican Subordination (Russian: Районы республиканского подчинения; Tajik: Ноҳияҳои тобеи ҷумҳурӣ, romanized: Nohiyahoyi tobe’i jumhuriy), is a region in Tajikistan, consisting of 9 districts and 4 district-level cities that are directly under central administration. Dushanbe, the capital of Tajikistan, is surrounded by the Districts under Central Government Jurisdiction, but not part of it.

Q641468.name: Sadarak District
Q641468.desc: district of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic in Azerbaijan
Q641468.about: Sadarak District (Azerbaijani: Sədərək rayonu) is one of the 7 districts of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The district borders the district of Sharur, as well as the Iğdır Province of Turkey, Ararat Province of Armenia and the West Azerbaijan Province of Iran.

Q643895.name: Babek District
Q643895.desc: district of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic in Azerbaijan
Q643895.about: Babek District (Azerbaijani: Babək rayonu) is one of the seven districts of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The district borders the districts of Julfa, Shahbuz, Kangarli, Nakhchivan city, as well as the Vayots Dzor Province of Armenia and the East Azerbaijan and West Azerbaijan provinces of Iran.

Q644035.name: Julfa District
Q644035.desc: district of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic in Azerbaijan
Q644035.about: Julfa District (Azerbaijani: Culfa rayonu) is one of the 7 districts of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The district borders the districts of Ordubad, Babek, Shahbuz, as well as the Syunik Province of Armenia and the East Azerbaijan Province of Iran.

Q644048.name: Gubadly District
Q644048.about: Qubadli District (Azerbaijani: Qubadlı rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the south-west of the country and belongs to the East Zangezur Economic Region.

Q3838.name: Kinshasa
Q3838.desc: capital and the largest city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo having the status of a province
Q3838.about: Kinshasa (; French: [kinʃasa]; Lingala: Kinsásá), formerly named Léopoldville (Dutch: Leopoldstad) from 1881 to 1966, is the capital and largest city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Kinshasa is one of the world's fastest-growing megacities, with an estimated population of 18.5 million in 2026.

Q3844.name: Brazzaville
Q3844.desc: capital of the Republic of the Congo
Q3844.about: Brazzaville (French pronunciation: [bʁazavil]) is the capital and largest city of the Republic of the Congo. Administratively, it is a department and a commune.

Q3899.name: East Kalimantan
Q3899.about: East Kalimantan (Indonesian: ; Jawi: کالیمانتان تيمور; abbreviated as Kaltim) is a province of Indonesia. Its territory comprises the eastern portion of Borneo/Kalimantan.
Q3899.img: Kapal Tongkang Batubara melintas Sungai Mahakam.jpg

Q4091.name: Emirate of Fujairah
Q4091.about: The Emirate of Fujairah (Arabic: إِمَـارَة ٱلْفُجَيْرَة, romanized: Al-Fuǧaira; MSA: /al fud͡ʒajra/ Emirati Arabic : [ɪl fʊd͡ʒe̞ːrä]) is one of the seven emirates that make up the United Arab Emirates, the only one of the seven with a coastline solely on the Gulf of Oman and none on the Persian Gulf. Its capital is Fujairah.
Q4091.img: Ciudad de Fuyaira, protegida por el relieve montañoso de la cordillera Hajar (cropped).jpg

Q186295.name: Košice Region
Q186295.about: The Košice Region (Slovak: Košický kraj, IPA: [ˈkɔʂitskiː ˈkraj]; Hungarian: Kassai kerület) is one of the eight Slovak administrative regions. The region was first established in 1923 and its present borders were established in 1996.

Q186410.name: Šiauliai County
Q186410.about: Šiauliai County (Lithuanian: Šiaulių apskritis) is one of ten counties in Lithuania. It is in the north of the country, and its capital is Šiauliai.

Q186466.name: Almaty Region
Q186466.about: Almaty Region (Kazakh: Almaty oblysy [ɑɫmɑˈtə ˌwobɫɤˈsə]; Russian: Алматинская область), formerly known as the Alma-Ata Region until 1993, is a region in Kazakhstan, located in the southeastern part of the country. It surrounds, but does not include, the eponymous city of Almaty.

Q187402.name: County Cavan
Q187402.about: County Cavan (  KAV-ən; Irish: Contae an Chabháin) is a county in Ireland. It is in the province of Ulster and is part of the Northern and Western Region.

Q187677.name: Vas County
Q187677.about: Vas (Hungarian: Vas megye, pronounced [ˈvɒʃ]; German: Komitat Eisenburg; Slovene: Železna županija or županija Železna; Croatian: Željezna županija) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) of Hungary. It was also one of the counties of the former Kingdom of Hungary.

Q3680.name: Krasnodar Krai
Q3680.desc: administrative division (krai) in the North Caucasus region of southern Russia
Q3680.about: Krasnodar Krai is a federal subject of Russia (a krai) located in the North Caucasus region in Southern Russia and administratively part of the Southern Federal District. Its administrative center is the city of Krasnodar.

Q3769.name: French Guiana
Q3769.desc: French overseas department and region in South America
Q3769.about: French Guiana, also known by its French name Guyane or Guyane française, is an overseas department and region of France located on the northern coast of South America in the Guianas and the West Indies. Bordered by Suriname to the west and Brazil to the east and south, French Guiana covers a total area of 84,000 km2 (32,000 sq mi) and a land area of 83,534 km2 (32,253 sq mi).

Q5219.name: Ingushetia
Q5219.about: Ingushetia or Ingushetiya, officially the Republic of Ingushetia, is a republic of Russia located in the North Caucasus of Eastern Europe. The republic is part of the North Caucasian Federal District, and shares land borders with the country of Georgia to its south; and borders the Russian republics of North Ossetia–Alania to its west and north and Chechnya to its east and northeast.

Q5237.name: North Ossetia–Alania
Q5237.about: North Ossetia–Alania, officially the Republic of North Ossetia–Alania, is a republic of Russia situated in the North Caucasus of Eastern Europe. It borders the country of Georgia (South Ossetia) to the south, and the Russian federal subjects of Kabardino-Balkaria to the west, Stavropol Krai to the north, Chechnya to the east and Ingushetia to the southeast.

Q5267.name: Kabardino-Balkaria
Q5267.about: Kabardino-Balkaria (Russian: Кабарди́но-Балка́рия), officially the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic, is a republic of Russia located in the North Caucasus. As of the 2021 Census, its population was 904,200.

Q187753.name: Győr-Moson-Sopron County
Q187753.desc: administrative district in the extreme north-west Hungary
Q187753.about: Győr–Moson–Sopron (Hungarian: Győr-Moson-Sopron megye, pronounced [ˈɟøːr ˈmoʃon ˈʃopron ˈvaːrmɛɟɛ]; Croatian: Đursko-mošonjsko-šopronska županija; German: Komitat Raab-Wieselburg-Ödenburg) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) in north-western Hungary, on the border with Slovakia (Bratislava region, Nitra region and Trnava region) and Austria (Burgenland). It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Komárom–Esztergom, Veszprém and Vas.

Q188061.name: Vilnius County
Q188061.about: Vilnius County (Lithuanian: Vilniaus apskritis) is the largest of the 10 counties of Lithuania, located in the east of the country around the city Vilnius and is also known as Capital Region or Sostinės regionas by the Lithuanian statistics department and Eurostat. On 1 July 2010, the county administration was abolished, and since that date, Vilnius County remains as a territorial and statistical unit.
Q188061.img: Beautiful spring sunset in Vilnius Lithuania.jpg

Q188076.name: Võru County
Q188076.about: Võru County (Estonian: Võru maakond or Võrumaa; Võro: Võro maakund) is a county in southern Estonia. It is bordered by Valga and Põlva counties, Latvia's Alūksne and Ape municipalities, and Russia's Pskov Oblast (making it the only Estonian county to border two countries).

Q188085.name: Panevėžys County
Q188085.about: Panevėžys County (Lithuanian: Panevėžio apskritis) is one of ten counties in Lithuania. It is in the north-east of the country, and its capital is Panevėžys.

Q1046329.name: Nugal
Q1046329.desc: administrative region in Puntland, bordered by Waqooyi-bari to the west
Q1046329.about: Nugal (Somali: Nugaal, Arabic: نوغال, Italian: Nogal), traditionally known as Nugaaleed-Bari or Bari-Nugaal meaning eastern Nugaal, or Nugaal xaggeeda hoose meaning lower Nugaal, is an administrative region (gobol) in northern Somalia.
Q1046329.img: Darawiish Dhulbahante garesa of Dhowre, Eyl - Illig, Garowe province Nugaal.png

Q1047921.name: Grand Cape Mount County
Q1047921.about: Grand Cape Mount is a county in the northwestern portion of the West African nation of Liberia. One of 15 counties that constitute the first-level of administrative division in the nation, it has five districts.

Q1050497.name: Eastern Province
Q1050497.about: The Eastern Province (Krio: Istan Prɔvins) is one of the four provinces of Sierra Leone. It covers an area of 15,736 km2 and has a population of 1,943,610 (2021 census).

Q1051505.name: Nkhata Bay District
Q1051505.about: Nkhata Bay is a district in the Northern Region of Malawi. The capital is Nkhata Bay.

Q1061368.name: Oruro Department
Q1061368.about: Oruro (Spanish pronunciation: [oˈɾuɾo]; Quechua: Uru Uru; Aymara: Ururu) is a department of Bolivia, with an area of 53,588 km2 (20,690 sq mi). Its capital is the city of Oruro.

Q1080673.name: Plzeň-City District
Q1080673.about: Plzeň-City District (Czech: okres Plzeň-město) is a district in the Plzeň Region of the Czech Republic. Its capital is the city of Plzeň.

Q1125333.name: Ohrid Municipality
Q1125333.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1125333.about: The Municipality of Ohrid (Macedonian: Општина Охрид) is a municipality in the southwestern part of North Macedonia. Ohrid is also the name of the city where the municipal seat is found.

Q1130138.name: Sipaliwini District
Q1130138.about: Sipaliwini is the largest district of Suriname, located in the south. Sipaliwini is the only district that does not have a regional capital, as it is directly administered by the national government in Paramaribo.

Q173822.name: Brest region
Q173822.about: Brest region, also known as Brest oblast or Brest voblasts, is one of the six regions of Belarus. Its administrative center is Brest.

Q174187.name: Rivne Oblast
Q174187.about: Rivne Oblast (Ukrainian: Рівненська область, romanized: Rívnensʹka óblastʹ), also referred to as Rivnenshchyna (Ukrainian: Рівненщина, romanized: Rívnenščyna), is an oblast in northwestern Ukraine. Its administrative center is Rivne.

Q179029.name: Sabah
Q179029.about: Sabah (Malay pronunciation: [ˈsabah]) is a state of Malaysia located in northern Borneo, in the region of East Malaysia. Sabah has land borders with the Malaysian state of Sarawak to the southwest and Indonesia's North Kalimantan province to the south.

Q189541.name: Duhok Governorate
Q189541.desc: Duhok Governorate is part of Iraqi Kurdistan
Q189541.about: Duhok Governorate (Kurdish: پارێزگای دھۆک, Parêzgeha Dihok, Syriac: ܗܘܦܪܟܝܐ ܕܢܘܗܕܪܐ, romanized: Hoparkiya d’Nohadra, Arabic: محافظة دهوك, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Dohūk) is a governorate in the semi-autonomous Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Its capital is the city of Duhok.

Q189942.name: Northern District
Q189942.desc: one of the six districts of Israel
Q189942.about: The Northern District (Hebrew: מָחוֹז הַצָּפוֹן, romanized: Mekhoz HaTzafon; Arabic: منطقة الشمال, romanized: Minṭaqat ash-Shamāl) is one of Israel's six administrative districts. The Northern District has a land area of 4,473 km2, making it the second largest district in Israel.

Q190518.name: Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg County
Q190518.about: Szabolcs–Szatmár–Bereg (Hungarian: Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg megye, pronounced [ˈsɒbolt͡ʃ ˈsɒtmaːr ˈbɛrɛɡ]) is an administrative county (Hungarian: megye) in northeastern Hungary, bordering Slovakia (Košice Region), Ukraine (Zakarpattia Oblast), and Romania (Bihor and Satu Mare counties). It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Hajdú–Bihar and Borsod–Abaúj–Zemplén.

Q190550.name: Moravian-Silesian Region
Q190550.about: The Moravian-Silesian Region (Czech: Moravskoslezský kraj) is one of the 14 administrative regions of the Czech Republic. Before May 2001, it was called the Ostrava Region (Czech: Ostravský kraj).

Q870130.name: Lofa County
Q870130.about: Lofa is a county in the northernmost portion of Liberia. One of 15 counties that constitute the first-level of administrative division in the nation, it has nine districts.

Q870166.name: Faranah Region
Q870166.about: Faranah Region (N'Ko: ߝߙߊߣߊ߫ ߕߌ߲߬ߞߎߘߎ߲) is located in east-central Guinea. It is bordered by the countries of Sierra Leone and Mali and the Guinean regions of Kankan, Mamou, Nzérékoré, and Labé.

Q876772.name: Galguduud
Q876772.about: Galguduud (Somali: Galgaduud, Arabic: جلجدود, Italian: Galgudud or Ghelgudud) is an administrative region (gobol) of Galmudug state in central Somalia. Its administrative capital is Dusmareb.

Q877034.name: Mudug
Q877034.about: Mudug (Somali: Mudug) is an administrative region (gobol) in north-central Somalia. Spread across an area of 72,933 km2 (28,160 sq mi), the northern section of Mudug is part of Puntland whilst the majority of Mudug is part of Galmudug State, both of which are autonomous states within the Federal Republic of Somalia.

Q912359.name: Northern Province
Q912359.about: The Northern Province (Krio: Nɔtan Prɔvins) (commonly referred to as Northern Sierra Leone or simply the North) is one of the five provincial divisions of Sierra Leone. It is located in the Northern geographic region of Sierra Leone.

Q948691.name: Lūang Namthā
Q948691.about: Luang Namtha (Lao: ຫລວງນໍ້າທາ, pronounced [lǔaŋ nâːm.tʰáː]; literally 'royal sugar palm' or "'royal green river') is a province of Laos in the country's north. From 1966 to 1976 it formed, together with Bokeo, the province of Houakhong.

Q3393445.name: Alūksne Municipality
Q3393445.about: Alūksne Municipality (Latvian: Alūksnes novads) is a municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. It is located in the northeast of the country and borders Ape in the west, Balvi Municipality and Gulbene Municipality in the south, Pskov Oblast of Russia in the east and Võru County of Estonia in the north.

Q4116493.name: Central Darfur
Q4116493.about: Central Darfur State (Arabic: ولاية وسط دارفور, romanized: Wilāyat Wasaṭ Dārfūr) is a state in south-western Sudan, and one of five comprising the Darfur region. The state borders North Darfur to the north, South Darfur to the east, Central African Republic to the south, Chad and West Darfur to the west.

Q4792580.name: Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon
Q4792580.desc: one of the 11 local government districts of Northern Ireland established 2015
Q4792580.about: Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon is a local government district in Northern Ireland.  The district was created as Armagh, Banbridge and Craigavon on 1 April 2015 by merging the City and District of Armagh, Banbridge District and most of the Borough of Craigavon.

Q4864476.name: Plužine Municipality
Q4864476.about: Plužine Municipality (Serbian Cyrillic: Opština Plužine / Општина Плужине) is one of the municipalities in Northern Montenegro. The administrative center is the town of Plužine.

Q6714242.name: Muchinga Province
Q6714242.about: Muchinga Province is one of the ten provinces of Zambia. It is located in the northeast of the country and borders with Tanzania in the north, Malawi in the east, Eastern Province in the south, Central Province in the southwest, Luapula Province in the west, and Northern Province in the northwest.
Q6714242.img: Beautiful scenery of the Muchinga escarpment found in Zambia, sub saharan Africa region.jpg

Q12626.name: Meurthe-et-Moselle
Q12626.about: Meurthe-et-Moselle (French pronunciation: [mœʁt e mɔzɛl] , lit. 'Meurthe and Moselle') is a department in the Grand Est region of France, named after the rivers Meurthe and Moselle. Its prefecture and largest city is Nancy and it borders the departments of Meuse to the west, Vosges to the south, and Moselle and Bas-Rhin to the east, and it also borders the Belgian province of Luxembourg and the country of Luxembourg by the canton of Esch-sur-Alzette to the north.

Q827015.name: Bouenza Department
Q827015.desc: department of the Republic of the Congo
Q827015.about: Bouenza (can also be written as Buenza or Bwenza) is a department of the Republic of the Congo in the southern part of the country. It borders the departments of Lékoumou, Niari, and Pool, and internationally, the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Q831370.name: Orientale Province
Q831370.about: Orientale Province (French: Province orientale, lit. 'Eastern province') is one of the former provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo and its predecessors the Congo Free State and the Belgian Congo. It went through a series of boundary changes between 1898 and 2015, when it was divided into smaller units.
Q831370.img: Kisangani rond-point Cathédrale et Congo Palace.jpg

Q838778.name: South Darfur
Q838778.about: South Darfur State (Arabic: ولاية جنوب دارفور Wilāyat Ǧanūb Dārfūr; Janob Darfor) is one of the states of Sudan. It is one of the five states that compose the region of Darfur in western Sudan.

Q844929.name: Obock Region
Q844929.about: The Obock Region (Afar: Rakaakay Obock, Arabic: إقليم أوبوخ, Somali: Gobolka Obokh) is a region in northern Djibouti. Covering an area of 4,700 square kilometres (1,800 sq mi), it had an estimated population of 37,856 as of 2009.The region borders the Red Sea, Bab-el-Mandeb, Gulf of Aden, Gulf of Tadjoura, and includes the Seven Brothers, Doumeira Islands, and the coastal city of Obock.

Q848578.name: Haut-Mbomou Prefecture
Q848578.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848578.about: Haut-Mbomou ([o mbo.mu], "Upper Mbomou") is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Obo.

Q848585.name: Vakaga Prefecture
Q848585.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848585.about: Vakaga is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Birao.

Q848596.name: Haute-Kotto Prefecture
Q848596.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848596.about: Haute-Kotto ([ot ko.to], "Upper Kotto") is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Bria.
Q848596.img: Refugees camp in PK3, Bria, Central African Republic, 12 June 2018.jpg

Q12661.name: Nord
Q12661.about: Nord (French pronunciation: [nɔʁ] ; officially French: Département du Nord; Picard: Départémint dech Nord; Dutch: Noorderdepartement, lit. 'northern department') is a department in Hauts-de-France region in France, bordering Belgium. It was created from the western halves of the historical counties of Flanders and Hainaut, and the Bishopric of Cambrai.

Q12724.name: Canton of Ticino
Q12724.about: Ticino ( tih-CHEE-noh), sometimes Tessin ( tess-EEN), officially the Republic and Canton of Ticino, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of eight districts and its capital city is Bellinzona.

Q16161.name: Province of Como
Q16161.about: The province of Como (Italian: provincia di Como; Comasco: pruincia de Comm) is a province in the region of Lombardy in Italy. It borders the Swiss cantons of Ticino and Grigioni to the north, the Italian provinces of Sondrio and Lecco to the east, the province of Monza and Brianza to the south and the province of Varese to the west.

Q191061.name: Hrodna Region
Q191061.about: Grodno Region, also known as Grodno Oblast or Hrodna Voblasts, is a region of Belarus. Its administrative centre and its namesake, Grodno, is the largest city in the whole region.

Q191091.name: Karlovy Vary Region
Q191091.about: The Karlovy Vary Region (Czech: Karlovarský kraj) is an administrative unit (Czech: kraj) of the Czech Republic, located in the westernmost part of the country. It is named after its capital Karlovy Vary.

Q191616.name: Békés County
Q191616.about: Békés (Hungarian: Békés megye, pronounced [ˈbeːkeːʃ]; Romanian: Județul Bichiș; Serbian: Бекешка жупанија, Slovak: Békešská župa) is an administrative division (county or megye) in south-eastern Hungary, on the border with Romania. It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Csongrád-Csanád, Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok, and Hajdú-Bihar.

Q191792.name: Bayan-Ölgii Province
Q191792.about: Bayan-Ölgii ( BY-ən OHL-gee) is the westernmost of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia. The country's only Muslim and Kazakh-majority aimag, it was established in August 1940, having its capital at Ölgii.

Q192061.name: Viljandi County
Q192061.about: Viljandi County (Estonian: Viljandi maakond or Viljandimaa; German: Kreis Fellin) is one of 15 counties of Estonia. It is located in southern Estonia bordering Pärnu, Järva, Jõgeva, Tartu and Valga counties as well as Latvia.

Q487709.name: Central Equatoria
Q487709.about: Central Equatoria is a state in South Sudan. With an area of 43,033 square kilometres (16,615 sq mi), it is the smallest of the original South Sudanese states.

Q488326.name: South Kivu
Q488326.desc: province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q488326.about: South Kivu (Swahili: Jimbo la Kivu Kusini; French: Sud-Kivu) is one of 26 provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Its capital is Bukavu.

Q488519.name: Eastern Equatoria
Q488519.about: Eastern Equatoria is a state in South Sudan. It has an area of 73,472 km2.
Q488519.img: Peace agreement dancers in Kapoeta, Sudan.jpg

Q502188.name: Alajuela Province
Q502188.about: Alajuela (Spanish pronunciation: [alaˈxwela]) is a province of Costa Rica. It is located in the north-central part of the country, bordering Nicaragua to the north.

Q511151.name: Vaiņode Municipality
Q511151.about: Vaiņode Municipality (Latvian: Vaiņodes novads) is a former municipality in Courland, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Embūte parish and Vaiņode parish; the administrative centre being Vaiņode.

Q512623.name: Ordubad District
Q512623.desc: district of Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic in Azerbaijan
Q512623.about: Ordubad District (Azerbaijani: Ordubad rayonu) is one of the 7 districts of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan. The district borders the district of Julfa, as well as the Syunik Province of Armenia, and the East Azerbaijan Province of Iran.
Q512623.img: Ordubad naxcivan nakhchivan azerbaijan azerbaycan daglar svln4821 08.jpg

Q521112.name: Gostivar Municipality
Q521112.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q521112.about: Gostivar (Macedonian: Гостивар [ˈɡɔstivar] ; Albanian: Komuna e Gostivarit) is a municipality in the western part of North Macedonia.  Gostivar is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.

Q529796.name: Guelmim-Es Semara
Q529796.about: Guelmim-Es Semara (Arabic: كلميم السمارة) was one of the sixteen former regions of Morocco from 1997 to 2015. It covered an area of 122,825 square kilometres (47,423 sq mi) and had a population of 501,921 (2014 census).

Q573467.name: Karas Region
Q573467.about: The ǁKharas Region (Khoekhoe pronunciation: [ᵏǁʰa.ɾas], with a lateral click; formerly Karas Region, without the click) is the southernmost, largest, and least densely populated of the 14 regions of Namibia; its capital is Keetmanshoop. The name assigned to the region reflects the prominence of the Karas mountain range in its southern part.
Q573467.img: Oryx på Fish River Canyon-1871 - Flickr - Ragnhild & Neil Crawford.jpg

Q592251.name: Gbarpolu County
Q592251.about: Gbarpolu is a county in the northern portion of Liberia. One of 15 counties that comprise the first-level of administrative division in the nation, it has six districts.
Q592251.img: By chance, FEST engineer ‘comes across’ cousin in Liberia (15766600347).jpg

Q598793.name: Lhuntse District
Q598793.about: Lhuentse District (Dzongkha: ལྷུན་རྩེ་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Lhun-rtse rdzong-khag; previously "Lhuntshi", and officially spelled Lhuentse ) is one of the 20 dzongkhag (districts) in Bhutan. It consists of 2506 households.

Q600200.name: Trashiyangtse District
Q600200.about: Trashiyangtse District (Dzongkha: བཀྲ་ཤིས་གཡང་རྩེ་རྫོང་ཁག།, romanized: bkra shis g.yang rtse rdzong khag)  is one of the twenty dzongkhags (districts) comprising Bhutan. It was created in 1992 when Trashiyangtse district was split off from Trashigang District.

Q606825.name: Newry and Mourne
Q606825.about: Newry and Mourne District Council (Irish: Comhairle an Iúir agus Mhúrn) was a local council in Northern Ireland. It merged with Down District Council in May 2015 under local government reorganisation in Northern Ireland to become Newry, Mourne and Down District Council.

Q192866.name: Dibra County
Q192866.desc: Dibra County includes the district of Peshkopia, the district of Bulqiza, and the district of Mat
Q192866.about: Dibër County (Albanian pronunciation: [dibəɽ]; Albanian: Qarku i Dibrës) is one of the 12 counties of the Republic of Albania, spanning a surface area of 2,586 square kilometres (998 sq mi) with the capital in Peshkopi. The county borders on the counties of Durrës, Elbasan, Kukës, Lezhë, Tirana and the country of North Macedonia.

Q192945.name: Govi-Altai Province
Q192945.about: Govi-Altai (or Gobi-Altai) is one of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia, located in the west of the country. Its capital is Altai City.

Q193031.name: Csongrád-Csanád County
Q193031.desc: 2nd level administrative division in southeastern Hungary
Q193031.about: Csongrád-Csanád (Hungarian: Csongrád-Csanád megye [ˈt͡ʃoŋɡraːd ˈt͡ʃɒnaːd]; German: Komitat Tschongrad-Tschanad; Romanian: Județul Ciongrad-Cenad; Serbian: Чонградско-чанадска жупанија) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) in southern Hungary, straddling the river Tisza, on the border with Serbia and Romania. It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Bács-Kiskun County, Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok County and Békés.

Q193266.name: Liberec Region
Q193266.about: Liberec Region (Czech: Liberecký kraj) is an administrative unit (Czech: kraj) of the Czech Republic, located in the northernmost part of its historical region of Bohemia. It is named after its capital Liberec.

Q193295.name: Hradec Králové Region
Q193295.about: Hradec Králové Region (Czech: Královéhradecký kraj, pronounced [ˈkraːlovɛːˌɦradɛtskiː ˈkraj]) is an administrative unit (Czech: kraj) of the Czech Republic located in the north-eastern part of the historical region of Bohemia. It is named after its capital Hradec Králové.

Q2361012.name: Baltinava Municipality
Q2361012.desc: former municipality of Latvia between 2009 and 2021
Q2361012.about: Baltinava Municipality (Latvian: Baltinavas novads) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The administrative centre was Baltinava.

Q2395952.name: Kārsava Municipality
Q2395952.about: Kārsava Municipality (Latvian: Kārsavas novads, Latgalian: Kuorsovys nūvods) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Goliševa Parish, Malnava Parish, Mērdzene Parish, Mežvidi Parish, Salnava Parish and Kārsava town of the former Ludza district.

Q2410368.name: Oued Ed-Dahab Province
Q2410368.about: Oued Ed-Dahab (Arabic: إقليم وادي الذهب;Spanish: ex-Río de Oro) is a province in the region of Dakhla-Oued Ed-Dahab, in the Moroccan-occupied territory of Western Sahara. Its population at the 2004 Census was 65,378.

Q2523428.name: Syunik Province
Q2523428.about: Syunik (Armenian: Սյունիք, pronounced [sjuˈnikʰ] ) is the southernmost province of Armenia. It is bordered by the Vayots Dzor Province to the north, Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic exclave to the west, Azerbaijan to the east, and Iran to the south.
Q2523428.img: Национальный парк Аревик. Участок между Каджараном и селом Личк.jpg

Q2682731.name: Katavi Region
Q2682731.about: Katavi Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Katavi) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers an area of 45,843 km2 (17,700 sq mi).

Q2989420.name: Aloja Municipality
Q2989420.about: Aloja Municipality (Latvian: Alojas novads) was a municipality in Latvia. The administrative center was Aloja.

Q3274762.name: Zilupe Municipality
