The oblast has an area of 84,500 square kilometres (32,600 sq mi) and a population of 2,000,997 (2021 Census); up from 1,716,868 recorded in the 2010 Census.

Q2933.name: Asunción
Q2933.about: Asunción (English: , Spanish: [asunˈsjon] ; Guarani: Paraguay) is the capital and the largest city of Paraguay. The city lies on the eastern bank of the Paraguay River,  immediately north northeast of the confluence where it is joined by the Pilcomayo River.

Q728917.name: Samtse District
Q728917.about: Samtse District (Dzongkha: བསམ་རྩེ་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Bsam-rtse rdzong-khag; older spelling "Samchi") is one of the 20 dzongkhags (districts) comprising Bhutan. It comprises two subdistricts (dungkhags): Tashicholing and Dophuchen.

Q728929.name: Samdrup Jongkhar District
Q728929.about: Samdrup Jongkhar District (Dzongkha: བསམ་གྲུབ་ལྗོངས་མཁར་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Bsam-grub Ljongs-mkhar rdzong-khag) is one of the 20 dzongkhags (districts) in Bhutan. The dominant languages of the district are Tshangla (Sharchopkha) in the north and west, and Lhotsam in the east.

Q729010.name: Denguélé Region
Q729010.about: Denguélé Region (French: Région du Denguélé, pronounced [ʁeʒjɔ̃ dy dɛnɡele]) is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q644024.name: Chinandega Department
Q644024.about: Chinandega is an administrative division and department in northwestern Nicaragua.  It extends from the inland plains towards the Gulf of Fonseca in the Pacific coast.

Q648160.name: Oriental
Q648160.about: Oriental (Arabic: الجهة الشرقية) is one of the sixteen former regions of Morocco. It covers an area of 82,900 km2 and has a population of 1,918,094 (2004 census).

Q648718.name: South Bačka District
Q648718.about: The South Bačka District (Serbian: Јужнобачки округ, romanized: Južnobački okrug, pronounced [jûʒnobâːtʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the southern part of Bačka and northern part of Syrmia.

Q648758.name: North Bačka District
Q648758.about: The North Bačka District (Serbian: Севернобачки округ, romanized: Severnobački okrug, pronounced [sêʋeːrnobâːtʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the geographical region of Bačka.

Q650009.name: Municipality of Prevalje
Q650009.about: The Municipality of Prevalje (pronounced [ˈpɾeːʋaljɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Prevalje) is a municipality in the traditional region of Carinthia in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Prevalje.

Q262111.name: Zlín District
Q262111.about: Zlín District (Czech: okres Zlín) is a district in the Zlín Region of the Czech Republic. Its capital is the city of Zlín.

Q262125.name: Intibucá Department
Q262125.about: Intibucá (Spanish pronunciation: [in.ti.βuˈka]) is one of the 18 departments in the Republic of Honduras. Intibucá covers a total surface area of 1,186.1 square miles (3,072 km2).

Q263285.name: Temburong District
Q263285.about: Temburong District (Malay: Daerah Temburong; Jawi: دائيره تمبوروڠ) or simply known as Temburong (TUHM-boo-rong; Malay: [tǝmburoŋ] ), is the second largest and least populated district in Brunei. An exclave, it is divided from the rest of Brunei by the Malaysian district of Limbang to its west.

Q271442.name: Narathiwat
Q271442.about: Narathiwat (Thai: นราธิวาส, pronounced [nā.rāː.tʰí.wâːt]; Malay: Menara) is one of the southern provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from west clockwise) Yala and Pattani.

Q274118.name: Évora
Q274118.about: Évora District (Portuguese: Distrito de Évora [ˈɛvuɾɐ] ) is located in Alentejo, in southern Portugal. The district capital is the city of Évora.

Q279072.name: Municipality of Črna na Koroškem
Q279072.about: The Municipality of Črna na Koroškem (Slovene: Občina Črna na Koroškem) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Črna na Koroškem.

Q5831.name: Melilla
Q5831.desc: Spanish autonomous city in northwestern Africa
Q5831.about: Melilla (, Spanish: [meˈliʝa] ; Tarifit: Mřič) is an autonomous city of Spain on the North African coast. It lies on the eastern side of the Cape Three Forks, on the Morocco–Spain border, adjacent to the Moroccan port town of Beni Ansar, and faces the Mediterranean Sea.

Q7194.name: Girona
Q7194.about: The Province of Girona (Spanish: provincia de Gerona [pɾoˈβinθja ðe xeˈɾona]; Catalan: província de Girona [pɾuˈvinsiə ðə ʒiˈɾonə]) is a province in the northeastern part of the autonomous community of Catalonia in Spain. It is bordered on the northwest by the province of Lleida, on the southwest by the province of Barcelona, on the north by France (Pyrénées-Orientales), and on the east by the Mediterranean Sea.
Q7194.img: Vista platja de Castell-Camí de ronda Palamós a les Cales Cala Estreta (Costa Brava) - panoramio.jpg

Q11917.name: Canton of Geneva
Q11917.about: The Canton of Geneva, officially the Republic and Canton of Geneva, is one of the 26 cantons of the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of forty-five municipalities, and the seat of the government and parliament is in the city of Geneva.

Q629024.name: Ubon Ratchathani
Q629024.about: Ubon Ratchathani (Thai: อุบลราชธานี, pronounced [ʔù.bōn râːt.tɕʰā.tʰāː.nīː]; Northeastern Thai: อุบลราชธานี, pronounced [ʔǔ.bōn lâːt.sā.tʰa᷇ː.ni᷇ː]), often shortened to Ubon (อุบลฯ), is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces. It lies in lower northeastern Thailand (also called Isan).
Q629024.img: โขงเจียม ตำบล โขงเจียม จังหวัด อุบลราชธานี ประเทศไทย - panoramio.jpg

Q629538.name: Oddar Meanchey Province
Q629538.about: Oddar Meanchey is a province of Cambodia in the remote northwest. It borders the provinces of Banteay Meanchey to the west, Siem Reap to the south and Preah Vihear to the east.

Q629720.name: Čučer-Sandevo Municipality
Q629720.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q629720.about: Čučer-Sandevo Municipality (Macedonian: ), is a municipality in northern part of North Macedonia. Čučer-Sandevo is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q643989.name: Oghuz District
Q643989.about: Oghuz District (Azerbaijani: Oğuz rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the north of the country in the Shaki-Zagatala Economic Region.

Q405701.name: Al Jahra Governorate
Q405701.about: Jahra Governorate (Arabic: محافظة الجهراء Muḥāfaẓat al-Ǧahrāʾ) is one of the six governorates of Kuwait.  It is the largest Governorate in Kuwait accounting for 63 percent of its land area.

Q426114.name: Pehčevo Municipality
Q426114.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q426114.about: Pehčevo Municipality (Macedonian: Општина Пехчево [ˈpɛxtʃɛvɔ] ) is a municipality in the eastern part of North Macedonia. Pehčevo is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is located.

Q431908.name: Jegunovce Municipality
Q431908.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q431908.about: Jegunovce (Macedonian: , Albanian: Jegunoc) is a municipality in the northwest of North Macedonia. Jegunovce is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q456562.name: Matabeleland North Province
Q456562.about: Matabeleland North is a province in western Zimbabwe. With a population of 827,645 as of the 2022 census, it is the country's second-least populous province, after Matabeleland South, and the least densely Zimbabwean populated province.

Q464953.name: Kwara State
Q464953.about: Kwara (; ) is a state in Western Nigeria, bordered to the east by Kogi State for 188 km, to the north by Niger State for 400 km, mostly across the Niger River and Lake Jeba, and to the south by Ekiti for 61 km, Osun for 73 km, and Oyo states for 337 km, while its western border makes up part of the international border with Benin for 277 km including part of the Okpara River. Its capital is the city of Ilorin and the state has 16 local government areas.

Q466000.name: Koh Kong Province
Q466000.about: Koh Kong (Khmer: កោះកុង, Kaôh Kŏng [kɑh koŋ], lit. 'curved island') is a province (khaet) of Cambodia.  Its capital is Khemarak Phoumin (Koh Kong).

Q1095.name: Limburg
Q1095.about: Limburg (Dutch: Limburg, pronounced [ˈlɪmbʏr(ə)x] ; Limburgish: Limburg [ˈlɪm˦ˌbʏʀ˦əx] or Wes-Limburg [wæsˈlɪm˦ˌbʏʀ˦əx]; French: Limbourg, pronounced [lɛ̃buʁ] ), also known as Belgian Limburg, is a province in Belgium. It is the easternmost of the five Dutch-speaking provinces that together form the Region of Flanders, which is one of the three main political and cultural sub-divisions of modern-day Belgium.
Q1095.img: Panorama Hasselt- stadscentrum met Sint Quintinuskathedraal en Blauwe Boulevard.jpg

Q1101.name: North Brabant
Q1101.about: North Brabant (Dutch: Noord-Brabant [ˌnoːrt ˈbraːbɑnt] ; Brabantian: Broabant [ˈbrɑːban]), also unofficially called Brabant or Dutch Brabant, is a province in the south of the Netherlands. It borders the provinces of South Holland and Gelderland to the north, Limburg to the east, Zeeland to the west, and Belgium's provinces of Antwerp and Limburg to the south.

Q1114.name: East Flanders
Q1114.about: East Flanders is a province of Belgium. It borders (clockwise from the North) the Dutch province of Zeeland and the Belgian provinces of Antwerp, Flemish Brabant, Hainaut and West Flanders.
Q1114.img: View of the St. Nicholas Church, Ghent, Belgium.jpg

Q381889.name: Sa Kaeo
Q381889.about: Sa Kaeo (Thai: สระแก้ว, pronounced [sàʔ kɛ̂ːw]) is one of the 76 provinces (changwat) and lies in eastern Thailand about 200 km from Bangkok. Neighboring provinces are (from south clockwise) Chanthaburi, Chachoengsao, Prachinburi, Nakhon Ratchasima, and Buriram.

Q386506.name: Qusar District
Q386506.about: Qusar District (Gusar District; Azerbaijani: Qusar rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the northeast of the country, in the Guba-Khachmaz Economic Region.

Q391428.name: Municipality of Šempeter–Vrtojba
Q391428.about: The Municipality of Šempeter–Vrtojba (pronounced [ʃɛmˈpeːtəɾ ʋəɾˈtoːjba] or [ʃəmˈpeːtəɾ ʋəɾˈtoːjba]; Slovene: Občina Šempeter - Vrtojba; Italian: Comune di San Pietro-Vertoiba) is a municipality in Slovenia. The municipality comprises the town and municipal seat of Šempeter pri Gorici and the adjacent village of Vrtojba.

Q391446.name: Municipality of Šentilj
Q391446.about: The Municipality of Šentilj (pronounced [ʃɛnˈtiːl] or [ʃənˈtiːl]; Slovene: Občina Šentilj) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Šentilj v Slovenskih Goricah.

Q394103.name: Municipality of Žirovnica
Q394103.about: The Municipality of Žirovnica (pronounced [ʒiˈɾɔ́ːwnitsa]; Slovene: Občina Žirovnica) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the village of Breznica.

Q652754.name: Chukha District
Q652754.about: Chukha District (Dzongkha: ཆུ་ཁ་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Chu-kha rdzong-khag; officially spelled "Chhukha" ) is one of the 20 dzongkhag (districts) comprising Bhutan. The headquarters is the town of Mebisa, former called Chukha and the major town is Phuentsholing, the second largest city in Bhutan and its commercial capital.

Q652773.name: Trashigang District
Q652773.about: Trashigang District (Dzongkha: བཀྲ་ཤིས་སྒང་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Bkra-shis-sgang rdzong-khag; also spelled "Tashigang") is Bhutan's easternmost dzongkhag (district).

Q652818.name: Siem Reap Province
Q652818.about: Siem Reap Province, (Khmer: សៀមរាប, Khaêt Siĕm Riĕp; [siəm riəp], lit. 'defeat Siam'), is a province of northwestern Cambodia. It borders the provinces of Oddar Meanchey to the north, Preah Vihear and Kampong Thom to the east, Battambang to the south, and Banteay Meanchey to the west.
Q652818.img: Buddhist monks in front of the Angkor Wat.jpg

Q658076.name: Miren–Kostanjevica Municipality
Q658076.about:
The Municipality of Miren-Kostanjevica (pronounced [ˈmiːɾən kɔˈstaːnjɛʋitsa]; Slovene: Občina Miren - Kostanjevica, Italian: Comune di Merna Castagnevizza) is a municipality in western Slovenia, on the border with Italy.
Miren-Kostanjevica is part of the Goriška region of the Slovene Littoral, and its main settlements are Miren (the seat of the municipality) and Kostanjevica na Krasu.

Q671158.name: Santa Ana Department
Q671158.about: Santa Ana (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsanta ˈana]) is a department of El Salvador in the northwest of the country. The capital is Santa Ana, one of the largest cities in El Salvador.

Q678147.name: Municipality of Mežica
Q678147.about: The Municipality of Mežica (pronounced [mɛˈʒiːtsa] ; Slovene: Občina Mežica) is a municipality in the traditional region of Carinthia in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Mežica.

Q682642.name: Alto Paraguay Department
Q682642.about: Alto Paraguay (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈalto paɾaˈɣwaj]; Upper Paraguay) is the least populous department of Paraguay. The capital is the town of Fuerte Olimpo.

Q848554.name: Tambacounda Region
Q848554.about: Tambacounda, formerly known as Sénégal Oriental, is a region of Senegal.  It used to be part of the Mali Empire before the borders were created to separate Mali from Senegal.

Q852039.name: Al Buraimi Governorate
Q852039.about: Al Buraimi Governorate (Arabic: مُحَافَظَة ٱلْبُرَيْمِي, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Al-Buraimī) is one of the 11 governorates of Oman. The area was part of Ad Dhahirah Region until October 2006, when a new governorate was created from the wilayats (provinces) of Al Buraymi and Mahdah.

Q853152.name: Eastern Province
Q853152.about: Eastern Province ( in Kinyarwanda: Intara y'Iburasirazuba; French: Province de l'Est; Dutch: Oostelijke Provincie) is the largest, the most populous and the least densely populated of Rwanda's five provinces. It was created in early January 2006 as part of a government decentralization program that re-organized the country's local government structures.

Q853162.name: Southern Province
Q853162.about: Southern Province (Kinyarwanda: Intara y'Amajyepfo; French: Province du Sud; Dutch: Zuidelijke Provincie) is one of Rwanda's five provinces. It was created in early January 2006 as part of a government decentralization program that re-organized the country's local government structures.

Q853169.name: Beyla Prefecture
Q853169.about: Beyla is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Beyla.

Q855327.name: Kouilou Department
Q855327.desc: department of the Republic of the Congo
Q855327.about: Kouilou (Kongo: Kwilu, Kuilu ) is a department of the Republic of the Congo. Covering the country's coastline, it has an area of 13,650 square kilometres and at the start of 2023 it was home to about 97,362 people.

Q856657.name: Lubombo Region
Q856657.about: Lubombo is a region of Eswatini, located in the east of the country. It has an area of 5,849.11 km2 (2,258.35 sq mi) and a population of 212,531 (2017).

Q860639.name: Oe-Cusse Ambeno
Q860639.desc: Special Administrative Region of East Timor
Q860639.about:
Oecusse, also known as Oecusse-Ambeno (Portuguese: Oé-Cusse Ambeno; Tetun: Oecussi Ambeno) and formerly just Ambeno, is an exclave, municipality (formerly a district) and the only Special Administrative Region (SAR) of Timor-Leste.
Located on the north coast of the western portion of Timor, Oecusse is separated from the rest of Timor-Leste by West Timor, Indonesia, which is part of the province of East Nusa Tenggara.

Q1116.name: Antwerp
Q1116.about: The Antwerp Province (; Dutch: Provincie Antwerpen [proːˈvɪnsi ˈɑntʋɛrpə(n)]; French: Province d'Anvers; German: Provinz Antwerpen), between 1815 and 1830 known as Central Brabant (Dutch: Midden-Brabant [ˌmɪdə(m)ˈbraːbɑnt], French: Brabant-Central, German: Mittel-Brabant), is the northernmost province both of the Flemish Region, also called Flanders, and of Belgium. It borders on the Zeeland and North Brabant provinces of the Netherlands to the north and the Belgian provinces of Limburg, Flemish Brabant and East Flanders.

Q1164.name: Assam
Q1164.about: Assam is a state in Northeast India, located south of the Eastern Himalayas along the Brahmaputra Valley and Barak River valleys. It covers an area of 78,438 km2 (30,285 sq mi), and is the second largest state in northeastern India by area.

Q799800.name: Bafing Region
Q799800.about: Bafing Region is one of the 31 regions of Ivory Coast and is part of Woroba District. The region's seat is Touba.

Q804311.name: Blagoevgrad
Q804311.about: Blagoevgrad Province (Bulgarian: област Благоевград, oblast Blagoevgrad or Благоевградска област, Blagoevgradska oblast), also known as Pirin Macedonia or Bulgarian Macedonia (Bulgarian: Пиринска Македония; Българска Македония), (Pirinska Makedoniya or Bulgarska Makedoniya) is a province (oblast) of southwestern Bulgaria. It borders four other Bulgarian provinces to the north and east, the Greek region of Macedonia to the south, and North Macedonia to the west.

Q810923.name: Battambang Province
Q810923.about: Battambang Province (Khmer: ខេត្តបាត់ដំបង, Khaêt Băt Dâmbâng; [kʰaet ɓat ɗɑm.ɓɑːŋ]) is a province of Cambodia in the far northwest of the country. Bordering provinces are Banteay Meanchey to the north, Pursat to the east and south, Siem Reap to the northeast, and Pailin to the west.

Q815913.name: Lagos State
Q815913.about: Lagos State (Yoruba: Ìpínlẹ̀ Èkó, Gun: Ayìmátẹ̀n Awọnlìn tọ̀n) is a state in southwestern Nigeria. Of the 36 states, Lagos is the first or second most populous state (depending on the source) but is the smallest by area.

Q204642.name: Ntungamo District
Q204642.about: Ntungamo District is a district in Western Uganda. Like most Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Ntungamo, the location of the district headquarters.

Q206356.name: Faetano
Q206356.about: Faetano (Romagnol: Faitén) is one of the nine castelli of San Marino. It occupies an area of 7.75 km2 (2.99 sq mi).

Q212761.name: Al Muthanna Governorate
Q212761.about: Muthanna Governorate (Arabic: المثنى Al Muthannā) or Al Muthanna Province, is a province in Iraq, named after the 7th-century Arab general al-Muthanna ibn Haritha. It is in the south of the country, bordering Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.

Q213467.name: Perlis
Q213467.about: Perlis (Kedah Malay: Peghelih) is a state of Malaysia on the northwestern coast of Peninsular Malaysia. It is Malaysia's smallest state by area and population.

Q217331.name: Srem District
Q217331.about: The Srem District (Serbian: Сремски округ, romanized: Sremski okrug, pronounced [srɛ̂ːmskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the geographical regions of Syrmia and Mačva.

Q185412.name: Serravalle
Q185412.about: Serravalle (Romagnol: Saravâl) is one of the nine castelli of San Marino. It has a population of 11,226 inhabitants (of whom 2,000 are of foreign origin) and an area of 10.53 km2 (4 sq.

Q185944.name: Kelantan
Q185944.about: Kelantan (Malay pronunciation: [kəˈlantan]; Kelantanese Malay: Klate; Kelantanese Malay pronunciation: [kläˈtɛ]) is a state in Malaysia. The capital, Kota Bharu, includes the royal seat of Kubang Kerian.
Q185944.img: Sultan Ismail Petra Arch, Kota Bharu.jpg

Q186195.name: Baranya County
Q186195.about: Baranya (Hungarian: Baranya megye, pronounced [ˈbɒrɒɲɒ ˈvaːrmɛɟɛ]; German: Komitat Branau; Croatian: Baranjska županija) is a county (megye) in southern Hungary. It is part of the Southern Transdanubia statistical region and the historical Baranya region, which was a county (comitatus) in the Kingdom of Hungary dating back to the 11th century.

Q187712.name: Emirate of Abu Dhabi
Q187712.desc: emirate of the United Arab Emirates
Q187712.about: The Emirate of Abu Dhabi is one of seven emirates that constitute the United Arab Emirates. It is the largest emirate, accounting for 87% of the nation's total land area or 67,340 km2 (26,000 sq mi).

Q188166.name: Adrar Province
Q188166.about: Adrar (Arabic: ولاية أدرار, Berber languages: ⴰⴷⵔⴰⵔ) is a province (wilaya) in southwestern Algeria, named after its capital Adrar. It is the second-largest province, with an area of 254 000 km2, roughly the size of the US state of Wyoming.

Q820486.name: Dix-Huit Montagnes
Q820486.about: Dix-Huit Montagnes Region (often shorted to Montagnes Region) is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q822571.name: Muyinga Province
Q822571.about: Muyinga Province was one of the provinces of Burundi. In 2025, it was merged into the new province of Buhumuza.
Q822571.img: Image d une maisons de muyinga.jpg

Q834464.name: Pursat Province
Q834464.about: Pursat (Khmer: ពោធិ៍សាត់,  Poŭthĭsăt [poːsat]; lit. 'drifting banyan') is a province of Cambodia. It is in the western part of the country and borders clockwise from the north: Battambang province, the Tonlé Sap, Kampong Chhnang province, Kampong Speu province, Koh Kong province, and East Thailand.

Q836657.name: Ogun State
Q836657.about: Ogun State  (Yoruba: Ìpínlẹ̀ Ògùn [ìk͡pĩ́lɛ̀ ògũ̀]) is a state in southwestern Nigeria. It is bordered to the south by Lagos State and the Bight of Benin, to the east by Ondo State, and to the north by Oyo and Osun states while its western border forms part of the national border with the Republic of Benin.
Q836657.img: Ogun river view from Olumo top in Abeokuta, Ogun State-Nigeria.jpg

Q844528.name: Centre
Q844528.about: Centre (French, pronounced [sɑ̃tʁ] ) or Sant (Haitian Creole; both meaning "Center") is the only landlocked department (French: départements; Haitian Creole: depatman) of Haiti, located in the center of the country along the border with the Dominican Republic. As of 2015, its estimated population was 746,236.

Q845807.name: Northern Province
Q845807.about: Northern Province (Kinyarwanda: Intara y'Amajyaruguru; French: Province du Nord; Dutch: Noordelijke Provincie) is one of Rwanda's five provinces. It was created in early January 2006 as part of a government decentralization program that re-organized the country's local government structures.

Q735169.name: West Bačka District
Q735169.about: The West Bačka District (Serbian: Западнобачки округ, romanized: Zapadnobački okrug, pronounced [zâːpadnobâːtʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the geographical region of Bačka.

Q737354.name: Western Province
Q737354.about: Western Province (Kinyarwanda: Intara y'Iburengerazuba; French: Province de l'Ouest; Dutch: West-provincie) is one of Rwanda's five provinces. It was created in early January 2006 as part of a government decentralization program that re-organized the country's local government structures.
Q737354.img: Scenery in Hills above Lake Kivu - Near Karongi-Kibuye - Western Rwanda - 02.jpg

Q738081.name: Kolda
Q738081.about: Kolda is a region of Senegal (regional capitals have the same name as their respective regions). It is also referred to historically and popularly as Haute Casamance.

Q741009.name: Concepción Department
Q741009.about: Concepción (Spanish pronunciation: [konseβˈsjon]) is a department of Paraguay. The capital is the city of Concepción.
Q741009.img: Street and Señora de la Concepción.jpg

Q741017.name: Boquerón Department
Q741017.about: Boquerón (Spanish pronunciation: [bokeˈɾon]) is a department in the western region of Paraguay. It is the country's largest department, with an area of 91,669 km2 (35,394 sq mi), but, according to the census for 2022 by INE, its population is 71,078, being the second least populated department.

Q744138.name: Lempira Department
Q744138.about: Lempira is one of the 18 departments—a territorial division roughly comparable to a U.S. state—in Honduras. located in the western part of the country, it is bordered by the departments of Ocotepeque and Copán to the west, Intibucá to the east, and Santa Bárbara to the north.

Q748523.name: Kebbi State
Q748523.about: Kebbi State   (Hausa: Jihar Kebbi; Fulfulde: Leydi Kebbi 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤣𞤭 𞤳𞤫𞤦𞥆𞤭) is a state in northwestern Nigeria, bordered to the east and north by the states of Sokoto and Zamfara, and to the south by Niger State while its western border forms part of the national borders with Benin Republic and Niger. Named for the city of Birnin Kebbi—the state's capital and largest city—Kebbi State was formed from a part of Sokoto State on 27 August 1991.

Q188612.name: Pest County
Q188612.about: Pest (Hungarian: Pest megye, pronounced [ˈpɛʃt]; German: Komitat Pest) is a county (megye) in central Hungary. It covers an area of 6,393.14 square kilometres (2,468.41 sq mi), and has a population of 1,339,090 (2023).

Q188895.name: Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén County
Q188895.about: Borsod–Abaúj–Zemplén (Hungarian: Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén megye, pronounced [ˈborʃod ˈɒbɒuːj ˈzɛmpleːn]) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) in north-eastern Hungary (commonly called "Northern Hungary"), on the border with Slovakia (Košice Region). It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Nógrád, Heves, Hajdú–Bihar and Szabolcs–Szatmár–Bereg.

Q188947.name: Kedah
Q188947.about: Kedah (Malay pronunciation: [kəˈdah]), also known by its honorific Darul Aman (دار الأمان; Arabic for 'The Safe Abode') and historically as Queda, is a state of Malaysia, located in the northwestern part of Peninsular Malaysia. The state covers a total area of over 9,000 square kilometres (3,500 sq mi), and consists of a mainland portion and the Langkawi islands.

Q188953.name: Perak
Q188953.about: Perak (Malay pronunciation: [peraʔ]; Perak Malay: Peghok) is a state of Malaysia on the west coast of the Malay Peninsula. Perak has land borders with the Malaysian states of Kedah to the north, Penang to the northwest, Kelantan and Pahang to the east, and Selangor to the south.
Q188953.img: Golden Glow over Mount Bujang Melaka, Perak, Malaysia.jpg

Q2012234.name: Pernik
Q2012234.about: Pernik Province (Bulgarian: Област Перник) is a province in western Bulgaria, neighbouring Serbia. Its main city is Pernik, and other municipalities are Breznik, Kovachevtsi, Radomir, Tran, and Zemen.

Q2012772.name: Vidin
Q2012772.about: Vidin Province (Bulgarian: Област Видин) is the northwesternmost province of Bulgaria. It borders Serbia to the west and Romania to the northeast, and its administrative centre is the city of Vidin on the Danube river.

Q2018965.name: Valandovo Municipality
Q2018965.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2018965.about: Valandovo (Macedonian: Валандово [vaˈɫandɔvɔ] ) is a municipality in the southern part of North Macedonia. Valandovo is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.

Q2018974.name: Gevgelija Municipality
Q2018974.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2018974.about: Gevgelija (Macedonian: Општина Гевгелија, Opština Gevgelija) is a municipality in the southern part of North Macedonia. Gevgelija is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.

Q189769.name: Salgótarján
Q189769.about: Salgótarján (Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈʃɒlɡoːtɒrjaːn]; Slovak: Šalgotarján, German: Schalgau) is a city with county rights in Hungary, the capital of Nógrád County, north-eastern Hungary, making it the third least populous county capital. The nearby Salgó Castle is a well-known tourist attraction.

Q190018.name: Komárom-Esztergom County
Q190018.about: Komárom-Esztergom (Hungarian: Komárom-Esztergom megye, pronounced [ˈkomaːrom ˈɛstɛrɡom]; German: Burgkomitat Komorn-Gran;  Slovak: Komárňansko-ostrihomská župa) is an administrative Hungarian county in Central Transdanubia Region; its shares its northern border the Danube with Slovakia. It shares borders with the Hungarian counties of Győr-Moson-Sopron, Veszprém, Fejér and Pest and the Slovak Nitra Region (Nové Zámky District, Komárno District).

Q190522.name: Somogy County
Q190522.desc: administrative county (comitatus or megye) in present Hungary, and also in the former Kingdom of Hungary
Q190522.about:
Somogy (Hungarian: Somogy megye, pronounced [ˈʃomoɟ]; Croatian: Šomođska županija; Slovene: Šomodska županija, German: Komitat Schomodei) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) in present Hungary, and also in the former Kingdom of Hungary.
Somogy County lies in south-western Hungary, on the border with Croatia's Koprivnica-Križevci and Virovitica-Podravina counties.

Q193551.name: Basra Governorate
Q193551.about: The Basra Governorate (Arabic: محافظة البصرة‎ Muḥāfaẓa al-Baṣra), also called Basra Province, is a governorate in southern Iraq bordering Kuwait to the south and Iran to the east. The capital is the city of Basra, located in the Basrah district.

Q194273.name: Nógrád County
Q194273.about: Nógrád (Hungarian: Nógrád megye, pronounced [ˈnoːɡraːd]; Slovak: Novohradská župa) is a county (Hungarian: megye) of Hungary. It sits on the northern edge of Hungary and borders Slovakia.

Q498452.name: North Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region
Q498452.about:
The North Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region is one of two autonomous regions in Nicaragua. It was created along with the South Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region by the Autonomy Statute of 7 September 1986 
through a division of the former Zelaya Department.

Q499456.name: Sucumbíos Province
Q499456.about: Sucumbíos (Spanish pronunciation: [sukumˈbi.os]) is a province in northeast Ecuador. The capital and largest city is Nueva Loja (normally referred to as Lago Agrio).

Q502151.name: Preah Vihear Province
Q502151.about: Preah Vihear (Khmer: ព្រះវិហារ, Preăh Vĭhéar [preah ʋihiə]; lit. 'sacred sanctuary') is a province (khaet) of Cambodia. It borders the provinces of Oddar Meanchey and Siem Reap to the west, Kampong Thom to the south and Stung Treng to the east.

Q503905.name: Oyo State
Q503905.about: Oyo ()(Yoruba: Ìpínlẹ̀ Ọ̀yọ́ [ìk͡pĩ́lɛ̀ ɔ̀jɔ́]) is a state in southwestern Nigeria. Its capital is Ibadan, the third most populous city in the country and formerly the second most populous city in Africa.

Q12697.name: Canton of Schaffhausen
Q12697.about: The canton of Schaffhausen, also canton of Schaffhouse (German: Kanton Schaffhausen; Romansh: Chantun Schaffusa; French: Canton de Schaffhouse; Italian: Canton Sciaffusa), is the northernmost canton of Switzerland. The principal city and capital of the canton is Schaffhausen.
Q12697.img: Laufen-Uhwiesen - Schloss Laufen - Rheinfall - Neuhausen am Rheinfall 2010-06-24 19-15-44.JPG

Q12700.name: Hautes-Pyrénées
Q12700.about: Hautes-Pyrénées (French pronunciation: [ot piʁene] ; Gascon/Occitan: Nauts Pirenèus / Hauts Pirenèus ['awts piɾeˈnɛʊs]; Spanish: Altos Pirineos; Catalan: Alts Pirineus ['alts piɾiˈneʊs]) is a department in the region of Occitania, southwestern France. The department is bordered by Pyrénées-Atlantiques to the west, Gers to the north, Haute-Garonne to the east, as well by the Spanish province of Huesca in the autonomous community of Aragon to the south.
Q12700.img: Sers et Betpouey 65 vus de StJustin 2011.jpg

Q279085.name: Canindeyú Department
Q279085.about: Canindeyú (Spanish pronunciation: [kanindeˈʝu]) is a department in Paraguay. The capital is the city of Salto del Guairá.

Q311272.name: Al Rayyan Municipality
Q311272.about: Al Rayyan (Arabic: الريان; also spelled Ar Rayyan) is the third-largest municipality in Qatar. Its primary settlement is the city of the same name, which occupies the entire eastern section and is a part of the Doha Metropolitan Area.

Q321729.name: Carchi Province
Q321729.about: Carchi (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkaɾtʃi]) is a province in Ecuador. The capital is Tulcán.

Q327510.name: Buriram
Q327510.about: Buriram province (Thai: จังหวัดบุรีรัมย์, RTGS: Changwat Buri Ram, pronounced [tɕāŋ.wàt bū.rīː.rām]) is one of Thailand's seventy-seven  provinces (changwat) and lies in lower northeastern Thailand, also called Isan. Neighboring provinces are (from south clockwise) Sa Kaeo, Nakhon Ratchasima, Khon Kaen, Maha Sarakham, and Surin.

Q327730.name: Chanthaburi
Q327730.about: Chanthaburi (Thai: จันทบุรี, pronounced [tɕān.tʰá(ʔ).bū.rīː]; Chong: จันกะบูย chankabui, lit. 'Lady Chan, who wears a pan on her head') is one of seven provinces (changwat) in eastern Thailand, on the border with Battambang and Pailin of Cambodia, on the shore of the Gulf of Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are Trat in the east and Rayong, Chonburi, Chachoengsao, and Sa Kaeo to the west and north.

Q12146.name: Canton of Basel-Landschaft
Q12146.about: Canton of Basel-Landschaft or Basel-Country, informally known as Baselland or Baselbiet (; German: Kanton Basel-Landschaft [ˈkantɔn ˌbaːzl̩ ˈlantʃaft] ; Romansh: Chantun Basilea-Champagna; French: Canton de Bâle-Campagne [bɑl.kɑ̃.paɲ]; Italian: Canton Basilea Campagna), is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of five districts and its capital city is Liestal.

Q12172.name: Canton of Basel-Stadt
Q12172.about: Canton of Basel-Stadt or Basel-City (German: Kanton Basel-Stadt [ˌbaːzl̩ˈʃtat] ; Romansh: Chantun Basilea-Citad; French: Canton de Bâle-Ville [bɑl.vil]; Italian: Canton Basilea Città) is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of three municipalities with Basel as the capital.

Q12538.name: Haute-Garonne
Q12538.about: Haute-Garonne (French pronunciation: [ot ɡaʁɔn]; Occitan: Nauta Garona, pronounced [ˈnawto ɡaˈɾuno]; Upper Garonne) is a department in the southwestern French region of Occitanie. Named after the river Garonne, which flows through the department.

Q3083.name: Ain
Q3083.about: Ain (; French: [ɛ̃] ; Arpitan: En) is a French department in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region, Eastern France. Named after the Ain river, it is bordered by the Saône and Rhône rivers.

Q3120.name: Jura
Q3120.about: Jura ( JOOR-ə, ZHOOR-ə; French: [ʒyʁa] ) is a department in the northeastern French region of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. The department takes its name from the Jura Mountains.

Q1016800.name: Municipality of Podvelka
Q1016800.about: The Municipality of Podvelka (pronounced [pɔˈdʋeːlka]; Slovene: Občina Podvelka) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Podvelka.

Q1043446.name: Rasina District
Q1043446.about: The Rasina District (Serbian: Расински округ, romanized: Rasinski okrug, pronounced [rǎsiːnskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the central part of the country.

Q1046666.name: Kedougou Region
Q1046666.about: Kédougou is a region of Senegal. It was created in 2008.

Q1048184.name: Toplica District
Q1048184.about: The Toplica District (Serbian: Топлички округ, romanized: Toplički okrug, pronounced [tǒplit͡ʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the valley of Toplica river.

Q1061082.name: Raška District
Q1061082.about: The Raška District (Serbian: Рашки округ, romanized: Raški okrug, pronounced [râʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It expands to the southwestern part of the country.

Q1061099.name: Pčinja District
Q1061099.about: The Pčinja District (Serbian: Пчињски округ, romanized: Pčinjski okrug, pronounced [ptʃǐɲskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It occupies the southernmost part of the country.

Q12703.name: Pyrénées-Atlantiques
Q12703.desc: French departement in New Aquitaine (formerly Aquitaine)
Q12703.about: Pyrénées-Atlantiques (French pronunciation: [pi.ʁe.nez‿at.lɑ̃.tik] ; Gascon Occitan: Pirenèus Atlantics; Basque: Pirinio Atlantikoak) is a department located in the region of Nouvelle-Aquitaine in the southwest corner of metropolitan France. Named after the Pyrenees mountain range and the Atlantic Ocean, it covers the French Basque Country and the Béarn.

Q3125.name: Hautes-Alpes
Q3125.desc: department in southeastern France named after the Alps mountain range
Q3125.about: Hautes-Alpes (French pronunciation: [ot.z‿alp] ; Occitan: Auts Aups; English: Upper Alps) is a department in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region of Southeastern France. It is located in the heart of the French Alps, after which it is named.

Q3131.name: Alpes-de-Haute-Provence
Q3131.about: Alpes-de-Haute-Provence (sometimes abbreviated as AHP; French pronunciation: [alp də ot pʁɔvɑ̃s] ; Occitan: Aups d'Auta Provença; lit. 'Alps of Upper Provence'), formerly until 1970 known as Basses-Alpes (French pronunciation: [basz‿alp], lit. 'Lower Alps'), is a department in the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region of France, bordering Alpes-Maritimes and Italy to the east, Var to the south, Vaucluse to the west, Drôme and Hautes-Alpes to the north. Formerly part of the province of Provence, it had a population of 168,054 in 2023, which makes it the 8th least populated French department.

Q750551.name: Presidente Hayes Department
Q750551.about: Presidente Hayes (Spanish pronunciation: [pɾesiˈðente ˈaʝes]) is a department in Paraguay. The capital is the city of Villa Hayes.

Q753037.name: Chiquimula Department
Q753037.about: Chiquimula is one of the 22 departments of Guatemala, in Central America. The departmental capital is also called Chiquimula.

Q754448.name: Haa District
Q754448.about: Haa District (Dzongkha: ཧཱ་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Haa rzong-khag; alternative spellings include "Ha", also called "Hidden-Land Rice Valley.") is one of the 20 dzongkhag or districts comprising Bhutan. It the second least-populated dzongkhag in the country after Gasa.

Q755115.name: Ñeembucú Department
Q755115.about: Ñeembucú (Spanish pronunciation: [ɲe(e)mbuˈku]; Guaraní: Ñe'ẽmbuku) is a department located in the south of the Eastern Region of Paraguay. The capital is Pilar.

Q763400.name: Municipality of Brda
Q763400.about: The Municipality of Brda (pronounced [ˈbəɾda]; Slovene: Občina Brda, Italian: Comune di Collio) is a municipality in western Slovenia. It is located in the Slovenian Littoral region, extending from the Italian border to the Soča River.

Q765984.name: Jutiapa Department
Q765984.about: Jutiapa Department is a department of Guatemala that borders along El Salvador and the Pacific Ocean. The capital is the city of Jutiapa.

Q793727.name: Berovo Municipality
Q793727.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q793727.about: Berovo (Macedonian: Берово [ˈbɛrɔvɔ] ) is a municipality in the eastern part of the Republic of North Macedonia. Berovo is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is located.

Q3317366.name: Herceg Novi Municipality
Q3317366.about: Herceg Novi Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Herceg Novi, Општина Херцег Нови) is one of the municipalities in southwestern Montenegro. The administrative center is Herceg Novi.
Q3317366.img: Widoki z twierdzy Kanli Kula na Herceg Novi 03.jpg

Q3435104.name: Maribor City Municipality
Q3435104.about: The Urban Municipality of Maribor (pronounced [ˈmaːɾibɔɾ]), also the City of Maribor (Slovene: Mestna občina Maribor, acronym MOM), is one of twelve urban municipalities in Slovenia. Its seat is Maribor, the second-largest city in Slovenia.

Q3435689.name: Municipality of Gornji Petrovci
Q3435689.about: The Municipality of Gornji Petrovci (pronounced [ˈɡoːɾnji pɛˈtɾoːu̯tsi]; Slovene: Občina Gornji Petrovci) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Gornji Petrovci.

Q3494723.name: Municipality of Moravske Toplice
Q3494723.about: The Municipality of Moravske Toplice (pronounced [mɔˈɾaːu̯skɛ tɔˈpliːtsɛ]; Slovene: Občina Moravske Toplice) is a municipality in Slovenia, part of the Prekmurje region. Its seat is the spa settlement of Moravske Toplice.

Q3503123.name: Municipality of Dravograd
Q3503123.about: The Municipality of Dravograd (pronounced [ˈdɾaːʋɔɡɾat] ; Slovene: Občina Dravograd) is a municipality in northern Slovenia, on the border with Austria. The seat of the municipality is the town of Dravograd.

Q3526470.name: Kabale District
Q3526470.about: Kabale District  is a district in the Western Region of Uganda. Kabale hosts the district headquarters.

Q860913.name: Bobonaro Municipality
Q860913.about: Bobonaro (Portuguese: Município Bobonaro, Tetun: Munisípiu Bobonaru, or Munisípiu Buburnaru) is a municipality (and was formerly a district) in Timor-Leste. It is the second-most western municipality on the east half of the island.

Q866886.name: La Paz Department
Q866886.about: La Paz (Spanish pronunciation: [la pas]) is one of the 18 political and geographic departments of Honduras. The departmental capital is the city of La Paz.

Q867084.name: Ocotepeque Department
Q867084.about: Ocotepeque is one of the 18 departments of Honduras, Central America, located in the West and bordering both El Salvador and Guatemala. It was formed in 1906 from part of Copán department.

Q867089.name: Olancho Department
Q867089.about: Olancho is the largest of all the 18 departments into which Honduras is divided. The department covers a total surface area of 24,057 km2 (9,288 sq mi) and has an estimated 2015 population of 537,306 inhabitants.

Q867097.name: Valle Department
Q867097.about:
Valle is one of the 18 departments into which Honduras is divided.
The departmental capital is Nacaome.

Q867108.name: El Paraíso Department
Q867108.about:
El Paraíso (Spanish pronunciation: [el paɾaˈiso]) is one of the 18 departments (departamentos) into which Honduras is divided.
The territory of El Paraíso was initially part of the departments of Tegucigalpa (renamed Francisco Morazán in 1943) and Olancho after Central America gained its independence in 1825.

Q220736.name: Yambol
Q220736.about: Yambol (Bulgarian: област Ямбол, oblast Yambol, former name Yambol okrug) is a province in southeastern Bulgaria, neighbouring Turkey to the south. It is named after its main city Yambol, while other towns include Straldzha, Bolyarovo and Elhovo.

Q222564.name: Itapúa Department
Q222564.about: Itapúa (Spanish pronunciation: [itaˈpu.a]) is a department in the southern region of Paraguay. The capital is the city of Encarnación.

Q225189.name: Portalegre
Q225189.about: Portalegre is a district located in the east of Portugal. Its capital is the city of Portalegre.

Q230217.name: Nariño Department
Q230217.about: Nariño (Spanish pronunciation: [naˈɾiɲo]) is a department of Colombia named after independence leader Antonio Nariño. Its capital is Pasto.

Q1112985.name: Kyustendil
Q1112985.about: Kyustendil Province (Bulgarian: Област Кюстендил, romanized: Oblast Kyustendil) is a province in southwestern Bulgaria, extending over an area of 3,084.3 km2 (1,190.9 sq mi) (constituting 2.7% of the total territory of the Republic of Bulgaria), and with a population of 106 131.  It borders the provinces of Sofia, Pernik, and Blagoevgrad; to the west, its limits coincide with the state borders between Bulgaria and North Macedonia, and between Bulgaria and the Republic of Serbia.

Q1122836.name: Morazán Department
Q1122836.about: Morazán (Spanish pronunciation: [moɾaˈsan]) is a department of El Salvador. Located in the northeast part of the country, its capital is San Francisco Gotera.
Q1122836.img: Catarata de piedra en Perquín, El Salvador - panoramio.jpg

Q1130688.name: La Unión Department
Q1130688.about: La Unión (Spanish pronunciation: [lawˈnjon]) is the easternmost department of El Salvador. Its capital is La Unión.

Q1138575.name: Dajabón Province
Q1138575.about: Dajabón (Spanish pronunciation: [daxaˈβon]) is a northwestern province which currently comprises one of the 32 provinces of the Dominican Republic. It is divided into 5 municipalities and its capital city with the same name.

Q1140897.name: Marowijne District
Q1140897.about: Marowijne (Dutch: [maːroːˈʋɛinə]; Eastern Maroon Creole: Maawina) is a district of Suriname, located on the north-east coast. Marowijne's capital city is Albina, with other towns including Moengo and Wanhatti.

Q1147515.name: Nickerie District
Q1147515.about: Nickerie is a predominantly rural district of Suriname located on the north-west coast. Nickerie's capital city is Nieuw-Nickerie.

Q728041.name: North Banat District
Q728041.about: The North Banat District (Serbian: Севернобанатски округ, romanized: Severnobanatski okrug, pronounced [sêʋeːrnobǎnaːtskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the geographical regions of Banat and Bačka.

Q728056.name: Madriz Department
Q728056.about: Madriz (Spanish pronunciation: [maˈðɾis]) is an administrative division and department in Nicaragua. It covers an area of 1,708 km2 (659 sq mi) and has a population of 181,328 in 2023.

Q728120.name: Jinotega Department
Q728120.about: Jinotega (Spanish pronunciation: [xinoˈteɣa]) is a department of Nicaragua. Its departmental head is Jinotega.
Q728120.img: Jinotega desde La Peña de La Cruz.jpg

Q1155055.name: Kavadarci Municipality
Q1155055.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1155055.about: Kavadarci (Macedonian: Кавадарци [kaˈvadartsi] ) is a municipality in the southern part of North Macedonia. Kavadarci is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.
Q1155055.img: Makedonija, Kavadarci - most na reci Luda Mara.JPG

Q1309481.name: Saraj Municipality
Q1309481.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia, one of the ten municipalities of the city of Skopje
Q1309481.about:
Saraj (Macedonian: , Albanian: Saraj) is one of the ten municipalities that make up the city of Skopje, the capital of the Republic of North Macedonia.

Saraj, which means "palace" in Turkish, is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q1313614.name: Solčava Municipality
Q1313614.about: The Municipality of Solčava (pronounced [sɔlˈtʃaːʋa]; Slovene: Občina Solčava) is a municipality in the traditional region of Upper Carniola in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Solčava.

Q1318887.name: Isingiro District
Q1318887.about: Isingiro District is a district in the Western Region of Uganda. The town of Isingiro is the district's main municipal, administrative, and commercial center.

Q1323322.name: Delčevo Municipality
Q1323322.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1323322.about: Delčevo Municipality (Macedonian: Делчево [ˈdɛɫtʃɛvɔ] ) is a municipality in Eastern Statistical Region of North Macedonia. The center of the municipality is the city of Delčevo.

Q1352533.name: Pedernales Province
Q1352533.about: Pedernales (from Spanish 'flints'; pronounced [peðeɾˈnales]) is the southernmost province of the Dominican Republic, including the offshore island of Isla Beata. It was split from Barahona in 1957.

Q1422453.name: Kriva Palanka Municipality
Q1422453.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1422453.about: The Kriva Palanka Municipality (Macedonian: Општина Крива Паланка [ˌkriːva ˈpalaŋka]  ) is in the northeastern part of North Macedonia. Kriva Palanka is the town where the municipal seat is located.

Q16287.name: Province of Turin
Q16287.about: The province of Turin (Italian: provincia di Torino; Piedmontese: provinsa ëd Turin; French: province de Turin) was a province in the Piedmont region of Italy. Its capital was the city of Turin.

Q16294.name: Province of Udine
Q16294.about: The Province of Udine (Italian: provincia di Udine; Friulian: provincie di Udin; Slovene: Videmska pokrajina; Resian: Vydänskä provinčjä; German: Provinz Weiden) was a province in the autonomous region of Friuli-Venezia Giulia in Italy, bordering Austria and Slovenia, with the capital in the city of Udine. Abolished on 30 September 2017, it was reestablished in 2019 as the Regional Decentralization Entity of Udine (Italian: ente di decentramento regionale di Udine; Friulian: ent di decentrament regjonâl di Udin; Slovene: enota deželne decentralizacije Videm), and was reactivated on 1 July 2020.

Q16293.name: Province of Trieste
Q16293.about: The province of Trieste (Italian: provincia di Trieste) is a province in the autonomous Friuli-Venezia Giulia region of Italy. Its capital is the city of Trieste.

Q17152.name: Central Macedonia Region
Q17152.desc: one of the 13 administrative regions of Greece
Q17152.about: Central Macedonia is one of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece, consisting the central part of the geographical and historical region of Macedonia. With a population of almost 1.8 million, it is the second most populous region in Greece after Attica.
Q17152.img: Θεσσαλονίκη 2014 (The Metropolitan Church of Saint Gregory Palamas) - panoramio (1).jpg

Q18248.name: Una-Sana Canton
Q18248.about: The Una-Sana Canton (Bosnian: Unsko-sanski kanton; Croatian: Unsko-sanska županija; Serbian: Унско-сански кантон, romanized: Unsko-sanski kanton) is a federated state and one of the ten cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is located in the northwest of the country, a region known as Bosanska Krajina, and has been named after the rivers Una and Sana.

Q1424401.name: Independencia
Q1424401.about: Independencia (Spanish pronunciation: [indepenˈdensja]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It is spread over an area of 2,007.4 km2 (775.1 sq mi), and has its capital at Jimaní.

Q1434621.name: Ouest
Q1434621.about: Ouest (French, pronounced [wɛst] ) or Lwès (Haitian Creole; both meaning "West") is one of the ten departments of Haiti. It is located in south-central Haiti, linking the Great-North and the Tiburon Peninsula.

Q1468596.name: Ad Dhahirah Governorate
Q1468596.about: Al Dhahirah Governorate (Arabic: محافظة الظاهرة, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat aẓ-Ẓāhirah, lit. 'The Phenomenon') is one of the  eleven governorates (muhafazah) of Oman. It was previously a region (mintaqah), and became a governorate on 28 October 2011.

Q1470878.name: Mandiana Prefecture
Q1470878.about: Mandiana is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Mandiana.

Q1475001.name: Rankovce Municipality
Q1475001.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1475001.about: Rankovce (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in the northeastern region of the Republic of North Macedonia. Rankovce is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.

Q1688771.name: Municipality of Jezersko
Q1688771.about: The Municipality of Jezersko (pronounced [jɛˈzɛːɾskɔ]; Slovene: Občina Jezersko ) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. In 1995, Jezersko became part of Preddvor and became an independent municipality in 1998.

Q1781017.name: Mali Prefecture
Q1781017.about: Mali (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤃𞤢𞥄𞤤𞤭) is a prefecture, also known as the Préfecture De Mali, located in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Mali.

Q12746.name: Canton of St. Gallen
Q12746.about: The canton of St. Gallen or St Gall (German: Kanton St.

Q12751.name: Haute-Savoie
Q12751.about: Haute-Savoie (French pronunciation: [ot savwa] ; Upper Savoy) is a department in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region of Southeastern France, bordering both Switzerland and Italy. Its prefecture is Annecy.

Q1781312.name: Koundara Prefecture
Q1781312.about: Koundara is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Koundara.

Q1946579.name: Novo Selo Municipality
Q1946579.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1946579.about: Novo Selo (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in eastern North Macedonia. Novo Selo is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q1992752.name: Bogdanci Municipality
Q1992752.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1992752.about: Bogdanci (Macedonian: Богданци [ˈbɔɡdantsi] ) is a municipality in the southern part of North Macedonia. Bogdanci is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.

Q1996413.name: Dojran Municipality
Q1996413.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1996413.about: Dojran (Macedonian: Дојран [ˈdɔjran] ) is a municipality in the southeastern part of North Macedonia. Star Dojran is the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q1996740.name: Vrapčište Municipality
Q1996740.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1996740.about: Vrapčište (Macedonian: , Albanian: Vrapçisht) is a municipality in western North Macedonia. Vrapčište is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2012057.name: Montana
Q2012057.about: Montana Province (Bulgarian: Област Монтана, transliterated: Oblast Montana) is a province in northwestern Bulgaria, bordering Serbia in the southwest and Romania in the north. It spreads its area between the Danube river and the Balkan Mountains.

Q12755.name: Canton of Jura
Q12755.about: The Republic and Canton of Jura (officially in French: République et Canton du Jura), less formally the Canton of Jura or Canton Jura ( JOOR-ə, ZHOOR-ə; French: [ʒyʁa] ),is the newest (founded in 1979) of the 26 Swiss cantons, located in the northwestern part of Switzerland. The capital is Delémont.

Q12771.name: Canton of Vaud
Q12771.about: Vaud ( VOH; French: Vaud, pronounced [vo]; German: Waadt), more formally Canton of Vaud (French: Canton de Vaud, German: Kanton Waadt), is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of ten districts; its capital city is Lausanne.

Q24272.name: Ordino
Q24272.about: Ordino (Catalan pronunciation: [oɾˈðino]) is the most northerly parish in the Principality of Andorra. It's mostly the main area of Valira del Nord or Valira d'Ordino river valley.

Q24276.name: La Massana
Q24276.about: La Massana (Catalan pronunciation: [la maˈsana]; originally La Maçana) is one of the seven parishes of the Principality of Andorra. It is located in the northwest of the country.

Q24282.name: Sant Julià de Lòria
Q24282.about: Sant Julià de Lòria (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈsaɲ dʒuliˈa ðe ˈlɔɾia]) is one of the seven parishes of Andorra. Located in the south of the country, it is spread around the town of the same name along the banks of the Gran Valira River.

Q24286.name: Escaldes-Engordany
Q24286.about: Escaldes–Engordany (Catalan pronunciation: [esˈkaldez aŋɡoɾˈðaɲ]) is one of the seven parishes of Andorra. The Escaldes–Engordany parish was founded in 1978 by being separated from Andorra la Vella.

Q29136.name: Borgou Department
Q29136.about: Borgou [bɔʁ.ɡu] is one of the twelve departments of Benin. Borgou borders the country of Nigeria and the departments of Alibori, Atakora, Collines and Donga.

Q232953.name: Putumayo Department
Q232953.about: Putumayo (Spanish pronunciation: [putuˈmaʝo]) is a department of Southern Colombia.  It is in the south-west of the country, bordering Ecuador and Peru.

Q233838.name: Rakhine State
Q233838.about: Rakhine State (  rə-KYN; Burmese: ရခိုင်ပြည်နယ်, MLCTS: ra.hkuing pranynai, pronounced [jəkʰàiɰ̃ pjìnɛ̀]; Rakhine pronunciation: [ɹəkʰàiɰ̃ pɹènè]), formerly known as Arakan State, is a first-level administrative division in Myanmar (Burma). Situated on the western coast, it is bordered by Chin State to the north, Magway Region, Bago Region and Ayeyarwady Region to the east, the Bay of Bengal to the west and the Chattogram Division of Bangladesh to the northwest.

Q233933.name: Tarija Department
Q233933.about: Tarija (Spanish pronunciation: [taˈɾixa] ) is a department in Bolivia. It is located in south-eastern Bolivia bordering with Argentina to the south and Paraguay to the east.
Q233933.img: Atardecer Río Pilcomayo - Tarija, Gran Chaco, Villamontes.jpg

Q235106.name: Santa Cruz Department
Q235106.about: Santa Cruz (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌsanta ˈkɾus]) is the largest of the nine constituent departments of Bolivia, occupying about one-third (33.74%) of the country's territory. With an area of 370,621 km2 (143,098 sq mi), it is slightly smaller than Japan or the US state of Montana.

Q29141.name: Collines department
Q29141.about: Collines ([kɔ.lin], "hills") is one of the twelve departments of Benin, located in the centre of the country. The department of Collines was created in 1999 when it was split off from Zou Department.

Q29165.name: Alibori Department
Q29165.about: Alibori [a.li.bɔ.ʁi] is the largest and northernmost department (French: département) of Benin. Externally the department borders the countries of Burkina Faso, Niger, and Nigeria, and internally the departments of Atakora and Borgou.

Q29169.name: Ouémé Department
Q29169.about: Ouémé [we.me] is one of the twelve departments of Benin, containing the capital of the country Porto Novo, named for the Ouémé River. It is subdivided into nine communes, each centred at one of the principal towns: Adjarra, Adjohoun, Aguégués, Akpro-Missérété, Avrankou, Bonou, Dangbo, Porto-Novo and Sèmè-Kpodji.

Q32108.name: Plateau Department
Q32108.about: Plateau [pla.to] is one of the twelve departments of Benin. The department of Plateau was created in 1999 with an area of 2,835 square kilometres (1,095 sq mi) when it was split off from Ouémé Department.

Q37985.name: Carinthia
Q37985.desc: federal state in the South of Austria
Q37985.about: Carinthia (German: Kärnten [ˈkɛrntn̩] ; Slovene: Koroška [kɔˈɾóːʃka]  or avstrijska Koroška; Italian: Carinzia [kaˈrintsja]) is the southernmost and least densely populated Austrian state, in the Eastern Alps, and is noted for its mountains and lakes. The Lake Wolayer is a mountain lake on the Carinthian side of the Carnic Main Ridge, near the Plöcken Pass.

Q44758.name: Corrientes Province
Q44758.about: Corrientes (Spanish pronunciation: [koˈrjentes], lit. ‘currents’ or ‘streams’; Guarani: Taragui), officially the Province of Corrientes (Spanish: Provincia de Corrientes; Guarani: Taragui Tetãmini) is a province in northeast Argentina, in the Mesopotamia region.
Q44758.img: Casa de Gobierno de Corrientes - Fachada calle Salta.jpg

Q44761.name: Formosa Province
Q44761.about: Formosa Province (Spanish pronunciation: [foɾˈmosa]) is a province in northeastern Argentina, part of the Gran Chaco Region. Formosa's northeast end touches Asunción, Paraguay, and the province borders the provinces of Chaco and Salta to its south and west, respectively.

Q44798.name: Misiones Province
Q44798.about: Misiones (Spanish pronunciation: [miˈsjones], 'Missions') is one of the 23 provinces of Argentina, located in the northeastern corner of the country in the Mesopotamia region. It is surrounded by Paraguay to the northwest, Brazil to the north, east and south, and Corrientes Province of Argentina to the southwest.

Q46910.name: Chin State
Q46910.about: Chin State (Burmese: ချင်းပြည်နယ်, MLCTS: hkyang: pranynai, pronounced [tɕʰɪ́ɰ̃ pjìnɛ̀]) is a state in Northwestern Myanmar (Burma). Chin State is bordered by Sagaing Region and Magway Region to the east, Rakhine State to the south, the Chattogram Division of Bangladesh to the west, and the Indian states of Mizoram to the west and Manipur to the north.

Q49651.name: Triesenberg
Q49651.about: Triesenberg (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈtriːzn̩ˌbɛrɡ] ) is a municipality in Liechtenstein with a population of 2,636. Its area of 29.69 square kilometres (11.46 sq mi) makes it the largest municipality in Liechtenstein.

Q49654.name: Triesen
Q49654.about: Triesen (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈtriːzn̩] ; dialectal: Tresa) is the third largest municipality in Liechtenstein. It contains several historic churches dating from the fifteenth century.

Q49657.name: Schaan
Q49657.about: Schaan (German pronunciation: [ʃaːn] ; dialectal: Schaa) is the largest municipality of Liechtenstein by population. It is located to the north of Vaduz, the capital, in the central part of the country.

Q58268.name: Istria County
Q58268.about: Istria County (; Croatian: Istarska županija; Italian: Regione istriana, lit. "Istrian Region") is the westernmost county of Croatia which includes the majority of the Istrian peninsula.

Q58289.name: Dubrovnik-Neretva County
Q58289.about: The Dubrovnik-Neretva County (pronounced [dǔbroːʋniːk-něreːtʋa]; Croatian: Dubrovačko-neretvanska županija, pronounced [dǔbroʋat͡ʃko-nerěːtʋanskaː ʒupǎnija]) is the southernmost county of Croatia. The county seat is Dubrovnik and other large towns are Korčula, Metković, Opuzen and Ploče.
Q58289.img: Luftbild vom Hafen Polace auf Mljet mit Blick auf die Inseln Kobrava, Ovrata und Moracnik, Kroatien (48608980182).jpg

Q58330.name: Međimurje County
Q58330.about: Međimurje County (pronounced [medʑǐmuːrje]; Croatian: Međimurska županija [medʑǐmurskaː ʒupǎnija]; Hungarian: Muraköz megye) is the northernmost county of Croatia, roughly corresponding to the historical and geographical region of Međimurje. It is the smallest Croatian county by size, and the second most densely populated after the City of Zagreb.

Q49659.name: Ruggell
Q49659.about: Ruggell (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ruˈɡɛl] ; dialectal: Ruggäll) is a municipality of Liechtenstein. It is the northernmost and lowest elevated municipality.

Q49662.name: Gamprin
Q49662.about: Gamprin (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ɡamˈpriːn] ) is a municipality of Liechtenstein, on the Rhine on the border with the municipality of Sennwald, in Switzerland. It had 1,690 inhabitants in 2019.

Q49663.name: Balzers
Q49663.about: Balzers (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈbaltsərs] ) is a municipality and village located in southern Liechtenstein. In 2024, the village had a population of 4,806.

Q49661.name: Mauren
Q49661.about: Mauren (Swiss Standard German pronunciation: [ˈmaʊrən] ; High Alemannic: Muura) is a municipality in Liechtenstein that is situated in the north of the country. It has a population of 4,401.

Q54157.name: Lubusz Voivodeship
Q54157.about: Lubusz Voivodeship (Polish: województwo lubuskie [vɔjɛˈvut͡stfɔ luˈbuskʲɛ] ) is a voivodeship (province) in western Poland with a population of 972,140. Its regional capitals are Gorzów Wielkopolski and Zielona Góra.

Q40130.name: Amapá
Q40130.desc: state in the North Region of Brazil
Q40130.about: Amapá ( AH-mə-PAH; Portuguese: [amaˈpa] ) is one of the 26 states of Brazil. It is in the North Region of Brazil.

Q41115.name: Santa Catarina
Q41115.desc: state in the South Region of Brazil
Q41115.about: Santa Catarina (English:  SAN-tə KAT-ə-REE-nə, Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈsɐ̃tɐ kataˈɾinɐ] ) is one of the 27 federative units of Brazil. It is located in the centre of the country's Southern region.

Q4086488.name: Bijelo Polje Municipality
Q4086488.about: Bijelo Polje Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Bijelo Polje, Општина Бијело Поље) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro, and is located in northern Montenegro, in the Lim river valley. Its administrative centre is the town of Bijelo Polje and it covers an area of 924 km2.
Q4086488.img: Kostel sv. Michaila Archandela v Bijelem Polji, 14. stol.jpg

Q4853794.name: Berane Municipality
Q4853794.about: Berane Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Berane, Општина Беране) is one of the municipalities in Northern Montenegro. Its center is the town of Berane and until 2013, it covered an area of 544 km2.

Q4856305.name: Kotor Municipality
Q4856305.about: Kotor Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Kotor / Општина Котор) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. Its administrative center is Kotor.
Q4856305.img: 20090719 Crkva Gospa od Zdravlja Kotor Bay Montenegro.jpg

Q4859821.name: Plav Municipality
Q4859821.about: Plav Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Plav / Општина Плав, Albanian: Komuna e Plavës) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. It is located in Northern Montenegro.

Q4865016.name: Nikšić Municipality
Q4865016.about: Nikšić (Montenegrin: Opština Nikšić, Општина Никшић) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. The municipality is located in the central and northwestern region of Montenegro.

Q6309297.name: Municipality of Muta
Q6309297.about: The Municipality of Muta (pronounced [ˈmuːta]; Slovene: Občina Muta) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Muta.

Q3139.name: Alpes-Maritimes
Q3139.about: Alpes-Maritimes (French: [alp(ə)maʁitim]; Occitan: Aups Maritims; Monégasque: Alpes Marìtime; Italian: Alpi Marittime; lit. 'Maritime Alps') is a department of France located in the country's southeast corner, on the Italian border and Mediterranean coast. Part of the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region, it encompasses the French Riviera alongside neighbouring Var.

Q3184.name: Ariège
Q3184.about: Ariège (French pronunciation: [aʁjɛʒ] ; Occitan: Arièja [aɾiˈɛdʒɔ]) is a department in southwestern France, located in the region of Occitanie. It is named after the river Ariège and its capital is Foix.

Q55115.name: Monaco-Ville
Q55115.desc: ward and capital city of the Principality of Monaco
Q55115.about: Monaco-Ville ([mɔnakɔ vil]; Monégasque: Mu̍negu-A̍utu) is the southcentral ward in the Principality of Monaco. Located on a headland that extends into the Mediterranean Sea, it is nicknamed The Rock (French: Le Rocher; Monégasque: A Roca).

Q55182.name: Huesca Province
Q55182.about: The Province of Huesca (Spanish: Provincia de Huesca, Aragonese: Provincia de Uesca; Catalan: Província d'Osca), officially Huesca/Uesca, is a province of northeastern Spain, in the northern part of the autonomous community of Aragon. The capital is Huesca.

Q57060.name: Sisak-Moslavina County
Q57060.about: Sisak-Moslavina County (Croatian: Sisačko-moslavačka županija) is a Croatian county in eastern Central Croatia and southwestern Slavonia. It is named after the city of Sisak and the region Moslavina just across the river Sava.

Q57071.name: Karlovac County
Q57071.about: Karlovac County (Croatian: Karlovačka županija) is a county in central Croatia, with the administrative center in Karlovac. It borders Bosnia and Herzegovina and Slovenia.
Q57071.img: Stari grad Dubovac- Autor- Igor Čepurkovski.jpg

Q57525.name: Central District
Q57525.about: Central is the largest of Botswana's districts in terms of area and population. It encompasses the traditional homeland of the Bamangwato people.

Q57617.name: North-West District
Q57617.about: The North-West District or Ngamiland is one of the first-level administrative subdivisions of Botswana.  For census and administrative purposes Ngamiland is subdivided into Ngamiland East, Ngamiland West and Ngamiland Delta (Okavango).

Q57636.name: North-East District
Q57636.about: The North-East District is one of the administrative districts of Botswana. Its capital is Francistown.

Q58026.name: Koprivnica-Križevci County
Q58026.about: Koprivnica-Križevci County (Croatian: Koprivničko-križevačka županija [kǒpriːʋnit͡ʃko-krǐːʒeʋat͡ʃkaː ʒupǎnija]; Hungarian: Kapronca-Kőrös megye) is a county in Northern Croatia. Its hyphenated name comes from two entities: the two of its largest cities, Koprivnica and Križevci; Koprivnica is the official capital of the county.

Q41358.name: Styria
Q41358.desc: federal state in the south of Austria
Q41358.about: Styria (Austrian German: Steiermark [ˈʃtaɪɐmark] ; Bavarian: Steiamårk; Slovene: Štajerska; Hungarian: Stájerország [ˈʃtaːjɛrorsaːɡ]) is an Austrian state in the southeast of the country. With an area of approximately 16,399 km2 (6,332 sq mi), it is Austria's second-largest state by area, after Lower Austria.

Q43319.name: Mato Grosso do Sul
Q43319.desc: state in the Central-West Region of Brazil
Q43319.about: Mato Grosso do Sul (US:  MAH-toh GRAW-soh doh SOOL, Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈmatu ˈɡɾosu du ˈsuw] ; lit. 'South Thick Bush') is one of Brazil's 27 federal units, located in the southern part of the Central-West Region, bordering five Brazilian states: Mato Grosso (to the north), Goiás and Minas Gerais (northeast), São Paulo (east) and Paraná (southeast); and two South American countries: Paraguay (south and southwestern) and Bolivia (west). It is divided into 79 municipalities and covers an area of 357,145.532 square kilometers, which is about the same size as Germany.

Q43325.name: Salzburg
Q43325.desc: federal state in the North-West of Austria
Q43325.about: Salzburg (Austrian German: [ˈsaltsbʊrɡ], Northern German: [ˈzaltsbʊʁk] ; Bavarian: Soizbuag, also known as Salzburgerland) is a state (Land) of Austria bordering Germany and Italy. In German, its official name is Land Salzburg, to distinguish it from its eponymous capital Salzburg.

Q44757.name: Chaco Province
Q44757.about: Chaco (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈtʃako]; Wichi: To-kós-wet), officially the Province of Chaco (Spanish: Provincia del Chaco [pɾoˈβinsja ðel ˈtʃako]) is one of the 23 provinces of Argentina. Its capital and largest city is Resistencia.

Q930804.name: San Miguel Department
Q930804.about: San Miguel (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsam miˈɣel]) is a department in the eastern part of El Salvador. The capital is San Miguel.

Q936717.name: Sud-Est
Q936717.about: Sud-Est (French, pronounced [sydɛst] ) or Sidès (Haitian Creole; both meaning "South East") is one of the ten departments of Haiti located in southern Haiti. It has an area of 2,034.10 km2 and a population of 632,601 (2015).

Q953508.name: Eastern Province
Q953508.about: The Eastern Province (Arabic: المنطقة الشرقية‎, romanized: al-Mintaqah ash-Sharqīyah), also known as the Eastern Region, is a province in Saudi Arabia. It is the nation's largest province by area and the third most populous after Riyadh and Mecca provinces.

Q967339.name: Zaječar District
Q967339.about: The Zaječar District (Serbian: Зајечарски округ, romanized: Zaječarski okrug, pronounced [zâjɛtʃarskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the eastern part of the country.

Q2041219.name: Makedonska Kamenica Municipality
Q2041219.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2041219.about: Makedonska Kamenica (Macedonian: Македонска Каменица [maˈkɛdɔnska kaˈmɛnitsa] ) is a municipality in eastern North Macedonia. Makedonska Kamenica is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is located.

Q2041236.name: Lipkovo Municipality
Q2041236.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2041236.about: Lipkovo (Macedonian: , Albanian: Likovë) is a municipality in the north part of North Macedonia. Lipkovo is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2088022.name: Novaci Municipality
Q2088022.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2088022.about: Novaci (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in the southern part of North Macedonia. Novaci is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2128903.name: Staro Nagoričane Municipality
Q2128903.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2128903.about: Staro Nagoričane Municipality (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in the northern part of North Macedonia. The municipal seat is located in the village of Staro Nagoričane.

Q2282274.name: Tearce Municipality
Q2282274.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2282274.about: Tearce (Macedonian: Теарце [ˈtɛ.artsɛ] ; Albanian:Tearcë) is a municipality in northwestern North Macedonia. Tearce is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2308287.name: Strumica Municipality
Q2308287.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2308287.about: Strumica (Macedonian: Струмица [ˈstrumitsa] ) is a municipality located in the eastern part of North Macedonia. Strumica is also the name of the city where the municipal seat is found.

Q6312454.name: Prilep Municipality
Q6312454.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q6312454.about: Prilep (Macedonian: Прилеп [ˈpriːlɛp] ) is a municipality in the south of North Macedonia. Prilep is also the name of the city where the municipal seat is found.

Q6398826.name: Khachmaz District
Q6398826.about: Khachmaz District (Azerbaijani: Xaçmaz rayonu; Lezgian: Хъачмаз район) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the northeast of the country and belongs to the Guba-Khachmaz Economic Region.

Q9035785.name: Bogovinje Municipality
Q9035785.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q9035785.about: Bogovinje (Macedonian: , Albanian: Komuna e Bogovinës) is a municipality in the western part of the Republic of North Macedonia. Bogovinje is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q13365892.name: Municipality of Dobrovnik
Q13365892.about: The Municipality of Dobrovnik (Slovene: Občina Dobrovnik [ˈóːptʃina dɔˈbɾɔ́ːwnik]; Hungarian: Dobronak község [ˈdobronɒk ˈkøʃʃeːɡ]) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is Dobrovnik (Hungarian: Dobronak).

Q13365904.name: Municipality of Hodoš
Q13365904.about: The Municipality of Hodoš (Slovene: Občina Hodoš [ˈóːptʃina ˈxóːdɔʃ]; Hungarian: Őrihodos község is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the village of Hodoš (Hungarian: Őrihodos).

Q13377751.name: Municipality of Cankova
Q13377751.about: The Municipality of Cankova (pronounced [ˈtsaːŋkɔʋa]; Slovene: Občina Cankova) is a municipality in the Prekmurje region of Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Cankova.

Q2352376.name: Kumanovo Municipality
Q2352376.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2352376.about: Kumanovo (Macedonian: Куманово [kuˈmanɔvɔ] ; Albanian: Kumanovë) is a municipality located in the northern part of North Macedonia. Kumanovo is also the name of the city where the municipal seat is located.

Q3245456.name: Tetovo Municipality
Q3245456.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q3245456.about: Tetovo (Macedonian: Тетово, [ˈtɛtɔvɔ] ; Albanian: Tetova) is a municipality in the northwest part of North Macedonia. Tetovo's municipal seat is located in the town of the same name.

Q3259688.name: Municipality of Bovec
Q3259688.about: The Municipality of Bovec (pronounced [ˈbɔːʋəts] or [ˈboːʋəts]; Slovene: Občina Bovec) is a municipality in northwestern Slovenia. Its center is the town of Bovec.

Q3278915.name: Municipality of Apače
Q3278915.about: The Municipality of Apače (pronounced [ˈáːpatʃɛ]; Slovene: Občina Apače) is a municipality in Slovenia. It lies in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia and belongs to the Mura Statistical Region.

Q3296677.name: Rožaje Municipality
Q3296677.about: Rožaje Municipality (Montenegrin and Bosnian: Opština Rožaje / Општина Рожаје; Albanian: Komuna e Rozhajës) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. The main centre and capital of the Rožaje municipality is Rožaje.

Q3299950.name: Pljevlja Municipality
Q3299950.about: Pljevlja Municipality is located in Northern Montenegro. It covers an area of 1,346 km² and had a population of 30,786 at the 2011 census.
Q3299950.img: Architectural Ensemble of the Holy Trinity in Pljevlja - Montenegro.jpg

Q3304454.name: Žabljak Municipality
Q3304454.about: Žabǉak Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Žabǉak / Општина Жабљак) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. The municipality is located in northern Montenegro.

Q867112.name: Gracias a Dios Department
Q867112.about: Gracias a Dios (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈɡɾasjas a ˈðjos]; "Thanks to God" or "Thank God") is one of the 18 departments (departamentos) into which Honduras is divided. The departmental capital is Puerto Lempira; and up until 1975 it was Brus Laguna.
Q867112.img: Selva tropical en la biosfera de el rio plátano Honduras.jpg

Q867803.name: Mačva District
Q867803.about: The Mačva District (Serbian: Мачвански округ, romanized: Mačvanski okrug, pronounced [mǎtʃʋanskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the western part of Serbia, in the geographical regions of Mačva, Podrinje, Posavina, and Pocerina.

Q867869.name: Lac Region
Q867869.about: Lac (Arabic: البحيرة, romanised: al-Buḥayrah, lit. 'the Lake') is one of the 23 provinces of Chad. Its capital is Bol.

Q870191.name: Kankan Region
Q870191.about: Kankan Region (N'Ko: ߞߊ߲ߞߊ߲߫ ߕߌ߲߬ߞߎߘߎ߲) is a region of Guinea located in the east of the country. It is the largest region of Guinea by area, covering an area of 72,145 km2; and it had a population of 4,110,215 at the Census on 1 July 2025.

Q876541.name: Jablanica District
Q876541.about: The Jablanica District (Serbian: Јабланички округ, romanized: Jablanički okrug, pronounced [jâblaːnitʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the southeastern parts of the country.

Q899272.name: Choluteca Department
Q899272.about: Choluteca is one of the 18 departments (departamentos) into which Honduras is divided. The departmental capital is the city of Choluteca.

Q998566.name: Municipality of Kungota
Q998566.about: The Municipality of Kungota (pronounced [ˈkuːŋɡɔta]; Slovene: Občina Kungota) is a municipality in the western part of the Slovene Hills (Slovene: Slovenske gorice) in northeastern Slovenia. Its seat is the village of Zgornja Kungota.

Q1005364.name: Municipality of Radlje ob Dravi
Q1005364.about: The Municipality of Radlje ob Dravi (pronounced [ˈɾaːdljɛ ɔb ˈdɾaːʋi]; Slovene: Občina Radlje ob Dravi) is a municipality in Slovenia. It lies in the traditional region of Styria, but belongs to the Carinthia Statistical Region.

Q1012996.name: Kanal ob Soči
Q1012996.about: Kanal (pronounced [kaˈnaːl] or [kaˈnaːu̯]; Italian: Canale, German: Kanalburg), frequently referred to as Kanal ob Soči ("Kanal on the Soča"; pronounced [kaˈnaːl ɔp ˈsoːtʃi] or [kaˈnaːu̯ ɔp ˈsoːtʃi]; Italian: Canale d'Isonzo), is a settlement mostly on the left bank of the Soča River in the Slovene Littoral, the traditional region in southwestern Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Kanal ob Soči.

Q3361.name: Doubs
Q3361.about: Doubs ( DOO; French: [du] ; Arpitan: Dubs) is an administrative department in the northeastern French region of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté. Named after the river Doubs, it had a population of 547,163 in 2023.

Q12709.name: Pyrénées-Orientales
Q12709.desc: French department in the region of Occitania
Q12709.about: Pyrénées-Orientales (French: [piʁene ɔʁjɑ̃tal] ; Catalan: Pirineus Orientals [piɾiˈnɛwz uɾiənˈtals]; Occitan: Pirenèus Orientals [piɾeˈnɛwz uɾjenˈtals]; lit. 'Eastern Pyrenees'), also known as Northern Catalonia, is a department of the region of Occitania, Southern France, adjacent to the northern Spanish frontier and the Mediterranean Sea. It borders the departments of Ariège to the northwest and Aude to the north, the Mediterranean Sea to the east and the Spanish province of Girona in Catalonia to the south and the country of Andorra to the west.

Q12713.name: Canton of Thurgau
Q12713.about: Thurgau ( TOOR-gow, Swiss Standard German: [ˈtuːrɡaʊ] ; French: Thurgovie; Italian: Turgovia; Romansh: Turgovia), anglicized as Thurgovia, and formally as the Canton of Thurgau, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of five districts.

Q12782.name: Territoire de Belfort
Q12782.about: The Territoire de Belfort (French pronunciation: [tɛʁitwaʁ də bɛlfɔʁ] ; lit. "Territory of Belfort") is a department in the northeastern French region of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté.

Q13904.name: Province of Lleida
Q13904.about: The Province of Lleida (Spanish: Provincia de Lérida [ˈleɾiða]; Catalan: Província de Lleida Western Calatan: [ˈʎejða]; Aranese: Província de Lhèida [ˈʎɛjda]) is one of the four provinces of the autonomous community of Catalonia in Spain. It is bordered by the provinces of Girona, Barcelona, Tarragona, Zaragoza and Huesca and the country of France and the principality of Andorra.

Q12717.name: Bas-Rhin
Q12717.desc: French administrative district of the European Collectivity of Alsace
Q12717.about: Bas-Rhin (French pronunciation: [bɑ ʁɛ̃] ) is a department in Alsace which is a part of the Grand Est region of France. The name means 'Lower Rhine', referring to its lower altitude among the two French Rhine departments: it is downstream of the Haut-Rhin (Upper Rhine) department.

Q12722.name: Haut-Rhin
Q12722.desc: French administrative district of the European Collectivity of Alsace
Q12722.about: Haut-Rhin (French pronunciation: [oʁɛ̃] ) is a department in the Grand Est region, France, bordering both Germany and Switzerland. It is named after the river Rhine.

Q12738.name: Canton of Neuchâtel
Q12738.about: The Republic and Canton of Neuchâtel is one of the 26 cantons of the Swiss Confederation. It is a mostly French-speaking canton in the western part of the country.

Q15091.name: Province of Cuneo
