Q15091.about: The Province of Cuneo (Italian: provincia di Cuneo; Piedmontese: provincia ëd Coni) is a province in the region of Piedmont in northern Italy. To the west, it borders the French region of Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur (departments of Alpes-Maritimes, Alpes-de-Haute-Provence and Hautes-Alpes), to the north the Metropolitan City of Turin, to the east the province of Asti and to the south the Ligurian provinces of Savona and Imperia.

Q15499.name: Paraná
Q15499.desc: state in the South Region of Brazil
Q15499.about: Paraná ( PAR-ə-NAH, Brazilian Portuguese: [paɾɐˈna] ) is one of the 26 states of Brazil, in the south of the country. It is bordered in the north by São Paulo state, in the east by the Atlantic Ocean, in the south by Santa Catarina and the Argentine province of Misiones, and in the west by Mato Grosso do Sul and Paraguay, with the Paraná River as its western boundary.

Q15881.name: Municipality of Jesenice
Q15881.about: The Municipality of Jesenice (pronounced [jɛsɛˈniːtsɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Jesenice) is a municipality in northwest Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Jesenice.

Q906636.name: Municipality of Kuzma
Q906636.about: The Municipality of Kuzma (pronounced [ˈkuːzma]; Slovene: Občina Kuzma) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It gets its name from the largest settlement and administrative seat of the municipality, Kuzma.
Q906636.img: Cerkev svetega Kozme in Damijana, Kuzma.jpg

Q914058.name: Cabañas Department
Q914058.about: Cabañas (Spanish pronunciation: [kaˈβaɲas]) is a department of El Salvador in the north central part of the country. Its capital is Sensuntepeque and it is one of coldest parts of El Salvador.
Q914058.img: Cerro Eramon, visto desde el rio Copinolapa,Cabañas, El Salvador - panoramio.jpg

Q919934.name: Municipality of Selnica ob Dravi
Q919934.about: The Municipality of Selnica ob Dravi (Slovene: Občina Selnica ob Dravi) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Selnica ob Dravi.

Q924278.name: Ǵorče Petrov Municipality
Q924278.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia, one of the ten municipalities of the city of Skopje
Q924278.about: Gjorče Petrov (Macedonian: Ѓорче Петров) is one of the ten municipalities that compose the city of Skopje, the capital of North Macedonia. It is named after the revolutionary Gjorče Petrov.

Q928694.name: Nord-Est
Q928694.about: Nord-Est (French, pronounced [nɔʁɛst] ) or Nodès (Haitian Creole; both meaning "North East") is one of the ten departments of Haiti, located in northern Haiti. It has an area of 1,623 km2 (627 sq mi), making it the smallest of all the departments.

Q15890.name: Lendava
Q15890.about: Lendava (pronounced [ˈléːndaʋa] ; formerly Dolnja Lendava, in older sources also Dolenja Lendava; Hungarian: Lendva, formerly Alsólendva; German: Lindau, formerly Unter-Limbach) is a town in Slovenia in the region of Prekmurje. It is the seat of the Municipality of Lendava.

Q15911.name: Ravne na Koroškem
Q15911.about: Ravne na Koroškem (pronounced [ˈɾàːwnɛ na kɔˈɾóːʃkɛm] ; until 1952: Guštanj; German: Gutenstein in Kärnten) is a town in northern Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Ravne na Koroškem, and the largest town and the capital of Slovenia's Carinthia region.

Q15927.name: Municipality of Tržič
Q15927.about: The Municipality of Tržič (pronounced [təɾˈʒitʃ] ; Slovene: Občina Tržič) is a municipality in the traditional region of Upper Carniola in northwestern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Tržič.

Q15924.name: Municipality of Tolmin
Q15924.about: The Municipality of Tolmin (pronounced [tɔlˈmiːn]; Slovene: Občina Tolmin) is a municipality in northwestern Slovenia. Its seat and largest settlement is Tolmin.

Q16126.name: Province of Belluno
Q16126.desc: one of seven provinces in the Italian region Veneto
Q16126.about: The province of Belluno (Italian: provincia di Belluno; Austrian German: provinz Belluno; Ladin: provinzia de Belum) is a province in the region of Veneto in Italy. Its capital is the city of Belluno.

Q12745.name: Savoie
Q12745.desc: French department in the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes region of the French Alps
Q12745.about: Savoie (French pronunciation: [savwa]; Arpitan: Savouè or Savouè-d'Avâl, lit. 'Lower Savoy'; Italian: Savoia; Occitan: Savòia; English: Savoy, ) is a department in the region of Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Southeastern France. Located in the French Alps, its prefecture is Chambéry.

Q18249.name: Posavina Canton
Q18249.about: The Posavina Canton (Croatian: Županija Posavska; Serbian and Bosnian: Posavski kanton; Cyrillic: Посавски кантон) is a federated state and one of ten cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It is the smallest canton with an area of only 330.85 km2 (128 sq mi).

Q18275.name: West Herzegovina Canton
Q18275.about: The West Herzegovina Canton (Croatian: Županija Zapadnohercegovačka) is a federated state and one of the cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The West Herzegovina Canton is in the Herzegovina region in the southwest of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Q18273.name: Herzegovina-Neretva Canton
Q18273.about:
The Herzegovina-Neretva Canton (Croatian: Hercegovačko-neretvanska županija; Bosnian: Hercegovačko-neretvanski kanton; Serbian: Херцеговачко-неретвански кантон, romanized: Hercegovačko-neretvanski kanton) is a federated state and one of ten cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The canton mainly comprises the Neretva river valley area and parts of Herzegovina west of Mostar, its administrative centre.

Q24260.name: Canillo
Q24260.about: Canillo (Catalan pronunciation: [kaˈniʎo]) is one of the seven parishes which make up Andorra. Canillo is also the name of the main town of the parish.

Q24269.name: Encamp
Q24269.about: Encamp (Catalan pronunciation: [aŋˈkam]) is one of the parishes of Andorra, located on the Valira d'Orient river. It is also the name of the main town in the parish.

Q58092.name: Virovitica-Podravina County
Q58092.about: Virovitica-Podravina County (pronounced [ʋiroʋǐtit͡sa-pǒdraʋina]; Croatian: Virovitičko-podravska županija [ʋiroʋǐtit͡ʃko-pǒdraʋskaː ʒupǎnija]; Hungarian: Verőce-Drávamente megye) is a northern Slavonian county in Croatia. Its county seat is in Virovitica and it includes the area around the Drava river, Podravina being the Drava's drainage basin.

Q58129.name: Brod-Posavina County
Q58129.about: Brod-Posavina County (Croatian: Brodsko-posavska županija) is the southern Slavonian county in Croatia. Its center is the city of Slavonski Brod and it spreads along the left bank of the Sava river, hence the name Posavina.
Q58129.img: Tvrđava Brod (Brod Fortress, Slavonski Brod, Croatia).jpg

Q58146.name: Zadar County
Q58146.about: Zadar County (Croatian: Zadarska županija, [zâdarskaː ʒupǎnija]) is a county in Croatia, it encompasses northern Dalmatia and southeastern Lika. Its seat is the city of Zadar.

Q58159.name: Osijek-Baranja County
Q58159.about: Osijek-Baranja County (pronounced [ôsijeːk bǎraɲa], Croatian: Osječko-baranjska županija, Hungarian: Eszék-Baranya megye) is a county in Croatia, located in northeastern Slavonia and Baranja which is defined part of the Pannonian Plain. Its center is Osijek.

Q58225.name: Vukovar-Srijem County
Q58225.about: Vukovar-Srijem County (Croatian: Vukovarsko-srijemska županija), Vukovar-Sirmium County or Vukovar-Syrmia County, named after the eponymous town of Vukovar and the region of Syrmia, is the easternmost Croatian county. It includes the eastern parts of the region of Slavonia and the western parts of the region of Syrmia, as well as the lower Sava river basin, Posavina and Danube river basin Podunavlje.

Q58253.name: Split-Dalmatia County
Q58253.about: Split-Dalmatia County (Croatian: Splitsko-dalmatinska županija [splîtsko-dalmǎtiːnskaː ʒupǎnija]) is a central-southern Dalmatian county in Croatia. The administrative center is Split.
Q58253.img: Luftbild der Insel Ravnik im Adriatischen Meer von Kroatien (48608779517).jpg

Q16186.name: Province of Imperia
Q16186.about: The province of Imperia (Italian: provincia di Imperia; Ligurian: provinsa d'Imperia; Occitan: província d'Impèria; French: province d'Imperia) is a mountainous and hilly province in the region of Liguria in northern Italy, situated between France to the north and the west, and the Ligurian Sea, an arm of the Mediterranean Sea to the south. Its capital is Imperia, though the largest city is Sanremo.

Q16184.name: Province of Gorizia
Q16184.about: The province of Gorizia (Italian: provincia di Gorizia; Slovene: Goriška pokrajina; Friulian: provincie di Gurize) was a province in the autonomous region of Friuli-Venezia Giulia in Italy. Initially disbanded on 30 September 2017, it was reestablished in 2019 as the regional decentralization entity of Gorizia (Italian: ente di decentramento regionale di Gorizia; Slovene: enota deželne decentralizacije Gorica; Friulian: ent di decentrament regjonâl di Gurize), and was reactivated on 1 July 2020.

Q16241.name: Province of Pesaro and Urbino
Q16241.about: The province of Pesaro and Urbino (Italian: provincia di Pesaro e Urbino, Italian: [proˈvintʃa di ˈpeːzaro e urˈbiːno]) is a province in the region of Marche in Italy. Its capitals are the city of Pesaro and the town of Urbino.

Q16268.name: Province of Rimini
Q16268.about: The province of Rimini (Italian: provincia di Rimini) is the southernmost province of the region of Emilia-Romagna in Italy. Its capital is the city of Rimini, one of the "seven sisters" of the historical region of Romagna.

Q272406.name: Chagang Province
Q272406.about: Chagang Province (Korean: 자강도; MR: Chagang-do; Korean pronunciation: [tɕa.ɡaŋ.do]) is a province of North Korea; it is bordered by China's Jilin and Liaoning provinces to the north, Ryanggang and South Hamgyong to the east, South Pyongan to the south, and North Pyongan to the west.  Chagang was formed in 1949, after being demarcated from North Pyongan.

Q273794.name: Uttaradit
Q273794.about: Uttaradit (Thai: อุตรดิตถ์, pronounced [ʔùt.tā.rā.dìt]; Northern Thai:ᩏᨲ᩠ᨲᩁᨯᩥᨲ᩠ᨳ᩺) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat). It lies in upper northern Thailand.

Q275388.name: Loei
Q275388.about: Loei (Thai: เลย, pronounced [lɤ̄ːj]), is one of the more sparsely populated provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It lies in the Isan region of upper northeastern Thailand.

Q275740.name: Kanchanaburi
Q275740.about: Kanchanaburi (กาญจนบุรี, pronounced [kāːn.t͡ɕā.ná(ʔ).bū.rīː]) is the largest province (changwat) of Western Thailand. Tourists are attracted by the history of its ancient civilization and the World War II Bridge over the River Kwai, originally spelt "Khwae" but officially changed to Kwai to accommodate the expectations of tourists.

Q759.name: New Hampshire
Q759.desc: state of the United States of America
Q759.about: New Hampshire ( HAMP-shər) is a state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, Vermont to the west, Maine and the Gulf of Maine to the east, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.
Q759.img: Downtown Concord, NH, near the state capitol IMG 2719 (cropped).JPG

Q176.name: Quebec
Q176.about: Quebec (French: Québec) is Canada's largest province by area. Located in Central Canada, it is the country's only Francophone-majority province.

Q309478.name: Al Qadarif
Q309478.about: Al Qadarif (Arabic: القضارف Al Qaḍārif), also spelled Gedaref or Gadarif, is one of the 18 wilayat (states) of Sudan. It covers an area of 75,263 km2 and had an estimated population of approximately 2,208,385 as of 2018.It borders Kassala to the north, Khartoum to the northwest, Gezira to the west, Sennar to the south, Ethiopia and Eritrea to the east.

Q309489.name: Blue Nile State
Q309489.about: Blue Nile State (Arabic: ولاية النيل الأزرق Wilāyat an-Nīl al-ʾAzraq) is one of the 18 states of the Republic of the Sudan. Established by Presidential Decree No.

Q316216.name: Kara Region
Q316216.about: Kara Region (French: Région de la Kara) is one of Togo's five regions. Kara is the regional capital.

Q316291.name: Maritime
Q316291.about: Maritime Region (French: Région maritime) is the southernmost of Togo's five regions, with the country's only shoreline on the Bight of Benin. Tsévié serves as the regional capital.

Q316306.name: Plateaux Region
Q316306.desc: one of five Regions of Togo and the largest by area
Q316306.about:
Plateaux Region (French: Région des Plateaux) is one of Togo's five regions.
Atakpamé is the regional capital.

Q327737.name: Nong Khai
Q327737.about: Nong Khai province (Thai: หนองคาย, pronounced [nɔ̌ːŋ kʰāːj]; Northeastern Thai: หนองคาย, pronounced [nɔ̌ːŋ kʰa᷇ːj]) was formerly the northernmost of the northeastern (Isan) provinces (changwat) of Thailand until its eight eastern districts were split off to form Thailand's newest province, Bueng Kan province, in 2011. Nong Khai province lies in upper northeastern Thailand.

Q720030.name: South Banat District
Q720030.about: The South Banat District (Serbian: Јужнобанатски округ, romanized: Južnobanatski okrug, pronounced [jûʒnobǎnaːtskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the geographical region of Banat.

Q720066.name: Vientiane Province
Q720066.about: Vientiane province (Lao: ແຂວງວຽງຈັນ, pronounced [kʰwɛ̌ːŋ wíaŋ tɕàn]) is a province of Laos in the country's northwest. As of 2015 the province had a population of 419,090.

Q721431.name: Balqa Governorate
Q721431.about: Balqa' (Arabic: البلقاء Al Balqā’) is one of the governorates of Jordan. It is located northwest of Amman, Jordan's capital.

Q721441.name: Irbid Governorate
Q721441.about: Irbid or Irbed (Arabic: إربد) is a governorate in Jordan, located north of Amman, the country's capital. The capital of the governorate is the city of Irbid.

Q726620.name: Ouham Prefecture
Q726620.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q726620.about: Ouham is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Bossangoa.

Q735245.name: Karak Governorate
Q735245.about: Karak (Arabic: الكرك) is one of the governorates of Jordan, located south-west of Amman, Jordan's capital. Its capital is Al-Karak.

Q960.name: Tuva
Q960.desc: Republic and federal subject of Russia
Q960.about: Tuva or Tyva, officially the Republic of Tyva, is a republic of Russia. Tuva lies at the geographical center of Asia, in southern Siberia.

Q1212.name: Montana
Q1212.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1212.about: Montana (  mon-TAN-ə) is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is bordered by Idaho to the west, North Dakota to the east, South Dakota to the southeast, Wyoming to the south, and the Canadian provinces of Alberta, British Columbia, and Saskatchewan to the north.

Q1221.name: Idaho
Q1221.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1221.about: Idaho ( , EYE-də-hoe) is a landlocked state in the Pacific Northwest and Mountain West subregions of the Western United States. It borders Montana and Wyoming to the east, Nevada and Utah to the south, and Washington and Oregon to the west; the state shares a small portion of the Canada–United States border to the north with the Canadian province of British Columbia.

Q1384.name: New York
Q1384.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1384.about: New York, also called New York State, is a state located in the Northeastern United States. Bordering New England to its east, Pennsylvania and New Jersey to the south, and Canada to its north, New York extends into both the Atlantic Ocean and the Great Lakes.

Q1166.name: Michigan
Q1166.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1166.about: Michigan (  MISH-ig-ən) is a peninsular state in the Great Lakes region of the Upper Midwestern United States. It shares water and land boundaries with Minnesota to the northwest, Wisconsin to the west, Indiana and Illinois to the southwest, Ohio to the southeast, and the Canadian province of Ontario to the east, northeast and north.

Q330158.name: Dhaka Division
Q330158.about: Dhaka Division (Bengali: ঢাকা বিভাগ, romanized: Ḍhaka Bibhag) is an administrative division of Bangladesh. Dhaka serves as the capital city of Dhaka Division, the Dhaka District and Bangladesh.
Q330158.img: Massive soil erosion is affecting Bangladesh.jpg

Q330807.name: Beylagan District
Q330807.about: Beylagan District (Azerbaijani: Beyləqan rayonu) is one of the 67 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country and belongs to the Mil-Mughan Economic Region.

Q330834.name: Bilasuvar District
Q330834.about: Bilasuvar District (Azerbaijani: Biləsuvar rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the south-east of the country, in the Shirvan-Salyan Economic Region.

Q331687.name: Fuzuli District
Q331687.about: Fuzuli District (Azerbaijani: Füzuli rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the south-west of the country and belongs to the Karabakh Economic Region.

Q332392.name: Gao Region
Q332392.about: Gao (Bambara: ߜߊߏ ߘߌߣߋߖߊ tr. Gao Dineja) is a region in northeastern Mali.

Q334884.name: Bokeo Province
Q334884.about: Bokeo (Lao: ບໍ່ແກ້ວ, pronounced [bɔ̄ː kɛ̂ːw]; literally 'gem mine'; previously, Hua Khong, meaning 'head of the Mekong') is a northern province of Laos. It is the smallest and second least populous province in the country.
Q334884.img: Donesao Hill Tribe Cultural Garden, Laos 1.JPG

Q125711.name: Cuvette-Ouest Department
Q125711.desc: department of the Republic of the Congo
Q125711.about: Cuvette-Ouest ("West Cuvette") is a department of the Republic of the Congo in the western part of the country. Cuvette-Ouest is the least populated department in the country.

Q127255.name: Yardimli District
Q127255.about: Yardimli District (Azerbaijani: Yardımlı rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the south-east of the country and is part of the Lankaran-Astara Economic Region.

Q128978.name: Kilis Province
Q128978.about: Kilis Province (Turkish: Kilis ili) is a province in southern Turkey, on the border with Syria. Its area is 1,412 km2, and its population is 147,919 (2022).

Q130625.name: North Kivu
Q130625.desc: province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q130625.about: North Kivu (Swahili: Jimbo la Kivu Kaskazini) is a province bordering Lake Kivu in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The capital city is Goma.
Q130625.img: Lava flows around Goma - Julien Harneis - May 2, 2007 - 2.jpg

Q83274.name: Hatay Province
Q83274.about: Hatay Province (Turkish: Hatay ili, pronounced [ˈhataj]) is the southernmost province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey. Its area is 5,524 km2 (2,133 sq mi), and its population is 1,686,043 (2022).

Q109348.name: North Pyongan Province
Q109348.about: North Pyongan Province (also spelled North P'yŏngan; Korean: 평안북도; MR: Phyŏnganbukto; IPA: [pʰjʌŋanbuk̚t͈o]) is a western province of North Korea. The province was formed in 1896 from the northern half of the former P'yŏng'an Province, remained a province of Korea until 1945, then became a province of North Korea.

Q109361.name: North Hamgyong Province
Q109361.about: North Hamgyong Province (Hamgyŏngbukdo, Korean pronunciation: [ham.ɡjʌŋ.buk̚.t͈o]) is the northernmost province of North Korea. The province was formed in 1896 from the northern half of the former Hamgyong Province.

Q110171.name: Ryanggang Province
Q110171.about: Ryanggang Province (Ryanggangdo; Korean: 량강도; MR: Ryanggang-do, Korean pronunciation: [ɾjaŋ.ɡaŋ.do]) is a province in North Korea. The province is bordered by China (Jilin) to the north, North Hamgyong to the east, South Hamgyong to the south, and Chagang to the west.
Q110171.img: 巡道工出品 photo by Xundaogong - panoramio (106).jpg

Q121104.name: Balkh Province
Q121104.about: Balkh  is one of the northern provinces of Afghanistan and is widely regarded as one of the country's most historically significant and culturally rich regions. It borders Jowzjan and Sar-e-Pol to the west, Samangan to the south, Kunduz to the east, and the Surxondaryo Region of Uzbekistan to the north.
Q121104.img: Outskirts of Mazar-e Sharif in northern Afghanistan.jpg

Q275758.name: Tak
Q275758.about: Tak (Thai: ตาก, pronounced [tàːk]) is one of Thailand's seventy-seven provinces (changwat) and lies in Western Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Mae Hong Son, Chiang Mai, Lamphun, Lampang, Sukhothai, Kamphaeng Phet, Nakhon Sawan, Uthai Thani and Kanchanaburi.

Q275781.name: Phitsanulok
Q275781.about: Phitsanulok (Thai: พิษณุโลก, pronounced [pʰít.sā.nú.lôːk]; lit. 'Vishnu's realm') is a province of central Thailand. It borders the provinces of Uttaradit to the north, Loei and Phetchabun to the east, Phichit to the south, Kamphaeng Phet to the southwest, and Sukhothai to the west.
Q275781.img: วัดพระศรีมหาธาตุ2 - panoramio.jpg

Q279945.name: Savanes Region
Q279945.desc: northernmost of the five Regions of Togo
Q279945.about: Savanes Region (French: Région des Savanes) is the northernmost of the five Regions of Togo. Dapaong is the regional capital and largest city.

Q286646.name: Cimișlia District
Q286646.about: Cimișlia (Romanian pronunciation: [tʃimiʃˈli.a]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in southern Moldova, situated between the capital of Chișinău and the autonomous territorial unit of Gagauzia, with its administrative center (oraș-reședință) being the town of Cimișlia. In the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was officially recorded to be 30,986.

Q287789.name: Koulikoro Region
Q287789.about: Koulikoro Region (Bambara: ߞߎߟߌߞߏߙߏ ߘߌߣߋߖߊ tr. Kulikoro Dineja) is a region in western Mali.

Q302656.name: Salavan Province
Q302656.about: Salavan (also Saravane, Lao: ສາລະວັນ) is a province of Laos, located in the south of the country. Its earlier name was Saravan which was changed by the Thais to Salavan in 1828.

Q309190.name: Kagera Region
Q309190.about: Kagera Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Kagera) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions, with an area of 35,686 km2 (13,778 sq mi). Kagera Region is bordered to the east by Lake Victoria, Mwanza Region and Mara Region, to the south by Geita Region and Kigoma Region, to the west by Rwanda and to the north by Uganda and Burundi to the south west.

Q81725.name: KwaZulu-Natal
Q81725.about:
KwaZulu-Natal (, also referred to as KZN) is a province of South Africa that was created in 1994 when the government merged the Zulu bantustan of KwaZulu ("Place of the Zulu" in Zulu) and Natal Province.
It is located in the southeast of the country, with a long shoreline on the Indian Ocean.

Q81978.name: Cádiz Province
Q81978.about: The Province of Cádiz (Spanish: Provincia de Cádiz) is a province of southern Spain, in the southwestern part of the autonomous community of Andalusia. It is the southernmost part of mainland Spain, as well as the southernmost part of continental Europe.

Q83077.name: Kars Province
Q83077.about: Kars Province (Turkish: Kars ili; Azerbaijani: Qars Rayonu; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Qersê; Armenian: Կարսի նահանգ) is a province of Turkey, located in the northeastern part of the country. It shares part of its closed border with Armenia.

Q170446.name: Sumy Oblast
Q170446.desc: administrative division (oblast) in the north of Ukraine
Q170446.about: Sumy Oblast (Ukrainian: Сумська область, romanized: Sumska oblast), also known as Sumshchyna (Сумщина), is an oblast (province) in northeast Ukraine. The oblast was created in its modern-day form, from the merging of raions from Kharkiv Oblast, Chernihiv Oblast, and Poltava Oblast in 1939 by the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union.

Q170570.name: Ilam Province
Q170570.about: Ilam Province (Persian: استان ایلام) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Ilam.

Q1195.name: Meghalaya
Q1195.about: Meghalaya (; lit. "the abode of clouds") is a state in northeast India, with Shillong as its capital city.

Q1193.name: Manipur
Q1193.about: Manipur (, IPA: [məɳiˈpʊɾ]) is a state in northeastern India, with Imphal as its capital city. It borders the Indian states of Assam to the west, Mizoram to the south, and Nagaland to the north and shares the international border with Myanmar, specifically the Sagaing Region to the east and Chin State to the southeast.
Q1193.img: Breathtaking beauty of Dzukou Valley in Manipur-Nagaland border (edit).jpg

Q334888.name: Champasak Province
Q334888.about: Champasak (or Champassak, Champasack – Lao: ຈຳປາສັກ [t͡ɕàm pàː sák]) is a province in southwestern Laos. It is 1 of the 3 principalities that succeeded the kingdom of Lan Xang.

Q335119.name: Mukdahan
Q335119.about: Mukdahan (Thai: มุกดาหาร [múk̚dāːhǎːn]; Isan: มุกดาหาร [mùk̚dàːhǎːn]) is a border province located in the upper northeastern region of Thailand. Its topography lies within the Sakon Nakhon basin, with the Mekong River serving as a natural boundary separating Mukdahan province from Savannakhet province, Laos.

Q335492.name: Ratchaburi
Q335492.about: Ratchaburi province (Thai: จังหวัดราชบุรี, pronounced [t͡ɕāŋ.wàt râːt.t͡ɕʰā.bū.rīː]) or Rat Buri (pronounced [râːt bū.rīː]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) lies in Western Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Kanchanaburi, Nakhon Pathom, Samut Sakhon, Samut Songkhram and Phetchaburi.

Q337514.name: Adamawa State
Q337514.about: Adamawa () is a state in the North-East geopolitical zone of Nigeria, bordered by Borno to the northwest, Gombe to the west, and Taraba to the southwest while its eastern border forms part of the national border with Cameroon. It takes its name from the historic emirate of Adamawa, with the emirate's old capital of Yola serving as the capital city of Adamawa State.

Q343908.name: Imishli District
Q343908.about: Imishli District (Azerbaijani: İmişli rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country and belongs to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q351514.name: Adamawa
Q351514.about: The Adamawa Region (French: Région de l'Adamaoua) is a constituent region of the Republic of Cameroon. It borders the Centre and East regions to the south, the Northwest and West regions to the southwest, Nigeria to the west, the Central African Republic (CAR) to the east, and the North Region to the north.

Q1223.name: Washington
Q1223.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1223.about: Washington is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is often referred to as Washington state to distinguish it from the national capital; both are named after George Washington, a U.S. Founding Father and the first U.S. president.
Q1223.img: Mount Rainier from Clear Lake, Washington.jpg

Q1196.name: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
Q1196.desc: federated state of Germany, re-established in 1990
Q1196.about: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (MV; German: [ˌmeːklənbʊʁkˈfoːɐ̯pɔmɐn] or [ˌmɛk-] ; Low German: Mäkelborg-Vörpommern), often known by its anglicised name Mecklenburg–West Pomerania, is a coastal state in the north-east of Germany. Of the country's sixteen states, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern ranks 14th in population; it covers an area of 23,300 km2 (9,000 sq mi), making it the sixth largest German state in area; and it is 16th in population density.
Q1196.img: Schwerin Castle Aerial View Island Luftbild Schweriner Schloss Insel See.jpg

Q1207.name: North Dakota
Q1207.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1207.about: North Dakota (   də-KOH-tə) is a landlocked U.S. state in the Upper Midwest, named after the indigenous Dakota and Sioux peoples. It is bordered by the Canadian provinces of Saskatchewan and Manitoba to the north and by the U.S. states of Minnesota to the east, South Dakota to the south, and Montana to the west.

Q130840.name: Eastern Cape
Q130840.desc: province of South Africa formed in 1994, comprising former Xhosa bantustans Transkei and Ciskei; capital Bhisho, largest city Gqeberha; traditional homeland of the Xhosa people
Q130840.about: The Eastern Cape (Afrikaans: Oos-Kaap [ˈuəs.kɑːp]; Xhosa: eMpuma-Kapa; Khoekhoe: Aiǂoas!hub) is one of the nine provinces of South Africa. Its capital is Bhisho, and its largest city is Gqeberha (formerly Port Elizabeth).

Q131293.name: Mardin Province
Q131293.about: Mardin Province (Turkish: Mardin ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Mêrdîn; Arabic: محافظة ماردين; Classical Syriac: ܡܪܕܝܢ ܗܘܦܪܟܝܐ) is a province and metropolitan municipality in Turkey. Its area is 8,780 km2, and its population is 870,374 (2022).

Q134228.name: Ardabil Province
Q134228.about: Ardabil province (Persian: استان اردبیل) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Ardabil.

Q1397.name: Ohio
Q1397.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1397.about: Ohio (  oh-HY-oh) is a state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders the Canadian province of Ontario to the north (through Lake Erie), Pennsylvania to the east, West Virginia to the southeast, Kentucky to the southwest, Indiana to the west, and Michigan to the northwest.

Q1400.name: Pennsylvania
Q1400.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1400.about: Pennsylvania, officially the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, is a state located in the Mid-Atlantic, Northeastern, Appalachian, and Great Lakes regions of the United States. The state borders Delaware to its southeast, Maryland to its south, forming the Mason–Dixon line, West Virginia to its southwest, Ohio to its west, the Canadian province of Ontario to its northwest via Lake Erie, New York to its north, and the Delaware River and New Jersey to its east.

Q1363.name: Tripura
Q1363.about: Tripura () is a state in northeastern India. The third-smallest state in the country, it covers 10,491 km2 (4,051 sq mi); and the seventh-least populous state with a population of 3.67 million.

Q853460.name: Savanes Region
Q853460.about: Savanes Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q854443.name: Ungheni District
Q854443.about: Ungheni (Romanian pronunciation: [uŋˈɡenʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the central part of Moldova, bordering Romania, with the administrative center at Ungheni. The other major city is Cornești.

Q857122.name: South
Q857122.about: The South Region (French: Région du Sud) is located in the southwestern and south-central portion of the Republic of Cameroon. It is bordered to the east by the East Region, to the north by the Centre Region, to the northwest by the Littoral Region, to the west by the Gulf of Guinea (part of the Atlantic Ocean), and to the south by the countries of Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, and Congo.

Q860716.name: Glodeni District
Q860716.about: Glodeni District (Romanian pronunciation: [ɡloˈdenʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in northwestern Moldova, with its administrative center at Glodeni. As of the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 35,829.

Q861539.name: Braničevo District
Q861539.about: The Braničevo District (Serbian: Браничевски округ, romanized: Braničevski okrug, pronounced [brǎnitʃɛv̞skiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. According to the 2022 census, it has a population of 156,367 inhabitants.

Q861914.name: Tillabéri Region
Q861914.about: Tillabéri (var. Tillabéry) is one of the seven regions of Niger.

Q862611.name: Boké Region
Q862611.about: Boké Region (N'Ko: ߓߏ߬ߞߋ߫ ߕߌ߲߬ߞߎߘߎ߲) is located in western Guinea. It is bordered by the countries of Senegal and Guinea-Bissau and the Guinean regions of Kindia and Labé.

Q466538.name: Cabo Delgado Province
Q466538.about: Cabo Delgado is the northernmost province of Mozambique. It has an area of 82,625 km2 (31,902 mi2) and a population of 2,320,261 (2017).

Q468547.name: Nakhon Phanom
Q468547.about: Nakhon Phanom province (Thai: นครพนม, pronounced [ná(ʔ).kʰɔ̄ːn pʰā.nōm], lit. 'Mountain City'; Northeastern Thai: นครพนม, pronounced [nà(ʔ).kʰɔ᷇ːn pʰā.no᷇m]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) and lies in upper northeastern Thailand, also called Isan. Directly adjacent provinces are, from the south clockwise, Mukdahan, Sakon Nakhon, and Bueng Kan.

Q483154.name: Gaziantep Province
Q483154.about: Gaziantep Province (Turkish: Gaziantep ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in south-central Turkey. It is located in the westernmost part of Turkey's Southeastern Anatolia Region and partially in the Mediterranean Region.

Q487389.name: Lebap Region
Q487389.about: Lebap Region (Turkmen: Lebap welaýaty, IPA: [leˈbɑːp βeˌɫɑːjɑˈtɯ]) is one of the five regions of Turkmenistan. It borders Afghanistan and Uzbekistan along the Amu Darya river.

Q1502.name: Mizoram
Q1502.about: Mizoram is a state in northeastern India, with Aizawl as its capital and largest city. It shares 722 kilometres (449 miles) of international borders with Bangladesh to the west, and Myanmar to the east and south, with domestic borders with the Indian states of Assam, Manipur, and Tripura.
Q1502.img: Champhai, Mizoram, from south, with Zotlang in the foreground.jpg

Q1527.name: Minnesota
Q1527.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1527.about: Minnesota is a state in the Upper Midwestern region of the United States. It is bordered by the Canadian provinces of Manitoba and Ontario to the north and east and by the U.S. states of Wisconsin to the east, Iowa to the south, and North Dakota and South Dakota to the west.

Q388469.name: Şanlıurfa Province
Q388469.about: Şanlıurfa Province (Turkish: Şanlıurfa ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Rihayê), also known as Urfa Province, is a province and metropolitan municipality in southeastern Turkey. The city of Şanlıurfa is the capital of the province which bears its name.

Q390377.name: Vientiane
Q390377.desc: nine-municipality conurbation serving as the capital of Laos
Q390377.about: Vientiane Prefecture (Lao: ນະຄອນຫຼວງວຽງຈັນ, Nakhôn Louang Viengchan, pronounced [nā(ʔ).kʰɔ́ːn lǔaŋ wíaŋ tɕàn], RTGS: Nakhon Luang Wiang Chan) is a prefecture of Laos, in northwest Laos. The national capital, Vientiane, is in the prefecture.
Q390377.img: タートルアン湿地特定経済区2.jpg

Q397737.name: Brong-Ahafo Region
Q397737.about: The Brong-Ahafo region was a region in central Ghana. Brong-Ahafo was bordered to the north by the Black Volta river and to the east by the Lake Volta, and to the south by the Ashanti, Eastern and Western regions.

Q399899.name: Ahal Region
Q399899.about: Ahal Region (Turkmen: Ahal welaýaty, IPA: [ɑˈχɑːɫ βeˌɫɑːjɑˈtɯ]) is one of five provinces of Turkmenistan. It borders Iran and Afghanistan along the Kopet Dag range.

Q425782.name: Central Banat District
Q425782.about: The Central Banat District (Serbian: Средњобанатски округ, romanized: Srednjobanatski okrug, pronounced [srêdɲoːbǎnaːtskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the geographical region of Banat.

Q429908.name: Benue State
Q429908.about: Benue is a state in the North Central region of Nigeria. It is popularly referred to as part of the Middle Belt.

Q4341.name: Primorsky Krai
Q4341.desc: federal subject of Russia, krai of Russia
Q4341.about: Primorsky Krai, informally known as Primorye, is a federal subject (a krai) of Russia, part of the Far Eastern Federal District in the Russian Far East. The city of Vladivostok on the southern coast of the krai is its administrative center, and the second largest city in the Russian Far East, behind Khabarovsk in the neighbouring Khabarovsk Krai.
Q4341.img: Partizansky District, Primorsky Krai, Russia - panoramio (12).jpg

Q6809.name: Buryatia
Q6809.about: Buryatia, officially the Republic of Buryatia, is a republic of Russia located in the Russian Far East. Formerly part of the Siberian Federal District, it has been administered as part of the Far Eastern Federal District since 2018.

Q164193.name: Lviv Oblast
Q164193.about: Lviv Oblast (Ukrainian: Львівська область, romanized: Lvivska oblast, IPA: [ˈlʲwiu̯sʲkɐ ˈɔblɐsʲtʲ]), also referred to as Lvivshchyna (Ukrainian: Львівщина, IPA: [ˈlʲwiu̯ʃtʃɪnɐ]), is an oblast in western Ukraine. The administrative center of the oblast is the city of Lviv.

Q165956.name: North West
Q165956.about: North West (Afrikaans: Noord-Wes [nuərtˈvɛs]; Tswana: Bokone Bophirima) is a province of South Africa. Its capital is Mahikeng.

Q166709.name: Vinnytsia Oblast
Q166709.desc: administrative division (oblast) in center of Ukraine
Q166709.about: Vinnytsia Oblast (Ukrainian: Вінницька область, romanized: Vinnytska oblast, IPA: [ˈwinːɪtsʲkɐ ˈɔblɐsʲtʲ]), also referred to as Vinnychchyna (Ukrainian: Вінниччина), is an oblast in central Ukraine. Its administrative center is Vinnytsia.

Q750447.name: Madaba Governorate
Q750447.about: Madaba (Arabic مادبا) is one of the governorates of Jordan. It is located southwest of Amman, the capital of Jordan, and its capital is Madaba.

Q753795.name: Briceni District
Q753795.about: Briceni (Romanian pronunciation: [briˈtʃenʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the north-west of Moldova, with the administrative center at Briceni. The other major city is Lipcani.

Q775410.name: Sangha Department
Q775410.desc: department of the Republic of Congo
Q775410.about: Sangha is a department of the Republic of the Congo in the northern part of the country. It borders the departments of Cuvette, Cuvette-Ouest, and Likouala, and internationally, Cameroon, Gabon and the Central African Republic.

Q809733.name: Bas-Sassandra Region
Q809733.about: Bas-Sassandra Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q810484.name: Basse-Kotto Prefecture
Q810484.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q810484.about: Basse-Kotto ([bas ko.to], "Lower Kotto") is one of the 20 and the least populated prefecture of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Mobaye.
Q810484.img: Pêcheries dans le Rapide de Mobaye.jpg

Q817327.name: Thaba-Tseka District
Q817327.about: Thaba-Tseka is a district of Lesotho. Thaba-Tseka is also the name of the district's capital or camptown, which is the only town in the district.

Q817342.name: Mafeteng District
Q817342.about: Mafeteng is a district of Lesotho. It has an area of 2,119 km2 and a population in 2016 of 178,222.

Q817340.name: Mokhotlong District
Q817340.about: Mokhotlong (in Sesotho language "the place of the bald ibis") is a district of Lesotho. It includes the highest terrain in the Maloti Mountains and the source of the Senqu River, Lesotho's primary watershed.

Q431385.name: Bururi Province
Q431385.about: Bururi was one of the provinces of Burundi. It was formerly Burundi's largest province until the communes of Burambi, Buyengero and Rumonge were transferred to the province of Rumonge when it was created in 2015.

Q456847.name: Shan State
Q456847.desc: state in Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Q456847.about: Shan State (Shan: မိူင်းတႆး, Möng Tai; Burmese: ရှမ်းပြည်နယ်, pronounced [ʃáɰ̃ pjìnɛ̀]) is a state and first-level administrative division of Myanmar. Shan State borders China (Yunnan) to the north, Laos (Louang Namtha and Bokeo Provinces) to the east, and Thailand (Chiang Rai, Chiang Mai and Mae Hong Son provinces) to the south, and five administrative divisions of Myanmar in the west (Kachin State, Mandalay Region, Kayin State, Kayah State, and Sagaing Region).

Q457189.name: Mashonaland West Province
Q457189.about: Mashonaland West is a province of Zimbabwe. It has an area of 57,441 km² and a population of approximately 1.9 million (2022).

Q457491.name: Jabrayil District
Q457491.about: Jabrayil District (Azerbaijani: Cəbrayıl rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the south-west of the country and belongs to the East Zangezur Economic Region.

Q459732.name: Sylhet Division
Q459732.about: Sylhet Division (Bengali: সিলেট বিভাগ, pronounced [sileʈ bibʱaɡ] ) is the northeastern division of Bangladesh. It covers an area of approximately 12,000 km2 (4,600 sq mi), and shares international borders with the Indian states of Meghalaya, Assam and Tripura to the north, east and south respectively—while domestically it adjoins the divisions of Chattogram to the southwest and Dhaka and Mymensingh to the west.

Q372795.name: Jalilabad District
Q372795.about: Jalilabad District (Azerbaijani: Cəlilabad rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the southeast of the country and belongs to the Lankaran-Astara Economic Region.

Q378970.name: Ombella-M'Poko Prefecture
Q378970.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q378970.about: Ombella-M'Poko is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Boali since 10 December 2020, after the former capital Bimbo had to become part of Bangui Prefecture.

Q385584.name: Salamat Region
Q385584.about: Salamat (Arabic: سلامات, romanised: Salāmāt) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad, located in the south-east of the country. The region's capital is Am Timan.

Q385973.name: Soum Province
Q385973.about:
Djelgodji (known as Soum since 2025) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sahel Region.
Its capital is Djibo.

Q145793.name: Zamfara State
Q145793.about: Zamfara  (Hausa: Jihar Zamfara; Fula: Leydi Zamfara; Adlam: 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤣𞤭 𞤶𞤢𞤥𞤬𞤢𞤪𞤢) is a state in northwestern Nigeria. The capital of Zamfara state is Gusau and its current governor is Dauda Lawal.

Q147081.name: Zanzan Region
Q147081.about: Zanzan Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.
Q147081.img: Climat et météo le musée de Bondoukou photo Cisse Mohamed from Wiki Loves Africa Côte d'Ivoire Fan Club 14.png

Q153009.name: Brunei-Muara District
Q153009.about: Brunei–Muara District (Malay: Daerah Brunei–Muara; Jawi: دايره بروني موارا), or simply known as Brunei–Muara (BROO-nai moo-WAH-rah), is the smallest as well as the most populated district in Brunei. It has an area of 571 square kilometres (220 sq mi) and the population of 318,530 as of 2021.

Q160284.name: Free State
Q160284.about: The Free State is a province of South Africa. Its capital is Bloemfontein, which is also South Africa's judicial capital.

Q737086.name: Berea District
Q737086.about: Berea is a district of Lesotho. In the west, Berea borders on the Free State Province of South Africa.

Q738382.name: Southern Province
Q738382.about: Southern Province is one of Zambia's ten provinces. It is home to Zambia's premier tourist attraction, Mosi-oa-Tunya (Victoria Falls), shared with Zimbabwe.

Q739676.name: Cross River State
Q739676.about: Cross River State is a state in the South-South geopolitical zone of Nigeria. Named for the Cross River, the state was formed from the eastern part of the Eastern Region on 27 May 1967.

Q741025.name: Bamingui-Bangoran Prefecture
Q741025.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q741025.about: Bamingui-Bangoran is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. It covers an area of 58,200 km2 and had a population of 43,229 as of the 2003 census.

Q747881.name: Luang Prabang Province
Q747881.about: Luang Prabang (also Louangphabang, Lao: ຫລວງພະບາງ, pronounced [lǔaŋ pʰā(ʔ).bàːŋ]) is a province in northern Laos. Its capital of the same name, Luang Prabang, was the capital of the Lan Xang Kingdom during the 13th to 16th centuries.

Q750259.name: Tafilah Governorate
Q750259.about:
Tafilah (Arabic: الطفيلة) is one of the governorates of Jordan, located about 180 km south-west of Amman, Jordan's capital.
Tafilah Governorate is bordered by Karak Governorate to the north, Ma'an Governorate to the east and south, Aqaba Governorate to the south, and by Israel to the west.

Q1599.name: Nagaland
Q1599.about: Nagaland () is a state in the north-eastern region of India. It is bordered by the Indian states of Arunachal Pradesh to the north, Assam to the west, Manipur to the south, and the Naga Self-Administered Zone of the Sagaing Region of Myanmar (Burma) to the east.

Q1749.name: Kaliningrad Oblast
Q1749.desc: exclave of Russia bounded by Poland, Lithuania, and the Baltic Sea
Q1749.about: Kaliningrad Oblast (Russian: Калининградская область, romanized: Kaliningradskaya oblastʹ) is the westernmost federal subject of Russia. It is a semi-exclave on the Baltic Sea within the historical Baltic region of Prussia, bordered by Poland to the south, Lithuania to the north and east, and the Baltic Sea to the west.

Q1904.name: Ontario
Q1904.about: Ontario is the southernmost province of Canada. Located in Central Canada, Ontario is the country's most populous province.
Q1904.img: ISS059-E-98049 - View of the Province of Ontario.jpg

Q823762.name: Ogooué-Lolo Province
Q823762.about: The Ogooué-Lolo Province is one of the nine provinces of Gabon, slightly southeast of central Gabon. The regional capital is Koulamoutou, a city of approximately 16,000 people.

Q823774.name: Ngounié Province
Q823774.about: Ngounié is a province of south-central Gabon covering an area of 3,775 kilometres (2,346 mi). Its capital is Mouila.

Q823800.name: Woleu-Ntem Province
Q823800.about: Woleu-Ntem is the northernmost of Gabon's nine provinces. It covers an area of 38,465 km2 and named after Woleu and Ntem rivers that cross it.

Q823822.name: Ogooué-Ivindo Province
Q823822.about: Ogooué-Ivindo Province is the northeasternmost of Gabon's nine provinces, though its Lopé Department is in the very center of the country. It gets its name from two rivers, the Ogooué and the Ivindo.

Q823946.name: Northwest
Q823946.about: The Northwest Region, or North-West Region (French: Région du Nord-Ouest) is a region with special status in Cameroon. Its capital is Bamenda.

Q823976.name: Far North
Q823976.about: The Far North Region, also known as the Extreme North Region (French: Région de l'Extrême-Nord; Adamawa Fulfulde: woilare) is the northernmost and most populous constituent province of the Republic of Cameroon. It borders the North Region to the south, Chad to the east, and Nigeria to the west.

Q837889.name: Stung Treng Province
Q837889.about: Stung Treng (Khmer: ស្ទឹងត្រែង, Stœ̆ng Trêng [stɨŋ traeŋ]; Lao: ຊຽງແຕງ, Xiang Taeng [sía̯ŋ tɛ̀ːŋ]; lit. 'river of reeds') is a province of Cambodia in the northeast. It borders the provinces of Ratanakiri to the east, Mondulkiri and Kratié to the south and Kampong Thom and Preah Vihear to the west.

Q839060.name: Quthing District
Q839060.about: Quthing is a district of Lesotho. The town of Quthing (also known as Moyeni) is the camp town or capital of the district.

Q818742.name: Mon State
Q818742.about: Mon State (Burmese: မွန်ပြည်နယ်, pronounced [mʊ̀ɴ pjìnɛ̀]; Mon: တွဵုရးဍုင်မန်) is an administrative division of Myanmar. It lies between Kayin State to the east, the Andaman Sea to the west, Bago Region to the north and Tanintharyi Region to the south, also having a short border with Thailand's Kanchanaburi Province at its south-eastern tip.

Q819987.name: Leribe District
Q819987.about: Leribè is a district of Lesotho. It has an area of 2,828 km2 and a population in 2016 of approximately 337,500.

Q819998.name: Lusaka Province
Q819998.about: Lusaka Province is one of the ten provinces of Zambia. It is the smallest in terms of land area, covering 21,896 km2.

Q821037.name: Lobaye Prefecture
Q821037.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q821037.about: Lobaye [lo.bɛ] is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Mbaïki.

Q822566.name: Rutana Province
Q822566.about: Rutana was one of the provinces of Burundi. In 2025, it became part of the new province of Burunga.

Q822578.name: Ruyigi Province
Q822578.about: Ruyigi Province was one of the provinces of Burundi. In 2025, it was merged into the new province of Buhumuza.

Q823740.name: Makamba Province
Q823740.about: Makamba was a province of Burundi. The province had a population of 430,899 (2008 census) and covers an area of 1,960 km2.
Q823740.img: ACRC project in Makamba - Flickr - Dave Proffer.jpg

Q1948.name: Manitoba
Q1948.about: Manitoba is a province of Canada at the longitudinal centre of the country. It is Canada's fifth-most populous province, with an estimated population of 1,517,379 as of 2026.
Q1948.img: Deep Lake - Riding Mountain National Park.JPG

Q170666.name: Kharkiv Oblast
Q170666.about:
Kharkiv Oblast (Ukrainian: Харківська область, romanized: Kharkivska oblast, Russian: Харьковская область, romanized: Kharkovskaya oblast), also referred to as Kharkivshchyna (Ukrainian: Харківщина), is an oblast (province) in eastern Ukraine.
Kharkiv borders Luhansk Oblast to the east, Donetsk Oblast to the southeast, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast to the southwest, Poltava Oblast to the west, Sumy Oblast to the northwest and Russia's Belgorod Oblast to the north.

Q171314.name: Eastern Macedonia and Thrace Region
Q171314.desc: one of the 13 administrative regions of Greece
Q171314.about: Eastern Macedonia and Thrace ( MASS-ə-DOH-nee-ə; Greek: Ανατολική Μακεδονία και Θράκη, romanized: Anatolikí Makedonía ke Thráki, [anatoliˈci maceðoˈnia ce ˈθraci]) is one of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece. It consists of the eastern parts of Northern Greece, comprising the eastern part of Greek Macedonia along with Greek Thrace, and the islands of Thasos and Samothrace.

Q171852.name: Odesa Oblast
Q171852.about: Odesa Oblast (Ukrainian: Одеська область, romanized: Odeska oblast), also referred to as Odeshchyna (Одещина), is an oblast (province) of southwestern Ukraine, located along the northern coast of the Black Sea. Its administrative centre is the city of Odesa.

Q134386.name: Kurdistan Province
Q134386.about: Kurdistan province (Persian: استان کردستان Ostān-e Kordestān) is one of 31 provinces of Iran. The province is 28,817 km2 (11,126 sq mi) in area and its capital is the city of Sanandaj.

Q134907.name: Limpopo
Q134907.about: Limpopo () is the northernmost province of South Africa. It is named after the Limpopo River, which forms the province's western and northern borders.

Q140646.name: Kachin State
Q140646.about: Kachin State (Burmese: ကချင်ပြည်နယ်; Kachin: Jinghpaw Mungdaw) is the northernmost state of Myanmar. It is bordered by China to the north and east (Tibet and Yunnan, respectively), Shan State to the south, and Sagaing Region and India (Arunachal Pradesh) to the west.

Q167199.name: Vaslui County
Q167199.about: Vaslui County (Romanian pronunciation: [vasˈluj]) is a county (județ) of Romania, in the historical region Western Moldavia, with the seat at Vaslui.

Q167514.name: Logone Oriental Region
Q167514.about: Logone Oriental (Arabic: لوغون الشرقي, romanised: Lūghūn ash-Sharqī) is one of the 23 regions of Chad, located in the south-west of the country. Its capital is Doba.

Q167764.name: Zavkhan Province
Q167764.about: Zavkhan (; Mongolian: Завхан ᠵᠠᠪᠬᠠᠨ [ˈt͡saw̜χəɴ]), also spelt Zaukhan or Zabhkhan is one of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia, located in the west of the country, 1,104 km from Ulaanbaatar. Its capital is Uliastai.

Q168856.name: Chernivtsi Oblast
Q168856.about: Chernivtsi Oblast (Ukrainian: Чернівецька область, romanized: Chernivetska oblast), also referred to as Chernivechchyna (Чернівеччина), is an oblast (province) in western Ukraine, consisting of the northern parts of the historical regions of Bukovina and Bessarabia. It has an international border with Romania and Moldova.

Q1951.name: Alberta
Q1951.about: Alberta is a province in Western Canada and is one of the three prairie provinces. Alberta is bordered by British Columbia to its west, Saskatchewan to its east, the Northwest Territories to its north, and the U.S. state of Montana to its south.

Q1989.name: Saskatchewan
Q1989.about: Saskatchewan is a province in Western Canada. It is bordered to the west by Alberta, to the north by the Northwest Territories, to the east by Manitoba, to the northeast by Nunavut, and to the south by the United States (Montana and North Dakota).
Q1989.img: Satellite photo of Northern Saskatchewan, Northwest Territories, Canada.A2001185.1815.250m.jpg

Q1061128.name: Dondușeni District
Q1061128.about: Dondușeni District (Romanian pronunciation: [donduˈʃenʲ]) is a district (raion) in the north of Moldova. Its administrative center is the city of Dondușeni.

Q1074161.name: Houet Province
Q1074161.desc: province in Hauts-Bassins Region, Burkina Faso
Q1074161.about: Houet is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Hauts-Bassins Region. The capital of Houet is Bobo-Dioulasso.

Q1074485.name: Kossi Province
Q1074485.about: The Province de la Kossin (known as Kossi until 2025) lies in the western part of Burkina Faso and stretches to the border with Mali. It is in the Boucle du Mouhoun Region.

Q1074496.name: Comoé Province
Q1074496.about: Comoé is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Cascades Region. The capital of Comoé is Banfora.

Q1074521.name: Yatenga Province
Q1074521.about: Yatenga is one of the provinces of Burkina Faso, located in the Nord Region of the country. In modern Yatenga, the most prominent city is Ouahigouya (also known as Waiguya).

Q1104675.name: Kardzhali
Q1104675.about: Kardzhali Province  (Bulgarian: Област Кърджали, romanized: Oblast Kărdžali) is a province of southern Bulgaria, neighbouring Greece with the Greek regional units of Xanthi, Rhodope, and Evros to the south and east. It is 3,209.1 km2 in area.

Q1142054.name: Loroum Province
Q1142054.about: Loroum is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, a landlocked country in West Africa. It is located in its Nord Region with its seat at the city of Titao.

Q1142059.name: Kompienga Province
Q1142059.about:
Kompienga is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Est Region.
The capital of Kompienga is Pama.

Q907395.name: Dobrich
Q907395.about: Dobrich Province (Bulgarian: Област Добрич, Oblast Dobrich, former name Dobrich okrug) is a province in northeastern Bulgaria, part of Southern Dobruja geographical region. It is bounded on the east by the Black Sea, on the south by Varna Province, on the west by Shumen and Silistra provinces, and on the north by Romania.

Q910393.name: Mayo-Kebbi Ouest Region
Q910393.about: Mayo-Kebbi Ouest (Arabic: مايو كيبي الغربية) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad. Its capital is Pala.

Q911421.name: Mayo-Kebbi Est Region
Q911421.about: Mayo-Kebbi Est (Arabic: مايو كيبي الشرقي, romanised: Māyū Kībī ash-Sharqī) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad. Its capital is Bongor.

Q928828.name: Gilan Province
Q928828.about: Gilan Province (Persian: استان گیلان) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran, in the northwest of the country and southwest of the Caspian Sea. Its capital is the city of Rasht.

Q949332.name: Macenta Prefecture
Q949332.about: Macenta is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Macenta.

Q839074.name: Mohale's Hoek District
Q839074.about: Mohale's Hoek is a district of Lesotho. Mohale's Hoek is the capital city or camptown, and only town in the district.

Q842495.name: Sud-Comoé
Q842495.about: Sud-Comoé Region is one of the 31 regions of Ivory Coast. Since 2011, it has been one of two regions in Comoé District.

Q842499.name: Moyen-Cavally
Q842499.about: Moyen-Cavally Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 2000 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q843954.name: Tanintharyi Region
Q843954.about: Tanintharyi Region (; formerly Tenasserim Division and Tanintharyi Division) is a first-level administrative division of Myanmar, covering the long narrow southern part of the country on the northern Malay Peninsula, reaching to the Kra Isthmus. It borders the Andaman Sea to the west and the Tenasserim Hills, beyond which lie Thailand, to the east.

Q843975.name: Chari-Baguirmi Region
Q843975.about: Chari-Baguirmi (Arabic: شاري باقرمي, romanised: Shārī Bāqirmī) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad. Its capital is Massenya.

Q844921.name: Maseru District
Q844921.about: Maseru is a district of Lesotho. Maseru is also the name of the district's capital, and is the only city in the district and also the capital of the country.

Q846017.name: Nyanga Province
Q846017.about: Nyanga is the southernmost of Gabon's nine provinces. The provincial capital is Tchibanga, which had a total of 31,294 inhabitants in 2013 (more than the half of the province population).

Q847289.name: Sagaing Region
Q847289.about: Sagaing Region (Burmese: စစ်ကိုင်းတိုင်းဒေသကြီး, pronounced [zəɡáɪ̯ɰ̃ táɪ̯ɰ̃ dèθa̰ dʑí]; formerly Sagaing Division) is a first-level administrative division of Myanmar, located in the north-western part of the country between latitude 21° 30' north and longitude 94° 97' east. It is bordered by Chin State and India's Nagaland, Manipur, and Arunachal Pradesh states to the west and north, Kachin State, Shan State, and Mandalay Region to the east and Mandalay Region and Magway Region to the south.

Q848560.name: Ouaka Prefecture
Q848560.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848560.about: Ouaka [wa.ka] is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. It borders the Democratic Republic of the Congo, covers an area of 49,900 km2, and has a population of 276,710 (2003 census).

Q2347.name: Smolensk Oblast
Q2347.about: Smolensk Oblast, informally also called Smolenshchina, is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative centre is the city of Smolensk.
Q2347.img: Regional border sign in Smolensk Oblast.jpg

Q2810.name: Bryansk Oblast
Q2810.about: Bryansk Oblast, also known as Bryanshchina, is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Bryansk.
Q2810.img: Брянск. Введенская ц. Петропавловского женского мон..JPG

Q848572.name: Kémo Prefecture
Q848572.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848572.about: Kémo [ke.mo] is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Sibut.
Q848572.img: Séminaire Saint Marc de Sibut, Centrafrique.jpg

Q848582.name: Mbomou Prefecture
Q848582.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848582.about: Mbomou is one of the twenty prefectures of the Central African Republic. It covers an area of 61,150 square kilometres (23,610 sq mi) and has a population of 164,009 (according to a 2003 census).

Q848591.name: Ouham-Pendé Prefecture
Q848591.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848591.about: Ouham-Pendé is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Bozoum.

Q850036.name: Maradi Region
Q850036.about: The Region of Maradi is one of seven regions of Niger.  It is located in south-central Niger, east of the Region of Tahoua, west of Zinder, and north of the Nigerian city of Katsina.

Q850055.name: Dosso Region
Q850055.about: Dosso is one of the seven regions of Niger. The region has an area of 31,002 square kilometres (11,970 sq mi), with a population of 2,754,500 as of 2020.

Q850423.name: Qacha's Nek District
Q850423.about: Qacha's Nek is a district of Lesotho. Qacha's Nek is the capital or camptown, and the only town in the district.

Q460538.name: Bubanza Province
Q460538.about: Bubanza was one of the provinces of Burundi. In 2025, it was merged into the new Bujumbura Province.

Q461298.name: Sikasso Region
Q461298.about: Sikasso Region (Bambara: ߛߌߞߊߛߏ ߘߌߣߋߖߊ tr. Sikaso Dineja; Supyire: Sukwoo Síŋi) is the southernmost region of Mali.

Q463959.name: Taraba State
Q463959.desc: state in the northern part of Nigeria
Q463959.about: Taraba () is a state in north-eastern Nigeria, named after the Taraba River, which traverses the southern part of the state. It is nicknamed "Nature's Gift to the Nation".

Q465929.name: Sainyabūlī
Q465929.about: Sainyabuli province (Lao: ໄຊຍະບູລີ, pronounced [sáj.ɲā.bùː.líː]; alternate spellings: Xayabuli, Xaignabouri, Xayaboury, Sayabouli, Sayabouri) is a province in northwest Laos. The capital of the province is the town of Saiyabuli.

Q465940.name: Savannakhet Province
Q465940.about: Savannakhet (Lao: ສະຫວັນນະເຂດ, pronounced [sā.wǎn nā(ʔ).kʰȅːt]) is a province of Laos. The name of Savannakhet Province derives from old Pali-Sanskrit language, meaning “a field of gold”.

Q465947.name: Xiangkhouang Province
Q465947.about: Xiangkhouang (Lao: ຊຽງຂວາງ, meaning 'Horizontal City'), also spelled Siang Khuang, is a province of Laos on the Xiangkhoang Plateau. It has the distinction of being the most heavily bombed place on Earth.

Q171965.name: Luhansk Oblast
Q171965.about: Luhansk Oblast (Ukrainian: Луганська область, romanized: Luhanska oblast; Russian: Луганская область, romanized: Luganskaya oblast), also referred to as Luhanshchyna (Луганщина), is the easternmost oblast (province) of Ukraine. Its administrative center is the city of Luhansk.

Q172052.name: Badghis Province
Q172052.about: Badghis (Dari: ولایت بادغیس, romanized: Wilāyat-e Bādghīs and Pashto: د بادغیس ولایت, romanized: Da Bādghīs Wilāyat) is one of the northwestern provinces of Afghanistan. It borders Turkmenistan to the north, Herat to the west and southwest, Ghor to the south and southeast, and Faryab to the east.

Q173830.name: Faryab Province
Q173830.about: Faryab (Pashto, Dari: فاریاب) is one of the thirty-four provinces of Afghanistan, which is located in the north of the country bordering neighboring Turkmenistan. It has a population of about 1,109,223, which is multi-ethnic and mostly a tribal society.

Q174010.name: Kermanshah Province
Q174010.about: Kermanshah province (Persian: استان كرمانشاه) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran, bordering Iraq. Its capital is the city of Kermanshah.

Q244628.name: Prachuap Khiri Khan
Q244628.about: Prachuap Khiri Khan (Thai: ประจวบคีรีขันธ์, pronounced [prā.tɕùap kʰīː.rīː kʰǎn]) is one of the western provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It is in the northern part of the Malay Peninsula, some 240 km (149 mi) south of Bangkok.

Q244695.name: Chumphon
Q244695.about: Chumphon (Thai: ชุมพร, pronounced [t͡ɕʰūm.pʰɔ̄ːn]) is a southern province (changwat) of Thailand on the Gulf of Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are Prachuap Khiri Khan, Surat Thani, and Ranong.

Q244698.name: Nan
Q244698.about: Nan (Thai: น่าน, pronounced [nâːn]; Northern Thai: ᨶᩣ᩠᩵ᨶ) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat), and lies in upper northern Thailand.  Neighboring provinces are (from south clockwise): Uttaradit, Phrae, and Phayao.

Q244699.name: Phetchaburi
Q244699.about: Phetchaburi (Thai: เพชรบุรี, pronounced [pʰét.tɕʰā.bū.rīː]) or Phet Buri (pronounced [pʰét bū.rīː]) is one of the western or central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It lies at the north end of the Malay Peninsula, between the Gulf of Thailand and the Tanaosi range on the Myanmar border.
Q244699.img: วัดใหญ่สุวรรณาราม จังหวัดเพชรบุรี 03.JPG

Q244788.name: Khövsgöl Province
Q244788.about: Khövsgöl Province (Mongolian: Хөвсгөл аймаг) is the northernmost of the 21 provinces of Mongolia, bordering Buryatia and Tuva, Russia. Its name is derived from Lake Khövsgöl, the largest freshwater lake in the country.

Q3573.name: Rostov Oblast
Q3573.about: Rostov Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), located in the Southern Federal District. The oblast has an area of 100,967 square kilometers (38,984 sq mi) and a population of 4,200,729 (2021 Census), making it the sixth most populous federal subject in Russia.

Q3659.name: N'Djamena
Q3659.desc: capital and largest city of Chad
Q3659.about: N'Djamena (English:   ən-jah-MAY-nə) is the capital and largest city of Chad. It is also a Special Status Province, divided into 10 districts or arrondissements.

Q3832.name: Bangui
Q3832.desc: capital city of the Central African Republic
Q3832.about: Bangui (French pronunciation: [bɑ̃ɡi]; or Bangî in Sango, formerly written Bangi in English) is the capital and largest city of the Central African Republic. It was established as a French outpost in 1889 and named after its location on the northern bank of the Ubangi River (French: Oubangui); the Ubangi itself was named from the Bobangi word for the "rapids" located beside the settlement, which marked the end of navigable water north from Brazzaville.

Q872212.name: Gabú Region
Q872212.about: Gabú region is the easternmost region in Guinea-Bissau. Its capital is Gabú.

Q877578.name: Bong County
Q877578.desc: county in the north-central portion of Liberia
Q877578.about: Bong is a county in the north-central portion of the West African nation of Liberia. One of 15 counties that comprise the first-level of administrative division in the nation, it has twelve districts.

Q878266.name: Nisporeni District
Q878266.about:
Nisporeni (Romanian pronunciation: [nispoˈrenʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in west-central Moldova, with its administrative center at Nisporeni.
According to the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 36,413.
Q878266.img: Stephen the Great monument in Nisporeni.JPG

Q878290.name: Edineț District
Q878290.about: Edineț ([ediˈnets]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the northwestern part of Moldova, with its administrative center in the city of Edineț. The district’s other urban locality is Cupcini.
Q878290.img: Раонный совет, Единцы, Республика Молдова Consiliul Raional, Edinet, Republica Moldova District Council, Edinet, Republic of Moldova (50272906417).jpg

Q878297.name: Hîncești District
Q878297.about: Hîncești (Romanian pronunciation: [hɨnˈtʃeʃtʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) of Moldova, with the city of Hîncești as its administrative center. As of the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 69,462.

Q878375.name: Fălești District
Q878375.about: Fălești (pronunciation: [fəˈleʃtʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the north of Moldova, with its administrative center in the town of Fălești. The district borders Western Moldavia in Romania.

Q498351.name: Masvingo Province
Q498351.about: Masvingo, previously named Victoria,  is a province in southeastern Zimbabwe. It has a population of 1.638 million as of the 2022 census, ranking fifth out of Zimbabwe's ten provinces.

Q499465.name: Mtwara Region
Q499465.about: Mtwara Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Mtwara)  is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions, with its capital as the municipality of Mtwara. Mtwara Region is home to one of the most influential peoples in Tanzania, the Makonde.

Q502215.name: Northern Region
Q502215.about: The Northern Region is one of the sixteen regions of Ghana. It is situated in the northern part of the country and ranks as the second largest of the sixteen regions.

Q502341.name: North
Q502341.about: The North Region (French: Région du Nord) makes up 66,090 km2 of the northern half of The Republic of Cameroon. Neighbouring territories include the Far North Region to the north, the Adamawa Region to the south, Nigeria to the west, Chad to the east, and Central African Republic to the southeast.

Q502997.name: Hūaphan
Q502997.about: Houaphanh province (Lao: ຫົວພັນ, pronounced [hǔa.pʰán], Romanization of Lao: Houaphan also Huaphan) is a province in eastern Laos. Its capital is Xam Neua.

Q3178.name: Kursk Oblast
Q3178.about: Kursk Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Kursk.

Q3329.name: Belgorod Oblast
Q3329.about: Belgorod Oblast is a federal subject (an oblast) of Russia. Its administrative center is the city of Belgorod.

Q3447.name: Voronezh Oblast
Q3447.about: Voronezh Oblast (Russian: Воронежская о́бласть, romanized: Voroniežskaja oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Voronezh.
Q3447.img: Подсолнечные поля у села Боево Каширского района. Вид с трассы Воронеж - Нововоронеж.jpg

Q2012423.name: Silistra
Q2012423.about: Silistra Province (Bulgarian: Област Силистра, Oblast Silistra) is a province of Bulgaria. Formerly known as the Silistra okrug, it is located on the northeast corner of Bulgaria.

Q2012430.name: Smolyan
Q2012430.about: Smolyan Province (Bulgarian: Област Смолян, Oblast Smolyan; former name Smolyan okrug) is a province in Southern-central Bulgaria, located in the Rhodope Mountains, neighbouring Greece to the south. It is named after its administrative and industrial centre — the city of Smolyan.

Q2012621.name: Veliko Tarnovo
Q2012621.about: Veliko Tarnovo (Bulgarian: Област Велико Търново, romanized: Oblast Veliko Tǎrnovo) is a province in the middle of the northern part of Bulgaria. Its capital city, Veliko Tarnovo, is of historical significance as it was the capital of the Second Bulgarian Empire.

Q862753.name: Lékoumou Department
Q862753.desc: department of the Republic of the Congo
Q862753.about: Lékoumou (can also be written as Lekumu) is a department of the Republic of the Congo in the southern part of the country. It borders the departments of Bouenza, Niari, Plateaux, Pool, and the nation of Gabon.

Q865534.name: Sennar
Q865534.about: Sennar (Arabic: سنار Sannār) is one of the 18 wilayat or states of Sudan. It has an area of 37,844 km2 (14,612 sq mi) and had a population of approximately 1,918,692 in 2018.

Q865884.name: Taraclia District
Q865884.about: Taraclia (Romanian pronunciation: [taraˈkli.a], Bulgarian: Тараклия) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the south of Moldova, with the administrative center at Taraclia. It is surrounded by the Cahul District and the Autonomous Territorial Unit of Gagauzia, encompassing the enclave of Copceac.

Q868497.name: Nimba
Q868497.desc: county in the north-central portion of Liberia
Q868497.about: Nimba County is a county in northeastern Liberia that shares borders with the Republic of Côte d'Ivoire in the East and the Republic of Guinea in the Northwest. Its capital city is Sanniquellie and its most populous city is Ganta.

Q870138.name: Maryland County
Q870138.about: Maryland County is a county in the southeastern portion of Liberia. One of 15 counties that comprise the first-level of administrative division in the nation, it has two districts.

Q870155.name: Western Region
Q870155.about: The Western region, located in south Ghana, spreads from the Ivory Coast (Comoé District) in the west to the Central region in the east, includes the capital and large twin city of Sekondi-Takoradi on the coast, coastal Axim, and a hilly inland area including Elubo. It includes Ghana's southernmost location, Cape Three Points, where crude oil was discovered in commercial quantities in June 2007.

Q871083.name: Tahoua Region
Q871083.about: Tahoua is one of seven regions of Niger. The capital of the region is the commune of Tahoua.

Q193055.name: Giurgiu County
Q193055.about: Giurgiu (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈdʒjurdʒju] ) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Bulgaria, in Muntenia, with the capital city at Giurgiu.

Q193438.name: Shkodër County
Q193438.about: Shkodër County (Albanian: Qarku i Shkodrës) is a county in northwestern Albania, with the capital in Shkodër. The county spans 3,562 square kilometres (1,375 sq mi) and had a total population of 154,479 people as of the 2023 census.

Q200127.name: Tigray Region
Q200127.about: The Tigray Region (or simply Tigray; officially the Tigray National Regional State) is the northernmost regional state in Ethiopia. The Tigray Region is the homeland of the Tigrayan, Irob and Kunama people.

Q201147.name: Armavir Province
Q201147.about: Armavir (Armenian: Արմավիր, Armenian pronunciation: [ɑɾmɑˈviɾ] ), is a province (marz) in the western part of Armenia. Located in the Ararat plain dominated by Mount Ararat from the south and Mount Aragats from the north, the province's capital is the town of Armavir while the largest city is Vagharshapat (Etchmiadzin).

Q487702.name: Upper Nile
Q487702.about: Upper Nile is a state in South Sudan. The White Nile flows through the state, giving it its name.

Q488811.name: Jizzakh Region
Q488811.about: Jizzakh Region is one of the regions of Uzbekistan. It is located in the center/east of the country.

Q488904.name: Jonglei
Q488904.about: Jonglei State is a state of South Sudan with Bor as its centre of government and the biggest city. Jonglei state comprises nine counties: Bor, Akobo, Ayod, Uror, Duk, Nyirol, Pigi, Twic East, and Fangak.

Q495342.name: Kayin State
Q495342.about: Kayin State, formerly known as Karen State, is a state of Myanmar. The capital city is Hpa-An, also spelled Pa-An.

Q260796.name: Aqaba Governorate
Q260796.about: Aqaba (Arabic: العقبة al-ʻAqabah) is one of the governorates of Jordan, located south of Amman, capital of Jordan. Its capital is Aqaba.

Q266444.name: Ocnița District
Q266444.about: Ocnița (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈoknitsa]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the north of Moldova, with the administrative center at Ocnița. The other major cities are Otaci and Frunză.

Q269270.name: Mae Hong Son
Q269270.about: Mae Hong Son (Thai: แม่ฮ่องสอน, pronounced [mɛ̂ː.hɔ̂ŋ.sɔ̌ːn]; Northern Thai: ᨾᩯ᩵ᩁᩬ᩵ᨦᩈᩬᩁ; Burmese: မဲဟောင်ဆောင်; Shan: မႄႈႁွင်ႈသွၼ်), formerly called Mae Rong Son, also spelled Maehongson, Mae Hong Sorn or Maehongsorn, is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat). It lies in upper northern Thailand and is the westernmost province.

Q269680.name: Astara District
Q269680.about: Astara District (Azerbaijani: Astara rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the southeast of the country, in the Lankaran-Astara Economic Region.

Q2129061.name: Ștefan Vodă District
Q2129061.about: Ștefan Vodă (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈʃtefan ˈvodə] ) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the south-east of Moldova, with the administrative center at Ștefan Vodă. The district is situated 100 km from Chișinău and 100 km from Odesa, Ukraine.

Q2284812.name: Bhojpur District
Q2284812.about: Bhojpur District (Nepali: भोजपुर जिल्ला [bʱod͡zpur] ) is one of 14 districts of Koshi Province of eastern Nepal. The district's area is 1,507 km2 with a population of 182,459 (2011).

Q2344570.name: Rangpur District
Q2344570.desc: district in its namesake division in Bangladesh
Q2344570.about: Rangpur District (Bengali: রংপুর জেলা) is a district in northern Bengal, It is a part of Rangpur Division, Bangladesh.

Q2344697.name: Rajshahi District
Q2344697.desc: district in its namesake Division in Bangladesh
Q2344697.about: Rajshahi District (Bengali: রাজশাহী জেলা) is a district in mid-western Bangladesh. It is a part of Rajshahi Division.

Q2361131.name: Dagda Municipality
Q2361131.about: Dagda Municipality (Latvian: Dagdas novads) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Andrupene parish, Andzeļi parish, Asūne parish, Bērziņi parish, Dagda parish, Ezernieki parish, Konstantinova parish, Ķepova parish, Svariņi parish, Šķaune parish and Dagda town, the administrative centre being Dagda.

Q2384773.name: Andrijevica Municipality
Q2384773.about: The Andrijevica Municipality is located in northern Montenegro. Its center is the town of Andrijevica and its territory, which covers an area of 340 km2, is surrounded by the Komovi, Bjelasica and Accursed Mountains ranges.

Q2403514.name: Bolikhamsai Province
Q2403514.about: Bolikhamsai (Lao: ບໍລິຄໍາໄຊ, pronounced [bɔ̀ːlīʔ kʰámsáj]), formerly gallicized as Borikhamxay, is a province of Laos. Pakxan, Thaphabat, Pakkading, Borikhane, Viengthong, and Khamkeut are its districts and Pakxan is its capital city.

Q239040.name: Khentii Province
Q239040.about: Khentii (Mongolian: Хэнтий [xe̝ntʰí]), named after the Khentii Mountains, is one of the 21 provinces of Mongolia, located in the eastern part of the country. Its capital is Chinggis City.

Q241119.name: Khuzestan Province
Q241119.about: Khuzestan province ([xuːzest̪ʰɒːn] ; Persian: استان خوزستان) is one of the 31 Provinces of Iran. An extension of the Mesopotamian Plain, it is located in the southwest of the country, bordering Iraq and the Persian Gulf, and covering an area of 63,238 square kilometres (24,416 mi2).

Q243791.name: Amnat Charoen
Q243791.about: Amnat Charoen (Thai: อำนาจเจริญ, pronounced [ʔām.nâːt tɕā.rɤ̄ːn]; Northeastern Thai: อำนาจเจริญ, pronounced [ʔàm.nâːt tɕā.lɤ̂ːn]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) and lies central northeastern Thailand, also called Isan. Neighbouring provinces are (clockwise from the south) Ubon Ratchathani, Yasothon, and Mukdahan.
Q243791.img: จังหวัดอำนาจเจริญ Amnat Charoen -Mukdahan rd. - panoramio.jpg

Q244618.name: Phayao
Q244618.about: Phayao (Thai: พะเยา, pronounced [pʰā.jāw]; Northern Thai: ᩕᨻᨿᩣ᩠ᩅ, pronounced [pʰā.ɲāːw]) is one of Thailand's seventy-seven provinces (changwat), and lies in upper northern Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from the east clockwise) Nan, Phrae, Lampang, and Chiang Rai.
Q244618.img: พระธาตุจอมทอง(2).JPG

Q684183.name: Cantemir District
Q684183.about: Cantemir (Romanian pronunciation: [kanteˈmir]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the south of Moldova, with the administrative center at Cantemir. As of the 2024 Census, its population was 33,181.

Q688626.name: Lerik District
Q688626.about: Lerik District (Azerbaijani: Lerik rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the southeast of the country and belongs to the Lankaran-Astara Economic Region.

Q712828.name: Upper East Region
Q712828.about: The Upper East Region is located in the northern part of Ghana, and it is the third smallest of the 16 administrative regions in Ghana. Despite its relatively small size, the region holds an outsized significance in the nation's cultural heritage and historical narrative.

Q712832.name: Volta Region
Q712832.about:
Volta Region (or Volta) is one of Ghana's sixteen administrative regions, with Ho designated as its capital. 
Other major towns in the region include Anloga, Keta, Hohoe, Aflao, Sogakope, Akatsi, Juapong, Denu and many others.
Q712832.img: Volta Region Ghana View from the Togo mountains.jpg

Q596156.name: Mashonaland Central Province
Q596156.about: Mashonaland Central is a province of Zimbabwe. It is divided into eight districts and has an area of 28,347 km2 and a population of 1,384,891 (2012 census), representing about 9.1% of the total Zimbabwe population.

Q597410.name: Mandoul Region
Q597410.about: Mandoul (Arabic: ماندول, romanised: Māndūl) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad. Located in the south of the country, it comprises part of the former prefecture of Moyen-Chari.

Q607499.name: Southwest
Q607499.about: The Southwest Region or South-West Region (French: Région du Sud-Ouest) is a region with special status in Cameroon. Its capital is Buea.

Q611656.name: Rîșcani District
Q611656.about: Rîșcani (Romanian pronunciation: [rɨʃˈkanʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in north-western Moldova, with its administrative center in Rîșcani. The district also includes the town of Costești.

Q614669.name: Gaoual Prefecture
Q614669.about: Gaoual is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Gaoual.

Q621983.name: Tapoa Province
Q621983.about: Tapoa is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso. It is located in the Est Region.

Q622799.name: Niassa Province
Q622799.about: Niassa [ˈnjasɐ]  is a province of Mozambique with an area of 129,056 km2 and a population of 1,810,794 (2017). It is the most sparsely populated province in the country.

Q503004.name: Attapeu Province
Q503004.about: Attapeu (Lao: ອັດຕະປື, pronounced [ʔát.tā.pɯ̀ː]) is a province of Laos in the southeast of the country. It has five districts: Phouvong, Sanamxay, Sanxay, Saysetha and Samakkixay, covering an area of 10,320 square kilometres (3,980 sq mi) with an estimated population of 159,885 in 2020.

Q503941.name: Sokoto State
Q503941.desc: State in the northern part of Nigeria
Q503941.about: Sokoto  (Hausa: Jihar Sakkwato; Fula: 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤣𞤭 𞤧𞤮𞥅𞤳𞤮𞥅𞤼𞤮𞥅, Leydi Sokoto) is one of the 36 states of Nigeria, located in the extreme northwest of the country. It is bounded by Republic of the Niger to the north and west for 363 km (226 miles), and the states of Zamfara to the east, and Kebbi to the south and west, partly across the Ka River.

Q506641.name: Khammouane Province
