Q506641.about: Khammouane province (Khammouan) (Lao: ຄໍາມ່ວນ, pronounced [kʰám mūan]) is a province in southern Laos. Its capital is Thakhek.

Q514173.name: Oudalan Province
Q514173.about:
Oudalan is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sahel Region.
Its capital is Gorom-Gorom.

Q515655.name: Kadiogo
Q515655.about: Kadiogo, formerly known as Centre [sɑ̃tʁ], is one of Burkina Faso's 17 administrative regions. The population of Kadiogo Region was 1,727,390 at the 2006 census and increased by 75.6% in 13 years to 3,030,384 at the  2019 census (provisional figure), of which 50.8% was female.

Q535632.name: Butha-Buthe District
Q535632.about: Butha-Buthe is a district of Lesotho.  Butha-Buthe is the capital or camptown, and only town in the district.

Q558703.name: Sourou Province
Q558703.about:
Sourou is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Boucle du Mouhoun.
Its capital is Tougan.

Q585707.name: Sekong
Q585707.about: Sekong (also sometimes Xekong, Lao: ເຊກອງ, pronounced [séː kɔ̀ːŋ]) is a province of Laos in the southeast of the country. It is the second smallest province in Laos, covering an area of 7,665 square kilometres (2,959 sq mi).
Q585707.img: The Sekong River, Sekong, Lao PDR, 2009. Photo- Jim Holmes (10729646056).jpg

Q186395.name: Takhar Province
Q186395.about: Takhar (Pashto, Dari: تخار) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the northeast of the country next to Tajikistan. It is surrounded by Badakhshan in the east, Panjshir in the south, and Baghlan and Kunduz in the west.
Q186395.img: Hillside view in Khawajah Bahawuddin, Takhar Province, Afghanistan.jpg

Q186418.name: Kunduz Province
Q186418.about: Kunduz, also known as Qunduz, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the northern part of the country next to Tajikistan. The population of the province is around 1,136,677, which is mostly a tribal society; it is one of Afghanistan's most ethnically diverse provinces with many different ethnicities in large numbers living there.

Q187925.name: Caraș-Severin County
Q187925.about: Caraș-Severin (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈkaraʃ seveˈrin] ) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Serbia. The majority of its territory lies within the historical region of Banat, with a few northeastern villages considered part of Transylvania.

Q188505.name: Constanța County
Q188505.about: Constanța (Romanian pronunciation: [konˈstantsa] ) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Bulgaria, in the Northern Dobruja region.  Its capital city is also named Constanța.
Q188505.img: Catedral de San Pedro y San Pablo, Constanza, Rumania, 2016-05-27, DD 04-06 HDR.jpg

Q213170.name: Maysan Governorate
Q213170.about: Maysan Governorate (Arabic: ميسان, romanized: Maysān or Mīsān) is a governorate in southeastern Iraq, bordering Iran. Its administrative centre is the city of Amarah, and it is composed of six districts.

Q213182.name: Sulaymaniyah Governorate
Q213182.about: Sulaymaniyah Governorate (Sorani Kurdish: پارێزگای سلێمانی; Kurmanji Kurdish: Parêzgeha Silêmaniyê; Arabic: محافظة السليمانية) or Sulaymaniyah Province is a governorate in the Kurdistan Region of Iraq. Its capital and largest city is Sulaymaniyah.

Q214064.name: Aleppo Governorate
Q214064.about: Aleppo Governorate (Arabic: محافظة حلب, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Ḥalab, [muˈħaːfaðˤat ˈħalab];) is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is the most populous governorate in Syria with a population of more than 4,867,000 (2011 Est.), almost 23% of the total population of Syria.

Q214155.name: Mopti Region
Q214155.about: Mopti (Fulfulde: 𞤁𞤭𞥅𞤱𞤢𞤤 𞤃𞤮𞥅𞤩𞤼𞤭𞥅, transliterated Diiwal Moobti) is the fifth administrative region of Mali, covering 26,550 km2.  Its capital is the city of Mopti.

Q6838.name: Zabaykalsky Krai
Q6838.about: Zabaykalsky Krai is a federal subject of Russia (a krai), located in the Russian Far East. Its administrative center is Chita.
Q6838.img: 07.2016. Панорама со смотровой площадки на Алханай - panoramio.jpg

Q6886.name: Amur Oblast
Q6886.desc: federal subject of Russia, oblast of Russia
Q6886.about: Amur Oblast () is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), located on the banks of the Amur and Zeya rivers in the Russian Far East. The oblast borders Heilongjiang province of the People's Republic of China (PRC) to the south.

Q7730.name: Jewish Autonomous Oblast
Q7730.about: The Jewish Autonomous Oblast (JAO) is a federal subject of Russia in the far east of the country, bordering Khabarovsk Krai and Amur Oblast in Russia and Heilongjiang province in China. Its administrative center is the town of Birobidzhan.

Q36409.name: Lai Châu
Q36409.about: Lai Châu (Vietnamese pronunciation: [lāi cʌ̄w] ) is a mountainous province in the Northwest region of Vietnam. Lai Châu was a semi-independent White Tai confederation known as Sip Song Chau Tai, was absorbed by France into French Indochina in the 1880s and became part of Vietnam following Vietnamese independence in 1954.

Q36446.name: Lào Cai
Q36446.about: Lào Cai is a province in Northern Midland and Mountainous region of Vietnam bordering the province of Yunnan in China. The province covers an area of about 13,257 km2 (5,119 mi2) and as of 2025 it had a population of 1,778,785 people.

Q36512.name: Thanh Hóa
Q36512.about: Thanh Hóa is the northernmost coastal province in the North Central Coast region of Vietnam. It borders Sơn La, Phú Thọ, and Ninh Bình to the north, Nghệ An to the south, Laos to the west with a boundary of over 192 kilometres (119 mi) long, and the South China Sea (Gulf of Tonkin) to the east.

Q36579.name: Quảng Trị
Q36579.about: Quảng Trị (Vietnamese pronunciation: [kʷâŋ ʈ͡ʂîˀ]) is a coastal province in the North Central Coast region of Vietnam. It borders Hà Tĩnh province to the north, Huế to the south, Laos to the west and the South China Sea to the east, with 75 kilometres (47 mi) of coast.

Q9195.name: Sagarmatha Zone
Q9195.about: Sagarmāthā Zone (Nepali: सगरमाथा अञ्चल, [sʌgʌrmatʰa ʌnt͡sʌl]  "Sagarmāthā Anchal") was one of the fourteen zones of Nepal until the restructuring of zones into provinces. The headquarters of Sagarmatha is Rajbiraj.

Q9196.name: Seti Zone
Q9196.about: Seti (Nepali: सेती अञ्चल) was one of the fourteen zones located in the Far-Western Development Region of Nepal. Dhangadhi in the Terai is the major city of Seti Zone; headquarters are in Dipayal-Silgadhi.

Q15176.name: Guangxi
Q15176.desc: Provincial area of China organized in 1958 as an autonomous region for the Zhuang people
Q15176.about: Guangxi, officially the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region (GZAR), is an autonomous region of the People's Republic of China, located in South China and bordering Vietnam (Tuyên Quang, Cao Bằng, Lạng Sơn provinces, and Quảng Ninh City) and the Gulf of Tonkin. Formerly a province, Guangxi became an autonomous region in 1958.

Q16551.name: Vermont
Q16551.desc: state of the United States of America
Q16551.about: Vermont ( ) is a landlocked state in the New England region of the Northeastern United States. It borders Massachusetts to the south, New Hampshire to the east, New York to the west, and the Canadian province of Quebec to the north.

Q181209.name: Suceava County
Q181209.about: Suceava County (Romanian pronunciation: [suˈtʃe̯ava]) is a county (Romanian: județ) of Romania. Most of its territory lies in the southern part of the historical region of Bukovina, while the remainder forms part of Western Moldavia proper.

Q182844.name: Herat Province
Q182844.about: Herat, or Harat, is one of the thirty-four provinces of Afghanistan, located in the western part of the country. Together with Badghis, Farah, and Ghor provinces, it makes up the north-western region of Afghanistan.

Q182888.name: Iași County
Q182888.about: Iași County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈjaʃʲ]) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Western Moldavia, with the administrative seat at Iași. It is the most populous county in Romania, after the Municipality of Bucharest (which has the same administrative level as that of a county).

Q183036.name: Jowzjan Province
Q183036.about: Juzjan (Pashto, Dari: جوزجان), also spelled Jozjan or Jowzjan, and historically known as Guzgan, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the north of the country bordering neighboring Turkmenistan. Sheberghan is the capital of Jowzjan province.

Q202107.name: Oromia Region
Q202107.about:
Oromia (Oromo: Oromiyaa, Amharic: ኦሮሚያ) is a regional state in Ethiopia and the homeland of the Oromo people. 
It is bordered by the Somali Region to the east; the Amhara Region, the Afar Region and the Benishangul-Gumuz Region to the north; Dire Dawa to the northeast; the South Sudanese state of Upper Nile, Gambela Region, South West Ethiopia Region, Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples' Region and Sidama Region to the west; the Eastern Province of Kenya to the south; as well as Addis Ababa as an enclave surrounded by a Special Zone in its centre and the Harari Region as an enclave surrounded by East Hararghe in its east.
Q202107.img: Regione oromia, durante il periodo della mietitura del teff, 02.jpg

Q203009.name: Amhara Region
Q203009.about: The Amhara Region (Amharic: አምሐራ ክልል, romanized: Āmḥara Kilil), officially the Amhara National Regional State (Amharic: የአምሐራ ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት, romanized: yä-Amḥara Bəḥerawi Kəlləlawi Mängəst), is a regional state in northern Ethiopia and the homeland of the Amhara, Awi, Argobba, and Qemant people. Its capital is Bahir Dar which is the seat of the Regional Government of Amhara.

Q204367.name: Zinder Region
Q204367.about: Zinder Region is one of the seven regions of Niger; the capital of the region is Zinder. The region covers 145,430 km².

Q207635.name: Benishangul-Gumuz Region
Q207635.desc: one of the nine ethnic divisions (kililoch) of Ethiopia
Q207635.about: Benishangul-Gumuz (Amharic: ቤኒሻንጉል ጉሙዝ, romanized: Bēnīshaniguli Gumuzi) is a regional state in northwestern Ethiopia bordering Sudan. It was previously known as Region 6.

Q207638.name: Gambela Region
Q207638.about: The Gambela Region, officially the Gambela Peoples' Region, is a regional state in western Ethiopia. Previously known as Region 12, its capital and largest city is Gambela.

Q209774.name: Bulgan Province
Q209774.about: Bulgan Province (Mongolian: Булган аймаг) is one of the 21 provinces of Mongolia, located in the north of the country, bordering Russia. Its capital is also named Bulgan.

Q950841.name: Grand Gedeh County
Q950841.desc: county in the eastern portion of the West African nation of Liberia
Q950841.about: Grand Gedeh County is a county in southeastern Liberia. Its capital is Zwedru.

Q953657.name: Poni Province
Q953657.about:
Poni is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sud-Ouest Region.
Its capital is Gaoua.

Q977607.name: Léraba Province
Q977607.about:
Léraba is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Cascades Region.
Its capital is Sindou.

Q1001862.name: Bueng Kan
Q1001862.about: Bueng Kan (Thai: บึงกาฬ [bɯ̄ŋ kāːn]), sometimes anglicised as Bung Kan ( bung KAHN), is the 76th province (changwat) of Thailand, established by the Act Establishing Changwat Bueng Kan, BE 2554 (2011) on 23 March 2011. The province, consisting of the districts (amphoe) partitioned off Nong Khai province, lies in upper northeastern Thailand also called Isan (Thai: อีสาน).

Q1042437.name: Hadjer-Lamis
Q1042437.about: Hadjer-Lamis (Arabic: حجر لميس, romanised: Ḥajar Lamīs) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad, located in the southwest of the country. Its capital is Massakory.
Q1042437.img: Le rocher d'éléphant de Hadjar lamis.jpg

Q1047255.name: Tombali Region
Q1047255.about: Tombali is one of the eight regions of Guinea-Bissau. It is located in the extreme south of the country and its capital is Catió.

Q1047875.name: River Gee County
Q1047875.about: River Gee is a county in the southern portion of Liberia. One of 15 counties that constitute the first-level of administrative division in the nation, it has six districts.

Q1053302.name: Diffa Region
Q1053302.about: Diffa is one of the seven regions of Niger, and is located in the southeast of the country. The capital of the region is Diffa.

Q217075.name: Diyala Governorate
Q217075.about: Diyala Governorate (Arabic: محافظة ديالى Muḥāfaẓat Diyālā) or Diyala Province is a governorate in northeastern Iraq.

Q221734.name: Rason
Q221734.desc: North Korean city and ice-free port in the East Sea
Q221734.about: Rason (formerly Rajin-Sŏnbong; Korean pronunciation: [ɾa.sʌ̹n, ɾa.dʑin.sʰʌ̹n.boŋ]) is a North Korean special city and ice-free port in the Sea of Japan in the North Pacific Ocean on the northeast tip of North Korea. It is in the Kwanbuk region and location of the Rason Special Economic Zone.

Q233218.name: Idlib Governorate
Q233218.about: Idlib Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة ادلب, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat ʾIdlib) is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is situated in northwestern Syria, bordering Turkey's Hatay Province to the north, Aleppo Governorate to the east, Hama Governorate to the south, and Latakia Governorate to the west.

Q233236.name: Latakia Governorate
Q233236.about: Latakia Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة اللاذقية, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat al-Lāḏiqiyya), officially known as Lattakia Governorate, is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is situated in northwestern Syria, bordering Turkey's Hatay Province to the north, Idlib and Hama Governorate to the east, Tartus Governorate to the south, and the Mediterranean Sea to the west.

Q233588.name: Chiang Mai
Q233588.about: Chiang Mai is the largest province (changwat) of Thailand by area. It lies in upper northern Thailand and has a population of 1.78 million people.

Q1149611.name: Sila Region
Q1149611.about: Sila (Arabic: سيلا, romanised: Sīlā), also known as Dar Sila, is a province of Chad, located in the south-east of the country. It was created in 2008 from the departments of Sila and Djourf Al Ahmar which were previously part of Ouaddaï Region.

Q1150901.name: Kénédougou Province
Q1150901.about: Kénédougou is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Hauts-Bassins Region. The 2019 census reported a population of 399,836.

Q1226479.name: Dinguiraye Prefecture
Q1226479.about: Dinguiraye is a prefecture located in the Faranah Region of Guinea. The capital is Dinguiraye.

Q1251933.name: Ruse
Q1251933.about: Ruse Province (Bulgarian: Област Русе, romanized: Oblast Ruse), or Rusenska Oblast (Bulgarian: Русенска област, former name Ruse okrug) is a province in northern Bulgaria, named after its main city, Ruse, neighbouring Romania via the Danube. It is  divided into eight municipalities with a total population, as of February 2011, of 235,252 inhabitants.
Q1251933.img: Бяла - мостът на Кольо Фичето през нощта.jpg

Q1432094.name: Tougué Prefecture
Q1432094.about: Tougué (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤚𞤵𞤺𞤫𞥅) is a prefecture located in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Tougué.

Q1471203.name: Nzérékoré Prefecture
Q1471203.about: Nzérékoré is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital is Nzérékoré.

Q1780649.name: Siguiri Prefecture
Q1780649.about: Siguiri is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Siguiri.

Q1816580.name: Bujumbura Mairie
Q1816580.about: Bujumbura Mairie Province was one of the eighteen provinces of Burundi. It consisted entirely of the city of Bujumbura, Burundi's largest city and economic capital.

Q1826662.name: Leova District
Q1826662.about: Leova District is a district (Romanian: raion) in the central part of Moldova, bordering Romania, with the administrative center at Leova. In the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 28,835.

Q2012785.name: Vratsa
Q2012785.about: Vratsa Province (Bulgarian: Област Враца Oblast Vraca, former name Vraca okrug) is a Bulgarian province located in the northwestern part of the country, between Danube river in the north and Stara Planina mountain in the south. It is named after its main town: Vratsa.

Q2093344.name: Khulna District
Q2093344.desc: district in its namesake division in Bangladesh
Q2093344.about: Khulna District (Bengali: খুলনা জেলা) is a district of Bangladesh. It is located in the Khulna Division, bordered in the north by Jashore District and Narail District, in the south by the Bay of Bengal, in the east by Bagerhat District, and the west by Satkhira District.

Q2128869.name: Căușeni District
Q2128869.about: Căușeni District (Romanian: Raionul Căușeni, pronunciation: [kə.uˈʃenʲ]) is a district in the central part of Moldova, with the administrative center at Căușeni. The other major city in the district is Căinari.

Q2128882.name: Cahul District
Q2128882.desc: district in the south of Moldova
Q2128882.about: Cahul (Romanian pronunciation: [kaˈhul]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the south of Moldova, with the administrative center at Cahul. As of the 2024 Census, Cahul District had a population of 72,775.

Q2129022.name: Soroca District
Q2129022.about: Soroca is a district in north-east Moldova. Its administrative center is the town of Soroca.

Q23533.name: Quảng Bình
Q23533.about: Quảng Bình was formerly a southern coastal province in the North Central Coast region, the Central of Vietnam. It borders Hà Tĩnh to the north, Quảng Trị to the south, Khammouane of Laos to the west and the Gulf of Tonkin (South China Sea) to the east.

Q29154.name: Atakora Department
Q29154.about: Atakora [a.ta.kɔ.ʁa] (also spelled Atacora, named for the Atakora Mountains) is the northwesternmost department of Benin. Externally it borders Togo to the west and Burkina Faso to the north; internally it borders the departments of Alibori, Borgou and Donga.

Q33351.name: Hà Tĩnh
Q33351.about: Hà Tĩnh is a province in the North Central Coast region of Vietnam. It borders Nghệ An to the north, Quảng Trị to the south, Laos to the west, and the South China Sea (Gulf of Tonkin) to the east.

Q43934.name: Liaoning
Q43934.about: Liaoning is a coastal province in Northeastern China that is the smallest, southernmost, and most populous province in the region. With its capital at Shenyang, it is located on the northern shore of the Yellow Sea, and is the northernmost coastal province of the People's Republic of China.

Q45208.name: Jilin
Q45208.about: Jilin is one of the three provinces of Northeast China. Its capital and largest city is Changchun.

Q54155.name: Lublin Voivodeship
Q54155.about:
Lublin Voivodeship (Polish: województwo lubelskie [vɔjɛˈvut͡stfɔ luˈbɛlskʲɛ] ) is a voivodeship (province) of Poland, located in the southeastern part of the country, with its capital being the city of Lublin.
The region is named after its largest city and regional capital, Lublin, and its territory is made of four historical lands: the western and central part of the voivodeship, with Lublin itself, belongs to Lesser Poland, the eastern part of Lublin Area belongs to Cherven Cities/Red Ruthenia, and the northeast belongs to Polesie and Podlasie.

Q188796.name: Galați County
Q188796.about: Galați (Romanian pronunciation: [ɡaˈlatsʲ] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Moldavia region, with the seat at Galați, between 45°25'N and 46°10'N latitude, 27°20'E and 28°10'E longitude. It borders the counties of Vaslui, Vrancea, Brăila, Tulcea.

Q188813.name: Maramureș County
Q188813.about:
Maramureș County (Romanian pronunciation: [maraˈmureʃ] ) is a county (județ) 
in Romania, in the Southern Maramureș region. The county seat is Baia Mare.

Q188945.name: Olt County
Q188945.about: Olt County (Romanian pronunciation: [olt]) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Bulgaria, in the historical regions of Oltenia and Muntenia (the regions are separated by the Olt river). The capital city is Slatina.

Q188948.name: Călărași County
Q188948.about: Călărași (Romanian pronunciation: [kələˈraʃʲ] ) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Bulgaria, in Muntenia, with the county seat at Călărași.

Q623139.name: Yomou Prefecture
Q623139.about: Yomou is a prefecture located in the Nzérékoré Region of Guinea. The capital and principal town of the prefecture is Yomou.

Q623409.name: Koubia Prefecture
Q623409.about: Koubia (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤑𞤵𞤦𞤭𞤴𞤢𞥄) is a prefecture located in the Labé Region of Guinea in the Fouta Djallon mountains. Fulas are the majority ethnic group in the region with Fula (Pular) as the primary language.

Q633511.name: Khatlon Province
Q633511.about: Khatlon Region (Tajik: Вилояти Хатлон, romanized: Viloyati Xatlon), one of the four provinces of Tajikistan, is the most populous of the four first-level administrative regions in the country. It is situated in the southwest of the country, between the Hisor (Gissar) Range in the north and the river Panj in the south and borders on Districts under Republican Subordination in the north, on GBAO in the east, on Afghanistan (Balkh, Kunduz, Takhar and Badakhshan provinces) in the southeast and on Uzbekistan (Surxondaryo region)in the west.

Q645033.name: Cankuzo Province
Q645033.about: Cankuzo was one of the provinces of Burundi. Located in the eastern part of the country, the province covered an area of 1,965 km2.
Q645033.img: Waste disposal area opposite of the market (6915214871).jpg

Q645043.name: Bujumbura Rural Province
Q645043.about: Bujumbura Rural Province was one of the provinces of Burundi. It surrounded the former national capital Bujumbura and its provincial capital was Isale.

Q646647.name: Noumbiel Province
Q646647.about: Noumbiel is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Sud-Ouest Region. The province is the least populated province in the country.

Q652845.name: Kayah State
Q652845.about: Kayah State (Burmese: ကယားပြည်နယ်, pronounced [kəjá pjìnɛ̀]), or Karenni State, is a state of Myanmar. Situated in eastern Myanmar, it is bounded on the north by Shan State, on the east by Thailand's Mae Hong Son Province, and on the south and west by Kayin State.

Q54188.name: West Pomeranian Voivodeship
Q54188.about: West Pomeranian Voivodeship is a voivodeship (province) in northwestern Poland. Its capital and largest city is Szczecin.

Q57581.name: Kgalagadi District
Q57581.about: Kgalagadi is a district in southwest Botswana, lying along the country's border with Namibia and South Africa. The administrative center is Tsabong.

Q57593.name: Kgatleng District
Q57593.about: Kgatleng is one of the districts of Botswana, coterminous with the homeland of the Bakgatla people.  Its capital is Mochudi, the hometown of protagonist Precious Ramotswe in Alexander McCall Smith's popular The No.

Q17915.name: Aragatsotn Province
Q17915.about: Aragatsotn (Armenian: Արագածոտն, Armenian pronunciation: [ɑɾɑɡɑˈt͡sɔtən] ) is a province (marz) of Armenia. It is located in the western part of the country.

Q19206.name: Heilongjiang
Q19206.about: Heilongjiang is an inland province in northeast China. It is the northernmost and easternmost province of the country and contains China's northernmost point (in Mohe City along the Amur) and easternmost point (at the confluence of the Amur and Ussuri rivers).

Q1980044.name: Basarabeasca District
Q1980044.about: Basarabeasca (Romanian pronunciation: [basaraˈbe̯aska]) is a raion in the south of Moldova, with the administrative center at Basarabeasca.

Q2012050.name: Donetsk Oblast
Q2012050.about: Donetsk Oblast, also called Donechchyna (Ukrainian: Донеччина, IPA: [doˈnɛtʃːɪnɐ]), is an oblast in the Donbas region of eastern Ukraine that is currently four-fifths (80%) occupied by Russia. Before the Russo-Ukrainian War, it was Ukraine's most populous province, with around 4.1 million residents.

Q2012242.name: Pleven
Q2012242.about: Pleven Province (Bulgarian: Област Плевен or Плевенска Област) is a province located in central northern Bulgaria, bordering the Danube river, Romania and the Bulgarian provinces of Vratsa, Veliko Tarnovo and Lovech. It is divided into 11 subdivisions, called municipalities, that embrace a territory of 4,653.32 km2 (1,796.66 sq mi) with a population, as of February 2011, of 269 752 inhabitants.

Q57609.name: Southern District
Q57609.about: Southern is one of the districts of Botswana. The capital of Southern district is Kanye, home to the Bangwaketse and Barolong in Botswana.
Q57609.img: New Ministry building, Gabarone, Botswana - panoramio.jpg

Q57695.name: South-East District
Q57695.about: South-East is one of the districts of Botswana. The capital city of Botswana, Gaborone, is surrounded by this district.

Q2604068.name: Bar Municipality
Q2604068.about: Bar Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Bar, Општина Бар) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. The center is the town of Bar.

Q3305169.name: Ulcinj Municipality
Q3305169.about: Ulcinj Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Ulcinj / Општина Улцињ, Albanian: Komuna e Ulqinit) is the southernmost municipality of Montenegro, bordered by Albania to the east, Bar Municipality to the north and Adriatic Sea to the south and the west. It has an area of 255 km², and a population of 19,921 as of the 2011 census.

Q3305250.name: Podgorica Capital City
Q3305250.about: Podgorica Capital City (Montenegrin: Glavni grad Podgorica / Главни град Подгорица) is one of the territorial subdivisions of Montenegro. The seat of municipality is the city of Podgorica.

Q7788.name: Khabarovsk Krai
Q7788.about: Khabarovsk Krai is a federal subject (a krai) of Russia. It is located in the Russian Far East and is administratively part of the Far Eastern Federal District.

Q9046.name: Bagmati Zone
Q9046.about: Bagmati Zone (Nepali: बागमती अञ्चल Bāgmatī Añcal) was one of the fourteen zones of Nepal until the restoration of zones to Provinces. Its headquarters are Kathmandu.

Q9088.name: Dhaulagiri Zone
Q9088.about: Dhaulagiri (Nepali: धौलागिरी अञ्चल ) was one of the fourteen zones which Nepal was divided into for administrative purposes, prior to the September 10, 2015 adoption of a new Constitution, which divided the nation instead into 7 provinces.  It is in the Western Development Region of Nepal and its headquarters are Baglung.

Q9133.name: Gandaki Zone
Q9133.about: Gandaki zone (Nepali: गण्डकी अञ्चल) was one of the fourteen zones of Nepal, located in the Western Development Region.  It was named Sapta Gandaki after the seven tributaries (Kali Gandaki, Trishuli, Budhi Gandaki, Marsyangdi, Madi, Seti Gandaki, and Daraundi) that make up the Gandaki River.

Q9152.name: Janakpur Zone
Q9152.about:
Janakpur Zone (Nepali: जनकपुर अञ्चल ) was one of the fourteen zones of Nepal, reaching from the Indian border in the south to the Tibetan border in the north and Sagarmatha Zone in the east and Bagmati and Naryani Zones in the west.
The headquarters of Janakpur Zone and its main city was Janakpur.

Q9164.name: Karnali Zone
Q9164.about: Karnali Zone (Nepali: खसान अञ्चल) was one of the fourteen zones located in the Mid-Western Development Region of Nepal. The headquarters of Karnali Zone was Jumla.

Q9178.name: Mahakali Zone
Q9178.about: Mahakali (Nepali: महाकाली अञ्चल ) was one of the fourteen zones located in the Far-Western Development Region of Nepal, covering an area of 7449.28 km2 in the westernmost part of the country. It stretches along Nepal's far western border with India, marked by the Kali River or Mahakali River.

Q9180.name: Mechi Zone
Q9180.about: Mechi (Nepali: मेची अञ्चल ) was one of the fourteen zones of Nepal until the restructuring of zones to provinces, comprising four districts; namely Ilam, Jhapa, Panchthar and Taplejung. Its headquarters are at Ilam.

Q233914.name: Hasakah Governorate
Q233914.about: Hasakah Governorate (Arabic: محافظة الحسكة, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat al-Ḥasaka; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Hesekê; Classical Syriac: ܗܘܦܪܟܝܐ ܕܚܣܟܗ, romanized: Huparkiyo d'Ḥasake, and also known as ܓܙܪܬܐ, Gozarto) is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is located in the far north-east corner of Syria and distinguished by its fertile lands, plentiful water, natural environment, and more than one hundred archaeological sites.

Q234680.name: Selenge Province
Q234680.about: Selenge (Mongolian: Сэлэнгэ) is one of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia, located in the north of the country, directly bordering Russia. It lies in the broad, fertile river basins of the Selenge and Orkhon rivers, which are among Mongolia's most important waterways.

Q235563.name: Raqqa Governorate
Q235563.about: Raqqa Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة الرقة, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat ar-Raqqah; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Reqa) is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is situated in the north of the country and covers an area of 19,618 km2.

Q236419.name: Chiang Rai
Q236419.about: Chiang Rai (Thai: เชียงราย, pronounced [tɕʰīaŋ rāːj]; Northern Thai: ᨩ᩠ᨿᨦᩁᩣ᩠ᨿ, pronounced [tɕīaŋ hāːj])  is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces that lies in upper northern Thailand and is Thailand's northernmost province. It is bordered by the Shan State of Myanmar to the north, Bokeo province of Laos to the east, Phayao to the south, Lampang to the southwest, and Chiang Mai to the west.

Q236802.name: Ranong
Q236802.about: Ranong is one of Thailand's southern provinces (changwat), on the west coast along the Andaman Sea. It is the second-least populous province.
Q236802.img: เจดีย์วัดอุปนันทาราม.JPG

Q33356.name: Quảng Nam
Q33356.about: Quảng Nam (Vietnamese: [kwaːŋ˧˩ naːm˧˧] ) was formerly a coastal province near northernmost part of the South Central Coast region, the Central of Vietnam. It borders Huế to the north, Đà Nẵng to the northeast, Kon Tum to the southwest, Quảng Ngãi to the southeast, Sekong of Laos to the west and the South China Sea to the east.

Q33379.name: Sơn La
Q33379.about: Sơn La is a province in Northern Midland and Mountainous region of Vietnam. The province shares a 274km border with Lao People’s Democratic Republic.

Q33396.name: Quảng Ninh
Q33396.about: Quảng Ninh (Vietnamese pronunciation: [kwâŋ nīŋ] ) is a centrally-governed city along the northeastern coast of Vietnam and part of the Red River Delta, located 153 km (95 mi) east of Hanoi. It is divided into 30 wards, 22 communes, and two special zones.

Q33403.name: Lạng Sơn
Q33403.about: Lạng Sơn (Vietnamese pronunciation: [laŋ˧˨ʔ ɕɤn˧˧]) is a province in the Northeastern region of Vietnam, bordering China.

Q36399.name: Huế
Q36399.about: Huế, formerly Thừa Thiên Huế province, is a centrally-governed city in central Vietnam, located approximately at the center of the country, and an educational, medical, and cultural hub. It borders Quảng Trị to the north, Đà Nẵng to the south, Salavan and Sekong of Laos to the west and the South China Sea to the east.

Q176081.name: East Azerbaijan Province
Q176081.about: East Azerbaijan Province (Persian: استان آذربایجان شرقی) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Tabriz.

Q177799.name: Moyen-Chari Region
Q177799.about: Moyen-Chari (Arabic: شاري الأوسط) is one of the 23 regions of Chad, located in the south of the country. Its capital is Sarh.

Q178269.name: Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast
Q178269.about: Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast (Ukrainian: Івано-Франківська область, romanized: Ivano-Frankivska oblast), also referred to as Ivano-Frankivshchyna (Івано-Франківщина) or simply Frankivshchyna, is an oblast (region) in western Ukraine. Its administrative center is the city of Ivano-Frankivsk.

Q178861.name: Botoșani County
Q178861.about: Botoșani County (Romanian pronunciation: [botoˈʃanʲ] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Western Moldavia (encompassing a few villages in neighbouring Suceava County from Bukovina to the west as well), with the county seat at Botoșani.

Q487401.name: Mary Region
Q487401.about: Mary Region (Turkmen: Mary welaýaty) is one of five provinces in Turkmenistan. It is located in the south-east of the country, bordering Afghanistan.

Q487532.name: Samarqand Region
Q487532.about: Samarkand Region is the most populous region of Uzbekistan. It is located in the center of the country in the basin of the Zarafshan River.

Q487537.name: Surxondaryo Region
Q487537.about: Surxondaryo Region is a region (viloyat) of Uzbekistan, located in the extreme south-east of the country. Established on 6 March 1941, it borders on Qashqadaryo Region internally, and Turkmenistan, Afghanistan and Tajikistan externally, going anticlockwise from the north.

Q487547.name: Sirdaryo Region
Q487547.about: Sirdaryo Region (Uzbek: Sirdaryo viloyati) is one of the regions of Uzbekistan, located in the center of the country on the left bank of the Syr Darya. It borders with Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Tashkent Region, and Jizzakh Region.

Q487577.name: Qashqadaryo Region
Q487577.about: Qashqadaryo Region is one of the regions of Uzbekistan, located in the south-eastern part of the country in the basin of the river Qashqadaryo and on the western slopes of the Pamir-Alay mountains. It borders with Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Samarqand Region, Bukhara Region and Surxondaryo Region.

Q188960.name: Tauragė County
Q188960.desc: county of Lithuania (1995-2010), statistical territorial entity (2010-)
Q188960.about: Tauragė County (Lithuanian: Tauragės apskritis) is one of ten counties in Lithuania.  It is in the west of the country, and its capital is Tauragė.

Q189747.name: Wasit Governorate
Q189747.about: Wasit Governorate (Arabic: واسط, romanized: Wāsit) is a governorate in eastern Iraq, south-east of Baghdad and bordering Iran. Prior to 1976 it was known as Kut Province.

Q189822.name: Mahilyow Region
Q189822.about: Mogilev region, also known as Mogilev oblast or Mahilyow voblasts, is one of the regions of Belarus. Its administrative center is the city of Mogilev.

Q191065.name: Dolj County
Q191065.about: Dolj County (Romanian pronunciation: [dolʒ] ; originally meant Dol(no)-Jiu, "lower Jiu", as opposed to Gorj (upper Jiu)) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Bulgaria, in Oltenia, with the capital city at Craiova.

Q191078.name: Tulcea County
Q191078.about: Tulcea County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈtult͡ʃe̯a]) is a county (județ) of Romania, in the historical region Northern Dobruja, with the capital city at Tulcea. It includes in its northeast corner the large and thinly-populated delta of the Danube.

Q191653.name: Teleorman County
Q191653.about:
Teleorman County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈtele.orman]) is a county (județ) of Romania on the border with Bulgaria, in the historical region Muntenia, with its capital city at Alexandria.
The name Teleorman is of Cumanic (Turkic) origin.

Q191717.name: Mehedinți County
Q191717.about: Mehedinți County (Romanian pronunciation: [meheˈdint͡sʲ] ) is a county (Romanian: județ) of Romania on the border with Serbia and Bulgaria. It is mostly located in the historical province of Oltenia, with one municipality (Orșova) and three communes (Dubova, Eșelnița, and Svinița) located in the Banat.

Q192176.name: Bender
Q192176.desc: city in Pridnestrovie, Republic of Moldova
Q192176.about: Bender ([benˈder], Moldovan Cyrillic: Бендер) or Bendery (Russian: Бендеры, [bʲɪnˈdɛrɨ]; Ukrainian: Бендери), also known as Tighina, is a city within the internationally recognized borders of Moldova under de facto control of the unrecognized Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic (Transnistria) (PMR) since 1992. It is located on the western bank of the river Dniester in the historical region of Bessarabia.

Q192942.name: Uvs Province
Q192942.about: Uvs Province ( UUFS) is one of the 21 aimags (provinces) of Mongolia. It is located in the west of the country, 1,336 kilometres or 830 miles away from the national capital, Ulaanbaatar.

Q654438.name: Haut-Ogooué Province
Q654438.about: Haut-Ogooué is the southeasternmost of Gabon's nine provinces. It is named after the Ogooué River.

Q656845.name: Ségou Region
Q656845.about: Ségou Region (Bambara: ߛߋߓߎ ߘߌߣߋߖߊ tr. Segu Dineja) is an administrative region in Mali, situated in the centre of the country with an area of 52,100 km2 (20,100 sq mi), around 4% of Mali.

Q657821.name: Katsina State
Q657821.about:
Katsina State 
(Hausa: Jihar Katsina; Hausa Ajami: جِىهَرْ کَڟِࢽَ) is a state in the northwestern geopolitical zone of Nigeria. It is bordered to the west by Zamfara State, to the east by Kano and Jigawa states, and to the south by Kaduna State, while its northern border forms part of the national border with Niger.

Q674664.name: Banwa Province
Q674664.about: Banwa is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Boucle du Mouhoun Region. The capital of Banwa is Solenzo.

Q682691.name: Jigawa State
Q682691.about: Jigawa   (Hausa: Jihar Jigawa; Fula: Leydi Jigawa 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤮𞤤 𞤶𞤭𞤺𞤢𞤱𞤢) is a state in Nigeria, located in the North-west region of the country. Jigawa was created on 27 August 1991, under the General Ibrahim Babangida military administration.
Q682691.img: Dutse Mountains, Dutse Jigawa State, Nigeria by Micheal Jerry Eshemokhai (9).jpg

Q682777.name: Yobe State
Q682777.desc: state in the northern part of Nigeria
Q682777.about: Yobe() is a state located in northeastern Nigeria. A mainly agricultural state, Yobe as created on 27 August 1991.

Q36587.name: Nghệ An
Q36587.about: Nghệ An (Vietnamese pronunciation: [ŋêˀ ān] ) is a coastal province in the North Central Coast region of Vietnam. It borders Thanh Hóa to the north, Hà Tĩnh to the south, Laos to the west, and the South China Sea (Gulf of Tonkin) to the east.

Q36685.name: Hà Giang
Q36685.about: Hà Giang (Vietnamese pronunciation: [haː2 zaːŋ1], ) was a province in the Northeast region of Vietnam. It was located in the far north of the country, and contains Vietnam's northernmost point.

Q36865.name: Cao Bằng
Q36865.about: Cao Bằng ([kāw ɓɐ̀ŋ] ) is a province of the Northeast region of Vietnam. The province has borders with Tuyên Quang, Thái Nguyên and Lạng Sơn provinces within Vietnam.

Q36955.name: Điện Biên
Q36955.about: Điện Biên is a province in the Northwest region of Vietnam. It is bordered by Lai Châu to the northeast, Sơn La to the southeast, Pu'er City, Yunnan, China, to the northwest, and Phongsaly province in Laos to the west.

Q40395.name: Belait District
Q40395.about: Belait District (Malay: Daerah Belait; Jawi: داءيره بلاءيت) or simply known as Belait (buh-LEIT; Malay: [bəlait] ), is the largest as well as the westernmost district in Brunei. It has an area of 2,727 square kilometres (1,053 sq mi) and the population of 65,531 as of 2021.

Q40398.name: Tutong District
Q40398.about: Tutong District (Malay: Daerah Tutong; Jawi: دائيره توتوڠ) or simply known as Tutong (tu-tong), is the third largest and populated district in Brunei. It has an area of 1,166 square kilometres (450 sq mi) and the population of 47,210 as of 2021.

Q80007.name: Tamaulipas
Q80007.about: Tamaulipas, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Tamaulipas, is a state in Mexico; it is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, comprise the 32 federated entities of Mexico. It is divided into 43 municipalities.

Q80245.name: Quintana Roo
Q80245.about: Quintana Roo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Quintana Roo, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, constitute the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is divided into 11 municipalities, and its capital city is Chetumal.

Q80908.name: Campeche
Q80908.about: Campeche, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Campeche, is one of the 31 states which, with Mexico City, make up the 32 federal entities of Mexico. Located in southeast Mexico, it is bordered by the states of Tabasco to the southwest, Yucatán to the northeast, Quintana Roo to the east, by the Petén department of Guatemala to the south, and by the Orange Walk District of Belize to the southeast.

Q80914.name: Tabasco
Q80914.about: Tabasco, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Tabasco, is one of the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is divided into 17 municipalities and its capital city is Villahermosa.

Q328158.name: Hajjah Governorate
Q328158.about: Hajjah (Arabic: حجة, romanized: Ḥaǧǧa) is a governorate of Yemen in the north-western part of the country. It borders the Red Sea to the west, and its capital is also named Hajjah.

Q328199.name: Kef Governorate
Q328199.about: Kef Governorate (Tunisian Arabic: ولاية الكاف Wilāyat el-Kāf pronounced [lke̞ːf]; French: Gouvernorat du Kef) is one of the twenty-four governorates of Tunisia. It comprises chiefly part of the dorsal Atlas Mountains and their foothills in north-western Tunisia, bordering Algeria.
Q328199.img: El Kef roman baths, mosque and casbah.jpg

Q328493.name: Eastern Province
Q328493.about: The Eastern Province (Swahili: Mkoa wa Mashariki) of Kenya was one of 8 Provinces of Kenya. Its northern boundary ran along with that of Ethiopia; the North Eastern Province and Coast Province lay to the east and south; and the remainder of Kenya's provinces, including Central Province, ran along its western border, and Rift Valley lay to the north west and south west.

Q328922.name: Kilimanjaro Region
Q328922.about: Kilimanjaro Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Kilimanjaro) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The regional capital and largest city is the municipality of Moshi.

Q329261.name: Arusha Region
Q329261.about: Arusha Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Arusha) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions and is located in the northeast of the country. The region's capital and largest city is the city of Arusha.

Q338988.name: Kidal Region
Q338988.about: Kidal Region (Bambara: ߞߌߘߊߟ ߘߌߣߋߖߊ tr. Kidal Dineja) the eighth administrative region of Mali, covering 151,450 square kilometres or 58,480 square miles.

Q341658.name: Municipality of Črenšovci
Q341658.about: The Municipality of Črenšovci (pronounced [ˈtʃɾeːnʃɔu̯tsi]; Slovene: Občina Črenšovci) is a municipality in the Prekmurje region in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Črenšovci.

Q780838.name: Cacheu Region
Q780838.about: Cacheu is a region in western Guinea-Bissau, on the border with Senegal. It has an area of 5,175 km2 and a population estimated in 2004 at 164,676.

Q797933.name: Mwanza District
Q797933.about: Mwanza is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Mwanza.

Q797937.name: Ntcheu District
Q797937.about: Ntcheu is a district in the Central Region of Malawi. It borders with the country of Mozambique.

Q799791.name: Bafatá
Q799791.about: Bafatá is a region in north-central Guinea-Bissau and its capital is Bafatá. It is an inland region covered with savannah or light savannah woodland and receives an annual rainfall of more than 2,000 mm (79 in).

Q822692.name: Ziguinchor Region
Q822692.about: Ziguinchor is a region of Senegal (regional capitals have the same name as their respective regions).  The region is also referred to historically and popularly as Basse Casamance.

Q824373.name: Upper River Division
Q824373.about: Upper River was one of the five Divisions of the Gambia. Its capital was Basse Santa Su.

Q824421.name: Lower River Division
Q824421.desc: one of the five administrative divisions of the Gambia, whose capital is Mansa Konko
Q824421.about: Lower River Division is one of the five administrative divisions of the Gambia. Its capital is Mansa Konko.

Q824431.name: Central River Division
Q824431.about: Central River is the largest of the five regions of the Gambia. Its capital is Janjanbureh (formerly Georgetown), on MacCarthy Island.

Q834513.name: Kunene Region
Q834513.about: Kunene is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia. Its capital is Opuwo, its governor is Vipuakuje Muharukua.

Q838775.name: Omaheke Region
Q838775.about: Omaheke (the Otjiherero word for sandveld) is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia, the least populous region. Its capital is Gobabis.

Q841338.name: Ouaddaï Region
Q841338.about: Ouaddaï or Wadai (Arabic: وداي, romanised: Waddāy) is a province of Chad, located in the south-east of the country, with its capital at Abéché. Prior to 2002 it was known as Ouaddaï Prefecture; in 2008 the southern portions of Ouaddaï (the Sila Department and Djourf Al Ahmar Department) were split off to become the new Sila Region (also known as Dar Sila).

Q842266.name: Huehuetenango Department
Q842266.about: Huehuetenango (Spanish pronunciation: [w̝e.we.t̪eˈnãŋ.ɡo]) is one of the 22 departments of Guatemala. It is located in the western highlands and shares the borders with the Mexican state of Chiapas in the north and west; with El Quiché in the east, and Totonicapán, Quetzaltenango and San Marcos in the south.

Q843984.name: Copán Department
Q843984.about: Copán is one of the departments in the western part of Honduras. The departmental capital is the town of Santa Rosa de Copán.

Q845168.name: East
Q845168.about: The East Region (French: Région de l'Est) occupies the southeastern portion of the Republic of Cameroon. It is bordered to the east by the Central African Republic, to the south by Congo, to the north by the Adamawa Region, and to the west by the Centre and South Regions.

Q845702.name: Ohangwena Region
Q845702.about: Ohangwena is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia; its capital is Eenhana. Major settlements in the region are the towns of Eenhana and Helao Nafidi, as well as the self-governed village of Okongo and the proclaimed settlements Ongha, Ongenga and Omungwelume.

Q845823.name: Centro Sur
Q845823.about: Centro Sur (Spanish for "South Central") is a province of Equatorial Guinea, the largest province in the country by area. Its capital is Evinayong.

Q366626.name: Adrar
Q366626.about: Adrar (Arabic: ولاية أدرار, romanized: Wilāyat Adrār) is a large administrative region in Mauritania, named for the Adrar Plateau. The capital is Atar.

Q386667.name: Luapula Province
Q386667.about: Luapula Province is one of Zambia's ten provinces located in the northern part of the country. Luapula Province is named after the Luapula River and its capital is Mansa.

Q388047.name: Kasserine Governorate
Q388047.about: Kasserine Governorate (Arabic: ولاية الڨصرين Wilāyat al-Gaṣrīn pronounced [ɡasˤˈriːn]; French: Gouvernorat de Kasserine), sometimes spelt Casrein, is one of the twenty-four governorates (provinces) of Tunisia. It is in west-central Tunisia on the frontier with Algeria, wholly north of the true centre line but the area is south or west of the bulk of the population of the country, based on Tunisia's greater northern rainfall.

Q388059.name: Tozeur Governorate
Q388059.about: Tozeur (Tunisian Arabic: توزر Tauzar) is the westernmost of the 24 governorates (provinces) of Tunisia and as such bordering Algeria. It covers an area of 4,719 km2 and has a population of 107,912 (2014 census) making it the least populated province.

Q389737.name: Tanga Region
Q389737.about: Tanga Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Tanga) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers an area of 26,667 km2 (10,296 sq mi).

Q389944.name: Agadez Region
Q389944.about: Agadez Region  is one of the seven regions of Niger. At 667,799 square kilometres (257,839 mi2), it covers more than half of Niger's land area, and is the largest region in the country, as well as the largest African state subdivision.

Q188147.name: Kunar Province
Q188147.about: Kunar (Pashto: کونړ; Dari: کنر) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the northeastern part of the country. Its capital is Asadabad, historically known as Chaghasray (چغسري) or Chaghan Saray (چغان سرای).

Q189352.name: Nineveh Governorate
Q189352.about: Nineveh Governorate is a governorate in northern Iraq. It has an area of 37,323 km2 (14,410 sq mi) and a population of 4,261,980 people as of 2024.

Q189963.name: Ida-Viru County
Q189963.about: Ida-Viru County (Estonian: Ida-Viru maakond) is one of the 15 counties of Estonia. It is the most northeastern part of the country.

Q189974.name: Jõgeva County
Q189974.about: Jõgeva County (Estonian: Jõgeva maakond or Jõgevamaa) is one of 15 counties of Estonia. It is located in the eastern part of the country, and it borders Ida-Viru County to the northeast, Lake Peipus to the east, Tartu County to the south, Viljandi County to the southwest, Järva County to the northwest, and Lääne-Viru County to the north.

Q508773.name: Cayo District
Q508773.about: Cayo is a district located in the west part of Belize, and it contains the capital, Belmopan. It is the most extensive, second-most populous and third-most densely populated of the six districts of Belize.

Q509097.name: Mulanje District
Q509097.about: Mulanje is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. Its capital is Mulanje.

Q512273.name: Corozal District
Q512273.about: Corozal is the northernmost district of the nation of Belize. The population was 46,071 in 2024.

Q537740.name: Barima-Waini
Q537740.desc: Region N.1 according to the administrative political division controlled by Guyana and claimed by Venezuela
Q537740.about: Barima-Waini (Region 1) is a region of Guyana and is located in the northwest of the country. Barima-Waini has three sub-regions: Mabaruma, Matakai, and Moruca.
Q537740.img: Temporary Home in the Wini River - panoramio.jpg

Q538991.name: Phalombe District
Q538991.about: Phalombe is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Phalombe.

Q549522.name: Morona-Santiago Province
Q549522.about: Morona Santiago (Spanish pronunciation: [moˈɾona sanˈtjaɣo]) is a province in Ecuador. The province was established on February 24, 1954.

Q552354.name: Al Ahmadi Governorate
Q552354.about: The Ahmadi Governorate is a governorate in southern Kuwait. It is the second most populated governorate in Kuwait, behind Farwaniya Governorate.

Q485437.name: Aktöbe Region
Q485437.desc: region in the Western part of Kazakhstan
Q485437.about: Aktobe Region (Kazakh: Ақтөбе облысы, romanized: Aqtöbe oblysy; Russian: Актюбинская область) is a region of Kazakhstan. The name Aktobe comes from Kazakh aq 'white' and töbe 'hill'; supposedly, Aktobe's initial settlers were able to see white mountains far to the north.

Q485605.name: Kostanay Region
Q485605.about: Kostanay Region (Kazakh: Қостанай облысы, romanized: Qostanai oblysy; Russian: Костанайская область, romanized: Kostanayskaya oblast) is a region of Kazakhstan. Its administrative center is the city of Kostanay.

Q486007.name: West Kazakhstan Region
Q486007.about: West Kazakhstan Region is a region of Kazakhstan. As of 1 August 2025, it had a population of 695,900.
Q486007.img: Steppe of western Kazakhstan in the early spring.jpg

Q163239.name: Balochistan
Q163239.desc: province of Islamic Republic of Pakistan
Q163239.about: Balochistan () is a province of Pakistan. Located in the southwestern region of the country, Balochistan is the largest province of Pakistan by land area but is also the least populated.

Q163271.name: Kherson Oblast
Q163271.about: Kherson Oblast (Ukrainian: Херсонська область, romanized: Khersonska oblast, IPA: [xerˈsɔnʲsʲkɐ ˈɔblɐsʲtʲ]; Russian: Херсонская область, romanized: Khersonskaya oblast'), also known as Khersonshchyna (Херсонщина, IPA: [xerˈsɔnʃtʃɪnɐ]), is an oblast (province) in southern Ukraine. It is located just north of Crimea.

Q167001.name: Municipality of Zavrč
Q167001.about: The Municipality of Zavrč (pronounced [ˈzaːʋəɾtʃ]; Slovene: Občina Zavrč) is a municipality in the Haloze area of Slovenia, on the border with Croatia. Its seat is the village of Zavrč.

Q167485.name: Nuristan Province
Q167485.about: Nuristan (Pashto; Dari: نورستان, lit. 'Land of Light'), also spelled as Nurestan, Nooristan or Nuriston (Katë: نورستان), and historically known as Kafiristan (Pashto, Dari: کافرستان lit. 'Land of Infidels') until 1896, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the eastern part of the country. It is divided into seven districts and is Afghanistan's least populous province, with a population of around 167,000.

Q170041.name: Golestan Province
Q170041.about: Golestan province is one of the 31 provinces of Iran, located in the northeast of the country and southeast of the Caspian Sea. Its capital is the city of Gorgan, formerly called Esterabad until 1937.
Q170041.img: Gonbad-e Qabus Tower by Hadi Karimi.jpg

Q939575.name: Sistan and Baluchestan Province
Q939575.about: The Sistan and Baluchestan province (Persian: استان سيستان و بلوچستان), simply referred to as Sistan-Baluchestan, is the second largest of the 31 provinces of Iran, after Kerman province, with an area of 180,726 km2. Its capital is the city of Zahedan.

Q954963.name: Kassala
Q954963.about: Kassala (Arabic: ولاية كسلا, called Ash Sharqiyah during 1991–1994) is one of the 18 wilayat (states) of Sudan. It has an area of 36,710 km2 and an estimated population of approximately 2,519,071 in 2018.

Q958518.name: Al Wusta Governorate
Q958518.about: Al Wusta Governorate (Arabic: مُحَافَظَة ٱلْوُسْطَى, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Al-Wusṭā, lit. 'The Central Governorate') is the second biggest governorate of the 11 governorates of Oman which is approximately 82,471 km². Its capital city is Haima.

Q964281.name: Sissili Province
Q964281.about: Sissili is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Ouest Region. In 2006 the population was 212,628 and in 2011 the population was 240,830, an increase of 13.3%.

Q976873.name: Rakai District
Q976873.about: Rakai District is a district in the Central Region of Uganda. The town of Rakai is the site of the district's headquarters.

Q1002863.name: municipality of Videm
Q1002863.about: The Municipality of Videm (pronounced [ˈʋiːdəm]) is a municipality in Slovenia. It includes part of the flatlands south of Ptuj and extends beyond the Dravinja River into the Haloze Hills to the south.
Q1002863.img: Videm pri Ptuju - cerkev sv. Vida.jpg

Q1032245.name: Kanungu District
Q1032245.about: Kanungu District is a district in the Western Region of Uganda. The town of Kanungu is the site of the district headquarters.

Q190718.name: Central Province
Q190718.about: Central Province is one of Zambia's ten provinces. The provincial capital is Kabwe, which is the home of the Mulungushi Rock of Authority.

Q191164.name: Bolívar
Q191164.about: Bolívar (Spanish: Estado Bolívar, IPA: [esˈtaðo βoˈliβaɾ]) is the largest of the 23 states of Venezuela in area. The state capital city is Ciudad Bolívar and the largest city is Ciudad Guayana.

Q191813.name: Põlva County
Q191813.about: Põlva County (Estonian: Põlva maakond or Põlvamaa) is one of 15 counties of Estonia. It is located in the southeastern part of the country and borders Tartu, Valga, and Võru counties.

Q192370.name: Tartu County
Q192370.about:
Tartu County (Estonian: Tartu maakond or Tartumaa) is one of 15 counties of Estonia.
It is located in eastern Estonia, and it borders Põlva County, Valga County, Viljandi County, and Jõgeva County.

Q192882.name: Najaf Governorate
Q192882.about: Najaf Governorate (Arabic: محافظة النجف, romanized: Muḥāfażat an-Najaf) is a governorate in central and southern Iraq. The capital is the city of Najaf, with another major city being Al Kufah.

Q195353.name: Salima District
Q195353.about: Salima is a district in the Central Region of Malawi. The city of Salima is the district's capital.

Q390213.name: North Eastern Province
Q390213.about: North Eastern Province (Swahili: Mkoa wa Kaskazini Mashariki, Somali: Goboleedka Waqooyi-bari) is one of the former provinces of Kenya. It had a land area of 127,358.5 km2, with its capital at Garissa.

Q427658.name: Atyrau Region
Q427658.desc: region of european part in Kazakhstan
Q427658.about: Atyrau Region (Kazakh: Атырау облысы, romanized: Atyrau oblysy; Russian: Атырауская область), formerly known as Guryev Region (Russian: Гурьевская область) until 1991, is one of the regions of Kazakhstan, in the western part of the country around the northeast of the Caspian Sea. Its capital is the city of Atyrau, with a population of 355,117; the region itself has a population of 681,241, of which Kazakhs make up more than 90%.

Q458406.name: Mara Region
Q458406.about: Mara Region (Mkoa wa Mara in Swahili) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers an area of 21,760 km2 (8,400 sq mi).

Q464718.name: Najran Province
Q464718.about: Najran Province is a province in southern Saudi Arabia, covering 150,000 km² and located along the border with Yemen. Its capital is Najran.

Q465490.name: South Kordofan
Q465490.about: South Kordofan (Arabic: جنوب كردفان Ǧanūb Kurdufān) is one of the 18 wilayat or states of Sudan. It borders North Kordofan to the north, West Kordofan to the west, South Sudan to the south and east, and White Nile to the northeast.

Q5095.name: Papua
Q5095.about: Papua, formerly known as West Irian and Irian Jaya, is a province of Indonesia, comprising the northern coast of Western New Guinea together with island groups in Cenderawasih Bay to the west. It roughly follows the borders of the Papuan customary region of Mamta – Saireri and is divided into eight regencies (kabupaten) and one city (kota), the latter being the provincial capital of Jayapura.

Q5334.name: Saratov Oblast
Q5334.about: Saratov Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), located in the Volga Federal District. Its administrative center is the city of Saratov.

Q5338.name: Orenburg Oblast
Q5338.about: Orenburg Oblast (also Orenburzhye) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), mainly located in Eastern Europe, with some land in the southern and eastern portions of the oblast falling within Asia. Its administrative center is the city of Orenburg.

Q310118.name: Northern State
Q310118.about: Northern State (Arabic: الولاية الشمالية Aš Šamāliya) is one of the 18 wilayat (states) of Sudan and the largest by area. It has an area of 348,765 km2 and an estimated population of 936,255.

Q310120.name: Red Sea
Q310120.about: Red Sea State (Arabic: ولاية البحر الأحمر, Wilāyat al-Baḥr al-ʾAḥmar) is one of the 18 wilayat (states) of Sudan. It covers an area of about 218,887 km2 and has an estimated population of 1.48 million.

Q311371.name: White Nile
Q311371.about: White Nile State (Arabic: النيل الأبيض, romanized: An Nīl al Ābyaḍ) is one of the 18 wilayat or states of Sudan. It has an area of 39,701 km2 and an estimated population of approximately 2,493,880 people (2018 est).

Q319965.name: Unity
Q319965.about: Unity State is a state in South Sudan. Unity State is in the Greater Upper Nile region.

Q328128.name: Al Jawf Governorate
Q328128.about: Al Jawf (Arabic: الجوف Al-Jawf) is a governorate of Yemen. Its capital is Al Hazm.

Q201162.name: Amazonas Department
Q201162.about: Amazonas (Spanish pronunciation: [amaˈsonas]) is a department of Peru. Located in the country's north, it is bordered by Ecuador on the north and west, Cajamarca on the west, La Libertad on the south, and Loreto and San Martín on the east.

Q201781.name: Northern Borders Province
Q201781.about: The Northern Borders Province is a province in Saudi Arabia, situated in the northern region, bordering Iraq to the north and northwest, and Jordan to the west.

Q203873.name: Litoral
Q203873.about: Litoral (Spanish pronunciation: [litoˈɾal], meaning "Coastal [Province]") is the most populous province of Equatorial Guinea, recording a population of 367,348 in the 2015 national census. Its capital is Bata; the other two cities are Mbini and Kogo.

Q205078.name: Cajamarca Department
Q205078.about: Cajamarca (Spanish pronunciation: [kaxaˈmaɾka]; Quechua: Kashamarka; Aymara: Qajamarka) is a department of Peru. It is located to the north of the country and shares a border with Ecuador.

Q205104.name: Puno Department
Q205104.about: Puno (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpuno]; Aymara and Quechua: Punu) is a department of Peru. Located in the country's southeast, it is the fifth largest department in Peru, after Cuzco, Madre de Dios, Ucayali, and Loreto.

Q170453.name: Amazonas
Q170453.about: Amazonas State (Spanish: Estado Amazonas, IPA: [esˈtaðo amaˈsonas]) is one of the 23 states into which Venezuela is divided. It covers nearly a fifth of the area of Venezuela, but has less than 1% of Venezuela's population.
Q170453.img: Plaza Bolívar y catedral María Auxiliadora de Puerto Ayacucho (Venezuela).jpg

Q171551.name: South Khorasan Province
Q171551.about: South Khorasan province (Persian: استان خراسان جنوبی) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran, located in the eastern part of the country. Its capital is the city of Birjand.
Q171551.img: Furg citadel Darmian County birjand iran 1.jpg

Q173808.name: Kandahar Province
Q173808.about: Kandahar is one of the southern provinces of Afghanistan and is widely regarded as one of the country's most historically influential and politically significant regions. It borders Helmand to the west, Uruzgan to the north, Zabul to the east, and the Balochistan province of Pakistan to the south.

Q173821.name: Helmand Province
Q173821.about: Helmand (Pashto and Dari: هلمند), known in ancient times as Hermand, Hirmand, and Hethumand, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, in the south of the country. It is the largest province by area, covering 58,584 square kilometres (20,000 sq mi) area.
Q173821.img: Arghandab River Valley between Kandahar and Lashkar Gah.jpg

Q655.name: Chihuahua
Q655.about: Chihuahua (Spanish pronunciation: [tʃiˈwawa] ), officially the Free and Sovereign State of Chihuahua is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, are the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is located in the northwestern part of Mexico and is bordered by the states of Sonora to the west, Sinaloa to the southwest, Durango to the south, and Coahuila to the east.

Q724.name: Maine
Q724.desc: state of the United States of America
Q724.about: Maine (  MAYN) is a state in the New England region of the United States, and the northeasternmost state in the contiguous United States. It borders New Hampshire to the west, the Gulf of Maine to the southeast, and the Canadian provinces of New Brunswick and Quebec to the northeast and northwest, and shares a maritime border with Nova Scotia.

Q207424.name: Ucayali Department
Q207424.about: Ucayali (Spanish pronunciation: [ukaˈʝali]) is a department of Peru. Located in the Amazon rainforest, it is the second largest department in Peru, after Loreto.

Q208183.name: Piura Department
Q208183.about: Piura (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpjuɾa])  is a department of Peru. Located on the country's northwestern coast, it is known for its tropical and dry beaches.

Q208270.name: Federally Administered Tribal Areas
Q208270.desc: former semi-autonomous tribal region in northwestern Pakistan (1947–2018)
Q208270.about: The Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA) was a semi-autonomous tribal region in north-western Pakistan that existed from 1947 until being merged with the neighbouring province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in 2018 through the Twenty-fifth amendment to the constitution of Pakistan. It consisted of seven tribal agencies (districts) and six frontier regions, and were directly governed by the federal government through a special set of laws called the Frontier Crimes Regulations.
Q208270.img: Village Tari Mengal Pewar Kurram Agency.jpg

Q209597.name: Tumbes Department
Q209597.about: Tumbes (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈtumbes]) is a department of Peru. It is located in the country's northwestern coast, bordering Ecuador.

Q214221.name: Lunda Norte Province
Q214221.about: Lunda Norte (English: North Lunda) is a province of Angola. It has an area of 103,760 km² and a population of 862,566.

Q214814.name: Pastaza Province
Q214814.about: Pastaza (Spanish pronunciation: [pasˈtasa]) is a province in the Oriente of Ecuador located in the eastern jungle. The capital is Puyo, founded on May 12, 1899, with a population of 33,325.

Q867219.name: Kalangala District
Q867219.about: Kalangala, also known as Ssesse, is a district in Central Uganda. The district is coterminous with the Ssese Islands in Lake Victoria and does not have territory on mainland Uganda.

Q873012.name: Gash-Barka Region
Q873012.about: Gash-Barka (Tigrinya: ጋሽ-ባርካ, Arabic: ‎‎‎إقليم قاش بركة) is an administrative region of Eritrea. It is situated in the south-west of the country, bordering the Anseba region to the north, and the Maekel (Central) and Debub (Southern) regions to the east; the country of Sudan lies to the west and Ethiopia to the south.

Q876506.name: Otjozondjupa Region
Q876506.about: Otjozondjupa is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia. Its capital is Otjiwarongo.

Q877042.name: Lower Juba
Q877042.about: Lower Juba (Somali: Jubbada Hoose, Maay: Jubithy Hoosy, Arabic: جوبا السفلى, Italian: Basso Giuba) is an administrative region (gobol) in southern Somalia. With its capital at Kismayo, it lies in the autonomous Jubaland region.

Q883907.name: San Marcos Department
Q883907.about:
San Marcos (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌsam ˈmaɾkos]) is a department in southwestern Guatemala, on the Pacific Ocean and along the western Guatemala–Mexico border.
The department's capital is the city of San Marcos.

Q895097.name: Boulgou
Q895097.about: Boulgou is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Centre-Est Region. The capital of Boulgou is Tenkodogo.

Q919017.name: Guna Yala
Q919017.about: Guna Yala, also known as Kuna Yala or by its former name San Blas, is a comarca indígena (indigenous province) in northeast Panama. Guna Yala is home to the indigenous people known as the Gunas.

Q934923.name: Koulpélogo Province
Q934923.about: Koulpélogo is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Est Region. The population in 2019 was 361,586.

Q236772.name: Souk Ahras Province
Q236772.about: Souk Ahras (Arabic: ولاية سوق أهراس) is a province (wilaya) in the Aures region in Algeria, named after its capital, Souk Ahras. It stands on the border between Algeria and Tunisia, and as of 2008, Souk Ahras had a population of 440,299 people.

Q236788.name: El Tarf Province
Q236788.about: El Taref (Arabic: ولاية الطارف) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria, with a population of 481,136 inhabitants in 2019. El Kala is a port town in this province and El Taref is the capital city.

Q236797.name: Suwayda Governorate
Q236797.about: Suwayda Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة السويداء, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat as-Suwaydāʾ) is one of the fourteen governorates (provinces) of Syria. It is the country's southernmost governorate, covering an area of 5,550 km2, and is bordered by Daraa Governorate in the west, Rif Dimashq Governorate in the north and northeast, and the country of Jordan in the south and southeast.

Q238645.name: Guainía Department
Q238645.about: Guainía (Spanish pronunciation: [ɡwajˈni.a]; Yuri language: "Land of many waters") is a department of Eastern Colombia. It is in the east of the country, bordering Venezuela and Brazil.

Q238931.name: Mangystau Region
Q238931.about: Mangystau (Kazakh: Маңғыстау облысы, romanized: Mañğystau oblysy; Russian: Мангистауская область, romanized: Mangistauskaya oblast), formerly known as Mangyshlak (Russian: Мангышлак) from 1973 until 1988, is a region of Kazakhstan. Its capital is Aqtau (a seaport), which has a population of 183,350 (2017); the entire Mangystau Province has a population of 745,909 (2022).

Q233058.name: Norte de Santander Department
Q233058.about: Norte de Santander (Spanish for Northern Santander) (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈnoɾte ðe santanˈdeɾ]) is a department of northeastern Colombia. It is in the north of the country, bordering Venezuela.
Q233058.img: Panorámica de San José de Cúcuta, Colombia.jpg

Q233169.name: Beni Department
Q233169.about: Beni (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈbeni]), sometimes El Beni, is a northeastern department of Bolivia, in the lowlands region of the country. It is the second-largest department in the country (after Santa Cruz), covering 213,564 square kilometers (82,458 sq mi), and it was created by supreme decree on November 18, 1842, during the administration of General José Ballivián.

Q233632.name: Tlemcen Province
Q233632.about: Tlemcen (Arabic: ولاية تلمسان, Tamazight: ⵜⴰⵡⵉⵍⴰⵢⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵍⴻⵎⵙⵉⵏ) is a province (wilaya) in northwestern Algeria. It is located southwest of Oran.

Q233651.name: El Oued Province
Q233651.about: El Oued (Arabic: ولاية الوادي, Berber languages: ⴻⵍ oⵓⴻⴷ) is a Saharan province of Algeria (n° 39) dominated by Oued Souf. It was named after its eponymous capital.
Q233651.img: Siège de la wilaya d'El Oued مقر ولاية الوادي.jpg

Q233659.name: Illizi Province
Q233659.about:
Illizi (Arabic: ولاية اليزي)  is a large province (wilaya) in the south-eastern corner of Algeria named after its eponymous seat.
It borders Ouargla Province to the north, Tunisia to the extreme northeast, Libya to the east, Djanet Province to the south and, to the west, In Salah Province and Tamanrasset Province.

Q173988.name: Moxico Province
Q173988.about:
Moxico (Portuguese spelling) is a province of Angola.
It used to have an area of 223,023 square kilometres (86,110 mi2), which corresponded to 18% of the landmass of Angola.
Q173988.img: Jardim do Palacio do Governador Luena Moxico.jpg

Q178471.name: Nangarhar Province
Q178471.about: Nangarhar (also spelled Nangrahar, Ningrahar, and Ningarhar, Pashto: د ننګرهار ولایت, romanized: Da Nangarhār Wilāyat and Dari: ولایت ننگرهار, romanized: Wilāyat-e Nangarhār) is an eastern provinces of Afghanistan which serves as an important economic and cultural gateway between Afghanistan and Pakistan. It borders Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province to the east and south, while internally it is adjacent to the Afghan provinces of Kunar, Laghman, Kabul, and Logar.
Q178471.img: Landscape between Jalalabad and Dari Noor 2.jpg

Q178872.name: Saint-Louis
Q178872.about: The Saint-Louis region (French: Région de Saint-Louis) of Senegal is on the border with Mauritania. Its capital is Saint-Louis.

Q180075.name: North Khorasan Province
Q180075.about: North Khorasan province (Persian: استان خراسان شمالی) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran, located in the northeast of the country. Its capital is the city of Bojnord.

Q196674.name: Zaire Province
Q196674.about: Zaire (Portuguese: Zaire, Kongo: Nzadi) is one of the 21 provinces of Angola.  It occupies 40,130 square kilometres (15,490 mi2) in the north west of the country and had a population of 594,428 inhabitants in 2014.

Q198587.name: Nsanje District
Q198587.about: Nsanje is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Nsanje.

Q198585.name: Machinga District
Q198585.about: Machinga is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Machinga.

Q200938.name: Loreto Department
Q200938.about: Loreto (Spanish pronunciation: [loˈɾeto] ) is a department of Peru. Covering almost one-third of Peru's territory, it is Peru's largest and northernmost department, occupying a large part of the country's portion of the Amazon rainforest.

Q201137.name: Delta Amacuro
Q201137.about: Delta Amacuro State (Spanish: Estado Delta Amacuro, IPA: [esˈtaðo ˈðelta amaˈkuɾo]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela, and is the location of the Orinoco Delta. The Paria Gulf and the Atlantic Ocean are to the north, Bolívar State is to the south, the Atlantic Ocean and Guyana are to the east, and Monagas State is to the west.

Q180330.name: Farah Province
Q180330.about: Farah (Pashto, Dari: فراه) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the western part of the country on the border with Iran. It is a spacious and sparsely populated province, divided into eleven districts and contains hundreds of villages.

Q182493.name: Paktia Province
Q182493.about: Paktia (also spelled Paktiya and Paktya) is one of the southeastern provinces of Afghanistan and is widely regarded as a region of major strategic, cultural, and tribal significance. It borders Khost to the south, Paktika to the east, Logar and Wardak to the west, and Nangarhar to the north, while also sharing a long international border with Pakistan’s Kurram and North Waziristan regions.
Q182493.img: Goud Qala Mangal ګډ قلعه منګل.jpg

Q183021.name: Nimruz Province
Q183021.about: Nimruz Province (Pashto and Dari: نیمروز, lit. 'Half-day'), also spelled Nimroz, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the southwestern part of the country. It lies to the east of the Sistan and Baluchestan province of Iran and north of Balochistan, Pakistan, also bordering the Afghan provinces of Farah and Helmand.

Q183314.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Q183314.about: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (abbreviated KP) is a province of Pakistan. Located in the northwestern region of the country, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa is the fourth largest province of Pakistan by land area and the third-largest province by population.

Q797.name: Alaska
Q797.desc: state of the United States of America
Q797.about: Alaska ( , ə-LASS-kə) is a U.S. state located in the northwestern regions of North America. Part of the Western United States region, it is one of the two non-contiguous U.S. states, alongside Hawaii.

Q486073.name: Balkan Province
Q486073.about: Balkan Region (Turkmen: Balkan welaýaty, Балкан велаяты) is the westernmost of the five regions of Turkmenistan. Clockwise from north it borders Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan (north); two provinces of Turkmenistan (east), Iran (south), and the Caspian Sea (west).
Q486073.img: Turkmenbashi city on the Caspian Sea.jpg

Q486144.name: Pavlodar Region
Q486144.about: Pavlodar Region is a region of Kazakhstan. Its population was 742,475 (2009 census results) and before that 806,983 (1999 census results).

Q487372.name: Bukhara Region
Q487372.about: Bukhara Region is a region of Uzbekistan located in the southwest of the country. The Kyzyl Kum desert takes up a large portion of its territory.

Q487561.name: Xorazm Region
Q487561.about: The Khorazm Region, also known as the Khorezm or Xorazm Region, (Uzbek: Xorazm viloyati, Хоразм вилояти, خوارزم ولایتی) is a viloyat (region) of Uzbekistan located in the northwest of the country in the lower reaches of the Amu Darya River. It borders Turkmenistan, Karakalpakstan, and the Bukhara Region.

Q487570.name: Navoiy Region
Q487570.about: Navoiy Region is one of the regions of Uzbekistan. It is located in the central north/northwest of the country.

Q241135.name: Hadhramaut Governorate
Q241135.about: Hadhramaut Governorate (Arabic: محافظة حضرموت, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Ḥaḍramawt) is a governorate of Yemen. Lying within the large historical region of Hadhramaut, it is the country's largest governorate.

Q254889.name: Thimphu District
Q254889.about: Thimphu District (Dzongkha: ཐིམ་ཕུ་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Thim-phu rdzong-khag) is a dzongkhag (district) of Bhutan. Thimphu is also the capital of Bhutan and the largest city in the whole kingdom.

Q264529.name: Suss-Massa-Draa
Q264529.about: Souss-Massa-Drâa (Arabic: سوس ماسة درعة) was formerly one of the sixteen regions of Morocco from 1997 to 2015. It covered an area of 70,880 km2 and had a population of 3,601,917 (2014 census).

Q267224.name: Tébessa Province
Q267224.about: Tébessa (Arabic: ولاية تبسة) is a province (wilayah) of Algeria. Tébessa is also the name of the capital, which in ancient times it was known as Theveste.

Q268729.name: Vichada Department
Q268729.about: Vichada Department (Spanish: Departamento del Vichada, Spanish pronunciation: [biˈtʃaða]) is a department of the Republic of Colombia in South America. Vichada is located in the eastern plains of Colombia, in the Orinoquía Region within the Orinoco river basin bordering the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela to the north and east.

Q185371.name: Coast Province
Q185371.about: The Coast Province (Swahili: Mkoa wa Pwani) was one of Kenya's eight provinces prior to 2010. It covered the entire country's coastline on the Indian Ocean.

Q185575.name: Paktika Province
Q185575.about: Paktika (Pashto, Dari: پکتیکا) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the eastern part of the country. Forming part of the larger Loya Paktia region, Paktika has a population of about 789,000 residents, who are mostly ethnic Pashtuns but smaller communities of Tajiks and others may also be found in the province.
Q185575.img: U.S. Soldiers with Charlie Company, 3rd Battalion, 187th Infantry Regiment, 101st Airborne Division, along with Afghan National Police officers, patrol the Sharana bazaar in western Paktika province 100821-A-OD503-018.jpg

Q185752.name: Khost Province
Q185752.about: Khost (Pashto, Dari: خوست), is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan located in the southeastern part of the country. Khost consists of thirteen districts and the city of Khost serves as the capital of the province.

Q187334.name: Al Anbar Governorate
Q187334.about: Al Anbar Governorate (Arabic: محافظة الأنبار; muḥāfaẓat al-’Anbār), or Anbar Province, is the largest governorate in Iraq by area. Encompassing much of the country's western territory, it shares borders with Syria, Jordan, and Saudi Arabia.

Q816.name: Arizona
Q816.desc: state of the United States of America
Q816.about: Arizona is a landlocked state in the Southwestern United States, sharing the Four Corners region with Colorado, New Mexico, and Utah. It also borders Nevada to the northwest and California to the west, and shares an international border with the Mexican states of Sonora and Baja California to the south and southwest.

Q1061.name: Gujarat
Q1061.about: Gujarat (Gujarati: Gujarāt, pronounced [ˈɡudʒəɾaːt] ) is a state along the western coast of India. Its coastline of about 2,340 km (1,450 mi) is the longest in the country, most of which lies on the Kathiawar peninsula.

Q99.name: California
Q99.desc: state of the United States of America
Q99.about: California is a state in the Western United States. It is bordered by Oregon to the north, the Mexican state of Baja California to the south, Nevada to the east, Arizona to the southeast, and the Pacific Ocean to the west.

Q845934.name: Shiselweni Region
Q845934.about: Shiselweni is a region of Eswatini, located in the south of the country. It has an area of 3,786.71 km² and a population of 204,111 (2017).

Q846158.name: West Coast Division
Q846158.about: West Coast Region, originally the Western Division, also known as Foni or Fonyi, was one of the five administrative divisions of the Gambia. Its capital was Brikama.

Q846161.name: North Bank Division
Q846161.about: North Bank was one of the five administrative divisions of the Gambia. Its capital was Kerewan.

Q846320.name: Northwestern Province
Q846320.about: North-Western Province is one of ten Provinces of Zambia. It covers an area of 125,826 km2 (48,582 sq mi), has a population of 1,278,357 and a population density of 20 per square kilometre as of 2022.
Q846320.img: COLLECTIE TROPENMUSEUM Een vrouw voegt water toe tegen het stuiven van te stampen mais omgeving van Kasempa TMnr 20039222.jpg

Q846331.name: West Darfur
Q846331.about: West Darfur State (Arabic: ولاية غرب دارفور Wilāyat Ḡarb Dārfūr), historically Dar Masalit (Arabic: دار مساليت), is one of the states of Sudan, and one of five comprising the Darfur region. Prior to the creation of two new states in January 2012, it had an area of 79,460 km² and an estimated population of approximately 1,775,945 in 2018.

Q847671.name: Kaolack
Q847671.about: The Kaolack region is a region in Senegal.  It borders Gambia and is a common stopping point for travel between Dakar and Banjul.
Q847671.img: Coucher de soleil sur une prairie. Région de Kaolack, Sénégal.jpg

Q848567.name: Mambéré-Kadéï
Q848567.desc: prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q848567.about: Mambéré-Kadéï [mɑ̃.be.ʁe ka.de.i] is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. Its capital is Berbérati.

Q121233.name: Boyacá Department
Q121233.about:
Boyacá (Spanish pronunciation: [boʝaˈka]) is one of the thirty-two departments of Colombia, and the remnant of Boyacá State, one of the original nine states of the "United States of Colombia".
Boyacá is centrally located within Colombia, almost entirely within the mountains of the Eastern Cordillera to the border with Venezuela, although the western end of the department extends to the Magdalena River at the town of Puerto Boyacá.
Q121233.img: Imagen Tomada desde cerro de monserrate en Cuítiva - panoramio.jpg

Q130576.name: Kasaï-Occidental
