Q4501876.about: Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate (Arabic: مُحَافَظَة شَمَال ٱلشَّرْقِيَّة, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Šamāl aš-Šarqīyah, English: Northeastern Governorate) is a governorate of Oman. It was created on 28 October 2011, when Ash Sharqiyah Region was split into Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate and Ash Sharqiyah South Governorate.

Q4703565.name: Al Batinah South Governorate
Q4703565.about: Al Batinah South Governorate (Arabic: محافظة جنوب الباطنة Muḥāfaẓat Ǧanūb al-Bāṭinah) is one of the eleven governorates of Oman. It was created on 28 October 2011 when Al Batinah Region was split into Al Batinah North Governorate and Al Batinah South Governorate.

Q7208306.name: Pointe-Noire District
Q7208306.desc: district in Pointe-Noire Department, Republic of the Congo

Q13377731.name: Municipality of Bistrica ob Sotli
Q13377731.about: The Municipality of Bistrica ob Sotli (pronounced [ˈbiːstɾitsa ɔp ˈsoːtli]; Slovene: Občina Bistrica ob Sotli) is a municipality in eastern Slovenia. It has been an independent municipality since 1999; before, it was part of the Municipality of Podčetrtek.

Q13377784.name: Municipality of Ilirska Bistrica
Q13377784.about: The Municipality of Ilirska Bistrica (pronounced [iˈliːɾska ˈbiːstɾitsa] ; Slovene: Občina Ilirska Bistrica) is a municipality in Slovenia. It belongs to the traditional region of Inner Carniola.

Q21712462.name: Mayaguana District
Q21712462.desc: administrative territorial entity of the Bahamas

Q13845.name: Maguindanao
Q13845.about: Maguindanao (locally [maˈɡindɐnaʊ, -ginˈdanaʊ]; Maguindanaon: Dairat nu Magindanaw; Iranun: Perobinsia a Magindanao; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Maguindanao) was a province of the Philippines located in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). From 2014 to 2023, its provincial capital was Buluan, but the legislative branch of government, the Maguindanao Provincial Board, convened at the old provincial capitol in Sultan Kudarat.

Q13857.name: Misamis Occidental
Q13857.about: Misamis Occidental (Cebuano: Kasadpang Misamis; Subanen: Sindepan Mis'samis; Maranao: Sedepan Misamis; Filipino: Kanlurang Misamis), officially the Province of Misamis Occidental, is a province located in the region of Northern Mindanao in the Philippines. Its capital is the city of Oroquieta while Ozamiz is the most-populous city.

Q13860.name: Misamis Oriental
Q13860.about: Misamis Oriental (Cebuano: Sidlakang Misamis; Maranao: Sebangan Misamis; Filipino: Silangang Misamis), officially the Province of Misamis Oriental, is a province located in the region of Northern Mindanao in the Philippines. Its capital and largest city is Cagayan de Oro, the regional center of Northern Mindanao, which is geographically grouped but governed independently from the province.

Q13869.name: Palawan
Q13869.about: Palawan (, pə-LAH-wən; Tagalog: [pɐˈlaː.wan]; officially the Province of Palawan; Cuyonon: Probinsya i'ang Palawan; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Palawan) is an archipelagic province of the Philippines that is located in the region of Mimaropa. It is the largest province in the country in terms of total area, with 14,649.73 km2 (5,656.29 mi2).
Q13869.img: The beach of Sabang, Palawan, Philippines, Stormy dramatic sky over South China Sea.jpg

Q40885.name: Alagoas
Q40885.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q40885.about: Alagoas (English: , AL-ə-GOH-əs ; Brazilian Portuguese: [alaˈɡoɐs] ) is one of the 27 federative units of Brazil and is situated in the eastern part of the Northeast Region. It borders Pernambuco to the north, Sergipe to the south, Bahia to the southwest, and the Atlantic Ocean to the east.

Q40942.name: Pernambuco
Q40942.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q40942.about: Pernambuco ( PUR-nəm-BEW-koh, -⁠BOO-; Brazilian Portuguese: [peʁnɐ̃ˈbuku] , locally [ˌpɛɦʁnɐ̃ˈbuku]) is a state of Brazil, on the east coast in the Northeast region of the country. With an estimated population of 9.5 million people as of 2024, it is the seventh-most populous state of Brazil and with around 98,067.877 km2, it is the 19th-largest in area among federative units of the country.
Q40942.img: Capitais do Brasil - Capital Cities of Brazil - Recife-PE (36163973822).jpg

Q41428.name: Rio de Janeiro
Q41428.about: Rio de Janeiro (Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈʁi.u d(ʒi) ʒɐˈne(j)ɾu] ), officially the State of Rio de Janeiro (Portuguese: Estado do Rio de Janeiro), is one of the 27 federative units of Brazil. It has the second largest economy of Brazil, with the largest being that of the state of São Paulo.
Q41428.img: Dedo de Deus Serra dos Órgãos 06.jpg

Q29147.name: Atlantique Department
Q29147.about: Atlantique ([a.tlɑ̃.tik], "Atlantic") is one of the twelve departments in Benin. The department is located in south-central Benin along the Atlantic coast, between Mono and Kouffo Department in the west, Zou in the north, and Ouémé in the east.
Q29147.img: Africa Endeavor is empowering African Partner nations to enhance their C4 (command, control, communications and computer systems) and cyber defense capabilities in Cotonou, Benin in July 2025 - 94.jpg

Q29158.name: Littoral
Q29158.about: Littoral ([li.tɔ.ʁal], "Littoral") is one of the twelve departments of Benin. At 79 km2 (31 sq mi), Littoral is the smallest department in the country.

Q30815.name: South Sinai Governorate
Q30815.about: South Sinai (Arabic: محافظة جنوب سيناء Muḥāfaẓah Ganūb Sīnāʾ) is the least populated governorate of Egypt. It is located in the east of the country, encompassing the southern half of the Sinai Peninsula.

Q31070.name: Suez Governorate
Q31070.about: Suez (Arabic: محافظة السويس Muḥāfāzah as-Suways) is one of the governorates of Egypt. It is located in the north-eastern part of the country and is coterminous with the city of Suez.

Q32845.name: Misurata Municipality
Q32845.about: Misrata or Misratah (Arabic: مصراته, romanized: Miṣrāta, Libyan Arabic: Məṣrāta), also known by the Italian spelling Misurata, is a sha'biyah (district) in northwestern Libya. Its capital is the city of Misrata.

Q3739.name: Bissau
Q3739.about: Bissau (; Portuguese pronunciation: [biˈsaw]) is the capital and largest city of Guinea-Bissau. As of 2015, it had a population of 492,004.

Q3741.name: Yogyakarta
Q3741.desc: province of Indonesia, on island of Java
Q3741.about: The Special Region of Yogyakarta, (English: ; Indonesian: Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta; DIY; Javanese: ꦥꦤꦒꦫꦩꦶꦫꦸꦁꦒꦤ꧀ꦔꦪꦺꦴꦒꦾꦏꦂꦠ, romanized: Panagara Mirunggan Ngayogyakarta) simply Yogyakarta, is a province-level special region of Indonesia in southern Java. It is a semi-enclave that is surrounded by on the landward side by Central Java Province to the west, north, and east, but has a long coastline on the Indian Ocean to the south.

Q3891.name: Central Kalimantan
Q3891.about: Central Kalimantan (Indonesian: Kalimantan Tengah) is a province of Indonesia. It is one of five provinces in Kalimantan, the Indonesian part of Borneo.

Q3889.name: Maputo
Q3889.desc: capital and chief port of Mozambique
Q3889.about: Maputo (Portuguese pronunciation: [mɐˈputu]) is the capital and largest city of Mozambique. Located near the southern end of the country, it is within 120 kilometres (75 miles) of the borders with Eswatini and South Africa.

Q3906.name: South Kalimantan
Q3906.about: South Kalimantan (Indonesian: Kalimantan Selatan, Jawi: کالیمانتان سلاتن) is a province of Indonesia. The provincial capital was Banjarmasin until 15 February 2022, where the capital was moved 35 km southeast to Banjarbaru.

Q38088.name: Paraíba
Q38088.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q38088.about: Paraíba ( PAR-ə-EE-bə, Brazilian Portuguese: [paɾaˈibɐ] ; Tupinambá: pa'ra a'íba) is a state in Brazil. It is located in the Brazilian Northeast, and it is bordered by Rio Grande do Norte to the north, Ceará to the west, Pernambuco to the south and the Atlantic Ocean to the east.

Q40123.name: Ceará
Q40123.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q40123.about: Ceará (, SEH-ah-RAH; Brazilian Portuguese: [seaˈɾa] , locally [sjaˈɾa] or [si.aˈɾa]) is one of the 26 states of Brazil, located in the northeastern part of the country, on the Atlantic coast. It is the eighth-largest Brazilian State by population and the 17th by area.

Q40430.name: Bahia
Q40430.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q40430.about: Bahia (English: , bə-(H)EE-ə; Brazilian Portuguese: [baˈi.ɐ] ) is one of the 26 states of Brazil, located in the Northeast Region of the country. It is the fourth-largest Brazilian state by population (after São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro) and the 5th-largest by area.

Q5068.name: North Sulawesi
Q5068.desc: province of Indonesia, on island of Sulawesi
Q5068.about: North Sulawesi (Indonesian: Sulawesi Utara) is a province of Indonesia. It is mainly located on the Minahasa Peninsula of the island of Sulawesi, south of the Philippines and southeast of Sabah, Malaysia, but also includes various small archipelagoes situated between the Minahasa Peninsula and the southern Philippines.

Q5075.name: Southeast Sulawesi
Q5075.desc: province of Indonesia, on island of Sulawesi
Q5075.about: Southeast Sulawesi (Indonesian: Sulawesi Tenggara, Indonesian pronunciation: [sulaˌwesi t̪əŋˈɡara]; often abbreviated to Sultra, Indonesian pronunciation: [ˈsʊlt̪ra]) is a province on the island of Sulawesi, forming the southeastern peninsula of that island, together with a number of substantial offshore islands such as Buton, Muna, Kabaena, and Wawonii (formerly called Wowoni), together with many smaller islands. It is bordered by South Sulawesi and Central Sulawesi to the north, sharing a maritime border with Maluku and North Maluku to the east and East Nusa Tenggara to the south, as well a very narrow maritime border with East Timor to the south.

Q5078.name: South Sulawesi
Q5078.desc: province of Indonesia, on island of Sulawesi
Q5078.about: South Sulawesi (Indonesian: Sulawesi Selatan; Lontara: ᨔᨘᨒᨓᨙᨔᨗ ᨔᨛᨒᨈ) is a province in the southern peninsula of Sulawesi, Indonesia. The Selayar Islands archipelago to the south of Sulawesi is also part of the province.

Q5082.name: West Sulawesi
Q5082.desc: province of Indonesia, on island of Sulawesi
Q5082.about: West Sulawesi (Indonesian: Sulawesi Barat), covering a land area of 16,590.67 km2 with its capital at Mamuju, is a province of Indonesia on the western side of Sulawesi (formerly Celebes) island, consisting of six regencies (kabupaten), namely Polewali Mandar, Mamasa, Majene, Mamuju, Central Mamuju and Pasangkayu (formerly called North Mamuju).

Q1351157.name: Saramacca District
Q1351157.about: Saramacca (Eastern Maroon Creole: Saamakaliba or just Saamaka) is a district of Suriname, in the north. Saramacca's capital city is Groningen, with other towns and cities including Batavia, Kampong Baroe, Uitkijk, Maho and Boskamp.

Q1353668.name: Inagua
Q1353668.about: Inagua is the southernmost district of the Bahamas, comprising the islands of Great Inagua and Little Inagua. The headquarters for the district council are in Matthew Town.

Q1493318.name: Trincomalee District
Q1493318.about: Trincomalee District (Tamil: திருக்கோணமலை மாவட்டம் Tirukkōṇamalai Māvaṭṭam; Sinhala: ත්‍රිකුණාමළය දිස්ත්‍රික්කය Trikuṇāmalaya distrikkaya) is one of the 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country. The district is administered by a District Secretariat headed by a District Secretary (previously known as a Government Agent) appointed by the central government of Sri Lanka.

Q1516381.name: Upper Takutu-Upper Essequibo
Q1516381.desc: Region N.9 according to the administrative political division controlled by Guyana and claimed by Venezuela
Q1516381.about: Upper Takutu-Upper Esequibo (Region 9) is an administrative region of Guyana. Located along the Guyana's border with Brazil, it is spread over an area of 57,750 km2 (22,300 sq mi).

Q1520182.name: Jaffna District
Q1520182.desc: Administrative District in Northern, Sri Lanka
Q1520182.about: Jaffna District (Tamil: யாழ்ப்பாணம் மாவட்டம் Yāḻppāṇam Māvaṭṭam; Sinhala: යාපනය දිස්ත්‍රික්කය yāpanaya distrikkaya) is one of the 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country. The district is administered by a District Secretariat headed by a District Secretary (previously known as a Government Agent) appointed by the central government of Sri Lanka.

Q1584007.name: Kilinochchi District
Q1584007.about: Kilinochchi District (Tamil: கிளிநொச்சி மாவட்டம் Kiḷinocci Māvaṭṭam; Sinhala: කිලිනොච්චි දිස්ත්‍රික්කය) is one of the 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country. The district is administered by a District Secretariat headed by a District Secretary (previously known as a Government Agent) appointed by the central government of Sri Lanka.

Q1587508.name: Mullaitivu District
Q1587508.about: Mullaitivu District (Tamil: முல்லைத்தீவு மாவட்டம், Mullaittīvu Māvaṭṭam; Sinhala: මුලතිවු දිස්ත්‍රික්කය, Mulativu distrikkaya) is one of the 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country. The district is administered by a District Secretariat headed by a District Secretary (previously known as a Government Agent) appointed by the central government of Sri Lanka.

Q36526.name: Port Moresby
Q36526.about: Port Moresby ( ; Tok Pisin: Pot Mosbi), also referred to as Pom City or simply Moresby, is the capital and largest city of Papua New Guinea. It is one of the largest cities in the southwestern Pacific (along with Jayapura) outside of Australia and New Zealand.

Q25279.name: Curaçao
Q25279.desc: island state in the Caribbean, part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
Q25279.about: Curaçao, officially the Country of Curaçao, is a constituent country within the Kingdom of the Netherlands. It is an island country located in the southern Caribbean Sea, specifically the Dutch Caribbean region, about 65 km (40 mi) north of Venezuela and 80 km (50 mi) southeast of Aruba.
Q25279.img: Facades of Handelskade, Willemstad, Curaçao - February 2020.jpg

Q26153.name: Zawiya District
Q26153.about: Zawiya, officially Zawia (Arabic: محافظة الزاوية Az Zāwiya), is one of the districts of Libya. It is located in the north western part of the country, in what had been the historical region of Tripolitania.

Q26417.name: Sirte District
Q26417.about: Sirte District (or Sirt or Surt District; Arabic: سرت Surt, ), is one of the districts of Libya, in the Tripolitania region in the north of the country and borders the Gulf of Sidra. Its capital is the city of Sirte.

Q27038.name: Zagreb County
Q27038.about: Zagreb County (Croatian: Zagrebačka županija) is a county in Northern Croatia. It surrounds, but does not contain, the nation's capital Zagreb, which is a separate territorial unit.

Q275755.name: Al Hudaydah Governorate
Q275755.about: Hodeidah (Arabic: الْحُدَيْدَة, romanized: Al Ḥudaida) is a governorate of Yemen. Its capital is Hodeidah.

Q276565.name: Sousse Governorate
Q276565.about: Sousse Governorate (Arabic: ولاية سوسة Wilāyat Sūsah pronounced [ˈsuː.sə]; French: Gouvernorat de Sousse) is one of the 24 governorates of Tunisia. It is beside the eastern coast of Tunisia in the north-east of the country and covers an area of 2,621 km2 and has a population of 762,281 (2024 census).

Q276576.name: Béja Governorate
Q276576.about: Béja Governorate (Arabic: ولاية باجة Wilāyat Bājah pronounced [ˈbæːʒæ]; French: Gouvernorat de Béja) is one of the twenty-four governorates of Tunisia. It is in northern Tunisia and has a brief coastline relative to its size.

Q42362.name: Maranhão
Q42362.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q42362.about: Maranhão (, MAH-rə-NYOWN; Brazilian Portuguese pronunciation: [maɾɐˈɲɐ̃w] ) is a state in Brazil. Located in Brazil's Northeast Region, it has a population of about 7 million, an area of 332,000 km² (128,000 sq mi), and is divided into 217 municipalities.

Q42722.name: Piauí
Q42722.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q42722.about:
Piauí (, pyow-EE; pronounced [pi.aˈwi] or [pjaˈwi] ) is one of the states of Brazil, located in the country's Northeast Region. The state has 1.6% of the Brazilian population and produces 0.7% of the Brazilian GDP.
Piauí has the shortest coastline of any coastal Brazilian state at 66 km (41 mi), and the capital, Teresina, is the only state capital in the northeast to be located inland.
Q42722.img: Parque Nacional de Sete Cidades - Piauí.jpg

Q1106416.name: Ash Sharqiyah Region
Q1106416.about: Ash-Sharqiyyah Region (Arabic: ٱلْمِنْطَقَة ٱلشَّرْقِيَّة, romanized: Al-Minṭaqah Ash-Sharqiyyah, lit. 'The Eastern Region') was the eastern minṭaqah (region) of the Sultanate of Oman. The capital of Ash-Sharqiyyah was Sur.

Q1124125.name: Santa Elena Province
Q1124125.about: The Province of Santa Elena (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌsanta eˈlena]) is a province of Ecuador in the coastal region. Created in 2007 from territory that belonged to the Guayas Province, it is one of the two newest provinces of Ecuador, along with Santo Domingo de Los Tsáchilas.

Q1129783.name: Ngöbe-Buglé Comarca
Q1129783.about: Ngäbe-Buglé (Spanish: [ˈŋɡoβe βuˈɣle]) is the largest and most populous of Panama's six comarcas indígenas. It was created in 1997 from lands formerly belonging to the provinces of Bocas del Toro, Chiriquí, and Veraguas.

Q1130134.name: Paramaribo District
Q1130134.about:
Paramaribo is a district of Suriname, coextensive with the capital city of Paramaribo.
Paramaribo district has a population of 240,924, almost half the population of the entire country, and an area of 182 km2.
Q1130134.img: Overzicht van uit de lucht van Paramaribo - Paramaribo - 20417734 - RCE.jpg

Q1130141.name: Coronie District
Q1130141.about: Coronie is a district of Suriname, situated on the coast. Coronie's capital city is Totness.

Q13744.name: Batangas
Q13744.about: Batangas, officially the Province of Batangas (Filipino: Lalawigan ng Batangas IPA: [bɐˈtaŋgas]), is a first class province in the Philippines located in the southwestern part of Luzon in the Calabarzon region. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 2,994,795, making it the 7th most populous province in the country.

Q13580.name: Metro Manila
Q13580.desc: metropolitan area and region of the Philippines
Q13580.about: Metropolitan Manila (Filipino: Kalakhang Maynila [kalakˌhaŋ maɪˈnilaʔ]), commonly shortened to Metro Manila and formally the National Capital Region (NCR; Filipino: Pambansang Punong Rehiyon), is the capital region and largest metropolitan area of the Philippines. It encompasses an area of 636.00 km2 (245.56 sq mi) and the region has a population of 14,001,751 as of 2024, making it the second most populous region in the country after Calabarzon.

Q13682.name: Zamboanga Peninsula
Q13682.about: Zamboanga Peninsula (Cebuano: Lawis sa Zamboanga; Chavacano/Spanish: Península de Zamboanga; Filipino: Tangway ng Zamboanga), designated as Region IX, is an administrative region in Mindanao, Philippines. It consists of the provinces of Sulu, Zamboanga del Norte, Zamboanga Sibugay and Zamboanga del Sur, and the cities of Isabela and Zamboanga.

Q13694.name: Davao Region
Q13694.about: The Davao Region (Cebuano: Rehiyon sa Dabaw; Filipino: Rehiyon ng Davao), designated as Region XI, is an administrative region in the Philippines. Formerly called Southern Mindanao, it is situated in the southeastern portion of Mindanao, enclosing the Davao Gulf.

Q13714.name: Agusan del Norte
Q13714.about: Agusan del Norte, officially the Province of Agusan del Norte (lit. 'Northern Agusan';Cebuano: Amihanang Agusan; Butuanon: Probinsya hong Agusan del Norte; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Agusan del Norte), is a province in the Caraga region of the Philippines. Its de jure capital is the city of Cabadbaran with several government offices located in the highly-urbanized city of Butuan, which is the largest city and its de facto capital as well as the regional center of Caraga Region.

Q1612920.name: North Province
Q1612920.about: The North Province (French: province Nord) is one of three administrative divisions in New Caledonia. It corresponds to the northern and northeastern portion of the New Caledonian mainland.

Q1665318.name: Puttalam District
Q1665318.desc: administrative district in North Western Province, Sri Lanka
Q1665318.about: Puttalam is a district of Sri Lanka situated near the west coast of the country. The district has an area of 3,072 km2 (1,186 mi2).

Q2634400.name: Constitutional Province of Callao
Q2634400.about: Callao (Spanish pronunciation: [kaˈʝa.o]) is a seaside city and constitutional province in Peru. Located next to the Pacific Ocean, it forms part of the Lima metropolitan area alongside Lima province.

Q3434092.name: Kostel Municipality
Q3434092.about: The Municipality of Kostel (pronounced [ˈkɔːstɛu̯]; Slovene: Občina Kostel) is a municipality in southern Slovenia. Its seat is the settlement of Vas.

Q3482211.name: Črnomelj Municipality
Q3482211.about: The Municipality of Črnomelj (pronounced [tʃəɾˈnoːməl]; Slovene: Občina Črnomelj) is a municipality in southeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Črnomelj.

Q3484655.name: City Municipality of Krško
Q3484655.about: The Urban Municipality of Krško (pronounced [ˈkə́ɾʃkɔ] ; Slovene: Mestna občina Krško) is an urban municipality in eastern Slovenia. Its seat is the town of Krško.

Q3502521.name: Rogaška Slatina
Q3502521.about: Rogaška Slatina (pronounced [ɾɔˈɡáːʃka ˈsláːtina] ; German: Rohitsch-Sauerbrunn) is a town in eastern Slovenia. It is the largest settlement in, and the seat of, the Municipality of Rogaška Slatina.

Q291279.name: South Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region
Q291279.about: The South Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region is one of two autonomous regions in Nicaragua. It was created along with the North Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region by the Autonomy Statute of 7 September 1987 through a division of the former Zelaya Department.

Q309339.name: Lindi Region
Q309339.about: Lindi Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Lindi) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers an area of 66,040 km2 (25,500 sq mi).

Q310786.name: Al Daayen
Q310786.about: Al Daayen (Arabic: الضعاين [ALA-LC: al-Ḍaʻāyin; Wehr: aḍ-ḍaʿāyin]; also spelled as الظعاين [ALA-LC: al-Ẓaʻāyin; Wehr: aẓ-ẓaʿāyin]) is a municipality in Qatar. Most of the urban landscape can be found in the southern zone of the municipality, particularly in the city of Lusail, while the northern and central sections are primarily rural.
Q310786.img: Aerial view of Al Daayen and Umm Salal Mohammed.png

Q310872.name: Al Shamal
Q310872.about: Al Shamal (Arabic: ٱلشَّمَال, romanized: Ash Shamāl, lit. 'the north') is a municipality in Qatar. Its seat is Madinat ash Shamal and it is considered to be one of the major cities in Qatar, although its population is barely over 7,000.

Q310893.name: Al Wakrah
Q310893.desc: the capital city of the Al Wakrah Municipality in Qatar
Q310893.about: Al Wakrah (Arabic: الوكرة, romanized: al-Wakra) is the capital city of the Al Wakrah Municipality in Qatar. Al Wakrah's eastern edge touches the shores of the Persian Gulf and Qatar's capital Doha is situated immediately north of the city.
Q310893.img: Qatar Souq Al Wakrah asv2024-10 img3.jpg

Q318102.name: Monastir Governorate
Q318102.about: Monastir Governorate (Arabic: ولاية المنستير, romanized: Wilāyat al-Munastīr; French: Gouvernorat de Monastir) is one of the twenty-four governorates of Tunisia. It is situated in the center-east of Tunisia.

Q249868.name: Hualien County
Q249868.about: Hualien (Wade–Giles: Hua¹-lien²) is a county on the east coast of Taiwan. It is Taiwan's largest county by area, yet due to its mountainous terrain, has one of the lowest populations in the country.

Q249904.name: Taitung County
Q249904.about: Taitung (Wade–Giles: Tʻai2-tung1; lit. 'Eastern part of Taiwan') is the third largest county in Taiwan, located primarily on the island's southeastern coast and also including Green Island, Orchid Island and Lesser Orchid Island.

Q249994.name: Hsinchu City
Q249994.about: Hsinchu (Chinese: 新竹; pinyin: Xīnzhú, IPA: [ɕin˥ʈʂu˧˥]), officially Hsinchu City, is a city located in northwestern Taiwan. It is the most populous city in Taiwan that is not a special municipality, with estimated 476,273 inhabitants.

Q16580.name: Colonia Department
Q16580.about: Colonia (Spanish pronunciation: [koˈlonja] ) is a department of southwestern Uruguay. Its capital is Colonia del Sacramento, the country's second-oldest city.

Q16584.name: Soriano Department
Q16584.about: Soriano (Spanish pronunciation: [soˈɾjano]) is a department of Uruguay. Its capital is Mercedes.
Q16584.img: Vista de Mercedes desde calle Alegria - panoramio.jpg

Q16596.name: Río Negro Department
Q16596.about: Río Negro Department (Spanish: Departamento de Río Negro, Spanish pronunciation: [ˈri.o ˈneɣɾo]) is a department of the northwestern region of Uruguay. It has an area of 9,282 km2 (3,584 sq mi) and a population of 57,334.

Q18250.name: Tuzla Canton
Q18250.about: The Tuzla Canton (Bosnian: Tuzlanski kanton; Croatian: Tuzlanska županija; Serbian: Тузлански кантон) is a federated state and one of ten cantons of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, one of two entities in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The cantonal seat is the city of Tuzla.

Q43233.name: Espírito Santo
Q43233.desc: state in the Southeast Region of Brazil
Q43233.about: Espírito Santo (Portuguese: [(i)sˈpiɾitu ˈsɐ̃tu] ; lit. 'Holy Spirit') is a state in southeastern Brazil. Its capital is Vitória, and its largest city is Serra.

Q43255.name: Rio Grande do Norte
Q43255.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q43255.about: Rio Grande do Norte (UK: , US: , Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈʁi.u ˈɡɾɐ̃dʒ(i) du ˈnɔʁtʃi] ) is one of the states of Brazil. It is located in the northeastern region of the country, forming the northeasternmost tip of the South American continent.

Q36666.name: Tiền Giang
Q36666.about:
Tiền Giang was a former province in the Mekong Delta region of southern Vietnam (this is now the eastern part of Đồng Tháp province).
The province was formed in February 1976, by the merger of Định Tường and Gò Công provinces of former Republic of Vietnam.

Q36687.name: Victoria
Q36687.about: Victoria, commonly abbreviated as VIC, is a state in southeastern Australia. It is the second most populous state with a population of over 7 million, and the second-smallest, with a land area of 227,444 square kilometres (87,817 sq mi), making it the most densely populated state in Australia (31.1 per km2).

Q36874.name: Bà Rịa-Vũng Tàu
Q36874.about: Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu (abbreviated as BRVT) is a former coastal province in the Southeast region of Vietnam. It bordered Đồng Nai to the north, Bình Thuận to the northeast and Ho Chi Minh City metropolitan area to the southwest.

Q43783.name: Sergipe
Q43783.desc: state in the Northeast Region of Brazil
Q43783.about: Sergipe (English: , sair-ZHEE-pee ; Brazilian Portuguese: [sɛʁˈʒipi] ), officially the State of Sergipe, is a state of Brazil. Located in the Northeast Region along the Atlantic coast of the country, Sergipe is the smallest state in Brazil by geographical area at 21,910 square kilometres (8,460 mi2), larger only than the Federal District.

Q44754.name: Buenos Aires Province
Q44754.about: Buenos Aires, officially the Province of Buenos Aires, is the largest and most populous Argentine province. It takes its name from the city of Buenos Aires, the capital of the country, which used to be part of the province and the province's capital until it was federalized in 1880.
Q44754.img: Provinz Buenos Aires Rio de la Plata Argentinien NASA.jpg

Q46508.name: Baja California Sur
Q46508.about: Baja California Sur, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Baja California Sur, is a state in Mexico. It is the 31st and last state to be admitted, in 1974.

Q41705.name: Fujian
Q41705.desc: province of the People's Republic of China, covering the mountainous coast opposite Taiwan
Q41705.about: Fujian is a province in southeast China. Fujian is bordered by Zhejiang to the north, Jiangxi to the west, Guangdong to the south, and the Taiwan Strait to the east.

Q42200.name: Hainan
Q42200.about: Hainan is an island and the southernmost province of China, consisting of the eponymous Hainan Island and various smaller islands in the South China Sea under the province's administration. Its name literally means "South of the Sea".

Q57056.name: Krapina-Zagorje County
Q57056.about: Krapina-Zagorje County (pronounced [krâpina zǎːɡɔːrje], Croatian: Krapinsko-zagorska županija) is a county in northern Croatia, bordering Slovenia. It encompasses most of the historic region called Hrvatsko Zagorje.
Q57056.img: ROJSTNA HIŠA JOSIP BROZ TITA - panoramio.jpg

Q58071.name: Primorje-Gorski Kotar County
Q58071.about: Primorje – Gorski Kotar County (Croatian: Primorsko-goranska županija, pronounced [prǐːmorsko-ɡǒranskaː ʒupǎnija]) is a county in west Croatia, most of it based in the historical and cultural region called Croatia proper and some of it in Istria, including the Bay of Kvarner, the surrounding Northern Croatian Littoral, and the mountainous region of Gorski Kotar. Its center is Rijeka.

Q61309.name: Colima
Q61309.about: Colima, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Colima, is among the 31 states that make up the 32 federated entities of Mexico. It shares its name with its capital and main city, Colima.
Q61309.img: Government Palace of Colima at night.jpg

Q63706.name: Miaoli County
Q63706.about: Miaoli is a county in western Taiwan, bordered by Hsinchu County and Hsinchu City to the north, Taichung to the south, and the Taiwan Strait to the west. Miaoli is classified as central Taiwan by the National Development Council and northern Taiwan by the Taiwan Central Weather Bureau.

Q321455.name: Beja
Q321455.about: The Beja District (Portuguese: Distrito de Beja; Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈbɛʒɐ] ) is located in southern Portugal. The district capital is the city of Beja.

Q326203.name: Braga
Q326203.desc: district in the northwest of Portugal
Q326203.about: Braga District (Portuguese: Distrito de Braga [ˈbɾaɣɐ] ) is a district in the northwest of Portugal. The district capital is the city of Braga, and it is bordered by the district of Viana do Castelo in the north, Vila Real in the east, Galicia (a Spanish autonomous community) in the northeast and Porto in the south.

Q1146777.name: Cuyuni-Mazaruni
Q1146777.desc: Region N.7 according to the administrative political division controlled by Guyana and claimed by Venezuela
Q1146777.about: Cuyuni-Mazaruni (Region 7)  is a region of Guyana. Its capital is Bartica.
Q1146777.img: Kaw Island Saw Milll HDR - panoramio.jpg

Q1147524.name: Wanica District
Q1147524.about: Wanica is a district of Suriname located in the north of the country. Wanica's capital city is Lelydorp, the second-largest city in Suriname.

Q1156471.name: Al Khor
Q1156471.about: Al Khor (Arabic: الخور; also spelled Al Khawr), officially Al Khor and Al Thakhira, is a municipality in northeastern Qatar. Al Khor, the municipal seat, is located on the northeast coast of Qatar, around 50 kilometres (31 miles) from the capital, Doha and is considered to be one of Qatar's major cities.

Q1185362.name: Demerara-Mahaica
Q1185362.about: Demerara-Mahaica (Region 4) is a region of Guyana. Its capital is Georgetown, the national capital and largest city of Guyana.

Q1263263.name: Dubréka Prefecture
Q1263263.about: Dubréka is a prefecture located in the Kindia Region of Guinea. The capital is Dubréka.

Q1277758.name: East Berbice-Corentyne
Q1277758.about: East Berbice-Corentyne (Region 6) is one of ten regions in Guyana. Its capital is New Amsterdam.

Q1281285.name: Matara District
Q1281285.about: Matara (Sinhala: මාතර දිස්ත්‍රික්කය Mātara distrikkaya; Tamil: மாத்தறை மாவட்டம் Māttaṛai māvaṭṭam) is a district in Southern Province, Sri Lanka. It is one of 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country.
Q1281285.img: M7 811 pulling an express train into Matara Station.jpg

Q1315953.name: Tabuk Province
Q1315953.about:
Tabuk Province 
is a province in Saudi Arabia, located along the northwestern coast of the country on the Red Sea. It borders Jordan to the north and is part of the Hejaz region.

Q66743.name: Puducherry
Q66743.about: Puducherry (also known as Poudouchéry in French or historically as Pondicherry) is a union territory of India, consisting of four small geographically unconnected districts. It was formed out of four territories of former French India, namely Pondichéry (now Puducherry), Karikal (Karaikal), Mahé and Yanaon (now Yanam), excluding Chandannagar (Chandernagore), and it is named after the largest district, Puducherry, which was also the capital of French India.

Q71699.name: Aomori Prefecture
Q71699.about: Aomori Prefecture (青森県, Aomori-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ä̀.ó̞.mò̞.ɾʲì, -mó̞.ɾʲí.kè̞ɴ̀], locally [ä̀.ó̞.mó̞.ɾʲí]) is a prefecture of Japan in the Tōhoku region. The prefecture's capital, largest city, and namesake is the city of Aomori.

Q71707.name: Fukushima Prefecture
Q71707.about: Fukushima Prefecture (福島県, Fukushima-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɸɯ̥̈.kɯ̈́.ɕì.mä̀, -ɕí.mä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Tōhoku region of Honshu. Fukushima Prefecture has a population of 1,771,100 (as of 1 July 2023) and has a geographic area of 13,783.90 square kilometres (5,321.99 sq mi).

Q72259.name: Portsmouth
Q72259.desc: city in Hampshire, England, United Kingdom
Q72259.about: Portsmouth (  PORTS-məth) is a port city and unitary authority in Hampshire, England. Most of Portsmouth is located on Portsea Island off the south coast of England in the Solent, making Portsmouth the only city in England not located primarily on the mainland.

Q199580.name: Central Greece Region
Q199580.desc: one of the 13 regions of Greece
Q199580.about: Central Greece is one of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece. The region occupies the eastern part of the traditional region of Central Greece, including the island of Euboea.

Q201149.name: Fife
Q201149.about: Fife ( FYFE, Scottish English: [fɐi̯f]; Scottish Gaelic: Fìobha [ˈfiːvə]; Scots: Fife) is a council area and lieutenancy area in Scotland. A peninsula, it is bordered by the Firth of Tay to the north, the North Sea to the east, the Firth of Forth to the south, Clackmannanshire to the south-west, and Perth and Kinross to the west.

Q202174.name: Argyll and Bute
Q202174.about: Argyll and Bute (Scots: Argyll an Buit; Scottish Gaelic: Earra-Ghàidheal agus Bòd, pronounced [ɛrˠəˈɣɛːəl̪ˠ akəs̪ ˈpɔːtʲ]) is one of 32 unitary council areas in Scotland and a lieutenancy area. The current lord-lieutenant for Argyll and Bute is Jane Margaret MacLeod (14 July 2020).

Q202177.name: Angus
Q202177.about: Angus (Scots: Angus; Scottish Gaelic: Aonghas) is one of the 32 local government council areas of Scotland, and a lieutenancy area. The council area borders Aberdeenshire, Dundee City and Perth and Kinross.
Q202177.img: Forfar East and Old Parish Church.JPG

Q202484.name: Peloponnese Region
Q202484.desc: one of the 13 administrative regions of Greece
Q202484.about: The Peloponnese Region (Greek: Περιφέρεια Πελοποννήσου, romanized: Periféria Peloponnísou, [periˈferia pelopoˈnisu]) is a region in southern Greece. It borders Western Greece to the north and Attica to the north-east.

Q72818.name: Haiphong
Q72818.about: Haiphong or Hai Phong (Vietnamese: Hải Phòng, pronounced [haːj˧˩ fawŋ͡m˨˩]) is the third-largest city in Vietnam, with an area of 3,194.72 km2 (1,233.49 mi2). It includes Bạch Long Vĩ and Cát Bà islands in the Gulf of Tonkin.

Q79846.name: Aydın Province
Q79846.about: Aydın Province (Turkish: Aydın ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality of southwestern Turkey, located in the Aegean Region. Its area is 8,116 km2, and its population is 1,148,241 (2022).

Q79848.name: Southampton
Q79848.desc: city and major port in Hampshire, South-East England, United Kingdom
Q79848.about: Southampton is a port city and unitary authority in Hampshire, England. It is located approximately 80 miles (130 km) southwest of London, 20 miles (32 km) west of Portsmouth, and 20 miles (32 km) southeast of Salisbury.

Q585.name: Oslo
Q585.about: Oslo is the capital and largest city of Norway. It constitutes both a county and a municipality.

Q16226.name: Province of Padua
Q16226.about: The province of Padua (Italian: provincia di Padova, Venetian: Provincia de Pàdova / Provincia de Pàdoa) is a province in the region of Veneto in Italy. Its capital is the city of Padua.

Q16242.name: Province of Pescara
Q16242.about: The Province of Pescara (Italian: provincia di Pescara; Abruzzese: pruvìngie de Pescàre) is a province in the region of Abruzzo in southern Italy. Its capital is the city of Pescara.

Q16244.name: Province of Pisa
Q16244.about: The Province of Pisa (Italian: Provincia di Pisa) is a province in the region of Tuscany in central Italy. Its capital is the city of Pisa.

Q16249.name: province of Potenza
Q16249.about: The province of Potenza (Italian: provincia di Potenza; Potentino: provìgnë dë Pùtenzë) is a province in the region of Basilicata in southern Italy. Its capital is the city of Potenza.

Q83342.name: Bartın Province
Q83342.about: Bartın Province (Turkish: Bartın ili) is a small province in northern Turkey on the Black Sea, surrounding the city of Bartın. Its area is 2,330 km2, and its population is 203,351 (2022).

Q83965.name: Kocaeli Province
Q83965.about: Kocaeli Province (Turkish: Kocaeli ili, pronounced [koˈdʒaeli]) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey and one of only three not to have the same official name as its capital, İzmit, which is thus also sometimes called Kocaeli. Its area is 3,397 km2 (1,312 sq mi), and its population is 2,102,907 (2023).

Q211091.name: Renfrewshire
Q211091.about: Renfrewshire ( REN-froo-sheer, -⁠shər; Scots: Renfrewshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Rinn Friù) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland. Renfrewshire is located in the west central Lowlands.

Q211106.name: Moray
Q211106.about: Moray ( ; Scottish Gaelic: Moireibh or Moireabh) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland. It lies in the north-east of the country, with a coastline on the Moray Firth, and borders the council areas of Aberdeenshire and Highland.

Q212540.name: Sonsonate Department
Q212540.about: Sonsonate (Spanish pronunciation: [sonsoˈnate]) is a department of El Salvador in the western part of the country. The capital is Sonsonate.

Q212768.name: Southern Peninsula Region
Q212768.about: Southern Peninsula (Icelandic: Suðurnes, pronounced [ˈsʏːðʏrˌnɛːs] ) is an administrative unit and part of Reykjanesskagi (pronounced [ˈreiːcaˌnɛsˌskaijɪ]), or Reykjanes Peninsula, a region in southwest Iceland. It was named after Reykjanes, the southwestern tip of Reykjanesskagi.

Q213361.name: Pembrokeshire
Q213361.desc: principal area in south-west Wales, United Kingdom
Q213361.about: Pembrokeshire ( PEM-bruuk-sheer, -⁠shər; Welsh: Sir Benfro [siːr ˈbɛnvrɔ]) is a county in the south-west of Wales. It is bordered by Ceredigion to the north-east, Carmarthenshire to the east, and otherwise by the sea.
Q213361.img: Circular walk from Solva to St Elvis and Dinas Fawr (25) - geograph.org.uk - 1532807.jpg

Q213893.name: Negeri Sembilan
Q213893.about: Negeri Sembilan (Malay pronunciation: [nəgəˈri səmbiˈlan], Negeri Sembilan Malay: Nogoghi Sombilan, Nismilan), historically spelled as Negri Sembilan and also known by the shorthand N9, is a state in Malaysia which lies on the western coast of Peninsular Malaysia. It borders Selangor on the north, Pahang in the east, and Malacca and Johor to the south.

Q203304.name: Capital Region
Q203304.desc: in Iceland, the capital Reykjavik and surrounding municipalities
Q203304.about: The Capital Region (Icelandic: Höfuðborgarsvæðið ) is a region in southwestern Iceland. It is one of the two classified Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics (NUTS-2) statistical regions of Iceland.

Q203349.name: Poole
Q203349.desc: town, seaport and civil parish in Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole, Dorset, England
Q203349.about: Poole ( ) is a coastal seaport town, on the south coast of England and civil parish in the Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole unitary authority area in Dorset, England. The town is 21 miles (34 km) east of Dorchester and adjoins Bournemouth to the east.

Q203995.name: Southend-on-Sea
Q203995.about: Southend-on-Sea ( ), commonly referred to as Southend (), is a coastal city and unitary authority area in south-eastern Essex, England. It lies on the north side of the Thames Estuary, 40 miles (64 km) east of central London.

Q204796.name: Southern Region
Q204796.about: Southern Region (Icelandic: Suðurland, pronounced [ˈsʏːðʏrˌlant] , lit. 'Southern Land') is a region of Iceland. The population of the region was 34,076 (1 January 2024).
Q204796.img: Dryholaus Nature Preserve Iceland Travel Photography (210240351).jpeg

Q104926.name: Uppsala County
Q104926.about: Uppsala County (Swedish: Uppsala län, pronounced [ˈɵpːˌsɑːla lɛːn]) is a county or län on the eastern coast of Sweden, whose capital is the city of Uppsala. It borders the counties of Dalarna, Stockholm, Södermanland, Västmanland, Gävleborg, and the Baltic Sea.
Q104926.img: Uppsala slott as seen from the botanical garden.jpg

Q104940.name: Östergötland County
Q104940.about: Östergötland County (Swedish: Östergötlands län, pronounced [ˈœsːtɛrˌjøːtlands lɛːn]) is a county or län in southeastern Sweden. It has land borders with the counties of Kalmar to the southeast, Jönköping to the southwest, Örebro to the northwest, and Södermanland to the northeast.

Q106915.name: Södermanland County
Q106915.about: Södermanland County (Swedish: Södermanlands län, pronounced [ˈsøːdɛrmanland lɛːn]) is a county or län on the southeast coast of Sweden. In the local Sörmlandic dialects it is virtually universally shortened and pronounced as Sörmlands län, or simply Sörmland, which is the dominant pronunciation and spelling inside the county.

Q109128.name: Gwynedd
Q109128.about: Gwynedd (Welsh: [ˈɡwɨnɛð]) is a county in the north-west of Wales. It borders Anglesey across the Menai Strait to the north, Conwy County Borough, Denbighshire, and Powys to the east, Ceredigion over the Dyfi estuary to the south, and the Irish Sea to the west.

Q109368.name: South Hamgyong Province
Q109368.about: South Hamgyong Province (Korean: 함경남도, Hamgyŏngnamdo; Korean pronunciation: [ham.ɡjʌŋ.nam.do]) is a province of North Korea.  The province was formed in 1896 from the southern half of the former Hamgyong Province, remained a province of Korea until 1945, then became a province of North Korea.

Q243805.name: Trang
Q243805.about: Trang (Thai: ตรัง, Thai pronunciation: [trāŋ]; Malay: Terang), also called Mueang Thap Thiang, is one of the southern provinces (changwat) of Thailand, on the west side of the Malay Peninsula facing the Strait of Malacca. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Krabi, Nakhon Si Thammarat, Phatthalung, and Satun.

Q243808.name: Phatthalung
Q243808.about: Phatthalung (Thai: พัทลุง, pronounced [pʰát̚.tʰā.lūŋ]) is one of the southern provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Nakhon Si Thammarat, Songkhla, Satun, and Trang.

Q244691.name: Nakhon Si Thammarat
Q244691.about: Nakhon Si Thammarat province (Thai/Southern Thai: นครศรีธรรมราช, Thai pronunciation: [ná(ʔ).kʰɔ̄ːn sǐː tʰām.mā.râːt], Southern Thai pronunciation: [nàʔ.kʰɔ̂ːn.síː.tʰām.mǎʔ.rǎt̚]) is a province (changwat) of Thailand, on the western shore of the Gulf of Thailand.  As of 2018, it was the most populous province of Southern Thailand, with a population of approximately 1.5 million.

Q1861.name: Bangkok
Q1861.about: Bangkok, known in Thai as Krung Thep Maha Nakhon and colloquially as Krung Thep, is the capital and largest city of Thailand. The city occupies 1,568.7 square kilometres (605.7 sq mi) in the Chao Phraya River delta in central Thailand and has an estimated population of 9.1 million people as of 2024, 15.9% of the country's population.
Q1861.img: Temple of the Emerald of buddha or Wat Phra Kaew (cropped).jpg

Q1191.name: Maharashtra
Q1191.desc: state in the western and central peninsular region of India
Q1191.about: Maharashtra is a state in the western peninsular region of India occupying a substantial portion of the Deccan Plateau. It is bordered by the Arabian Sea to the west, the Indian states of Karnataka and Goa to the south, Telangana to the southeast and Chhattisgarh to the east, Gujarat and Madhya Pradesh to the north, and the Indian union territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu to the northwest.

Q1256.name: Liguria
Q1256.about: Liguria ( lig-YOOR-ee-ə, Italian: [liˈɡuːrja]; Ligurian: Ligûria [liˈɡyːɾja]; French: Ligurie) is a region of north-western Italy; its capital is Genoa. Its territory is crossed by the Alps and the Apennines mountain range and is roughly coextensive with the former territory of the Republic of Genoa.

Q656.name: Saint Petersburg
Q656.desc: federal city and former capital of Russia
Q656.about: Saint Petersburg, formerly known as Petrograd (Петроград), and later Leningrad (Ленинград), is the second-largest city in Russia, after Moscow, the nation's capital. Situated on the Neva River at the head of the Gulf of Finland on the Baltic Sea, its area of 1,439 square kilometers (556 sq mi) makes it the smallest administrative division of Russia by area.

Q824.name: Oregon
Q824.desc: state of the United States of America
Q824.about: Oregon (  ORR-ih-ghən, -⁠gon) is a state in the Pacific Northwest region of the United States. It is a part of the Western United States, with the Columbia River delineating much of Oregon's northern boundary with Washington, while the Snake River delineates much of its eastern boundary with Idaho.
Q824.img: Columbia river gorge from crown point.jpg

Q16318.name: Province of Viterbo
Q16318.about: The Province of Viterbo (Italian: provincia di Viterbo) is a province in the region of Lazio in Italy. Its capital is the city of Viterbo.

Q16520.name: Busan
Q16520.about: Busan (Korean: 부산; pronounced [pusʰan]; alternatively romanized as Pusan), officially Busan Metropolitan City, is the second most populous city in South Korea, after Seoul; it has a population of over 3.3 million as of 2024. It is the economic, cultural and educational center of southeastern South Korea, with its port being South Korea's busiest and the sixth-busiest in the world.

Q16963.name: Jiangsu
Q16963.about: Jiangsu is a coastal province in East China. It is one of the leading provinces in finance, education, technology, and tourism, with its capital in Nanjing.

Q20934.name: Incheon
Q20934.desc: city in Seoul Capital Area, South Korea
Q20934.about: Incheon is a city located in northwestern South Korea, bordering Seoul and Gyeonggi Province to the east. Inhabited since the Neolithic, Incheon was home to just 4,700 people when it became an international port in 1883.

Q21208.name: Hebei
Q21208.about: Hebei is a province in North China. It is China's sixth-most populous province, with 74.6 million people at the 2020 census; the provincial statistics bureau estimated the resident population at 73.54 million at the end of 2025.

Q127513.name: Kanagawa Prefecture
Q127513.about: Kanagawa Prefecture (神奈川県, Kanagawa-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [kä̀.nä́.ɡä̀.β̞ä̀, -ŋä̀.β̞ä̀, -ɡä́.β̞ä́, -ŋä́.β̞ä́, -ɡä́.β̞ä́.kè̞ɴ, -ŋä́.β̞ä́-]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Kanagawa Prefecture is the second-most populous prefecture of Japan at 9,221,129 (1 April 2022) and third-densest at 3,800 inhabitants per square kilometre (9,800/sq mi).

Q128147.name: Kingston upon Hull
Q128147.desc: city in the East Riding of Yorkshire, England, UK
Q128147.about: Kingston upon Hull, or simply Hull, is a port city and unitary authority area in the East Riding of Yorkshire, England. It lies upon the River Hull at its confluence with the Humber Estuary, 25 miles (40 km) inland from the North Sea.

Q128196.name: Mie Prefecture
Q128196.about: Mie Prefecture (三重県, Mie-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [mʲí.è̞, mʲì.é̞.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Kansai region of Honshu. Mie Prefecture has a population of 1,781,948 (as of 1 June 2019) and has a geographic area of 5,774 square kilometers (2,229 sq mi).
Q128196.img: 140405 Tsu Castle Tsu MIe pref Japan01s.jpg

Q1171.name: Goa
Q1171.about: Goa ( GOH-ə; Konkani: [ɡɔ̃j]; Portuguese: [ˈɡoɐ] ) is a state on the southwestern coast of India within the Konkan region. It is geographically separated from the Deccan highlands by the Western Ghats.
Q1171.img: The Terekhol River and Querim Beach, panoramic view, Goa, India.jpg

Q1445.name: Tamil Nadu
Q1445.about: Tamil Nadu is the southernmost state of India. The tenth largest Indian state by area and the sixth largest by population, it is the home of the Tamils, who speak the Tamil language, the state's official language and the first to be recognised as a classical language in India.
Q1445.img: Tea Fields Nilgiris Ranges Mynala Dec25 A7CR 09866.jpg

Q1490.name: Tokyo
Q1490.desc: capital and largest city of Japan
Q1490.about: Tokyo, officially the Tokyo Metropolis, is the capital and most populous city of Japan. The population of the city proper was over 14 million as of 2023.

Q2164.name: Nenets Autonomous District
Q2164.desc: federal subject of Russia, administered by Arkhangelsk Oblast
Q2164.about: The Nenets Autonomous Okrug (Russian: Не́нецкий автоно́мный о́круг; Nenets: Ненэцие" автономной округ’, romanized: Nyeneciye” awtonomnoy okruk’), also known as Nenetsia (Russian: Нене́ция [nʲɪˈnʲet͡sɨjə]), is a federal subject of Russia and an autonomous okrug of Arkhangelsk Oblast. Its administrative center is the town of Naryan-Mar.

Q2254.name: Telemark
Q2254.about: Telemark (pronounced [ˈtêːləmɑrk] ) is a county in Norway. Telemark borders the counties of Vestfold, Buskerud, Vestland, Rogaland and Agder.

Q103707.name: Kalmar County
Q103707.about: Kalmar County (Swedish: Kalmar län, pronounced [ˈkǎlmar lɛːn]) is a county or län in southern Sweden. It borders the counties of Kronoberg, Jönköping, Blekinge and Östergötland.

Q104036.name: Ventspils
Q104036.desc: state city in western Latvia on the Baltic Sea
Q104036.about:
Ventspils (Latvian: [ˈvæntspils] ) is a state city in northwestern Latvia in the historical Courland region of Latvia, and is the sixth largest city in the country.
At the beginning of 2020, Ventspils had a population of 33,906.

Q104231.name: Stockholm County
Q104231.about: Stockholm County (Swedish: Stockholms län, pronounced [ˈstɔ̂kː(h)ɔlms ˈlɛːn]) is a county (Swedish: län) on the Baltic Sea coast of Sweden. It borders Uppsala County and Södermanland County.

Q104891.name: Västernorrland County
Q104891.about: Västernorrland County (Swedish: Västernorrlands län, pronounced [ˈvɛstɛrˌnɔrlands ˈlɛːn]) is a county (län) in the north of Sweden. It is bordered by the counties of Gävleborg, Jämtland, Västerbotten and the Gulf of Bothnia.

Q207679.name: Perth and Kinross
Q207679.desc: council area of Scotland, United Kingdom
Q207679.about: Perth and Kinross (Scots: Pairth an Kinross; Scottish Gaelic: Peairt agus Ceann Rois) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland, and a lieutenancy area. It is bordered by Highland and Aberdeenshire to the north, Angus, Dundee, and Fife to the east, Clackmannanshire to the south, and Stirling and Argyll and Bute to the west.

Q208121.name: West Dunbartonshire
Q208121.about: West Dunbartonshire (Scots: Wast Dunbairtonshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Dhùn Breatann an Iar, pronounced [ˈʃirˠəxk ɣum ˈpɾʲɛht̪ən̪ˠ əɲ ˈiəɾ]) is one of the 32 local government council areas of Scotland. The area lies to the north-west of the Glasgow City council area and contains many of Glasgow's commuter towns and villages.

Q208271.name: Inverclyde
Q208271.about: Inverclyde (Scots: Inerclyde; Scottish Gaelic: Inbhir Chluaidh, pronounced [iɲiɾʲˈxl̪ˠuəj], "mouth of the Clyde") is one of 32 council areas used for local government in Scotland. Together with the East Renfrewshire and Renfrewshire council areas, Inverclyde forms part of the historic county of Renfrewshire, which currently exists as a registration county and lieutenancy area.

Q208279.name: Highland
Q208279.desc: council area in the Scottish Highlands
Q208279.about: The Highland (Scottish Gaelic: Gàidhealtachd, pronounced [ˈkɛːəl̪ˠt̪əxk]; Scots: Hieland) council area is a council area in the Scottish Highlands and is the largest local government area in both Scotland and the United Kingdom. It was the 7th most populous council area in Scotland at the 2011 census.

Q209131.name: South Ayrshire
Q209131.about: South Ayrshire (Scots: Sooth Ayrshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Àir a Deas, pronounced [ˈʃirˠəxk aːɾʲ ə ˈtʲes̪]) is one of thirty-two council areas of Scotland, covering the southern part of Ayrshire. It borders onto Dumfries and Galloway, East Ayrshire and North Ayrshire.

Q210866.name: Northwestern Region
Q210866.desc: first-level administrative country subdivision (region) in Iceland
Q210866.about: Northwestern Region (Icelandic: Norðurland vestra, pronounced [ˈnɔrðʏrˌlant ˈvɛstra] ) is one of the traditional eight regions of Iceland, located in the north of the island. The largest town in the region is Sauðárkrókur, with a population of 2,609 in 2024.

Q16252.name: Province of Ravenna
Q16252.about: The province of Ravenna (Italian: provincia di Ravenna; Romagnol: pruvènza ed Ravèna) is a province in the region of Emilia-Romagna in Italy. Its capital is the city of Ravenna.

Q16253.name: Province of Reggio Calabria
Q16253.desc: ex province of Italy, now Metropolitan City of Reggio Calabria
Q16253.about: The province of Reggio Calabria (Italian: provincia di Reggio Calabria) was a province in the Calabria region of Italy. It was the southernmost province in mainland Italy and is separated from the island of Sicily by the Strait of Messina.

Q16270.name: Province of Rovigo
Q16270.desc: Italian province in the region of Veneto
Q16270.about: The province of Rovigo (Italian: provincia di Rovigo) is a province in the Veneto region of Italy. Its capital is the city of Rovigo.
Q16270.img: Villa Badoer Fratta Polesine facciata by Marcok 2009-08-16 n08.jpg

Q16271.name: Province of Salerno
Q16271.about: The province of Salerno (Italian: provincia di Salerno, Neapolitan: Pruvincia 'e Salierno) is a province in the Campania region of Italy. It has a population of 1,053,302 in an area of 4,954.16 square kilometres (1,912.81 sq mi) across its 158 municipalities.

Q16274.name: Province of Savona
Q16274.about: The province of Savona (Italian: provincia di Savona; Ligurian: provinsa de Sann-a) is a province in the region of Liguria in northern Italy. Its capital is the city of Savona.

Q3240.name: Bouches-du-Rhône
Q3240.about: Bouches-du-Rhône ( BOOSH dew ROHN; French: les Bouches-du-Rhône [le buʃ dy ʁon] , locally [le ˈbuʃə dy ˈʁɔnə]; Occitan: lei Bocas de Ròse [lej ˈbukɔz de ˈʀɔze]; "the Mouths of the Rhône") is a department in southern France. It borders Vaucluse to the north, Gard to the west and Var to the east.

Q5696.name: Central Ostrobothnia
Q5696.about: Central Ostrobothnia (Finnish: Keski-Pohjanmaa; Swedish: Mellersta Österbotten) is a region in Finland. Central Ostrobothnia borders the Bothnian Bay and the regions of Ostrobothnia, North Ostrobothnia, Central Finland and South Ostrobothnia.

Q5702.name: Ostrobothnia
Q5702.about: Ostrobothnia (Swedish: Österbotten; Finnish: Pohjanmaa) is a region on the west coast of Finland. It borders Central Ostrobothnia, South Ostrobothnia and Satakunta, and faces the Gulf of Bothnia.

Q16283.name: Province of Taranto
Q16283.about: The Province of Taranto (Italian: provincia di Taranto; Tarantino: provìnge de Tarde; Salentino: provincia ti Tàrantu), previously known as the province of the Ionian, is a province in the region of Apulia in southern Italy. Its capital is the city of Taranto.

Q16284.name: Province of Teramo
Q16284.about: The Province of Teramo (Italian: provincia di Teramo; Abruzzese: pruvìngie de Tèreme) is a province in the region of Abruzzo in southern Italy. Its capital is the city of Teramo.

Q16310.name: Province of Venice
Q16310.desc: former province in the region of Veneto, Italy
Q16310.about: The province of Venice (Italian: provincia di Venezia) was a province in the Veneto region of Italy. Its capital was the city of Venice.
Q16310.img: Palazzo Corner della Ca' Grande gran canal san marco .jpg

Q16315.name: Province of Vibo Valentia
Q16315.about:
The province of Vibo Valentia (Italian: provincia di Vibo Valentia; Vibonese: pruvincia i Vibbu Valenzia) is a province in the region of Calabria in southern Italy, Its capital is the city of Vibo Valentia and its vehicle licence plate code is VV.
The province has a population of 149,922 in an area of 1,150.64 square kilometres (444.26 sq mi) across its 50 municipalities.

Q102377.name: Blekinge County
Q102377.about: Blekinge County (Swedish: Blekinge län, pronounced [ˈbleːkɪŋɛ lɛːn]) is a county or län in the south of Sweden. It borders the Counties of Skåne, Kronoberg, Kalmar and the Baltic Sea.

Q103659.name: Skåne County
Q103659.about: Skåne County (Swedish: Skåne län, pronounced [ˈskôːnɛ ˈlɛːn]), sometimes referred to as Scania County or just Scania ( SKAY-nee-ə) in English, is the southernmost county, or län, of Sweden, mostly corresponding to the traditional province of Scania. It borders the counties of Halland, Kronoberg and Blekinge and connects to Capital Region, Denmark by the Öresund Bridge across the Øresund strait.

Q103691.name: Halland County
Q103691.about: Halland County (Swedish: Hallands län, pronounced [ˈhǎlːan(d)s ˈlɛːn]) is a county (län) on the western coast of Sweden. It corresponds roughly to the cultural and historical province of Halland.

Q103699.name: Gävleborg County
Q103699.about: Gävleborg County (Swedish: Gävleborgs län, pronounced [ˈjɛːvlɛˌbɔrjs ˈlɛːn]) is a county or län on the Baltic Sea coast of Sweden. It borders the counties of Uppsala, Västmanland, Dalarna, Jämtland, and Västernorrland.

Q236769.name: Krabi
Q236769.about: Krabi (Thai: กระบี่ pronounced [krā.bìː]) is a province (changwat) of southern Thailand, on the shore of the Andaman Sea. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Phang Nga, Surat Thani, Nakhon Si Thammarat, and Trang.

Q236781.name: Pattani
Q236781.about: Pattani (Thai: ปัตตานี, pronounced [pàt.tāː.nīː]; Pattani Malay: ڤطاني, 'ตานิง, Taning, pronounced [ˈtːaniŋ]; Malay: Patani) is one of the southern provinces of Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from southeast clockwise) Narathiwat, Yala, and Songkhla.

Q240463.name: Surat Thani
Q240463.about: Surat Thani (Thai: สุราษฎร์ธานี, pronounced [sù.râːt tʰāː.nīː]), often shortened to Surat, is the largest province (changwat) of Southern Thailand. It lies on the western shore of the Gulf of Thailand.
Q240463.img: Ao Thong Nai Pan, Koh Phangan, Thailand 02-2003.jpg

Q241551.name: Northeastern Region
Q241551.about: Northeastern Region (Icelandic: Norðurland eystra, pronounced [ˈnɔrðʏrˌlant ˈeistra] ) is one of the traditional eight regions of Iceland, located in the north of the island. The biggest town in the region is Akureyri, with a population of 19,542 in 2024.

Q219956.name: Zonguldak Province
Q219956.about: Zonguldak Province (Turkish: Zonguldak ili) is a province along the western Black Sea coast region of Turkey. Its area is 3,342 km2, and its population is 588,510 (2022).

Q220663.name: Eastern Region
Q220663.about: Eastern Region (Icelandic: Austurland; pronounced [ˈœystʏrˌlant] ) is a region in eastern Iceland. Its area is 15,706 square kilometres (6,064 sq mi).

Q221791.name: Western Region
Q221791.about: Western Region (Icelandic: Vesturland, pronounced [ˈvɛstʏrˌlant] ) is one of the traditional eight regions of Iceland, located on the western coast of the island. As of 2024, the region has a population of 17,419.

Q229892.name: Tirana County
Q229892.about: Tirana County (Albanian: Qarku Tiranë), officially the County of Tirana (Albanian: Qarku i Tiranës), is a county in the Central Region of Albania. It is the tenth-largest by area and the most populous of the twelve counties according to the 2023 Census, with about 760,000 inhabitants within an area of 1,652 km2 (638 sq mi).

Q231900.name: Fier County
Q231900.about: Fier County (Albanian pronunciation: [fieɽ]; Albanian: Qarku Fier), officially the County of Fier (Albanian: Qarku i Fierit), is a county in the Southern Region of the Republic of Albania. It is the eighth largest by area and the third most populous of the twelve counties, with about 240,000 people within an area of 1,890 km2 (730 sq mi).

Q132945.name: Bushehr Province
Q132945.about: Bushehr Province (Persian: استان بوشهر) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. It is in the south of the country, with a long coastline on the Persian Gulf.
Q132945.img: PERSIAN GULF, Mangrove jungle in Asalouyeh جنگل حرا ، بندر عسلویه - panoramio.jpg

Q133879.name: Fukui Prefecture
Q133879.about: Fukui Prefecture (福井県, Fukui-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɸɯ̥̈.kɯ̈́ì, -kɯ̈́í, -kɯ̈̀ì, -kɯ̈́.í.kè̞ɴ̀, -kɯ̈́ì-]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshū. Fukui Prefecture has a population of 737,229 (1 January 2025) and has a geographic area of 4,190 km2 (1,617 sq mi).

Q133924.name: Ōita Prefecture
Q133924.about: Ōita Prefecture (大分県, Ōita-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ó̞ò̞.ì.tä̀, ò̞ó̞.í.tä́(.kè̞ɴ̀), ó̞ó̞.í.tä́(.kè̞ɴ̀)]) is a prefecture of Japan located on the island of Kyūshū. Ōita Prefecture has a population of 1,081,646 (1 February 2025) and has a geographic area of 6,340 km2 (2,450 sq mi).

Q123258.name: Fukuoka Prefecture
Q123258.about: Fukuoka Prefecture (福岡県, Fukuoka-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɸɯ̥̈.kɯ̈́.ò̞.kä̀, -ó̞.kä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located on the island of Kyūshū. Fukuoka Prefecture has a population of 5,081,879 (1 October 2025) and has a geographic area of 4,986 square kilometres (1,925 sq mi).

Q123376.name: Ehime Prefecture
Q123376.about: Ehime Prefecture (愛媛県, Ehime-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [é̞.çì.mè̞, è̞.çí.mé̞.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located on the island of Shikoku. Ehime Prefecture has a population of 1,334,841 and a geographic area of 5,676 km2 (2,191 sq mi).

Q123709.name: Dundee
Q123709.about:
Dundee is the fourth-largest city in Scotland. The 2020 mid-year population estimate for the locality was 
148,210.

Q22048.name: Odisha
Q22048.about: Odisha (Oriya: oṛiśā, pronounced [oˈɽisa] ), spelled Orissa until 2011, is a state located in eastern India. It is the eighth-largest state by area, and the eleventh-largest by population, with over 41 million inhabitants.

Q23051.name: Swansea
Q23051.about: Swansea ( SWON-zee; Welsh: Abertawe [abɛrˈtawɛ]) is a port and coastal city in Wales. It is the second-largest city in the country.

Q23077.name: Lancashire
Q23077.desc: ceremonial county in North-West England, United Kingdom
Q23077.about: Lancashire ( LANG-kə-shər,  -⁠sheer; abbreviated Lancs) is a ceremonial county in North West England. It is bordered by Cumbria to the north, North Yorkshire and West Yorkshire to the east, Greater Manchester and Merseyside to the south, and the Irish Sea to the west.

Q79861.name: Michoacán
Q79861.about: Michoacán, formally Michoacán de Ocampo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Michoacán de Ocampo, is one of the 31 states which, together with Mexico City, compose the Federal Entities of Mexico. The state is divided into 113 municipalities and its capital city is Morelia (formerly called Valladolid).

Q80011.name: Chiba Prefecture
Q80011.about: Chiba Prefecture (千葉県, Chiba-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [c̟͡ɕí.bä̀, c̟͡ɕì.bä́(.kè̞ɴ̀)]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Chiba Prefecture has a population of 6,278,060 (1 June 2019) and has a geographic area of 5,157 km2 (1,991 sq mi).
Q80011.img: Mt. Fuji and Keiyo petrochemical complex.JPG

Q80434.name: Aichi Prefecture
Q80434.about: Aichi Prefecture (愛知県, Aichi-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ä́ì.c̟͡ɕì, ä̀í.c̟͡ɕi̥.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshū. Aichi Prefecture has a population of 7,461,111 (as of 1 January 2025) and a geographic area of 5,172.92 square kilometres (1,997.28 sq mi) with a population density of 1,442 inhabitants per square kilometre (3,730/sq mi).

Q23090.name: Lincolnshire
Q23090.desc: ceremonial county in the east of England
Q23090.about: Lincolnshire () is a ceremonial county in the East Midlands and Yorkshire and the Humber regions of England. It is bordered by the East Riding of Yorkshire across the Humber estuary to the north, the North Sea to the east, Norfolk, Cambridgeshire, Northamptonshire, and Rutland to the south, and Leicestershire, Nottinghamshire, and South Yorkshire to the west.
Q23090.img: Lincoln Cathedral viewed from Lincoln Castle.jpg

Q23111.name: Suffolk
Q23111.about: Suffolk (  SUF-ək) is a ceremonial county in the East of England and East Anglia. It is bordered by Norfolk to the north, the North Sea to the east, Essex to the south, and Cambridgeshire to the west.

Q23109.name: Norfolk
Q23109.desc: county in East Anglia, England, UK
Q23109.about: Norfolk ( NOR-fək, -⁠fuuk) is a ceremonial county in England, located in the East of England and East Anglia. It borders Lincolnshire and The Wash to the north-west, the North Sea to the north and east, Cambridgeshire to the west, and Suffolk to the south.

Q1773.name: Riga
Q1773.desc: capital and largest city of Latvia
Q1773.about: Riga (  REE-gə), officially Riga State City (Latvian: Rīgas valstspilsēta), is the capital, primate, and largest city of Latvia and the second most-populous city in the Baltics. Home to 588,911 inhabitants (as of 2026), the city accounts for a third of Latvia's total population.
Q1773.img: Vistas desde la iglesia de San Pedro, Riga, Letonia, 2012-08-07, DD 12.JPG

Q5711.name: Uusimaa
Q5711.about: Uusimaa (Finnish: [ˈuːsimɑː]; Swedish: Nyland, Finland Swedish: [ˈnyːlɑnd]) is a region of Finland. It borders the regions of Southwest Finland, Kanta-Häme, Päijät-Häme, and Kymenlaakso.

Q5709.name: Satakunta
Q5709.about: Satakunta (in both Finnish and Swedish, Finnish pronunciation: [ˈs̠ɑt̪ɑˌkun̪t̪ɑ]; historically Satacundia or Satagundia) is a region (maakunta / landskap) of Finland, part of the former Western Finland Province. It borders the regions of Southwest Finland, Pirkanmaa, South Ostrobothnia and Ostrobothnia.

Q1186.name: Kerala
Q1186.about: Kerala (English:  / KERR-ə-lə; Malayalam: [keːɾɐɭɐm] ), officially Keralam, is a state on the Malabar Coast of southern India. It was formed on 1 November 1956 under the States Reorganisation Act, which unified the country's Malayalam-speaking regions into a single state.

Q1185.name: Karnataka
Q1185.about: Karnataka is a state on the southwestern coast of India. It was formed as Mysore State on 1 November 1956, with the passage of the States Reorganisation Act, and renamed in 1973.

Q388995.name: Trabzon Province
Q388995.about: Trabzon Province (Turkish: Trabzon ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey on the Black Sea coast. Its area is 4,628 km2, and its population is 818,023 (2022).

Q432391.name: Düzce Province
Q432391.about: Düzce Province (Turkish: Düzce ili) is a province in northwestern Turkey. The province is on the coastline of the Black Sea and is traversed by the main highway between Istanbul and Ankara.

Q459723.name: Barisal Division
Q459723.about: Barisal Division (Bengali: বরিশাল বিভাগ, romanized: Borishal Bibhag; Bengali pronunciation: [boriʃal bibʱag]) is one of the eight administrative divisions of Bangladesh. Located in the south-central part of the country, it has an area of 13,225 km2 (5,106 sq mi), and a population of 9,325,820 at the 2022 census.
Q459723.img: Barisal Judge Court and Collectorate Pond.jpg

Q459742.name: Samut Songkhram
Q459742.about:
Samut Songkhram (Thai: สมุทรสงคราม, pronounced [sā.mùt sǒŋ.kʰrāːm]) is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand.
Neighbouring provinces are (from the south clockwise) Phetchaburi, Ratchaburi and Samut Sakhon.

Q204940.name: West Lothian
Q204940.about: West Lothian (Scots: Wast Lowden; Scottish Gaelic: Lodainn an Iar) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland, bordering (in a clockwise direction) the City of Edinburgh council area, Scottish Borders, South Lanarkshire, North Lanarkshire and Falkirk. The modern council area was formed in 1975 when the historic county of West Lothian, also known as Linlithgowshire, was reshaped substantially as part of local government reforms; some areas that had formerly been part of Midlothian were added to a new West Lothian District within the Region of Lothian, whilst some areas in the north-west were transferred to the Falkirk District and areas in the north-east were transferred to the City of Edinburgh District.

Q206926.name: North Ayrshire
Q206926.about: North Ayrshire (Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Àir a Tuath, pronounced [ˈʃirˠəxk aːɾʲ ə ˈt̪ʰuə]) is one of 32 council areas in Scotland. The council area borders Inverclyde to the north, Renfrewshire and East Renfrewshire to the northeast, and East Ayrshire and South Ayrshire to the east and south respectively.

Q206934.name: Midlothian
Q206934.about: Midlothian (; Scottish Gaelic: Meadhan Lodainn) is a registration county, lieutenancy area and one of 32 council areas of Scotland used for local government. Midlothian lies in the east-central Lowlands, bordering the City of Edinburgh council area, East Lothian and the Scottish Borders.

Q207068.name: Chon Buri
Q207068.about: Chonburi (Thai: ชลบุรี, RTGS: Chon Buri, [tɕ͡ʰōn bū.rīː] ) is a province of Thailand (changwat) located in eastern Thailand. Its capital is also named Chonburi.

Q207257.name: East Lothian
Q207257.desc: council area of Scotland; lieutenancy area
Q207257.about: East Lothian (; Scots: Aest Lowden; Scottish Gaelic: Lodainn an Ear) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland, as well as an historic county, registration county and lieutenancy area. The county was called Haddingtonshire until 1921.

Q207268.name: Clackmannanshire
Q207268.about: Clackmannanshire ( ; Scots: Clackmannanshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Chlach Mhanann), or the County of Clackmannan, is a historic county, council area, registration county and lieutenancy area in Scotland, bordering the council areas of Stirling, Fife, and Perth and Kinross. To the south, it is separated from Falkirk by the Firth of Forth.

Q23082.name: County Durham
Q23082.desc: ceremonial county in North East England, United Kingdom
Q23082.about: County Durham, also called simply Durham, is a ceremonial county in North East England. The county borders Northumberland and Tyne and Wear to the north, the North Sea to the east, North Yorkshire to the south, and Cumbria to the west.

Q23086.name: North Yorkshire
Q23086.about: North Yorkshire is a ceremonial county in Northern England. It is bordered by County Durham to the north, the North Sea to the east, the East Riding of Yorkshire to the south-east, South Yorkshire to the south, West Yorkshire to the south-west, and Cumbria and Lancashire to the west.

Q23088.name: East Riding of Yorkshire
Q23088.about: The East Riding of Yorkshire, often abbreviated to the East Riding or East Yorkshire, is a ceremonial county in the Yorkshire and the Humber region of England. It borders North Yorkshire to the north and west, South Yorkshire to the south-west, and Lincolnshire to the south across the Humber Estuary.

Q1764.name: Reykjavík
Q1764.desc: capital and largest city in Iceland
Q1764.about: Reykjavík is the capital and largest city of Iceland. It is located on the southern shore of the Faxaflói bay in southwest Iceland and has a latitude of 64°08′ N, making it the world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state.

Q216802.name: Falkirk
Q216802.desc: unitary authority council area of Scotland
Q216802.about: Falkirk ( FAWL-kurk; Scots: Fawkirk [ˈfɔːkɪrk]; Scottish Gaelic: An Eaglais Bhreac) is one of 32 unitary authority council areas of Scotland. It was formed on 1 April 1996 by way of the Local Government etc.

Q216945.name: Mount Lebanon Governorate
Q216945.about: Mount Lebanon Governorate (Arabic: محافظة جبل لبنان, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Jabal Lubnān) is one of the nine governorates of Lebanon, of which it is the most populous. Its capital is Baabda.

Q217829.name: Ceredigion
Q217829.desc: principal area in mid-Wales, corresponding to the historic county of Cardiganshire
Q217829.about: Ceredigion (Welsh: [kɛrɛˈdɪɡjɔn] ), historically Cardiganshire (, Welsh: Sir Aberteifi), is a county in the west of Wales. It borders Gwynedd across the Dyfi estuary to the north, Powys to the east, Carmarthenshire and Pembrokeshire to the south, and the Irish Sea to the west.

Q217838.name: Stirling
Q217838.about: The Stirling council area (Scots: Stirlin; Scottish Gaelic: Sruighlea) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland, and has an estimated population of 94,040 (2025). It was created in 1975 as a lower-tier district within the Central region.

Q217840.name: Carmarthenshire
Q217840.about: Carmarthenshire ( kər-MAR-dhən-shər, -⁠sheer; Welsh: Sir Gaerfyrddin [ˈsiːr ɡaːɨrˈvərðɪn] or informally Sir Gâr) is a county  in the south-west of Wales. The three largest towns are Llanelli, Carmarthen and Ammanford.

Q5712.name: Southwest Finland
Q5712.about: Southwest Finland (Finnish: Varsinais-Suomi, IPA: [ˈʋɑrs̠inɑi̯s̠ˌs̠uo̞̯mi]; Swedish: Egentliga Finland) is a region (Finnish: maakunta, Swedish: landskap) of Finland. It borders the regions of Satakunta, Pirkanmaa, Kanta-Häme, Uusimaa, and Åland.

Q6407.name: Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous District
Q6407.desc: federal subject of Russia, administered by Tyumen Oblast
Q6407.about: The Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug, also known as Yamalia (Russian: Ямалия) is a federal subject of Russia and an autonomous okrug of Tyumen Oblast. Its administrative center is the town of Salekhard, and its largest city is Novy Urengoy.

Q6563.name: Krasnoyarsk Krai
Q6563.desc: krai and federal subject in Siberian Federal District, Russia
Q6563.about: Krasnoyarsk Krai is a federal subject (a krai) of Russia located in Siberia. Its administrative center is the city of Krasnoyarsk, the second-largest city in Siberia after Novosibirsk.

Q123934.name: Muğla Province
Q123934.about: Muğla Province (Turkish: Muğla ili, pronounced [muːɫa iˈli]) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey, at the country's southwestern corner, on the Aegean Sea. Its area is 12,654 km2, and its population is 1,048,185 (2022).

Q125863.name: Yamagata Prefecture
Q125863.about: Yamagata Prefecture (山形県, Yamagata-ken) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Tōhoku region of Honshu. It has a population of 1,005,926 (1 February 2025) and an area of 9,325 km2 (3,600 sq mi).

Q127264.name: Yamaguchi Prefecture
Q127264.about: Yamaguchi Prefecture (山口県, Yamaguchi-ken) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūgoku region of Honshu. Yamaguchi Prefecture has a population of 1,377,631 (1 February 2018) and has a geographic area of 6,112 km2 (2,359 sq mi).

Q81863.name: Akita Prefecture
Q81863.about: Akita Prefecture (秋田県, Akita-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ä́.k̟ʲi̥.tä̀, ä̀.k̟ʲi̥.tä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Tōhoku region of Honshu. Its population is estimated 915,691 as of 1 August 2023 and its geographic area is 11,637 square kilometres (4,493 sq mi).
Q81863.img: Akita Prefectural Government Office building No.1 20180520n.jpg

Q83069.name: Sakarya Province
Q83069.about: Sakarya  (Turkish: Sakarya ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in Turkey, located on the coast of the Black Sea. Its area is 4,824 km2 (1,863 sq mi), and its population is 1,110,735 (2024).

Q83273.name: Ibaraki Prefecture
Q83273.about: Ibaraki Prefecture (茨城県, Ibaraki-ken, -gi-; Japanese pronunciation: [ì.bä́.ɾä̀.k̟ʲì, -ɡ̟ʲì, -ŋ̟ʲì, -ɾä́.k̟ʲi̥.kè̞ɴ̀, -ɡ̟ʲí-, -ŋ̟ʲí-]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Ibaraki Prefecture has a population of 2,828,086 (1 July 2023) and has a geographic area of 6,097.19 square kilometres (2,354.14 square miles).
Q83273.img: Autumn of Fukuroda Falls, Daigo, Ibaraki; November 2016.jpg

Q132751.name: Shimane Prefecture
Q132751.about: Shimane Prefecture (島根県, Shimane-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɕí.mä̀.nè̞, ɕì.mä́.né̞.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūgoku region of Honshu. Shimane Prefecture is the second-least populous prefecture of Japan at 665,205 (February 1, 2021) and has a geographic area of 6,708.26 km2.

Q132929.name: Toyama Prefecture
Q132929.about: Toyama Prefecture (富山県, Toyama-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [tó̞.jä̀.mä̀, tò̞.jä́.mä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. Toyama Prefecture has a population of 993,848 (1 January 2025) and has a geographic area of 4,247.61 km2 (1,640.01 sq mi).

Q132936.name: Okayama Prefecture
Q132936.about: Okayama Prefecture (岡山県, Okayama-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ò̞.kä́.jä̀.mä̀, -jä́.mä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūgoku region of Honshu. Okayama Prefecture has a population of 1,815,165 (1 October 2025) and has a geographic area of 7,114 km2 (2,746 sq mi).

Q132637.name: Mersin Province
Q132637.about: Mersin Province (Turkish: Mersin ili), formerly İçel Province (İçel ili), is a province and metropolitan municipality in southern Turkey, on the Mediterranean coast between Antalya and Adana. Its area is 16,010 km2, and its population is 1,916,432 (2022).

Q132705.name: Niigata Prefecture
Q132705.about: Niigata Prefecture (新潟県, Niigata-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɲ̟ìí.ɡä́.tä́(.kè̞ɴ̀), -ŋä́-, ɲ̟íí-]) is a prefecture in the Chūbu region of Honshu of Japan. Niigata Prefecture has a population of 2,071,066 (as of 1 October 2025) and is the fifth-largest prefecture of Japan by geographic area at 12,584.18 km2 (4,858.78 sq mi).

Q16114.name: Province of Ancona
Q16114.about: The province of Ancona (Italian: provincia di Ancona) is a province in the region of Marche in Italy. Its capital is the city of Ancona, and the province borders the Adriatic Sea.

Q16117.name: Province of Ascoli Piceno
Q16117.about: The province of Ascoli Piceno (Italian: provincia di Ascoli Piceno) is a province in the region of Marche in Italy. Its capital is the city of Ascoli Piceno.

Q16123.name: Province of Bari
Q16123.about: The province of Bari (Italian: provincia di Bari; Neapolitan: pruvincia 'e Bari; Barese: provinge de Bare) was a province in the Apulia region of Italy. Its capital was the city of Bari.

Q16124.name: Province of Barletta-Andria-Trani
Q16124.about: The province of Barletta-Andria-Trani (Italian: Provincia di Barletta-Andria-Trani, Neapolitan: Pruvincia 'e Barletta-Andria-Trani) is a province in the region of Apulia in Italy. The establishment of the province took effect in June 2009, and Andria was appointed as its seat of government on 21 May 2010.

Q16148.name: Province of Brindisi
Q16148.about: The province of Brindisi (Italian: provincia di Brindisi) is a province in the region of Apulia in southern Italy. Its capital is the city of Brindisi.

Q1875.name: Arkhangelsk Oblast
Q1875.desc: oblast and federal subject in the North-West of Russia
Q1875.about: Arkhangelsk Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). It includes the Arctic archipelagos of Franz Josef Land and Novaya Zemlya, as well as the Solovetsky Islands in the White Sea.

Q1952.name: Nova Scotia
Q1952.about: Nova Scotia is a province in The Maritimes region of Canada, located on the nation's east coast. With an estimated population of over 1 million as of 2026, Nova Scotia is the most populous province in Atlantic Canada.

Q2003.name: Newfoundland and Labrador
