Q82119.about: The Province of A Coruña (Galician: provincia da Coruña [pɾoˈβinθjɐ ðɐ koˈɾuɲɐ]; Spanish: provincia de La Coruña [pɾoˈβinθja ðe la koˈɾuɲa] ; historical English: Corunna) is the northwesternmost province of Spain, and one of the four provinces which constitute the autonomous community of Galicia. This province is surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean to the west and north, Pontevedra Province to the south and Lugo Province to the east.
Q82119.img: Vista de la Catedral de Santiago de Compostela.JPG

Q82142.name: Province of Granada
Q82142.about: The Province of Granada (Spanish: Provincia de Granada) is a province in the eastern part of the autonomous community of Andalusia in Spain. It is bordered by the provinces of Albacete, Murcia, Almería, Jaén, Córdoba, Málaga, and the Mediterranean Sea (along the Costa Tropical).

Q100166.name: Orkney Islands
Q100166.desc: archipelago, county and council area in northern Scotland
Q100166.about: Orkney (), also known as the Orkney Islands, is an archipelago off the north coast of mainland Scotland. The plural name the Orkneys, though heavily disliked by Orcadians, is also sometimes used.

Q103738.name: Gotland County
Q103738.about: Gotland County (Swedish: Gotlands län, pronounced [ˈɡɔtːlands lɛːn]) is a county or län of Sweden. Gotland is located in the Baltic Sea to the east of Öland, and is the largest of Sweden's islands.

Q115027.name: Isla de la Juventud
Q115027.about: Isla de la Juventud (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈizla ðe la xuβenˈtuð]; lit. 'Isle of Youth') is the second-largest Cuban island (after Cuba's mainland) and the seventh-largest island in the West Indies (after mainland Cuba, Hispaniola, Jamaica, Puerto Rico, Trinidad, and Andros Island). The island was called the Isle of Pines (Spanish: Isla de Pinos) until 1978.

Q115302.name: Holguín Province
Q115302.about: Holguín (Spanish pronunciation: [olˈɣin]) is one of the provinces of Cuba, the third most populous after Havana and Santiago de Cuba.  It lies in the southeast of the country.

Q115434.name: Villa Clara Province
Q115434.about: Villa Clara is one of the provinces of Cuba.  It is located in the central region of the island bordering on the Atlantic Ocean to the north, Matanzas Province to the west, Sancti Spiritus Province to the east, and Cienfuegos Province to the South.

Q694.name: South Holland
Q694.about: South Holland (Dutch: Zuid-Holland [ˌzœyt ˈɦɔlɑnt] ) is a province of the Netherlands with a population of over 3.8 million as of January 2023 and a population density of about 1,410/km2 (3,700/sq mi), making it the country's most populous province and one of the world's most densely populated areas. Situated on the North Sea in the west of the Netherlands, South Holland covers an area of 3,308 km2 (1,277 sq mi), of which 609 km2 (235 sq mi) is water.

Q701.name: North Holland
Q701.about: North Holland (Dutch: Noord-Holland, pronounced [ˌnoːrt ˈɦɔlɑnt] ) is a province of the Netherlands in the northwestern part of the country. It is located on the North Sea, north of South Holland and Utrecht, and west of Friesland and Flevoland.

Q770.name: Friesland
Q770.about: Friesland ( FREEZ-lənd; Dutch: [ˈfrislɑnt] ; official West Frisian: Fryslân [ˈfrislɔ̃ːn] ), historically and traditionally known as Frisia (), is a province of the Netherlands located in the north of the country. As of January 2023, the province had a population of about 660,000, and a total area of 5,753 km2 (2,221 sq mi).

Q688633.name: Neftchala District
Q688633.about: Neftchala District (Azerbaijani: Neftçala rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the southeast of the country and belongs to the Shirvan-Salyan Economic Region.

Q693487.name: Puerto Plata Province
Q693487.about: Puerto Plata (Spanish pronunciation: [pweɾtoˈplata], Silver Port); (French: Port-de-Plate) is a province in northern Dominican Republic. It is divided into 9 municipalities, 12 municipal districts and its capital is the resort city of the same name.

Q695387.name: Sermersooq
Q695387.about: Sermersooq (Greenlandic pronunciation: [sɜm.mɜs.sɔːq̚]) is a municipality in Greenland, formed on 1 January 2009 from five previous, smaller municipalities, and is the largest municipality in the world by area. Its administrative seat is the city of Nuuk, the capital of Greenland, and it is the most populous municipality in the country, with 24,229 inhabitants as of January 2025.

Q700048.name: Ratak Chain
Q700048.desc: chain of islands, eastern sub-archipelago of the Marshall Islands
Q700048.about: The Ratak Chain (Ratak [rˠɑːdˠɑk], Marshallese for 'sunrise') is a chain of islands and atolls within the island nation of the Marshall Islands. It lies to the east of the country's other island chain, the Ralik Chain.

Q732322.name: Saint Andrew Parish
Q732322.about: Saint Andrew is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by St.

Q747221.name: Ribeira Brava Municipality
Q747221.desc: municipality on the island of São Nicolau, Cape Verde
Q747221.about: Ribeira Brava is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the eastern part of the island of São Nicolau, it covers 65% of the island area (224.8 km2), and is home to 59% of its population (7,580 at the 2010 census).

Q751725.name: Bay Islands Department
Q751725.about: The Bay Islands (Spanish: Islas de la Bahía; pronounced [ˈislas de la βaˈi.a]) is a group of islands off the Caribbean coast of Honduras. Collectively, the islands form one of the 18 departments of Honduras.

Q12689.name: Pas-de-Calais
Q12689.about: The Pas-de-Calais (French: [pɑ d(ə) kalɛ] ) is a department in northern France named after the French designation of the Strait of Dover, which it borders. It has the most communes of all the departments of France, with 887, and is the 8th most populous.

Q3929.name: Port Louis
Q3929.about: Port Louis (French: Port-Louis, [pɔʁ lwi] ; Mauritian Creole: Porlwi, [poːlwi]) is the capital and most populous city of Mauritius, mainly located in the Port Louis District, with a small western part in the Black River District. Port Louis is the country's financial and political centre.

Q1053600.name: Savanne District
Q1053600.about: Savanne (Mauritian Creole pronunciation: [savan]) or Savannah is a district of Mauritius, situated in the south of the island. The district has an area of 244.8 square kilometres (94.5 sq mi).

Q1075816.name: Choiseul Quarter
Q1075816.about: Choiseul District is one of the 10 districts (formerly called quarter) of the Caribbean island nation of Saint Lucia.  Located on the southwestern side of the island, the district is home to 6,130 people, according to the 2019 census.

Q1095557.name: Clarendon Parish
Q1095557.about: Clarendon (Jamaican Patois: Clarindan) is a parish in Jamaica. It is located on the south of the island, roughly halfway between the island's eastern and western ends.

Q1116700.name: Makira-Ulawa Province
Q1116700.about: Makira-Ulawa Province is one of the nine provinces of Solomon Islands. It is mainly made up of the island of the same name, located east of Guadalcanal.

Q1123340.name: Trelawny Parish
Q1123340.about: Trelawny (Jamaican Patois: Trilaani or Chrilaani) is a parish in the county of Cornwall in northwest Jamaica. Its capital is Falmouth.

Q1131779.name: Hanover Parish
Q1131779.about: Hanover (Jamaican Patois: Anuova) is a parish located on the northwestern tip of the island of Jamaica. It is a part of the county of Cornwall, bordered by St.
Q1131779.img: "Lucea and Dolphin Head, Jamaica", early 20th century (imp-cswc-GB-237-CSWC47-LS12-020).jpg

Q1137551.name: Barahona Province
Q1137551.about: Barahona (Spanish pronunciation: [baɾaˈona]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It is spread over an area of 1,768.71 km2 (682.90 sq mi), and has its capital at Santa Cruz de Barahona.

Q1139082.name: Isabel Province
Q1139082.about: Isabel Province (also spelled Ysabel) is one of the provinces of Solomon Islands. The province had a population of around 31,420 as of 2019, mostly concentrated on the main island, Santa Isabel Island.

Q1140742.name: La Romana
Q1140742.about: La Romana (Spanish pronunciation: [la ɾoˈmana]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. The capital is also named La Romana, and is the third-largest city in the country.

Q785.name: Jersey
Q785.desc: British Crown dependency in the Channel Islands
Q785.about: Jersey ( JUR-zee; Jèrriais: Jèrri [ʒɛri]), officially the Bailiwick of Jersey, is an autonomous and self-governing British Crown Dependency in Northwestern Europe 14 miles (23 km) off the Cotentin Peninsula of north-west France. At 45 square miles (120 km2), the main island, Jersey, is the largest of the Channel Islands.

Q1055.name: Hamburg
Q1055.desc: city and state in the North of Germany
Q1055.about: Hamburg, officially the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg, is the second-largest city in Germany after Berlin and sixth-largest city in the European Union, with a population of over 1.9 million. The Hamburg Metropolitan Region has a population of over 5.1 million and is the tenth-largest metropolitan region by GDP in the European Union.

Q782.name: Hawaii
Q782.desc: state of the United States of America
Q782.about: Hawaii (  hə-WY-ee; Hawaiian: Hawaiʻi [həˈvɐjʔi, həˈwɐjʔi]) is an island state of the United States, in the Pacific Ocean about 2,000 miles (3,200 km) southwest of the U.S. mainland. One of the two non-contiguous U.S. states (along with Alaska), it is the only state not on the North American mainland, the only state that is an archipelago, the only state south of the Tropic of Cancer, one of only two states, along with Florida, with regions that have a tropical climate, and one of the two U.S. states, along with Texas, that were internationally recognized sovereign countries before becoming U.S. states.

Q1183.name: Puerto Rico
Q1183.desc: unincorporated territory of the United States of America
Q1183.about: Puerto Rico (abbreviated PR), officially the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico, is a self-governing Caribbean archipelago and island organized as an unincorporated territory of the United States under the designation of commonwealth. Located about 1,000 miles (1,600 km) southeast of Miami, Florida, between the Dominican Republic in the Greater Antilles and the U.S. Virgin Islands in the Lesser Antilles, it consists of the eponymous main island and numerous smaller islands, including Vieques, Culebra, and Mona.

Q1808165.name: Port Glaud
Q1808165.about: Port Glaud (French pronunciation: [pɔʁ ɡlo]) is an administrative district of Seychelles located on the northwestern coast of the island of Mahé. It is 25 km2 and has a population of 2174 (2002 census).
Q1808165.img: Port Glaud view of Vache Island asv2024-10 img2.jpg

Q1859950.name: Rum Cay
Q1859950.about: Rum Cay (formerly known as Mamana and Santa Maria de la Concepción) is an island and district of The Bahamas. It measures 30 square miles (78 km2) in area.

Q1864637.name: Saint Patrick Parish
Q1864637.desc: administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the island of Saint Vincent
Q1864637.about: Saint Patrick is an administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the island of Saint Vincent. According to the 2000 census, it had a population of 5,800, which makes Saint Patrick the least populous parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.
Q1864637.wiki: Saint Patrick Parish, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
Q1864637.img: Playa de Princess Bay, de arena negra, en la parroquia de San Patricio.jpg

Q1895853.name: Tarrafal de São Nicolau
Q1895853.desc: municipality on the island of São Nicolau, Cape Verde
Q1895853.about: Tarrafal de São Nicolau is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the western part of the island of São Nicolau, it covers 35% of the island area (119.8 km2) and is home to 41% of its population (5,237 at the 2010 census).
Q1895853.img: Seaside of Tarrafal São Nicolau, Cabo Verde.jpg

Q1899163.name: Tunapuna–Piarco
Q1899163.about: Tunapuna–Piarco is one of the 9 regions of Trinidad and Tobago. It is the most populous region in the country by total population and the fifth-largest by total land area.

Q1949656.name: María Trinidad Sánchez Province
Q1949656.about: María Trinidad Sánchez (Spanish pronunciation: [maˈɾi.a tɾiniˈðað ˈsantʃes]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It was split from Samaná Province in September 1959 as Julia Molina Province; in November 1961, it got its current name.

Q1952603.name: Saint Peter
Q1952603.about: Saint Peter (Antiguan and Barbudan Creole: Sen Peeta), officially the Parish of Saint Peter, is a parish of Antigua and Barbuda on the island of Antigua. Saint Peter borders Saint Paul to the south, Saint Philip to the east, and Saint George and Saint John to the west.

Q1991632.name: Pituffik
Q1991632.about: Pituffik (meaning 'mooring place, place to tie something') is a former Inughuit settlement in North Star Bay, near Mount Dundas at the eastern end of Bylot Sound in northern Greenland. It was located on the plain that is now occupied by the runway of the U.S. Pituffik Space Base, formerly Thule Air Base.

Q1996895.name: Saint Philip
Q1996895.about: Saint Philip (Antiguan and Barbudan Creole: Sen Filip), officially the Parish of Saint Philip, is a civil parish of Antigua and Barbuda, on the easternmost portion of Antigua island. Its capital is the village of St.

Q3278.name: Charente-Maritime
Q3278.about: Charente-Maritime (French pronunciation: [ʃaʁɑ̃t maʁitim] ; Poitevin-Saintongeais: Chérente-Marine; Occitan: Charanta Maritima) is a department in the French region of Nouvelle-Aquitaine, on the country's west coast. Named after the river Charente, its prefecture is La Rochelle.
Q3278.img: 920 - Hôtel Poupet Préfecture 40 rue Réaumur - La Rochelle.jpg

Q115438.name: Matanzas Province
Q115438.about: Matanzas (Latin American Spanish pronunciation: [maˈtansas]) is one of the provinces of Cuba.  Major towns in the province include Cárdenas, Colón, Jovellanos and the capital of the same name, Matanzas.

Q115441.name: Sancti Spíritus Province
Q115441.about: Sancti Spíritus (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsaŋktjesˈpiɾitus]) is one of the provinces of Cuba. Its capital is the identically named Sancti Spíritus.

Q115459.name: Chatham Islands
Q115459.desc: remote group of inhabited islands in New Zealand
Q115459.about: The Chatham Islands ( CHAT-əm; Moriori: Rēkohu, lit. 'Misty Sun'; Māori: Wharekauri), officially the Chatham Islands Territory, are an archipelago in the Pacific Ocean about 800 km (430 nmi) east of New Zealand's South Island, administered as part of New Zealand, and consisting of about 10 islands within an approximate 60 km (30 nmi) radius, the largest of which are Chatham Island and Pitt Island (Rangiauria).

Q125148.name: Portland Parish
Q125148.about: Portland (Jamaican Patois: Puotlan), with its capital town Port Antonio, is a parish located on Jamaica's northeast coast. It is situated to the north of St Thomas and to the east of St Mary in Surrey County.

Q125232.name: Nippes
Q125232.about: Nippes (French, pronounced [nip] ) or Nip (Haitian Creole) is one of the ten departments (the highest-level political subdivisions) of Haiti located in southern Haiti. It is the most recently created department, having been split from Grand'Anse in 2003.

Q9679.name: Isle of Wight
Q9679.desc: island, county and unitary authority area of England, United Kingdom
Q9679.about: The Isle of Wight ( WYTE) is an island off the south coast of England, separated from the mainland by the Solent strait, and otherwise surrounded by the English Channel. For local government purposes the island is a unitary authority area, and it is also a ceremonial county; it was historically part of Hampshire.

Q244510.name: Santarém
Q244510.about: The District of Santarém (Portuguese: Distrito de Santarém [sɐ̃tɐˈɾɐ̃j] ) is a district of Portugal, located in Portugal's West and Tagus Valley region. The district capital is the city of Santarém.

Q244512.name: Leiria
Q244512.about: The District of Leiria (Portuguese: Distrito de Leiria [lɐjˈɾi.ɐ] ) is a district located between the Oeste e Vale do Tejo and Centro regions of Portugal, and divided between the traditional provinces of Beira Litoral and Estremadura. It borders on the north with district of Coimbra, on the east with district of Castelo Branco and with district of Santarém, on the south with district of Lisbon and on the west with the Atlantic Ocean.

Q244517.name: Coimbra
Q244517.about: Coimbra is a district located in the Centro region, Portugal. The district capital is the city of Coimbra.

Q249870.name: Kinmen County
Q249870.desc: small archipelago of several islands in Fujian Province, ROC
Q249870.about: Kinmen, alternatively known as Quemoy, is a group of islands and a county of the Republic of China (Taiwan), only 10 km (6 mi) east from the city of Xiamen in Fujian, located at the southeastern coast of the People's Republic of China, from which they are separated by Xiamen Bay. Kinmen is also 187 km (116 mi) west from the closest shoreline of the island of Taiwan across the Taiwan Strait.

Q1647439.name: Saint Andrew
Q1647439.about: St. Andrew is one of eleven parishes of Barbados.

Q1647436.name: Saint Philip
Q1647436.about: Saint Philip is a parish of Barbados at the easternmost end of the island. Saint Philip’s Parish Church was built as the Anglican parish church in 1640.

Q1647443.name: Saint George
Q1647443.about: St. George is a parish of Barbados.

Q1647447.name: Saint Lucy
Q1647447.about: The parish of St. Lucy is the northernmost in the country of Barbados.

Q1676934.name: Anse la Raye Quarter
Q1676934.about: Anse la Raye District is one of 10 districts (formerly called quarters) of the island nation of St. Lucia in the Caribbean Sea.

Q1687545.name: South East Community Development Council
Q1687545.about: The South East Community Development Council is one of five Community Development Councils (CDCs) set up across the Republic of Singapore to aid in local administration of governmental policies and schemes. They are funded in part by the government although they are free to engage in fund-raising activities.

Q1725609.name: Saint Peter Basseterre Parish
Q1725609.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1725609.about: Saint Peter Basseterre is one of 14 administrative parishes that make up Saint Kitts and Nevis. It is located on the main island of Saint Kitts and the parish capital is Monkey Hill.

Q1752101.name: Saint Thomas Middle Island Parish
Q1752101.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1752101.about: Saint Thomas Middle Island is one of 14 administrative parishes that make up Saint Kitts and Nevis. It is the third largest parish on the island of Saint Kitts, and fourth largest in the federation.
Q1752101.img: Anglican Church Middle Island – St. Thomas - panoramio.jpg

Q1752122.name: Saint Thomas Lowland Parish
Q1752122.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1752122.about: Saint Thomas Lowland is one of 5 Nevis parishes which are in turn part of the 14 administrative parishes that make up the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis. Leeward Islands, Lesser Antilles, West Indies.

Q1770796.name: Saint George
Q1770796.about: Saint George (Antiguan and Barbudan Creole: Sen Jaaj), officially the Parish of Saint George, is a parish of Antigua and Barbuda on the island of Antigua. Saint George borders Saint Peter to the southeast, and Saint John to the west and south.

Q1774831.name: El Seibo Province
Q1774831.about: El Seibo (Spanish pronunciation: [el ˈsejβo]), alternatively spelt El Seybo, is a province of the Dominican Republic. Before 1992 it included what is now Hato Mayor province.

Q753702.name: East New Britain Province
Q753702.about: East New Britain is a province of Papua New Guinea, consisting of the north-eastern part of the island of New Britain and the Duke of York Islands. The capital of the province is Kokopo, not far from the old capital of Rabaul, which was largely destroyed in a volcanic eruption in 1994.

Q755979.name: Mellieħa
Q755979.about: Mellieħa (Maltese: il-Mellieħa [ɪl mɛˈlːɪːħɐ]) is a large village in the Northern Region of Malta. The population of Mellieħa was 14,232 in July 2024.

Q760888.name: Guadalcanal Province
Q760888.about: Guadalcanal Province is one of the nine provinces of Solomon Islands, consisting primarily of the island of Guadalcanal. Its area is 5,336 km2 (2,060 sq mi) and is largely jungle.

Q766445.name: Okinawa Prefecture
Q766445.about: Okinawa Prefecture (Japanese: 沖縄県, Hepburn: Okinawa-ken; pronounced [ò̞.k̟ʲí.nä́.β̞ä́(.kè̞ɴ̀)]; Okinawan: ウチナーチン, romanized: Uchinaachin) is the southernmost and westernmost prefecture of Japan. It consists of three main island groups—the Okinawa Islands, the Sakishima Islands, and the Daitō Islands—spread across a maritime zone approximately 1,000 kilometers east to west and 400 kilometers north to south.

Q858513.name: New Providence
Q858513.about: New Providence is the most populous island in the Bahamas. On the eastern side of the island is the national capital city of Nassau; it had a population of 246,329 at the 2010 Census, and a population of 292,522 at the 2022 census.

Q859666.name: Vavaʻu group
Q859666.about: Vavaʻu is an island group, consisting of one large island (ʻUtu Vavaʻu) and 40 smaller ones, in Tonga. It is part of Vavaʻu District, which includes several other individual islands.

Q860630.name: Manatuto Municipality
Q860630.about: Manatuto (Portuguese: Município Manatuto, Tetun: Munisípiu Manatutu) is one of the municipalities (formerly districts) of Timor-Leste, located in the central part of the country. It has a population of 45,541 (Census 2010) and an area of 1,783.3 km2.

Q860897.name: Liquiçá Municipality
Q860897.about: Liquiçá (Portuguese: Município Liquiçá, Tetun: Munisípiu Likisá) is one of the municipalities (formerly districts) of Timor-Leste. Its capital is also called Liquiçá.

Q860901.name: Dili Municipality
Q860901.about: Dili Municipality (Portuguese: Município Díli, Tetun: Munisípiu Dili) is one of the 14 municipalities, formerly districts, of Timor-Leste, and includes the national capital Dili. The municipality had a population of 277,279 as of 2015, most of whom live in the capital city.

Q867573.name: Freeport
Q867573.desc: city, district and free trade zone on Grand Bahama
Q867573.about: Freeport is a city, district and free trade zone on the island of Grand Bahama in the northwest part of The Bahamas. In 1955, Wallace Groves, a Virginian financier with lumber interests in Grand Bahama, was granted 20,000 hectares (50,000 acres) of pineyard with substantial areas of swamp and scrubland by the Bahamian government with a mandate to economically develop the area.

Q873740.name: Rivière Noire District
Q873740.about: Rivière Noire (Mauritian Creole: Rivièr Nwar, pronounced [ʁivjɛː nwɑː]) or Black River is a district on the western side of Mauritius. Rivière Noire translates to Black River.

Q1140993.name: Crooked Island
Q1140993.desc: island and district, part of a group of Bahamian islands
Q1140993.about: Crooked Island is an island and district, part of a group of Bahamian islands defining a large, shallow lagoon called the Bight of Acklins, of which the largest are Crooked Island in the north and Acklins in the south-east, and the smaller are Long Cay (once known as Fortune Island) in the north-west, and Castle Island in the south.

Q1145487.name: Samaná Province
Q1145487.about: Samaná (Spanish pronunciation: [samaˈna]) is a province of the Dominican Republic in the Samaná Peninsula located in the eastern region. Its capital is Santa Bárbara de Samaná, usually known as Samaná.

Q1147216.name: Palauli
Q1147216.about: Palauli is a district and village of Samoa, with a population (2016 Census) of 9,300. It consists of two sections on the southern side of Savai'i.

Q1147674.name: Ionian Islands Region
Q1147674.desc: one of the 13 regions of Greece
Q1147674.about: The Ionian Islands Region ( eye-OH-nee-ən; Greek: Περιφέρεια Ιονίων Νήσων, romanized: Periféria Ioníon Níson, [periˈferia ioˈnion ˈnison]) is the smallest by area of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece located in the Ionian Sea. It comprises all the Ionian Islands except Kythera, which, although historically part of the island group, was separated and integrated to the Attica Region.

Q1154134.name: Fa'asaleleaga
Q1154134.about: Faʻasaleleaga is a district  of Samoa situated on the eastern side of Savaiʻi island. It has a population of 13,566 (2016 Census).

Q1188890.name: Dennery Quarter
Q1188890.about: Dennery District is one of 10 districts (formerly Quarters) of the Caribbean island nation of Saint Lucia.  The seat of Dennery District is the Dennery Village.

Q1190896.name: Malaita Province
Q1190896.about: Malaita Province is the most populous of the nine provinces of Solomon Islands. The population of the province is 172,740 as of 2019.
Q1190896.img: A man keeps flies away from his fish at the old market Auki, the capitol of Malaita. (10662280276).jpg

Q1193134.name: Gaga'ifomauga
Q1193134.about: Gagaʻifomauga is a political district on the island of Savaiʻi in Samoa. The district is situated on the northern side of the island with a population of 4,878 (2016 Census).

Q929969.name: Nadur
Q929969.about: Nadur (Maltese: In-Nadur) is an administrative unit of Malta, located in the eastern part of the island of Gozo. Nadur is built on a plateau and is one of the largest localities in Gozo.

Q932723.name: Saint Peter
Q932723.about: The parish of St. Peter is one of eleven in the Caribbean island country of Barbados.

Q934126.name: Pamplemousses District
Q934126.about: Pamplemousses (Mauritian Creole pronunciation: [pɑ̃plemus]) is a district of Mauritius, located in the northwest of the island, and is one of the most densely populated parts of the island. The name of the district comes from the French word for grapefruits.

Q936088.name: Temotu Province
Q936088.about: Temotu (or Te Motu, literally "the island" in several Polynesian languages) is the easternmost province of Solomon Islands.  The province was formerly known as Santa Cruz Islands Province.

Q937217.name: Hato Mayor Province
Q937217.about: Hato Mayor (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈato maˈʝoɾ]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It was split from El Seibo in 1984.

Q938518.name: Central Eleuthera
Q938518.about:
Central Eleuthera is one of 31 administrative districts in the Bahamas, and 5 on the island of Eleuthera.
Its capital, Governor's Harbour, is the largest city in the district, with a population of 701.

Q943932.name: Nord
Q943932.about: Nord (French, pronounced [nɔʁ] ) or Nò (Haitian Creole, pronounced [nɔ]; both meaning "North") is one of the ten departments of Haiti and located in northern Haiti. It has an area of 2,114.91 km2 (816.57 sq mi) and a population of 1,067,177 (2015).

Q953557.name: Gros Islet Quarter
Q953557.about: Gros Islet District, one of 10 first order subdivision (districts, formerly quarters) of the Caribbean island nation of Saint Lucia which includes the island's northernmost point, Cap Point and the notable Cap Estate, where the renowned St. Lucia Golf and Country Club is located.

Q965632.name: South Province
Q965632.about: The South Province (French: Province Sud) is one of three administrative divisions in New Caledonia. It corresponds to the southern and southwestern portion of the New Caledonian mainland.

Q1466462.name: Hiiu County
Q1466462.about: Hiiu County (Estonian: Hiiu maakond or Hiiumaa) is one of 15 counties of Estonia, being the smallest county both in terms of area and population. It consists of Hiiumaa (German and Swedish: Dagö), the second-largest island of Estonia, and several smaller islands near it.

Q3207.name: Aude
Q3207.about: Aude ( OHD; French: [od] ; Occitan: [ˈawðe]) is a department in southern France, located in Occitania and named after the river Aude. The departmental council also calls it "Cathar Country" (French: Pays cathare) after a group of religious dissidents active in the 12th to 14th centuries.

Q3249.name: Calvados
Q3249.about: Calvados (UK: , US: ; French: [kalvados] ) is a department in the Normandy region in northwestern France. It takes its name from a cluster of rocks off the Normandy coast.

Q220982.name: Tristan da Cunha
Q220982.about: Tristan da Cunha (), colloquially known as Tristan, is a remote group of volcanic islands in the South Atlantic Ocean. It is one of three constituent parts of the British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha, with its own constitution.

Q221684.name: Chuuk
Q221684.desc: state of the Federated States of Micronesia
Q221684.about: Chuuk State (; also known as Truk) is one of the four states of the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM). It consists of several island groups: Nomoneas, Faichuuk, the Hall Islands, Namonuito Atoll (Magur Islands), Pattiw (Western Islands), and the Mortlock Islands.

Q231324.name: Anjouan
Q231324.desc: island and administrative unit in the Comoros
Q231324.about: Anjouan ([ɑ̃.ʒu.ɑ̃]) is an autonomous volcanic island in the Comoro Islands in the southwestern Indian Ocean, part of the Union of the Comoros. It is known in Shikomori as Ndzuani, Ndzuwani or Nzwani, and, until the early twentieth century when the name fell out of general use (although still sometimes used by English-speakers in Zanzibar), in English as Johanna.

Q238752.name: Barbuda
Q238752.about: Barbuda (; Barbudan Creole: Baabyuuda) is an island and dependency located in the eastern Caribbean forming part of the twin-island state of Antigua and Barbuda as an autonomous entity. Barbuda is located approximately 30 miles (48 km) north of Antigua.

Q95080.name: Las Palmas
Q95080.desc: province of Spain in the Canary Islands
Q95080.about: The Province of Las Palmas (, UK: ; Spanish: Provincia de Las Palmas) is a province of Spain, consisting of the eastern part of the autonomous community of the Canary Islands. Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, the capital city of this province and of the island of Gran Canaria, is also the largest city in the Canary Islands.

Q95088.name: Seville Province
Q95088.about: The Province of Seville (Spanish: Provincia de Sevilla) is a province of southern Spain, in the western part of the autonomous community of Andalusia. It borders the provinces of Málaga and Cádiz in the south, Huelva in the west, Badajoz in the north and Córdoba in the east.
Q95088.img: Canal de Alfonso XIII Torre del Oro Sevilla.jpg

Q98392.name: Province of Tarragona
Q98392.about: Tarragona (Spanish: [taraˈɣona]; Catalan: [tərəˈɣonə]) is a province of eastern Spain, in the southern part of the autonomous community of Catalonia. It is bordered by the provinces of Castellón, Teruel, Zaragoza, Lleida and Barcelona and by the Mediterranean Sea.
Q98392.img: La vall del Seniol des de Segura.jpg

Q99976.name: Santa Cruz de Tenerife Province
Q99976.desc: province of Spain in the Canary Islands
Q99976.about: Province of Santa Cruz de Tenerife, also Province of Santa Cruz (Spanish: Provincia de Santa Cruz de Tenerife), is a province of Spain, consisting of the western part of the autonomous community of the Canary Islands. It consists of about half of the Atlantic archipelago: the islands of Tenerife, La Gomera, El Hierro, and La Palma.
Q99976.wiki: Province of Santa Cruz de Tenerife
Q99976.img: 38400 Puerto de la Cruz, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain - panoramio (210).jpg

Q3334.name: Haute-Corse
Q3334.about: Haute-Corse (French: [ot kɔʁs] ; Corsican: Corsica suprana [ˈkorsiɡa zuˈprana], Cismonte [tʃiˈzmɔnte] or Alta Corsica; English: Upper Corsica) is a department of France, consisting of the northern part of the island of Corsica. The corresponding departmental territorial collectivity merged with that of Corse-du-Sud on 1 January 2018, forming the single territorial collectivity of Corsica, with territorial elections coinciding with the dissolution of the separate councils.

Q258028.name: Birżebbuġa
Q258028.about: Birżebbuġa (Maltese pronunciation: [biːrzɛˈbːuːd͡ʒɐ]; sometimes shortened to B'Buġa) is a seaside town in the Southern Region of Malta, close to Marsaxlokk. It is approximately 13 kilometres (8 miles) from the capital Valletta.

Q271797.name: Mohéli
Q271797.desc: autonomous island that forms part of the Union of the Comoros
Q271797.about: Mohéli [mɔ.e.li], also known as Mwali, is an autonomously-governed island that forms part of the Union of the Comoros. It is the smallest of the three major islands in the country.

Q274109.name: Setúbal
Q274109.about: The District of Setúbal (Portuguese: Distrito de Setúbal [sɨˈtuβal] ) is a district located in the south-west of Portugal. It is named for its capital, the city of Setúbal.
Q274109.img: Palacio de Comenda, Arrábida, Setúbal, Portugal, 2022-07-21, DD 16.jpg

Q282203.name: Qrendi
Q282203.about: Qrendi (Maltese: Il-Qrendi) is a village in the Western Region of Malta It is located close to Mqabba, Żurrieq and Siġġiewi. Within its boundaries are the two Neolithic temples of Mnajdra and Ħaġar Qim.

Q290292.name: Sangre Grande Regional Corporation
Q290292.desc: regional corporation of Trinidad and Tobago
Q290292.about: Sangre Grande () is a region of Trinidad. The Region of Sangre Grande is a local government body and the largest Region of Trinidad and Tobago by area.

Q293722.name: Central Province
Q293722.about: The Central Province is one of the provinces of Solomon Islands, covering the Russell Islands, Nggela Islands (Florida Islands) and Savo Island. Its area comprises 615 square kilometres (237 square miles) and had a population of 26,051 as of 2009, rising to 30,326 as of 2019.

Q200939.name: Eysturoy
Q200939.about: Eysturoy (Faroese pronunciation: ['ɛstroi], meaning 'East Island') is a region and the second-largest of the Faroe Islands, both in size  and population.

Q203272.name: Saare County
Q203272.about: Saare County (Estonian: Saare maakond or Saaremaa; Latin: Oesel; Danish: Øsel; German: Ösel; Swedish: Ösel) is one of 15 counties of Estonia. It consists of Saaremaa, the largest island of Estonia, and several smaller islands near it, most notably Muhu, Ruhnu, Abruka, and Vilsandi.

Q204876.name: Nueva Esparta
Q204876.about: Nueva Esparta State (Spanish: Estado Nueva Esparta, pronounced [esˈtaðo ˈnweβa esˈpaɾta]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. It comprises Margarita Island, Coche, and the lightly inhabited Cubagua.

Q207199.name: Lisbon
Q207199.about: Lisbon (Portuguese: Lisboa) is a district located along the western coast of Portugal.  The district capital is the city of Lisbon, which is also the national capital.

Q12526.name: Gironde
Q12526.about: Gironde ( zhih-ROND, US usually  jih-; French: [ʒiʁɔ̃d] ; Occitan: Gironda, pronounced [dʒiˈɾundɔ]) is the largest department in the southwestern French region of Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Named after the Gironde estuary, a major waterway, its prefecture is Bordeaux.

Q12549.name: Ille-et-Vilaine
Q12549.about: Ille-et-Vilaine (French: [il e vilɛn] ; Gallo: Ill-e-Vilaenn; Breton: Il-ha-Gwilen; lit. 'Ille and Vilaine') is a department of France, located in the Brittany region in the northwest of the country.

Q12563.name: Landes
Q12563.about: Landes (French pronunciation: [lɑ̃d] ; Gascon and Occitan: Lanas [ˈlanəs]; Basque: Landak) is a department in the Nouvelle-Aquitaine region, Southwestern France, with a long coastline on the Atlantic Ocean to the west. It also borders Gers to the east, Pyrénées-Atlantiques to the south, Lot-et-Garonne to the north-east, and Gironde to the north.

Q12589.name: Manche
Q12589.about: Manche (; French: [mɑ̃ʃ] ; Norman: Maunche) is a coastal French department in Normandy on the English Channel, which is known as La Manche, literally "the sleeve", in French. Manche is bordered by Ille-et-Vilaine and Mayenne to the south, Orne and Calvados to the east, the English Channel to the west and north and by sharing maritime borders with the British Crown Dependencies of Bailiwick of Jersey and Bailiwick of Guernsey to the west.
Q12589.img: Baie d'Écalgrain - Vue du Nez de Voidries (4).JPG

Q12642.name: Morbihan
Q12642.about: The Morbihan department ( mor-bee-ON; French: [mɔʁbi(j)ɑ̃]; Gallo: Morbihan, Breton: Mor-Bihan [moːrˈbiː(h)ãn]) is a department in the administrative region of Brittany, situated in the northwest of France. It is named after the Morbihan (small sea in Breton), the enclosed sea that is the principal feature of the coastline.

Q339063.name: Saint Paul Parish
Q339063.about: Saint Paul is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by St.

Q353375.name: Addu Atoll
Q353375.about: Seenu Atoll, historically known as Addu Atoll, is the southernmost atoll of the Maldives. Addu Atoll, together with Fuvahmulah, located 40 km north of Addu Atoll, extend the Maldives into the Southern Hemisphere.

Q376738.name: Trinity Palmetto Point Parish
Q376738.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q376738.about: Trinity Palmetto Point is one of 14 administrative parishes that make up Saint Kitts and Nevis. It ranks 6th in terms of size of all the parishes on Saint Kitts.

Q386093.name: Saint Paul
Q386093.about: Saint Paul (Antiguan and Barbudan Creole: Sen Paal), officially the Parish of Saint Paul, is a parish of Antigua and Barbuda on the island of Antigua. It had an estimated population of 9,004 in 2018.

Q387994.name: Shabran District
Q387994.about: Shabran District (Azerbaijani: Şabran rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the northeast of the country, in the Guba-Khachmaz Economic Region.

Q405926.name: Ainaro Municipality
Q405926.about: Ainaro (Portuguese: Município Ainaro, Tetun: Munisípiu Ainaru) is one of 13 municipalities of Timor-Leste, in the southwest part of the country. It has a population of 59,175 (census 2010) and an area of 804 km2.
Q405926.img: Life in the clouds. corn fields and rock outcrops, Hatu Builico valley, Ainaro, Timor-Leste.jpg

Q423528.name: ʻEua
Q423528.about: ʻEua (Tongan pronunciation: [ʔe.ˈu.a]), formerly Middelburg Island, is an island in the kingdom of Tonga. It is close to Tongatapu, but forms a separate administrative division.

Q457485.name: Salyan District
Q457485.about: Salyan District (Azerbaijani: Salyan rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the east of the country, it belongs to the Shirvan-Salyan Economic Region.

Q1193139.name: Vaisigano
Q1193139.about: Vaisigano is a political district at the western tip of Savai'i island in Samoa. The capital of the district is Asau.

Q1193143.name: Gaga'emauga
Q1193143.about: Gagaʻemauga is a district on the island of Savaiʻi in Samoa. The district is situated on the central north side of Savaiʻi.

Q1231388.name: Grand'Anse Praslin
Q1231388.about: Grand'Anse Praslin is an administrative district of Seychelles located mostly on the island of Praslin, but also administers Cousin Island, Cousine Island, Booby Island, and Aride Island.

Q1240193.name: Micoud Quarter
Q1240193.about: Micoud District is one of  10 districts (formerly called quarters) of the Caribbean island nation of Saint Lucia The seat of this district is the town of Micoud inside this district.  According to the 2002 census, the population of the district was 16,143 people.

Q1291077.name: Saint Mark Parish
Q1291077.about: Saint Mark is a parish on the west coast of Grenada. It is the smallest parish on the island in terms of both area and population.

Q1323353.name: La Altagracia Province
Q1323353.about: La Altagracia (Spanish pronunciation: [la altaˈɣɾasja]) is a province located in the eastern part of the Dominican Republic. It is the only region that borders the Atlantic Ocean and the Caribbean Sea.

Q1326284.name: Saint Ann Parish
Q1326284.about: Saint Ann (Jamaican Patois: Sint An) is the largest parish in Jamaica. It is situated on the north coast of the island, in the county of Middlesex, roughly halfway between the eastern and western ends of the island.

Q1331932.name: Peravia Province
Q1331932.about: Peravia (Spanish pronunciation: [peˈɾaβja]) is a province in the southern region of the Dominican Republic. Located on the country's Caribbean coast which it is in the south, it is divided in 13 units (three municipalities and 10 municipal districts), while Baní is the province's capital.

Q1342139.name: Saint James Windward Parish
Q1342139.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1342139.about: Saint James Windward is the largest of five parishes on the island of Nevis. These five parishes are in turn part of the 14 administrative parishes making up the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis.

Q1352536.name: Santo Domingo Province
Q1352536.about: Santo Domingo (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsanto ðoˈmiŋɡo]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It was split from the Distrito Nacional on 16 October 2001.
Q1352536.img: Santo Domingo Este, Dominican Republic - panoramio (69).jpg

Q874935.name: Manus Province
Q874935.about: Manus Province is the smallest province in Papua New Guinea in terms of both land area and population, with a land area of 2,000 square kilometres (770 sq mi), but with more than 220,000 square kilometres (85,000 sq mi) of water, and the total population is 69,560. The provincial town of Manus is Lorengau.

Q890879.name: Long Island
Q890879.about: Long Island is an island in The Bahamas that is split by the Tropic of Cancer. It is one of the Districts of the Bahamas and is known as the most scenic island in the Bahamas.
Q890879.img: Dean Blue Hole Long Island Bahamas 20110210.JPG

Q905641.name: Dingli
Q905641.about: Dingli (Maltese: Ħad-Dingli) is a village in the Western Region of Malta. It is 13 kilometres (8 miles) from the capital Valletta and two kilometers (1.2 miles) from the nearest town, Rabat.

Q911635.name: Grand Port District
Q911635.about: Grand Port (Mauritian Creole pronunciation: [ɡʁɑ̃ poː]) is a district of Mauritius, situated in the east of the island. The name means "large port" in French.

Q911651.name: Flacq District
Q911651.about: Flacq (Mauritian Creole pronunciation: [flak]) is a district of Mauritius, situated in the east of the island. It is the country's largest district by geographical area,  covering 297.9 km2.

Q919908.name: Siġġiewi
Q919908.desc: City and Local council in Western Region, Malta
Q919908.about: Siġġiewi (Maltese: Is-Siġġiewi [ɪsːɪˈd͡ʒːɪːwɪ]), also called by its title Città Ferdinand, is a city and a local council in the Western Region of Malta.The island of Filfla is part of the village. It is the third largest council in Malta by surface area, after Rabat and Mellieħa.

Q920496.name: Manchester Parish
Q920496.about: The Parish of Manchester (Jamaican Patois: Manchesta) is a parish located in west-central Jamaica, in the county of Middlesex. Its capital, Mandeville, is a major business centre.

Q3934.name: Asturias
Q3934.desc: autonomous community of Spain, situated in the northwest part of the country
Q3934.about: Asturias, officially the Principality of Asturias, is an autonomous community in northwestern Spain. It is coextensive with the province of Asturias and contains some of the territory that was part of the larger Kingdom of Asturias in the Middle Ages.

Q3946.name: Cantabria
Q3946.about: Cantabria (, also UK: ; Spanish: [kanˈtaβɾja] ) is an autonomous community and province in northern Spain with Santander as its capital city. It is called a comunidad histórica, a historic community, in its current statute of autonomy.

Q3953.name: Kalmykia
Q3953.about: Kalmykia, officially the Republic of Kalmykia, is a republic of Russia, located in the Volga region of European Russia. The republic is part of the Southern Federal District, and borders Dagestan to the south and Stavropol Krai to the southwest; Volgograd Oblast to the northwest and north and Astrakhan Oblast to the north and east; Rostov Oblast to the west and the Caspian Sea to the east.

Q168159.name: Anglesey
Q168159.about: Anglesey ( ANG-gəl-see), or Ynys Môn (Welsh: [ˈənɨs ˈmoːn]), is an island off the north-west coast of Wales. It forms the majority of the county of the Isle of Anglesey, which also includes Holy Island to the west and some islets and skerries.
Q168159.img: View from the Anglesey Coastal Path (geograph 6222502).jpg

Q173616.name: South Aegean Region
Q173616.desc: one of the 13 regions of Greece
Q173616.about: The South Aegean Region (Greek: Περιφέρεια Νοτίου Αιγαίου, romanized: Periféreia Notíou Aigaíou [periˈferia noˈtiu eˈʝeu]) is one of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece. It consists of the Cyclades and Dodecanese island groups in the central and southeastern Aegean Sea.

Q173620.name: North Aegean Region
Q173620.desc: one of the 13 regions of Greece
Q173620.about: The North Aegean Region (Greek: Περιφέρεια Βορείου Αιγαίου, romanized: Periféreia Voreíou Aigaíou [periˈferia voˈriu eˈʝeu]) is one of the thirteen administrative regions of Greece. It comprises the islands of the north-eastern Aegean Sea, called the North Aegean islands, except for Thasos and Samothrace, which belong to the Greek region of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, and Imbros and Tenedos, which belong to Turkey.

Q176164.name: Christ Church Nichola Town Parish
Q176164.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q176164.about: Christ Church Nichola Town is one of the 14 administrative parishes that make up the Saint Kitts and Nevis. Christ Church Nichola Town is the fifth largest parish on Saint Kitts and is located on the east coast of the main island of Saint Kitts.

Q179833.name: Sumgait
Q179833.about: Sumgait, also spelled Sumgayit or Sumqayit; ; (Azerbaijani: Sumqayıt, Azerbaijani: [sumɡɑˈjɯt] ) is a city in Azerbaijan, located near the Caspian Sea, on the Absheron Peninsula, about 31 kilometres (19 miles) away from the capital Baku. The city had a population of 427,000 at the beginning of 2024, making it the second largest city in Azerbaijan after Baku.

Q1999872.name: Saint Mary
Q1999872.about: Saint Mary (South Antiguan Creole: Sen Mieree), officially the Parish of Saint Mary, is a parish of Antigua and Barbuda on the island of Antigua. Saint Mary borders Saint John to the north, and Saint Paul to the east.

Q2056273.name: Penal-Debe Regional Corporation
Q2056273.desc: regional corporation in Trinidad and Tobago
Q2056273.about: Penal–Debe region is a region of Trinidad.  The local government body is Penal–Debe Regional Corporation, a Regional Corporation of Trinidad and Tobago.

Q2075188.name: Charlotte Parish
Q2075188.desc: administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the east coast of the island of Saint Vincent
Q2075188.about: Charlotte is the largest parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, situated on the eastern coast of the island of Saint Vincent. With an area of 149 km², its size is comparable to that of the British Virgin Islands.
Q2075188.wiki: Charlotte Parish, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

Q2087806.name: Saint David Parish
Q2087806.about: Saint David's Parish is the fourth-largest of the parishes of Grenada in the island's southeast. The parish's main town (largest village) is St.

Q2096558.name: Central Andros
Q2096558.about: Central Andros is one of the districts of the Bahamas, on Andros Island. Its current Chief Councillor is Ms.

Q2199897.name: Plaisance
Q2199897.about: Plaisance (French pronunciation: [plɛzɑ̃s]) is an administrative district of Seychelles located on the island of Mahé.

Q2212935.name: Saint Andrew Parish
Q2212935.about: Saint Andrew (Jamaican Patois: Sint Anju) is a parish, situated in the southeast of Jamaica in the county of Surrey. It lies north, west and east of Kingston, and stretches into the Blue Mountains.

Q2228167.name: Princes Town
Q2228167.about: Princes Town is a region of Trinidad and Tobago.  The local government body is Princes Town Regional Corporation, a Regional Corporation of Trinidad and Tobago.

Q2287379.name: Takamaka
Q2287379.about: Takamaka is one of the 26 administrative regions of Mahé, Republic of Seychelles.  It is located on the southern part of the island of Mahé.
Q2287379.img: Relax at Anse Intendance Mahe, Seychelles (39619395161).jpg

Q459848.name: Kosrae
Q459848.desc: island in Federated States of Micronesia
Q459848.about: Kosrae ( koh-SHY), formerly known as Kusaie or Strong's Island, is an island in the Caroline Islands archipelago, and state within the Federated States of Micronesia. It includes the main island of Kosrae, traditionally known as Ualung (which means the "high island"), and a few intercoastal islands and islets, the most significant of which (Lelu Island) is inhabited by 1,500 people.

Q476233.name: Qeqqata
Q476233.about: Qeqqata (Greenlandic pronunciation: [qɜqːata], Danish: Centrum, lit. 'Centre') is a municipality in western Greenland, operational from 1 January 2009. The municipality was named after its location in the central-western part of the country.

Q476695.name: Masally District
Q476695.about: Masally District (Azerbaijani: Masallı rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the southeast of the country and belongs to the Lankaran-Astara Economic Region.

Q476708.name: Khizi District
Q476708.about: Khizi District (Azerbaijani: Xızı rayonu) is one of the 67 districts of Azerbaijan. Its position in the eastern part of the country puts it within the borders of Europe and within the Absheron-Khizi Economic Region.
Q476708.img: Badland on the road to Xizi.jpg

Q478813.name: Kujalleq
Q478813.about: Kujalleq (Greenlandic: Greenlandic pronunciation: [kujaɬːɜq̚], Danish: Syden, lit. 'The South') is a municipality on the southern tip of Greenland, operational from 1 January 2009. The administrative center of the municipality is in Qaqortoq (formerly called Julianehåb).

Q494874.name: São Miguel
Q494874.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q494874.about: São Miguel is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the northeastern part of the island of Santiago.

Q592141.name: Saint James
Q592141.about: The parish of St. James is located in the western central part of the country of Barbados.

Q599347.name: Laborie Quarter
Q599347.about: Laborie District is a district of Saint Lucia.  According to the 2022 census, it had a population of 8,507 inhabitants.

Q605343.name: Xagħra
Q605343.desc: town on the island of Gozo in Malta
Q605343.about: Xagħra (Maltese: Ix-Xagħra) is an administrative unit of Malta on the island of Gozo. It is one of the earliest inhabited parts of Gozo, being home to the Ġgantija megalithic temples, which date back to 3600 BC, and the Xagħra Stone Circle.

Q610726.name: Viqueque Municipality
Q610726.about: Viqueque (Portuguese: Município Viqueque, Tetun: Munisípiu Vikeke) is the largest of the municipalities (formerly districts) of Timor-Leste. It has a population of 77,402 (Census 2010) and an area of 1,877 km2.

Q617801.name: Saint George Parish
Q617801.about: Saint George is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by Saint Paul and part of the Boeri River (to the north), Saint David and Saint Patrick (to the east), Saint Luke (to the south).

Q620452.name: Tongatapu
Q620452.about: Tongatapu is the main island of Tonga and the site of its capital, Nukuʻalofa. Approximately 260 square kilometres (100 square miles) in size, it is located in Tonga's southern island group, to which it gives its name and it is the country's most populous island, with 74,611 residents (2016) or roughly 70.5% of the total population.

Q623327.name: North Abaco
Q623327.about: North Abaco is one of the districts of the Bahamas, on the Abaco Islands. It has a population of 9,578 according to the 2010 census.

Q629934.name: Manufahi Municipality
Q629934.about: Manufahi (Portuguese: Município Manufahi, Tetun: Munisípiu Manufahi) is one of the municipalities of Timor-Leste. It has a population of 53,691 (2015 census) and an area of 1,323 km2.

Q1209.name: Bremen
Q1209.about: Bremen (German: [ˈbʁeːmən] ), officially the Free Hanseatic City of Bremen (German: Freie Hansestadt Bremen; Low German: Free Hansestadt Bremen), is the smallest and least populous of Germany's 16 states. It is informally called Land Bremen ('State of Bremen'), although the term is sometimes used in official contexts.

Q1866.name: Bangka Belitung Islands
Q1866.desc: province of Indonesia, on Bangka and Belitung, and several smaller islands
Q1866.about: The Bangka Belitung Islands (Indonesian: Kepulauan Bangka Belitung) is a province of Indonesia. Situated off the southeastern coast of Sumatra, the province comprises two main land masses — the islands of Bangka and Belitung — and numerous smaller islands.

Q3068.name: Loire-Atlantique
Q3068.about: Loire-Atlantique (French pronunciation: [lwaʁ atlɑ̃tik] ; Gallo: Leire-de-Bertègn; Breton: Liger-Atlantel; before 1957: Loire-Inférieure, Breton: Liger-Izelañ) is a department in the economical administrative region of Pays de la Loire and the historical and cultural region of Brittany on the west coast of France, named after the river Loire and the Atlantic Ocean. It had a population of 1,487,570 in 2023.

Q3336.name: Corse-du-Sud
Q3336.about: Corse-du-Sud (French pronunciation: [kɔʁs dy syd] ; Corsican: Corsica suttana [ˈkorsiga zutˈtana],  Pumonte [puˈmɔntɛ] or Pumonti [puˈmɔnti]; English: Southern Corsica) is an administrative department of France, consisting of the southern part of the island of Corsica. The corresponding departmental territorial collectivity merged with that of Haute-Corse on 1 January 2018, forming the single territorial collectivity of Corsica, with territorial elections coinciding with the dissolution of the separate council.

Q494882.name: Santa Catarina
Q494882.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q494882.about: Santa Catarina is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the western part of the island of Santiago.

Q497019.name: Praia
Q497019.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q497019.about: Praia is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the southern part of the island of Santiago.

Q497472.name: Santa Cruz
Q497472.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q497472.about: Santa Cruz is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the eastern part of the island of Santiago.

Q498067.name: South Pemba Region
Q498067.about: Pemba South Region or South Pemba Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Pemba Kusini) is one of the 31 regions of Tanzania, covering an area of 332 km2 (128 sq mi). The region is comparable in size to the combined land area of the nation-state of Grenada.
Q498067.img: Pemba island, Tanzania. View from Chake Chake town center over the mangroves towards the sea.JPG

Q498073.name: North Pemba Region
Q498073.about: Pemba North Region or North Pemba Region  (Swahili: Mkoa wa Pemba Kaskazini) is one of the 31 regions of Tanzania. The region covers an area of 574 km2 (222 sq mi).

Q499009.name: São Domingos
Q499009.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q499009.about: São Domingos is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the southeastern part of the island of Santiago.

Q499598.name: Tarrafal
Q499598.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q499598.about: Tarrafal is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the northern part of the island of Santiago.

Q499620.name: Ribeira Grande de Santiago
Q499620.desc: municipality on the island of Santiago, Cape Verde
Q499620.about: Ribeira Grande de Santiago is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. It is situated in the southwestern part of the island of Santiago.
Q499620.wiki: Ribeira Grande de Santiago, Cape Verde

Q775756.name: Pembroke
Q775756.about: Pembroke is a town in the Eastern Region of Malta, and it is considered to be the country's newest locality. To the east is Paceville, the nightlife district of Malta.

Q786957.name: Point Fortin
Q786957.about: Point Fortin, officially the Borough of Point Fortin, is the smallest borough in Trinidad and Tobago and is located in southwestern Trinidad, about 32 km (20 mi) southwest of San Fernando. After the discovery of petroleum in the area in 1906 the town grew into a major oil-producing centre.

Q794239.name: Azua Province
Q794239.about: Azua (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈaswa]) is a province which is collectively one of the thirty-two provinces of the Dominican Republic. It is divided into 10 municipalities (the same as Santiago) and its capital city is Azua de Compostela.

Q803716.name: Baie Sainte Anne
Q803716.about: Baie Sainte Anne (French pronunciation: [bɛ sɛ̃t an]) is an administrative district of Seychelles located mostly on the island of Praslin, but also administers Curieuse Island and some other smaller islands.

Q811132.name: Baucau Municipality
Q811132.about: Baucau (Portuguese: Município Baucau, Tetun: Munisípiu Baukau) is a municipality, and was formerly a district, of Timor-Leste, on the northern coast in the eastern part of the country. The capital is also called Baucau (formerly Vila Salazar).

Q819170.name: Saint Michael
Q819170.about: The parish of St. Michael is one of 11 parishes in Barbados.

Q820940.name: Siyazan District
Q820940.about: Siyazan District (Azerbaijani: Siyəzən rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the northeast of the country and belongs to the Guba-Khachmaz Economic Region.

Q827173.name: Berry Islands
Q827173.about:
The Berry Islands are a chain of islands and a district of The Bahamas, covering about twelve square miles (31 km2).
The Berry Islands consist of about thirty islands and over one hundred small islands or cays, often referred to as "The Fish Bowl of The Bahamas." They have a population of 1,002 (2022 census), most of whom are on Great Harbour Cay.

Q1472520.name: Saint George Gingerland Parish
Q1472520.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1472520.about: Saint George Gingerland, also known as Marketshop. St George parish in the southeastern part of the island of Nevis, Leeward Islands, West Indies.

Q1472841.name: Soufrière Quarter
Q1472841.about: Soufrière is a district on the Southwest coast of Saint Lucia in the West Indies. Soufrière was the former capital of Saint Lucia during times of French rule.

Q1472864.name: Vieux Fort Quarter
Q1472864.about: Vieux Fort is one of 10 districts of the Caribbean island country of Saint Lucia. Vieux Fort is also the name of the main town in the district.
Q1472864.img: Rue de Vieux-Fort et église anglicane St-Paul (Sainte-Lucie).jpg

Q1473646.name: Saint Elizabeth Parish
Q1473646.about: Saint Elizabeth (Jamaican Patois: Sint Elizabet) is one of Jamaica's largest parishes. It is located in the southwest of the island, in the county of Cornwall.

Q1473654.name: Saint Anne Sandy Point Parish
Q1473654.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1473654.about: Saint Anne Sandy Point is one of 14 administrative parishes that make up Saint Kitts and Nevis. It is the smallest parish on St.
Q1473654.img: Sandy Point, St. Kitts - drawn by Lieut. Caddy, Royl. Artilly. ; engraved by C. Hunt. LCCN91790569.tif

Q1473663.name: Saint Catherine Parish
Q1473663.about: Saint Catherine (Jamaican Patois: Sint Cyatrine) is a parish in the south east of Jamaica. It is located in the county of Middlesex, and is one of the island's largest and most economically valued parishes because of its many resources.

Q1473680.name: Kingston Parish
Q1473680.about: Kingston Parish is one of the 14 Parishes of Jamaica. It is part of the amalgamated municipal unit of Kingston and St.

Q1475374.name: Paul
Q1475374.desc: municipality on the island of Santo Antão, Cape Verde
Q1475374.about: Paul is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the northeastern part of the island of Santo Antão, it covers 7% of the island area (54.3 km2), and is home to 16% of its population (6,997 at the 2010 census).

Q516835.name: Mosteiros
Q516835.desc: municipality on the island of Fogo, Cape Verde
Q516835.about: Mosteiros is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the northeastern part of the island of Fogo, it covers 19% of the island area, and is home to 26% of its population.

Q530231.name: Espaillat Province
Q530231.about: Espaillat (Spanish pronunciation: [espajˈʝat], locally [ehpajˈʝat]) is a province in the Dominican Republic. Located in the north central part of the country, it is spread over an area of 843 km2 (325 sq mi), and has its capital at Moca.

Q548816.name: Saint John
Q548816.about: Saint John (Antiguan and Barbudan Creole: Sen Jaan), officially the Parish of Saint John, is a civil parish of Antigua and Barbuda, on the northwestern portion of Antigua island. Its capital is the city of St.

Q550249.name: Saint Joseph
Q550249.about: The parish of St. Joseph in Barbados is on the eastern side of the island.

Q569453.name: Anse Boileau
Q569453.about: Anse Boileau (French pronunciation: [ɑ̃s bwalo] ) is an administrative district on the south of the island of Mahé in the Seychelles. Anse Boileau encapsulates the natural wonders of the Seychelles: it sits at the foot of a steep, green mountain, it is on the shores of the Indian Ocean, and in its midst are streams, mini-forests, creeks, ponds, and an enchanting array of all that defines the Seychellois landscape.

Q576651.name: Saint George Parish
Q576651.about: Saint George is one of the parishes of Grenada, located on the south-western end of the island. The capital of Grenada, St.

Q581154.name: La Digue
Q581154.about: La Digue is the third most populated island of the Seychelles, and fourth largest by land area, lying east of Praslin and west of Felicite Island. In size, it is the fourth-largest granitic island of Seychelles after Mahé, Praslin, and Silhouette Island.
Q581154.img: Remote view of La Digue asv2024-09.jpg

Q587462.name: Munxar
Q587462.about: Munxar (Maltese: Il-Munxar) is an administrative unit of Malta, which lies on the southern side of the island of Gozo. The population of Munxar was 1,872 in July 2024.

Q12758.name: Seine-Maritime
Q12758.about: Seine-Maritime (French pronunciation: [sɛn maʁitim] ) is a department of France in the Normandy region of northern France. It is situated on the northern coast of France, at the mouth of the Seine, and includes the cities of Rouen and Le Havre.

Q12770.name: Somme
Q12770.about: The Somme (French pronunciation: [sɔm] ; Picard: Sonme) is a department of France, located in the north of the country and named after the Somme river. It is part of the Hauts-de-France region.

Q308864.name: Mazandaran Province
Q308864.about: Mazandaran province is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Sari.
Q308864.img: Iran - Mazandaran - Damavand Volcano View from Rineh Road - panoramio.jpg

Q309276.name: Northeast Greenland National Park
Q309276.about: Northeast Greenland National Park (Greenlandic: Kalaallit Nunaanni nuna eqqissisimatitaq, Danish: Nordøstgrønlands Nationalpark) is the world's largest national park and the 10th largest protected area (the only larger protected areas consist mostly of sea). Established in 1974, the Northeast Greenland national park expanded to its present size in 1988.

Q322792.name: Oporto
Q322792.about: Porto is a district located on the north-west coast of Portugal. The district capital is the city of Porto, the second largest city in the country.

Q327788.name: Meneng District
Q327788.about: Meneng (or Menen) is a district located in the Meneng constituency in the country of Nauru. The constituency elects 2 members to the Parliament of Nauru in Yaren.

Q5765.name: Balearic Islands
Q5765.about: The Balearic Islands are an archipelago in the western Mediterranean Sea, off the eastern coast of the Iberian Peninsula, constituting an autonomous community and province of Spain, with Palma as their capital and largest city. With a population of 1,249,844, they are the 6th least populous autonomous community of Spain, and with an area of 4,991.70 square kilometres (1,927.31 sq mi), the smallest.

Q5772.name: Region of Murcia
Q5772.about: The Region of Murcia (, US also ; Spanish: Región de Murcia [reˈxjon de ˈmuɾθja]; Valencian: Regió de Múrcia) is an autonomous community of Spain located in the southeastern part of the Iberian Peninsula, on the Mediterranean coast. The region has a population of 1,586,989 in an area of 11,316.17 km2 (4,369.20 sq mi) as of 2025.

Q7948.name: Kamchatka Krai
Q7948.about: Kamchatka Krai is a federal subject of Russia (a krai), situated in the Russian Far East. It is administratively part of the Far Eastern Federal District.

Q180822.name: Mjini Magharibi Region
Q180822.about: Mjini Magharibi Region, Zanzibar Urban West Region or West Zanzibar Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Mjini Magharibi) is one of the 31 regions of Tanzania. The region covers an area of 230 km2 (89 sq mi).

Q182169.name: Eastern Division
Q182169.about: The Eastern Division (Fiji Hindi: पूर्वी प्रभाग) is one of Fiji's four divisions. It consists of Kadavu Province, Lau Province, Lomaiviti Province and Rotuma.

Q182565.name: Phuket
Q182565.desc: province of Thailand (for island see Q1777775)
Q182565.about: Phuket ( poo-KET; Thai: ภูเก็ต, [pʰūː.kèt] , Malay: Bukit or Tongkah) is one of the southern provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It consists of the island of Phuket, the country's largest island, and another 32 smaller islands off its coast.

Q182988.name: Dauphin Quarter
Q182988.about: Dauphin was a Quarter on the Caribbean island nation of Saint Lucia. The district was merged with Gros-Islet in 2014.

Q185111.name: Tobago
Q185111.about: Tobago, officially the Ward of Tobago, is an island and ward in Trinidad and Tobago. It is 35 kilometres (20 nautical miles) northeast of the larger island of Trinidad and about 160 kilometres (85 nautical miles) off Venezuela's northeastern coast.

Q1355642.name: Ribeira Grande
Q1355642.desc: municipality on the island of Santo Antão, Cape Verde
Q1355642.about: Ribeira Grande is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the northern part of the island of Santo Antão, it covers one fifth of the island area (166.5 km2), and is home to nearly half of its population (18,890 at the 2010 census).

Q1366107.name: San Cristóbal Province
Q1366107.about: San Cristóbal (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsaŋ kɾisˈtoβal]) is a province in the southern region of Dominican Republic, located west of the capital Santo Domingo. With approximately 690,000 inhabitants (2022), it is the fourth most populated province in the country, only behind Santo Domingo, Santiago and the National District.

Q1366119.name: San Pedro de Macorís
Q1366119.about: San Pedro de Macorís (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsam ˈpeðɾo ðe makoˈɾis]) is a province of the Dominican Republic, also the name of its capital city. The city is fairly active due to its proximity to the national capital of Santo Domingo and also its role in the sugar industry.

Q1385577.name: Exuma
Q1385577.about:
Exuma is a district of the Bahamas, consisting of over 365 islands and cays.
The largest of the islands is Great Exuma, which is 37 mi (60 km) in length and connected to another island, Little Exuma, by a small bridge.

Q1421939.name: Saint James Parish
Q1421939.about: St. James is a suburban parish, located on the north-west end of the island of Jamaica in the county of Cornwall.

Q1422332.name: Saint Thomas Parish
Q1422332.about: Saint Thomas (Jamaican Patois: Sen Tamas or Tahmas), once known as Saint Thomas in the East, is a suburban parish situated at the south eastern end of Jamaica, within the county of Surrey. It is the birthplace of Paul Bogle, designated in 1969 as one of Jamaica's seven National Heroes.

Q1431108.name: Saint Patrick Parish
Q1431108.about: Saint Patrick is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by St.

Q12798.name: Vendée
Q12798.about: Vendée (French pronunciation: [vɑ̃de] ) is a department in the Pays de la Loire region in Western France, on the Atlantic coast. In 2023, it had a population of 713,609.

Q13863.name: Negros Oriental
Q13863.about: Negros Oriental (Eastern Negros; Cebuano: Sidlakang Negros; Tagalog: Silangang Negros), officially the Province of Negros Oriental (Cebuano: Lalawigan sa Sidlakang Negros; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Silangang Negros), is a province in the Philippines located in the Negros Island. Its capital is the city of Dumaguete, one of the two regional centers of Negros Island Region, with the other being Bacolod.

Q13867.name: Occidental Mindoro
Q13867.about: Occidental Mindoro (Tagalog: Kanlurang Mindoro), officially the Province of Occidental Mindoro (Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Kanlurang Mindoro or Lalawigan ng Occidental Mindoro), is a province in the Philippines located in the Mimaropa region. The province occupies the western half of the island of Mindoro.
Q13867.img: Sitio Mabuhay, Central, San Jose, Occidental Mindoro - panoramio.jpg

Q13864.name: Northern Samar
Q13864.about: Northern Samar (Waray: Amihanan Samar/Norte san Samar; Tagalog: Hilagang Samar), officially the Province of Northern Samar, is a province in the Philippines located in the Eastern Visayas region. Its capital is Catarman, the most populous town in the province and is located at the northern portion of the island of Samar.

Q13868.name: Oriental Mindoro
Q13868.about: Oriental Mindoro (Tagalog: Silangang Mindoro), officially the Province of Oriental Mindoro (Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Silangang Mindoro (Oriental Mindoro)), is a province in the Philippines located on the island of Mindoro under Mimaropa region in Luzon, about 140 kilometres (87 mi) southwest of Manila. The province is bordered by the Verde Island Passage and the rest of Batangas to the north, by Marinduque, Maestre de Campo (or known as Sibale but official name is Concepcion) Island, Tablas Strait and the rest of Romblon to the east, by Semirara and the rest of Caluya Islands, Antique to the south, and by Occidental Mindoro to the west.

Q838690.name: New Ireland Province
Q838690.about: New Ireland Province, formerly New Mecklenburg (German: Neu-Mecklenburg), and Nova Hibernia, is the northeasternmost province of Papua New Guinea.

Q844024.name: Artibonite
Q844024.about: Artibonite (French pronunciation: [aʁtibɔnit]; Haitian Creole: Latibonit) is one of the ten departments of Haiti located in central Haiti. With an area of 4,887 km2 it is Haiti's largest department.

Q845540.name: San Salvador Island
Q845540.desc: island and district of the Bahamas
Q845540.about: San Salvador Island, previously Watling's Island, is an island and district of the Bahamas, famed for being the probable location of Christopher Columbus's first landing of the Americas on 12 October 1492 during his first voyage. This historical importance, the island's tropical beaches, and its proximity to the United States have made tourism central to the local economy.

Q845817.name: Bioko Sur
Q845817.about: Bioko Sur (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈbjo.ko suɾ] Spanish for "South Bioko") is a province of Equatorial Guinea. Its capital is Luba.

Q845834.name: Bioko Norte
Q845834.about: Bioko Norte (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈbjoko ˈnoɾte]) is the second-most populated of the eight provinces of Equatorial Guinea, after the Litoral province. It contained 300,374 of the island's 335,048 inhabitants in 2015, sub-divided into 2 districts - Malabo (271,008) and Baney (27,366).

Q210527.name: Aveiro
Q210527.about: Aveiro District (Portuguese: Distrito de Aveiro, pronounced [aˈvɐjɾu] ) is located in the central coastal region of Portugal. The capital of the district is the city of Aveiro, which also serves as the seat of Aveiro Municipality.

Q214504.name: Labuan
Q214504.about: Labuan (), officially the Federal Territory of Labuan (Malay: Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan), is an island federal territory of Malaysia. It includes Labuan Island and six smaller islands off the coast of the state of Sabah in East Malaysia.

Q215147.name: Camagüey Province
Q215147.about: Camagüey (Spanish pronunciation: [kamaˈ(ɣ)wej]) is the largest of the provinces of Cuba.  Its capital is Camagüey.

Q220692.name: Ciego de Ávila Province
Q220692.about: Ciego de Ávila (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsjeɣo ðe ˈaβila]) is one of the provinces of Cuba, and was previously part of Camagüey Province.  Its capital is Ciego de Ávila, which lies on the Carretera Central (central highway), and the second city is Morón, further north.

Q13825.name: Iloilo
Q13825.about: Iloilo ( ih-loh-EE-loh; [ɪlo.ˈilo]), officially the Province of Iloilo (Hiligaynon: Kapuoran sang Iloilo; Kinaray-a: Kapuoran kang Iloilo; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Iloilo; Spanish: Provincia de Iloílo),  is a province in the Philippines located in the Western Visayas region. Its capital and largest city is Iloilo City, the regional center of Western Visayas and politically independent from the province.

Q13846.name: Marinduque
Q13846.about: Marinduque (; Tagalog pronunciation: [maɾinˈduke]), officially the Province of Marinduque (Filipino: Lalawigan/Probinsya ng Marinduque), is an island province in the Philippines located in Southwestern Tagalog Region or Mimaropa, formerly designated as Region IV-B. Its capital is the municipality of Boac, the most populous in the province. Marinduque lies between Tayabas Bay to the north and Sibuyan Sea to the south.

Q13847.name: Masbate
Q13847.about: Masbate, officially the Province of Masbate (Masbateño: Probinsya san Masbate; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Masbate), is an island province in the Philippines located near the midsection of the nation's archipelago. Its provincial capital is Masbate City, the most populous in the province.

Q13862.name: Negros Occidental
Q13862.about: Negros Occidental (Western Negros; Hiligaynon: Nakatungdang Negros; Tagalog: Kanlurang Negros), officially the Province of Negros Occidental (Hiligaynon: Kapuoran sang Nakatungdang Negros; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Kanlurang Negros), is a province located in the western part of Negros Island in the Philippines. The provincial capital is Bacolod, a highly urbanized city and largest city by population.
Q13862.img: Provincial Capitol of Negros Occidental in Bacolod, Philippines.jpg

Q13723.name: Aklan
Q13723.about: Aklan, officially the Province of Aklan, is a province in the Western Visayas region of the Philippines. Its capital and largest town is Kalibo.

Q13727.name: Antique
Q13727.about: Antique ([ɐnˈtike]), officially the Province of Antique, is a province in the Philippines located in the Western Visayas region. Its capital and most populous town is San Jose de Buenavista.

Q13737.name: Basilan
Q13737.about: Basilan, officially the Province of Basilan (Spanish and Chavacano: Provincia de Basilan; Yakan: Wilayah Basilanin; Tausug: Wilaya' sin Basilan; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Basilan), is an island province of the Philippines located primarily in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region. Basilan Island is the largest and northernmost of the major islands of the Sulu Archipelago.
Q13737.img: Basilan Government Center Building, Santa Clara, Lamitan City.jpg

Q3349.name: Côtes-d'Armor
Q3349.about: The Côtes-d'Armor ( koht dar-mər,  -⁠dar-mor; French pronunciation: [kot daʁmɔʁ] ; Gallo: Côtes d'Ahaot, Breton: Aodoù-an-Arvor, [ˈoːdu ãn ˈarvor]), formerly known as Côtes-du-Nord until 1990 (Breton: Aodoù-an-Hanternoz, [ˈoːdu ãn ˌhãntɛrˈnoːs]), is a department in the north of Brittany, in northwestern France. In 2023, it had a population of 611,859.

Q3372.name: Eure
Q3372.about: Eure ( UR; French pronunciation: [œʁ]; Norman: Eure or Eûre) is a department in the administrative region of Normandy, northwestern France, named after the river Eure. Its prefecture is Évreux.

Q3389.name: Finistère
Q3389.about: Finistère (; French: [finistɛʁ] ; Breton: Penn-ar-Bed [ˌpɛnarˈbeːt]) is a department of France in the extreme west of Brittany. Its prefecture is Quimper and its largest city is Brest.

Q13740.name: Batanes
Q13740.about: Batanes, officially the Province of Batanes, is an archipelagic province in the Philippines, administratively part of the Cagayan Valley region. It is the northernmost province in the Philippines, and the smallest, both in population and land area.

Q13752.name: Bohol
Q13752.about: Bohol (Tagalog pronunciation: [buˈhol]), officially the Province of Bohol (Cebuano: Probinsya sa Bohol; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Bohol), is an island province of the Philippines located in the Central Visayas region, consisting of the island itself and 75 minor surrounding islands. It is home to Boholano people.

Q13769.name: Camiguin
Q13769.about: Camiguin, officially the Province of Camiguin (Cebuano: Lalawigan sa Camiguin; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Camiguin; Kamigin: Probinsya ta Kamigin), is an island province in the Philippines located in the Bohol Sea, about 10 kilometers (6.2 mi) off the northern coast of mainland Mindanao. It is geographically part of Region X, the Northern Mindanao Region of the country and formerly a part of Misamis Oriental province.

Q13772.name: Capiz
Q13772.about: Capiz ([kɑˈpiz]), officially the Province of Capiz (Capiznon/Hiligaynon: Kapuoran sang Capiz; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Capiz), is a province in the central part of the Western Visayas region of the Philippines. Capiz is located at the northeastern portion of Panay Island, bordering three other provinces, Aklan to the north, Antique to the west, and Iloilo to the south.

Q2300294.name: Saint George Parish
Q2300294.desc: administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, in the southerly portion of the island of Saint Vincent
Q2300294.about: Saint George is an administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, situated in the most southerly portion of the island of Saint Vincent. With an area of 52 km2 it is the country's third largest parish by total area.
Q2300294.wiki: Saint George Parish, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
Q2300294.img: St. Vincent, Karibik - Kingstown City - panoramio.jpg

Q2305115.name: Saint Andrew Parish
Q2305115.desc: administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the island of Saint Vincent
Q2305115.about: Saint Andrew is an administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the island of Saint Vincent. Its capital is Layou.
Q2305115.wiki: Saint Andrew Parish, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
Q2305115.img: Vista de Layou desde el mar.jpg

Q2366966.name: Príncipe Autonomous Region
Q2366966.desc: autonomous region in Sao Tome and Principe
Q2366966.about: The Autonomous Region of Príncipe (Portuguese: Região Autónoma do Príncipe) is an autonomous administrative division of the Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe. Established on 29 April 1995, it covers the island of Príncipe and a number of small uninhabited islands around it, with an area of 142 km2 (55 sq mi) in total.

Q2408672.name: South Andros
Q2408672.about:
South Andros is a district of the nation of the Bahamas.
Geographically, South Andros is the southernmost third of the land mass colloquially called Andros, which includes the districts of North Andros, Central Andros, Mangrove Cay and South Andros.

Q2412394.name: Saint David Parish
Q2412394.desc: administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the island of Saint Vincent
Q2412394.about: Saint David is an administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, on the island of Saint Vincent. Its capital is Chateaubelair.
Q2412394.wiki: Saint David Parish, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

Q2487249.name: Mayaro-Rio Claro
Q2487249.desc: region of Trinidad, Trinidad and Tobago
Q2487249.about: Mayaro–Rio Claro is a region of Trinidad. The local government body is Mayaro–Rio Claro Regional Corporation, a Regional Corporation of Trinidad and Tobago.

Q2494551.name: Baie Lazare
Q2494551.about: Baie Lazare (French pronunciation: [bɛ lazaʁ]) is an administrative district of Seychelles located on the island of Mahé.  It is named after the explorer Lazare Picault.

Q2499228.name: Distrito Nacional
