Q2499228.about: Distrito Nacional (D.N.; pronounced [disˈtɾito nasjoˈnal], locally [dihˈtɾito nasjoˈnal]; lit. 'National District') is a subdivision of the Dominican Republic enclosing the capital Santo Domingo. It is not in any of the provinces, but in practice, it acts as a province on its own.
Q2499228.img: Santo Domingo (Dominican Republic) taken atop Novocentro tower viewing the city to the southwest 2010.jpg

Q2525298.name: Black Point
Q2525298.about: Black Point is one of the districts of the Bahamas. As of 2010, it has a population of 414 and an area of 12.1 km2.

Q2525371.name: Central Abaco
Q2525371.about: Central Abaco is an administrative district of the Bahamas. It is part of the larger  Abaco Islands chain and is the largest Schedule 2 district in the Bahamas.

Q2544592.name: Central Singapore Community Development Council
Q2544592.desc: one of five Community Development Councils (CDCs) set up across the Republic of Singapore
Q2544592.about: The Central Singapore Community Development Council is one of five Community Development Councils (CDCs) set up across the Republic of Singapore to aid in local administration of governmental policies and schemes.

Q2545297.name: Grenadines Parish
Q2545297.desc: parish in Port Elizabeth, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
Q2545297.about: Grenadines is an administrative parish of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, comprising the islands of the Grenadines other than those belonging to Grenada. The capital is Port Elizabeth.

Q13778.name: Catanduanes
Q13778.about: Catanduanes (; Tagalog pronunciation: [kɐtɐndʊˈɐnes]), officially the Province of Catanduanes (Filipino: Lalawigan ng Catanduanes), is an island province located in the Bicol Region of Luzon in the Philippines. It is the 12th-largest island in the Philippines, and lies to the east of Camarines Sur, across the Maqueda Channel.

Q13786.name: Cebu
Q13786.about: Cebu ( seb-OO; Cebuano: Sugbo), officially the Province of Cebu (Cebuano: Lalawigan sa Sugbo; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Cebu), is a province of the Philippines located in the Central Visayas (Region VII) region. It consists of the main island and 167 surrounding islands and islets.

Q13810.name: Guimaras
Q13810.about: Guimaras ([ɡimaˈɾas]), officially the Province of Guimaras (Hiligaynon: Kapuoran sang Guimaras; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Guimaras), is an island province in the Philippines located in the Western Visayas region. The capital is Jordan, while the largest local government unit is the municipality of Buenavista.

Q1431129.name: Saint David Parish
Q1431129.about: Saint David is one of Dominica's ten administrative parishes, located on the eastern side of the island. It is bordered by St.

Q1440250.name: Westmoreland Parish
Q1440250.about: Westmoreland (Jamaican Patois: Wesmolan) is the westernmost parish in Jamaica, on the south side of the island. It lies south of Hanover, southwest of Saint James, and northwest of Saint Elizabeth, in the county of Cornwall.

Q1444575.name: Chaguanas
Q1444575.desc: city in central Trinidad, Trinidad and Tobago
Q1444575.about: The Borough of Chaguanas is the largest municipality (83,489 at the 2011 census) and fastest-growing town in Trinidad and Tobago. Located in west-central Trinidad, south of Port of Spain, north of Couva and San Fernando, and named after the indigenous tribe who originally settled there, it grew in size due to its proximity to the Woodford Lodge sugar refinery.

Q1476285.name: Saint John Parish
Q1476285.about: Saint John is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by St.

Q1476289.name: Saint John Parish
Q1476289.about: Saint John is one of the parishes of Grenada. Its capital is Gouyave.

Q1476294.name: Saint Peter Parish
Q1476294.about: Saint Peter is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by St.

Q1476302.name: Saint Joseph Parish
Q1476302.about: Saint Joseph is one of Dominica's 10 administrative parishes. It is bordered by St.

Q1476309.name: Saint Patrick Parish
Q1476309.desc: one of the parishes of Grenada, covering the north of the country
Q1476309.about: Saint Patrick is one of the Catholic parishes of Grenada, covering the north of the country.

Q1540744.name: Saint George Basseterre Parish
Q1540744.desc: parish of Saint Kitts and Nevis
Q1540744.about: Saint George Basseterre is one of 14 administrative parishes that make up Saint Kitts and Nevis. It is the largest parish on Saint Kitts and the second largest parish in Saint Kitts and Nevis (after Saint James Windward).

Q1552897.name: Porto Novo
Q1552897.desc: municipality on the island of Santo Antão, Cape Verde
Q1552897.about: Porto Novo is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the southern part of the island of Santo Antão, it covers 72% of the island area (564.3 km2), and is home to 41% of its population.

Q1567791.name: Praslin Quarter
Q1567791.about: Praslin Quarter was a former quarter  on the island nation of Saint Lucia.  Since at least 2001, it has been a second-order subdivision of the Micoud District.

Q1626524.name: Christ Church
Q1626524.about: The parish of Christ Church is one of eleven in Barbados. It has a land area of 57 km2 (22 sq mi) and is found at the southern end of the island.

Q1626540.name: Saint John
Q1626540.about: The parish of  St. John in Barbados is on the eastern side of the island.

Q977183.name: Saint Andrew Parish
Q977183.about: Saint Andrew's is the largest parish in Grenada. The main town is Grenville, which is also Grenada's second largest town after St George's.

Q979608.name: San Juan–Laventille
Q979608.desc: regional corporation of Trinidad and Tobago
Q979608.about: San Juan–Laventille () is a region of Trinidad. It has a land area of 220.39 km2.

Q1023712.name: San Fernando
Q1023712.about: San Fernando, officially the City of San Fernando, is the most populous city and second most populous municipality in Trinidad and Tobago, after Chaguanas. Sando, as it is known to many local Trinidadians, occupies 19 km2 (7.3 sq mi) and is located in the southwestern part of the island of Trinidad.

Q1049867.name: Castries Quarter
Q1049867.about: Castries District is one of 10 districts (formerly called quarters) of the Caribbean island nation of Saint Lucia. According to the 2012 census, the population of the district was 80,573, having shown a slow but steady increase over the past ten years.[1] The capital of Saint Lucia, the city of Castries, is located in this district.

Q1050154.name: Cat Island
Q1050154.about: Cat Island is located in the Bahamas, and is one of its districts.  Cat Island also has the nation's highest point, Mount Alvernia (formerly known as Como Hill).

Q1051475.name: Rennell and Bellona Province
Q1051475.about: Rennell and Bellona is one of the nine provinces of Solomon Islands, comprising two inhabited raised coral atolls, Rennell and Bellona, or Mu Gava and Mu Giki respectively in Rennellese (a Polynesian language), as well as the uninhabited Indispensable Reef. Rennell and Bellona are both Polynesian-inhabited islands within the predominantly Melanesian Solomons.

Q1053565.name: Rivière du Rempart District
Q1053565.about: Rivière du Rempart (Mauritian Creole pronunciation: [ʁivjɛː dʒi ʁɑ̃pɑː]) is a district of Mauritius, located in the north-east of the island. It has an area of 147.6 km2 and an estimated population of 108,005, as of 31 December 2015.

Q13875.name: Romblon
Q13875.about: Romblon (, rom-BLOHN, Tagalog: [ɾomˈblon]), officially the Province of Romblon (Filipino: Lalawingan/Probinsya ng Romblon), is an archipelagic province of the Philippines located in the Mimaropa region. Its main components include Romblon, an archipelagic municipality of the same name that also serves as the provincial capital; Tablas, the largest island, covering nine municipalities (including Odiongan, the largest municipality in the province); Sibuyan with its three towns; as well as the smaller island municipalities of Corcuera, Banton, Concepcion, and San Jose.

Q13879.name: Siquijor
Q13879.about: Siquijor ( SIK-ee-HOR, Tagalog: [sɪkɪˈhɔɾ]), officially the Province of Siquijor (Cebuano: Lalawigan sa Siquijor;  Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Siquijor), is a Philippine island province (the third smallest in the country, in terms of population and land area) located within the Negros Island Region. Its largest town and capital is the municipality of Siquijor.

Q13893.name: Tawi-Tawi
Q13893.about: Tawi-Tawi, officially the Province of Tawi-Tawi (Tausug: Wilaya' sin Tawi-Tawi; Sinama: Lahat Jawi Jawi/Jauih Jauih; Sabah Malay: Wilayah Tawi-Tawi; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Tawi-Tawi), is an island province in the Philippines located in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). The capital of Tawi-Tawi is Bongao.

Q16112.name: Province of Agrigento
Q16112.about: The province of Agrigento (Italian: provincia di Agrigento; Sicilian: pruvincia di Girgenti) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy, situated on its south-western coast. Following the suppression of the Sicilian provinces, it was replaced in 2015 by the Free Municipal Consortium of Agrigento (Italian: libero consorzio comunale di Agrigento).

Q9248.name: Baku
Q9248.about: Baku (US: , UK: ; Azerbaijani: Bakı [bɑˈcɯ] ) is the capital and largest city of Azerbaijan, as well as the largest city on the Caspian Sea and in the Caucasus region. Baku is 28 metres (92 ft) below sea level, which makes it the lowest lying national capital in the world and the largest city in the world below sea level.

Q17070.name: Réunion
Q17070.desc: overseas department of France in the Indian Ocean
Q17070.about: Réunion (; French: [la ʁe.ynjɔ̃] ; Reunionese Creole: La Rényon; known as Île Bourbon before 1848) is an island in the Indian Ocean that is an overseas department and region of France within the African region. Part of the Mascarene Islands, it is located approximately 679 kilometres (367 nautical miles) east of the island of Madagascar and 175 kilometres (94 nmi) southwest of the island of Mauritius.
Q17070.img: L'île de la Réunion vue par le satellite Sentinel-2 (cropped).jpg

Q18826.name: Autonomous Region of Bougainville
Q18826.desc: autonomous region of Papua New Guinea
Q18826.about: Bougainville (, BOH-gən-vil; Tok Pisin: Bogenvil), officially the Autonomous Region of Bougainville (Tok Pisin: Otonomos Rijen bilong Bogenvil), is an autonomous region in Papua New Guinea. The largest island is Bougainville Island, while the region also includes Buka Island and a number of outlying islands and atolls.

Q16150.name: Province of Caltanissetta
Q16150.about: The province of Caltanissetta (Italian: provincia di Caltanissetta; Sicilian: pruvincia di Nissa or pruvincia di Cartanissetta; officially libero consorzio comunale di Caltanissetta) is a province in the southern part of the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy. Following the suppression of the Sicilian provinces, it was replaced in 2015 by the free municipal consortium of Caltanissetta (Italian: libero consorzio comunale di Caltanissetta).

Q16149.name: Province of Cagliari
Q16149.about: The province of Cagliari (Italian: provincia di Cagliari; Sardinian: provìntzia de Casteddu) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sardinia, Italy. Its capital city was Cagliari.

Q16154.name: Province of Catania
Q16154.desc: one of nine provinces in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy
Q16154.about: The province of Catania (Italian: provincia di Catania; Sicilian: pruvincia di Catania) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sicily, Italy. Its capital was the city of Catania.

Q16152.name: Province of Carbonia-Iglesias
Q16152.about: The province of Carbonia-Iglesias (Italian: provincia di Carbonia-Iglesias; Sardinian: provìntzia de Carbònia-Igrèsias) was a province in the autonomous region of Sardinia, Italy. It included the historical area of Sulcis-Iglesiente and it was the smallest province of Sardinia.

Q2551133.name: Maio
Q2551133.desc: municipality on the island of Maio, Cape Verde
Q2551133.about: Maio (Portuguese for "May"), is the easternmost of the Sotavento islands of Cape Verde. Maio is located south of the island of Boa Vista and east of Santiago.

Q2554877.name: Sigave
Q2554877.about: Sigavé (also Singave or Sigave) is one of the three official chiefdoms of the French territory of Wallis and Futuna in Oceania in the South Pacific Ocean.
Q2554877.img: Couverture de feuilles de pandanus d'un fale familial à Vaisei, Sigave, Futuna, 2017.jpg

Q2571624.name: Brava
Q2571624.desc: municipality on the island of Brava, Cape Verde
Q2571624.about: Brava (Portuguese for 'wild') is an island in Cape Verde, and is part of the Sotavento group, in the central Atlantic Ocean. At 62.5 km2 (24.1 sq mi), it is the smallest inhabited island of the Cape Verde archipelago, but at the same time the greenest.

Q2608046.name: Santa Catarina do Fogo
Q2608046.desc: municipality on the island of Fogo, Cape Verde
Q2608046.about: Santa Catarina do Fogo is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the southeastern part of the island of Fogo, it covers 32% of the island area (152.95 km2), and is home to 14% of its population (5,299 at the 2010 census).
Q2608046.img: Cape Verde Fogo Chã das Caldeiras school.jpg

Q2630334.name: East Grand Bahama
Q2630334.about:
East Grand Bahama is a district of The Bahamas, situated on the eastern part of the island of Grand Bahama, with a population collectively of 11,411 people.
The local government seat for the district is in the settlement of High Rock, a fairly small town.

Q2679107.name: Diego Martin Regional Corporation
Q2679107.desc: regional corporation in Trinidad and Tobago
Q2679107.about: Diego Martin () is a borough of Trinidad and Tobago. The region has a land area of 127.53 km2.

Q2679119.name: Siparia Regional Corporation
Q2679119.desc: regional corporation in Trinidad and Tobago
Q2679119.about: The Borough of Siparia is the fifth and newest Borough of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago, located in the southwestern portion of the island, it is Trinidad and Tobago's southernmost borough. The Siparia Borough Corporation is headquartered in Siparia proper (downtown).

Q2679127.name: Couva-Tabaquite-Talparo
Q2679127.about: Couva–Tabaquite–Talparo () is one of the nine regions of Trinidad and Tobago, and one of the five regions which form the Gulf of Paria coastline on Trinidad's West Coast. Its regional capital and commercial center is Couva.

Q2699411.name: North Andros
Q2699411.about: North Andros is one of the 31 districts of the Bahamas. It is also the largest district (in area) in the country, and has some of the largest settlements in Andros Island.

Q2699715.name: South Eleuthera
Q2699715.desc: administrative territorial entity of the Bahamas
Q2699715.about:
South Eleuthera is one of the districts of the Bahamas, on the island of Eleuthera.
The district had a population of 4,955 in 2010.

Q2702334.name: Mangrove Cay
Q2702334.about: Mangrove Cay is one of the districts of the Bahamas on Andros. The capital of Mangrove Cay is Moxey Town in the northeast corner of the island.

Q16207.name: Province of Medio Campidano
Q16207.about: The province of Medio Campidano (Italian: provincia del Medio Campidano; Sardinian: provìntzia de su Campidanu de Mesu; both lit. 'province of the Middle Campidano') is a province in the autonomous island region of Sardinia in Italy. As of 2026, the province has a population of 89,155 over an area of 1,517.34 square kilometres (585.85 mi2), giving it a population density of 58 inhabitants per square kilometer.

Q16208.name: Province of Messina
Q16208.about: The province of Messina (Italian: provincia di Messina; Sicilian: pruvincia di Missina) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sicily, Italy. Its capital was the city of Messina.

Q16223.name: Province of Ogliastra
Q16223.about: The province of Ogliastra (Italian: provincia dell'Ogliastra, [proˈvintʃa delloʎˈʎastra], Sardinian: Provìntzia de Ogiastra) is a province in the autonomous island region of Sardinia in Italy. The province has two capitals; Lanusei and Tortolì.

Q16220.name: Province of Nuoro
Q16220.about: The province of Nuoro (Italian: provincia di Nuoro; Sardinian: provìntzia de Nùgoro) is a province in the autonomous island region of Sardinia in Italy. Its capital is the town of Nuoro.

Q25231.name: Svalbard
Q25231.desc: Norwegian archipelago in the Arctic Ocean
Q25231.about: Svalbard (US:  SVAHL-bar(d), UK: also  SVAL-, Urban East Norwegian: [ˈsvɑ̂ːɫbɑr]), formerly Spitsbergen or Spitzbergen, is a Norwegian archipelago that lies at the convergence of the Arctic Ocean with the Atlantic Ocean. North of mainland Europe, it lies about midway between the northern coast of Norway and the North Pole.

Q25263.name: Azores
Q25263.desc: Atlantic Ocean archipelago and autonomous region of Portugal
Q25263.about: The Azores, officially the Autonomous Region of the Azores, is an archipelago of Portugal, in the Atlantic Ocean, about 1,400 km (870 miles) west of the Portuguese mainland. Politically and administratively, together with Madeira, it is one of the two autonomous regions of Portugal and a special territory of the European Union.

Q26073.name: Capital Region of Denmark
Q26073.about:
The Capital Region of Denmark (Danish: Region Hovedstaden, pronounced [ʁekiˈoˀn ˈhoːð̩ˌstæðˀn̩]) is the easternmost administrative region of Denmark, and contains Copenhagen, the national capital.
The Capital Region has 29 municipalities and a regional council consisting of 41 elected members.

Q26180.name: Sint Eustatius
Q26180.desc: island in the Caribbean, part of the Netherlands
Q26180.about: Sint Eustatius, known locally as Statia, is an island in the Caribbean. It is a special municipality (officially "public body") of the Netherlands.

Q26253.name: Madeira
Q26253.desc: Autonomous Region of Portugal in the archipelago of Madeira
Q26253.about: Madeira, officially the Autonomous Region of Madeira, is an autonomous region of Portugal, in the Atlantic Ocean about 805 km (500 miles) southwest of mainland Portugal. Together with the Azores, it is one of the two autonomous regions of Portugal and a special territory of the European Union.

Q26586.name: Central Denmark
Q26586.about: The Central Denmark Region (Danish: Region Midtjylland), or more directly translated as the Central Jutland Region and sometimes simply Mid-Jutland, is an administrative region of Denmark established on 1 January 2007 as part of the 2007 Danish municipal reform. The reform abolished the traditional counties (amter) and replaced them with five new administrative regions.
Q26586.img: View to the Northwest from Todbjerg Tower 2014-07-25 1.jpg

Q130343.name: Federal Dependencies
Q130343.desc: first-level administrative territorial entity of Venezuela, not organized as a state
Q130343.about: The Federal Dependencies of Venezuela (Spanish: Dependencias Federales de Venezuela) encompass most of Venezuela's offshore islands in the Caribbean Sea, excluding those islands that form the state of Nueva Esparta and some Caribbean coastal islands that are integrated with nearby states. These islands, with a total area of 342 square kilometres, are sparsely populated – according to the preliminary results of the 2011 Census only 2,155 people live there permanently, with another hundred from Margarita Island who live there seasonally to engage in fishing.

Q147116.name: Unguja North Region
Q147116.about: Unguja North Region, Zanzibar North Region or North Zanzibar Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Unguja Kaskazini) is one of the 31 regions of Tanzania. The region covers an area of 407 km2 (157 sq mi).

Q150325.name: Western Province
Q150325.about: Western Province is the largest of the nine provinces of Solomon Islands. The area is renowned for its beautiful tropical islands, excellent diving and snorkelling, coral reefs and World War II wrecks, ecotourism lodges, and head-hunting shrines.

Q2702338.name: West Grand Bahama
Q2702338.about: West Grand Bahama is one of 31 districts of the Bahamas. The district covers the entire western portion of Grand Bahama island, excluding the city of Freeport, which forms its own district.

Q2702345.name: Moore's Island
Q2702345.about:
Moore's Island is one of the districts of the Bahamas, on the Abaco Islands.
Moore's Island is a cay, 28 miles (45 km) to the west of the main island of Abaco.

Q2703192.name: South Abaco
Q2703192.about:
South Abaco is one of the districts of the Bahamas, on the Abaco Islands.
The district had a population of 7,646 in 2010.

Q2705535.name: North Eleuthera
Q2705535.about: North Eleuthera is one of the districts of the Bahamas, on the island of Eleuthera. It had a  population of 3,247 in 2010.

Q2721003.name: Sal
Q2721003.desc: municipality on the island of Sal, Cape Verde
Q2721003.about: Sal (Portuguese for "salt") is an island in Cape Verde. Sal is a tourist destination with white sand beaches and over 350 days of sunshine a year.

Q2721025.name: Boa Vista
Q2721025.desc: municipality on the island of Boa Vista, Cape Verde
Q2721025.about: Boa Vista (Portuguese for "good view"), sometimes spelled Boavista, is a desert-like island that belongs to the Cape Verde Islands. At 631 km2 (244 sq mi), it is the third largest island of the Cape Verde archipelago.

Q2734700.name: Alo
Q2734700.about: Alo (also known unofficially as Tu`a or the Kingdom of Futuna) is one of three official chiefdoms of the French territory of Wallis and Futuna, in Oceania, in the South Pacific Ocean.

Q3044818.name: Carriacou and Petite Martinique
Q3044818.about:
Carriacou and Petite Martinique, also known as the Southern Grenadines, is a dependency (part) of Grenada, lying north of Grenada island and south of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines in the Lesser Antilles.
Carriacou Island is the largest island of the Grenadines, an archipelago in the Windward Islands chain.

Q3125978.name: Bali
Q3125978.about: Bali (English:  ; Indonesian: ['bali]; Balinese: ᬩᬮᬶ) is an Indonesian island and province and the westernmost of the Lesser Sunda Islands. East of Java and west of Lombok, the province includes the island of Bali and a few smaller offshore islands, notably Nusa Penida, Nusa Lembongan, and Nusa Ceningan to the southeast.

Q34497.name: Saint Helena
Q34497.desc: island in the South Atlantic Ocean
Q34497.about: Saint Helena (, US: ; US:  ) is a volcanic tropical island located in the South Atlantic Ocean, west of Africa. The nearest countries geographically are Angola and Namibia.

Q39178.name: Port of Spain
Q39178.hog: Prime Minister of Trinidad and Tobago
Q39178.about: Port of Spain (Trinidadian English: Port ah Spain [ˈpʊo̯t a ˈspɪe̯n] ) is the capital and chief port of Trinidad and Tobago. With a municipal population of 49,867 (2017), an urban population of 81,142 and a transient daily population of 250,000, it is Trinidad and Tobago's third largest municipality, after Chaguanas and San Fernando.

Q3241696.name: Glacis
Q3241696.about: Glacis (French pronunciation: [ɡlasi]) is an administrative district of Seychelles located in the North Region of the island of Mahé. It also encompasses uninhabited Mamelles Island 13 kilometers to the northeast of Mahé, and the tiny Brisan Rocks in between.

Q3710534.name: North East Community Development Council
Q3710534.about: The North East Community Development Council is one of five Community Development Councils (CDCs) set up across the Republic of Singapore to aid in local administration of governmental policies and schemes. They are funded in part by the government although they are free to engage in fund-raising activities.

Q3736616.name: Annobón Province
Q3736616.about: Annobón (Spanish: [anoˈβon] ; Portuguese: Ano-Bom) is a province of Equatorial Guinea. The province consists of the island of Annobón and its associated islets in the Gulf of Guinea.
Q3736616.img: San Antonio de Palé Airport SDV-1.jpg

Q6430079.name: São Filipe
Q6430079.desc: municipality on the island of Fogo, Cape Verde
Q6430079.about: São Filipe is a concelho (municipality) of Cape Verde. Situated in the western part of the island of Fogo, it covers 49% of the island area (228.84 km2), and is home to 60% of its population (22,248 at the 2010 census).
Q6430079.img: Jardim Florido, S. Filipe. Fogo, Cape Verde - 1997.jpg

Q7479348.name: Beau Vallon
Q7479348.about: Beau Vallon (French pronunciation: [bo valɔ̃] ) is a bay on the north western coast of Mahé in the Seychelles.  Beau Vallon Beach is well-frequented and is possibly the most popular beach on the island.

Q7771127.name: Pohnpei State
Q7771127.desc: state of the Federated States of Micronesia
Q7771127.about: Pohnpei State (), officially simply Pohnpei, is one of the four states of the Federated States of Micronesia (FSM). Its capital is Kolonia.

Q18655787.name: Loyalty Islands Province
Q18655787.about: Loyalty Islands Province (French: Province des îles Loyauté, pronounced [pʁɔvɛ̃s dez‿il lwajote]) is one of the three top-level administrative subdivisions of New Caledonia. It encompasses the Loyalty Islands (French: Îles Loyauté) archipelago in the Pacific Ocean, located northeast of the New Caledonian mainland of Grande Terre.

Q25362.name: Saint Barthélemy
Q25362.desc: overseas collectivity of France, island of the Little Antilles
Q25362.about: Saint Barthélemy, officially the Territorial Collectivity of Saint Barthélemy, also known as St. Barts and St.

Q25396.name: Bonaire
Q25396.desc: Caribbean overseas territory of the Netherlands
Q25396.about: Bonaire is a Caribbean island in the Leeward Antilles. A special municipality (officially "public body") of the Netherlands, its seat is the port of Kralendijk, on the west (leeward) coast of the island.

Q26067.name: North Denmark Region
Q26067.about: The North Jutland Region (Danish: Region Nordjylland), or in some official sources, the North Denmark Region, is an administrative region of Denmark established on 1 January 2007 as part of the 2007 Danish municipal reform, which abolished the traditional counties (amter) and set up five larger regions. At the same time, smaller municipalities were merged into larger units, cutting the number of municipalities from 271 before 1 January 2006, when Ærø Municipality was created, to 98.

Q26589.name: Region Zealand
Q26589.about: Region Zealand (Danish: Region Sjælland) is an administrative region of Denmark. It is one of the five classified NUTS-2 statistical regions of Denmark.

Q26855.name: Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina
Q26855.about: San Andrés and Providencia  (Spanish: San Andrés y Providencia, pronounced [aɾtʃiˈpjelaɣo ðe ˌsan anˈdɾes pɾoβiˈðensja i ˌsanta kataˈlina]) is one of the departments of Colombia. It consists of two island groups in the Caribbean Sea about 775 km (418 nmi; 482 mi) northwest of mainland Colombia, and eight outlying banks and reefs.

Q26927.name: Lakshadweep
Q26927.about: Lakshadweep is a union territory of India. It is an archipelago of 36 islands divided into three island subgroups: the Amindivi Islands in the north, the Laccadive Islands (separated from Amindivi roughly by the 11th parallel north), and the atoll of Minicoy to the south of the Nine Degree Channel.

Q34366.name: Tasmania
Q34366.about: Tasmania (/tæzˈmeɪniə/; palawa kani: Lutruwita) is an island state of Australia. It is located 240 kilometres (150 miles) to the south of the Australian mainland, and is separated from it by the Bass Strait.

Q16227.name: Province of Palermo
Q16227.about: The province of Palermo (Italian: provincia di Palermo; Sicilian: pruvincia di Palermu) was a province in the autonomous region of Sicily, a major island in Southern Italy. Its capital was the city of Palermo.

Q16224.name: Province of Olbia-Tempio
Q16224.about: The province of Olbia-Tempio (Italian: provincia di Olbia-Tempio; Sardinian: provìntzia de Terranòa-Tèmpiu; Gallurese: pruìncia di Tarranoa-Tèmpiu) was a province in the autonomous region of Sardinia, Italy. It had two provincial capitals, Olbia (58,723 inhabitants) and Tempio Pausania (14,342 inhabitants).

Q16225.name: Province of Oristano
Q16225.about: The province of Oristano (Italian: provincia di Oristano; Sardinian: provìntzia de Aristanis) is a province in the autonomous island region of Sardinia in Italy. Its capital is the city of Oristano.

Q16251.name: Province of Ragusa
Q16251.about: The province of Ragusa (Italian: provincia di Ragusa; Sicilian: pruvincia di Rausa) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy, located in the southeast of the island. Following the abolition of the Sicilian provinces, it was replaced in 2015 by the Free municipal consortium of Ragusa (Italian: Libero consorzio comunale di Ragusa; Sicilian: Lìbbiru cunsòrziu cumunali di Rausa).

Q16272.name: Province of Sassari
Q16272.about: The province of Sassari (Italian: provincia di Sassari; Sardinian: provìntzia de Tàtari; Sassarese: prubìnzia di Sàssari; Algherese: província de Sàsser; Gallurese: pruvincia di Sassari) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sardinia, Italy. Its capital was the city of Sassari.

Q16277.name: Province of Syracuse
Q16277.about:
The province of Syracuse (Italian: provincia di Siracusa; Sicilian: pruvincia di Saragusa) was a province in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy. Its capital was the city of Syracuse, a town established by Greek colonists arriving from Corinth in the 8th century BC.
The former province has a population of 382,450 in an area of 2,124.13 square kilometres (820.13 mi2) across its 21 municipalities.

Q16288.name: Province of Trapani
Q16288.about: The province of Trapani (Italian: provincia di Trapani; Sicilian: pruvincia di Tràpani; officially libero consorzio comunale di Trapani) is a province in the autonomous island region of Sicily in Italy. Following the suppression of the Sicilian provinces, it was replaced in 2015 by the free municipal consortium of Trapani (Italian: libero consorzio comunale di Trapani).

Q17012.name: Guadeloupe
Q17012.desc: overseas region and department of France, and archipelago in the Caribbean
Q17012.about: Guadeloupe is an overseas department and region of France in the Caribbean. It consists of six inhabited islands—Basse-Terre, Grande-Terre, Marie-Galante, La Désirade, and two Îles des Saintes—and 30 uninhabited islets and 3 inhabited islets.

Q17054.name: Martinique
Q17054.desc: island in the Lesser Antilles, overseas region and department of France
Q17054.about: Martinique ( MAR-tin-EEK, French pronunciation: [maʁtinik] ; Martinican Creole: Matinik or Matnik; Kalinago: Madinina or Madiana) is an island in the Lesser Antilles of the West Indies, in the eastern Caribbean Sea. A part of the French West Indies (Antilles), Martinique is an overseas department and region and a single territorial collectivity of France.

Q34374.name: Crete
Q34374.about: Crete ( KREET) is the largest and most populous island of Greece, the 89th largest island in the world, and the fifth largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, after Sicily, Sardinia, Cyprus, and Corsica. Crete is located approximately 100 km (62 mi) south of the Peloponnese, and about 300 km (190 mi) southwest of Anatolia.

Q41164.name: Jeju Province
Q41164.about: Jeju Province (Jeju and Korean: 제주도), officially Jeju Special Self-Governing Province (Jeju: 제주특벨ᄌᆞ치도; Korean: 제주특별자치도), is the southernmost province of South Korea, consisting of eight inhabited and 55 uninhabited islands, including Marado, Udo, the Chuja Archipelago, and the country's largest island, Jeju Island. The province is located in the Korea Strait, with the Korean Peninsula to the northwest, Japan to the east, and China to the west.

Q44381.name: Rabat
Q44381.about: Rabat (Maltese: Ir-Rabat [ɪˈrːɐbɐt]) is a town in the Western Region of Malta. It adjoins the ancient capital city of Mdina, and a north-western part of Rabat was in the Roman city of Melite until its medieval retrenchment.

Q44397.name: Naxxar
Q44397.about: Naxxar (Maltese: In-Naxxar) is a city and local council in the Northern Region of Malta. The population of Naxxar was 18,063 in July 2024.

Q44417.name: Żurrieq
Q44417.about: Żurrieq (Maltese: Iż-Żurrieq [ɪzːʊˈrːɪːʔ]) is a town in the Western Region of Malta. It is one of the oldest towns in the country.

Q46197.name: Ascension Island
Q46197.desc: equatorial island in the Atlantic Ocean, a British overseas territory belonging to the United Kingdom
Q46197.about: Ascension Island is an isolated volcanic island, near 8° south of the Equator in the South Atlantic Ocean. It is about 960 miles (1,540 km) from the coast of Africa and 1,400 miles (2,300 km) from the coast of South America.

Q46650.name: Macquarie Island
Q46650.about: Macquarie Island is a subantarctic island in the south-western Pacific Ocean, about halfway between Tasmania and Antarctica. It has been governed as a part of Tasmania, Australia, since 1880.

Q47134.name: Shetland Islands
Q47134.desc: subarctic archipelago, county and council area of Scotland that lies north-east of mainland Britain
Q47134.about: Shetland, also called the Shetland Islands, is an archipelago in Scotland lying between Orkney, the Faroe Islands, and Norway, marking the northernmost region of the United Kingdom. The islands lie about 50 miles (80 kilometres) to the northeast of Orkney, 110 mi (170 km) from mainland Scotland, and 140 mi (220 km) west of Norway.
Q47134.img: Aerial view of North Haven, Fair Isle - geograph.org.uk - 17893.jpg

Q54936.name: Province of Alicante
Q54936.about: The Province of Alicante (, also UK: , US: ; Spanish: Provincia de Alicante, pronounced [aliˈkante], Valencian: Província d'Alacant, pronounced [alaˈkant]) is a province located in eastern Spain, in the southern part of the Valencian Community. It is the 2nd most populated Valencian province, containing the second and third biggest cities in the Valencian Community—Alicante (also known in Valencian as Alacant) and Elche (Elx), respectively.

Q54939.name: Province of Valencia
Q54939.desc: province of the Valencian Country, Spain
Q54939.about: The province of Valencia (Spanish: Provincia de Valencia,  və-LEN-see-ə or  və-LEN-sh(ee-)ə, Spanish: [baˈlenθja] ), officially València (Província de València, Valencian: [vaˈlensia]), is a province of Spain, in the central part of the Valencian Community. Of the province's 2.7 million people, almost one-third live in the capital, Valencia, which is also the capital of the autonomous community and the 3rd biggest city in Spain, with a metropolitan area of 2,522,383 people it is also one of the most populated cities of Southern Europe.
Q54939.img: Vistas de la zona del campillo desde Gestalgar.jpg

Q54942.name: Castellón
Q54942.desc: province of Spain in the Community of Valencia
Q54942.about: The Province of Castellón (Spanish: Provincia de Castellón [kasteˈʎon]; Valencian: Província de Castelló [kasteˈʎo]) is a province in the northern part of the Valencian Community in Spain. Its capital is the city of Castellón de la Plana.

Q39521.name: St. Paul's Bay
Q39521.about: Saint Paul's Bay (Maltese: San Pawl il-Baħar) is a town located on the northeast coast of Malta in the Northern Region. It is a major residential and commercial area and a centre for shopping, bars, dining, and café life.

Q39526.name: Sliema
Q39526.about: Sliema (Maltese: Tas-Sliema [tɐˈsːlɪːmɐ]) is a town located on the northeast coast of Malta in the Northern Harbour District. It is a major residential and commercial area and a centre for shopping, bars, dining, and café life.

Q40888.name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
Q40888.about: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands is a union territory of India comprising 836 islands, of which only 31 are inhabited. The islands are grouped into two main clusters: the northern Andaman Islands and the southern Nicobar Islands, separated by the 150 km (93 mi)-wide Ten Degree Channel.
Q40888.img: Havelock Island, Mangrove tree on the beach, Andaman Islands.jpg

Q40921.name: Honiara
Q40921.desc: capital of Solomon Islands, on the tropical island Guadalcanal
Q40921.about: Honiara ( HON-nee-AH-rə) is the capital and largest city of Solomon Islands, situated on the northwestern coast of Guadalcanal. As of 2019, it had a population of 129,569 people.

Q17063.name: Mayotte
Q17063.desc: French overseas region and department located in the Indian Ocean
Q17063.about: Mayotte ( my-OT; French: Mayotte, [majɔt] ; Shimaore: Maore, IPA: [maˈore]; Kibushi: Maori, IPA: [maˈori]), officially the Department of Mayotte (French: Département de Mayotte), is an overseas department and region and single territorial collectivity of France. It is one of the overseas departments of France as well as one of the 18 regions of France, with the same status as the departments of Metropolitan France.

Q59133.name: Paphos District
Q59133.about: The Paphos District, or simply Paphos (also Pafos), is one of the six districts of Cyprus and it is situated in the western part of Cyprus. Its main town and capital is Paphos.

Q5784126.name: South West Community Development Council
Q5784126.about: The South West Community Development Council is one of five Community Development Councils (CDCs) set up across the Republic of Singapore to aid in local administration of governmental policies and schemes. They are funded in part by the government although they are free to engage in fund-raising activities.

Q878317.name: Rezina District
Q878317.about: Rezina is a district (Romanian: raion) in the east of Moldova, with the administrative center at Rezina. Rezina is situated on the western bank of the Nistru river.

Q915380.name: Moravica District
Q915380.about: The Moravica District (Serbian: Моравички округ, romanized: Moravički okrug, pronounced [mǒraʋitʃkiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It is located in the central and southwestern parts of Serbia.

Q917397.name: Ig Municipality
Q917397.about: The Municipality of Ig (pronounced [ˈiːk]; Slovene: Občina Ig) is a municipality in central Slovenia. Its seat is the settlement of Ig.

Q920353.name: Municipality of Sveti Jurij ob Ščavnici
Q920353.about: The Municipality of Sveti Jurij ob Ščavnici (pronounced [ˈsʋeːti ˈjuːɾii̯ ɔp ˈʃtʃaːu̯nitsi]; Slovene: Občina Sveti Jurij ob Ščavnici) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Sveti Jurij ob Ščavnici.
Q920353.wiki: Municipality of Sveti Jurij ob Ščavnici

Q921092.name: Municipality of Puconci
Q921092.about: The Municipality of Puconci (pronounced [ˈpuːtsɔntsi]; Slovene: Občina Puconci) is a municipality in the traditional region of Prekmurje in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Puconci.

Q925149.name: Municipality of Sveti Andraž v Slovenskih Goricah
Q925149.about: The Municipality of Sveti Andraž v Slovenskih Goricah (pronounced [ˈsʋeːti anˈdɾaːʃ ʍ slɔˈʋeːnskiɣ ɡɔˈɾiːtsax]; Slovene: Občina Sveti Andraž v Slovenskih goricah) is a small municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It lies in the Slovene Hills.
Q925149.wiki: Municipality of Sveti Andraž v Slovenskih Goricah

Q71140.name: León Province
Q71140.desc: province of Castile and León, Spain
Q71140.about:
The Province of León (UK: , US: ; Spanish: Provincia de León [leˈon]; Leonese: Provincia de Llión [ʎiˈoŋ]; Leonese: [leˈoŋ]) is a province of northwestern Spain, in the northern part of the Region of León, and in the northwestern part of the autonomous community of Castile and León.
It has a population of 448,030 in an area of 15,578.32 square kilometres (6,014.82 sq mi) across its 211 municipalities.

Q80036.name: Amasya Province
Q80036.about: Amasya Province (Turkish: Amasya ili) is a province of Turkey, situated on the Yeşil River in the Black Sea Region to the north of the country. Its area is 5,628 km2, and its population is 338,267 (2022).

Q81801.name: Álava
Q81801.about:
The Province of Álava (Spanish: [ˈalaβ̞a] ) or Araba (Basque pronunciation: [aˈɾaβ̞a]), officially Araba/Álava, is a province of Spain and a historical territory of the Basque Country, heir of the ancient Lordship of Álava, former medieval Catholic bishopric and now Latin titular see.
Its capital city, Vitoria-Gasteiz, is also the seat of the political main institutions of the Basque Autonomous Community.

Q334841.name: Nakhon Pathom
Q334841.about: Nakhon Pathom (Thai: จังหวัดนครปฐม, pronounced [náʔkʰɔ̄ːn pā.tʰǒm], (Pronunciation)) is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Suphan Buri, Ayutthaya, Nonthaburi, Bangkok, Samut Sakhon, Ratchaburi, and Kanchanaburi.

Q336122.name: Lopburi
Q336122.about: Lopburi (Thai: ลพบุรี, RTGS: Lop Buri, pronounced [lóp bū.rīː]) is a province in the central region of Thailand. The province is divided into 11 administrative districts, and Mueang Lopburi district is the capital.

Q337627.name: Saraburi
Q337627.about: Saraburi (Thai: สระบุรี) is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Lopburi, Nakhon Ratchasima, Nakhon Nayok, Pathum Thani, and Ayutthaya.

Q338743.name: Municipality of Radenci
Q338743.about: The Municipality of Radenci (pronounced [ˈɾaːdɛntsi]; Slovene: Občina Radenci) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. It gets its name from the largest settlement and administrative seat of the municipality, Radenci.

Q370390.name: Municipality of Vuzenica
Q370390.about: The Municipality of Vuzenica (pronounced [ʋuzɛˈniːtsa]; Slovene: Občina Vuzenica) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. Vuzenica became a municipality in 1994.

Q82089.name: Bolu Province
Q82089.about: Bolu Province (Turkish: Bolu ili) is a province in north-western Turkey, between the capital, Ankara, and the largest city in the country, Istanbul. Its area is 8,313 square kilometres (3,210 sq mi), and its population is 320,824 (2022).

Q82357.name: Nantou County
Q82357.about: Nantou is the second largest county of Taiwan by area. Located in the central part of the island, and containing its geographic center, it is the only landlocked county in Taiwan.

Q103672.name: Jönköping County
Q103672.about: Jönköping County (Swedish: Jönköpings län, pronounced [ˈjœnːˌɕøːpɪŋs lɛːn]) is a county or län in southern Sweden. It borders the counties of Halland, Västra Götaland, Östergötland, Kalmar and Kronoberg.

Q104257.name: Örebro County
Q104257.about: Örebro County (Swedish: Örebro län, pronounced [œrɛˈbruː ˈlɛːn]) is a county or län in central Sweden. It borders the counties of Västra Götaland, Värmland, Dalarna, Västmanland, Södermanland and Östergötland.
Q104257.img: Örebro slott seen from northwest in the evening.jpg

Q1227.name: Nevada
Q1227.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1227.about: Nevada ( , nə-VAD-ə; Spanish: [ne.ˈβa.ða] ) is a landlocked state in the Western United States. It is also sometimes placed in the Mountain West and Southwestern United States.

Q829.name: Utah
Q829.desc: state of the United States of America
Q829.about: Utah is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the  Western United States. It is one of the Four Corners states, sharing a border with Arizona, Colorado, and New Mexico.

Q1021.name: Kranj
Q1021.about: Kranj (pronounced [ˈkɾàːn] , German: Krainburg) is the fourth-largest city in Slovenia and the largest urban center of the traditional region of Upper Carniola (northwestern Slovenia) and the Slovene Alps. It is located approximately 20 kilometres (12 miles) northwest of the national capital Ljubljana, acting as the seat of the City Municipality of Kranj.

Q938443.name: Municipality of Polzela
Q938443.about: The Municipality of Polzela (pronounced [ˈpoːu̯zɛla]; Slovene: Občina Polzela) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Polzela.

Q946766.name: Municipality of Lukovica
Q946766.about: The Municipality of Lukovica (pronounced [ˈluːkɔʋitsa]; Slovene: Občina Lukovica) is a municipality in the eastern part of the Upper Carniola region in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is Lukovica pri Domžalah.

Q954987.name: Municipality of Nazarje
Q954987.about: The Municipality of Nazarje (pronounced [ˈnaːzaɾjɛ]; Slovene: Občina Nazarje) is a municipality in Slovenia. It lies along the Dreta River.

Q963986.name: Komenda Municipality
Q963986.about: The Municipality of Komenda (pronounced [kɔˈmɛːnda]; Slovene: Občina Komenda) is a municipality in the Upper Carniola region of Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the village of Komenda.

Q975076.name: Ngeremlengui
Q975076.about: Ngeremlengui (also spelled Ngaremlengui) is one of Palau's sixteen states. It has a population of 349 (according to the 2020 census), and is just west of the capital in Melekeok state.

Q990063.name: Sveta Ana Municipality
Q990063.about: The Municipality of Sveta Ana (pronounced [ˈsʋeːta ˈaːna]; Slovene: Občina Sveta Ana) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It has just over 2,000 inhabitants.

Q995048.name: Municipality of Pesnica
Q995048.about: The Municipality of Pesnica (Slovene: Občina Pesnica) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is Pesnica pri Mariboru, a suburb near Maribor.

Q375630.name: Muharraq Governorate
Q375630.about: The Muharraq Governorate (Arabic: محافظة المحرق, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat al-Muḥarraq) is one of the four governorates of Bahrain. It is now co-extensive with the municipality of Al Muharraq and with Muharraq Island together with outlying islets.

Q380752.name: Udon Thani
Q380752.about: Udon Thani province (Thai/Northeastern Thai: อุดรธานี, Thai pronunciation: [ʔù.dɔ̄ːn tʰāː.nīː], Lao pronunciation: [ʔú.dɔ̀ːn tʰáː.níː]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) which lies in upper northeastern Thailand, also called Isan. It is bordered by the provinces of Nong Khai to the north, Sakon Nakhon to the east, Kalasin province to the southeast, Khon Kaen to the south, and Loei and Nong Bua Lamphu to the west.

Q380764.name: Sukhothai
Q380764.about: Sukhothai (Thai: สุโขทัย, pronounced [sù.kʰǒː.tʰāj]) is a province in lower northern Thailand. Neighboring provinces are Phrae, Uttaradit, Phitsanulok, Kamphaeng Phet, Tak, and Lampang.
Q380764.img: Lake in historical park of Sukhothai.jpg

Q382125.name: Sakon Nakhon
Q382125.about: Sakon Nakhon (Thai: สกลนคร, pronounced [sā.kōn ná(ʔ).kʰɔ̄ːn]; Northeastern Thai: สกลนคร, pronounced [sā.kōn nà(ʔ).kʰɔ̂ːn]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat). It lies in upper Northeastern Thailand.
Q382125.img: หนองหาน สกลนคร - panoramio (1).jpg

Q382144.name: Kalasin
Q382144.about: Kalasin (Thai: กาฬสินธุ์, pronounced [kāː.lā.sǐn]; Northeastern Thai: กาฬสินธุ์, pronounced [kàː.lā.sǐn]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat), located in upper northeastern Thailand, also called Isan. The province was established by the Act Establishing Changwat Kalasin, BE 2490 (1947), and it came into existence on 1 October 1947.
Q382144.img: Phu Phan Mountains - view from Wat Tham Kham.jpg

Q161808.name: Cherkasy Oblast
Q161808.about: Cherkasy Oblast, also referred to as Cherkashchyna, is an oblast (province) in central Ukraine located along the Dnieper River. The administrative center of the oblast is the city of Cherkasy.

Q164123.name: Municipality of Bloke
Q164123.about: The Municipality of Bloke (pronounced [ˈblòːkɛ, ˈblóːkɛ]; Slovene: Občina Bloke) is a municipality in Slovenia. Originally a municipality in its own right, it was incorporated into the Municipality of Cerknica in 1955 and it was included in the Municipality of Loška Dolina in 1994, when it split from Cerknica.

Q168949.name: Semnan Province
Q168949.about: Semnan province (Persian: استان سمنان) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. It is in the north of the country.
Q168949.img: Alborz in Semnan Province of Iran.jpg

Q1261.name: Colorado
Q1261.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1261.about: Colorado is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It is part of the Southwestern United States, sharing the Four Corners region with Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah.

Q169501.name: Poltava Oblast
Q169501.about: Poltava Oblast (Ukrainian: Полтавська область, romanized: Poltavska oblast), also referred to as Poltavshchyna (Ukrainian: Полтавщина), is an oblast (province) of central Ukraine. The administrative center of the oblast is the city of Poltava.

Q170672.name: Dnipropetrovsk Oblast
Q170672.about: Dnipropetrovsk Oblast (Ukrainian: Дніпропетровська область, romanized: Dnipropetrovska oblast), also commonly known as Dnipropetrovshchyna (Ukrainian: Дніпропетровщина), is an oblast (province) in southeastern Ukraine, the most important industrial region of the country. It was created on 27 February 1932.

Q104746.name: Kronoberg County
Q104746.about: Kronoberg County (Swedish: Kronobergs län, pronounced [ˈkrûːnʊˌbærjs ˌlɛːn]; is a county or län in southern Sweden. Kronoberg is one of three counties in the province of Småland.

Q105075.name: Västmanland County
Q105075.about: Västmanland County (Swedish: Västmanlands län, pronounced [ˈvɛ̂stmanlands ˈlɛːn]) is a county or län in central Sweden. It borders the counties of Södermanland, Örebro, Gävleborg, Dalarna and Uppsala.

Q115046.name: Granma Province
Q115046.about: Granma is one of the provinces of Cuba. Its capital is Bayamo.

Q115310.name: Mayabeque Province
Q115310.about: Mayabeque Province is one of two new provinces created from the former La Habana Province, whose creation was approved by the Cuban National Assembly on August 1, 2010, the other being Artemisa Province. The new provinces came in to existence on January 1, 2011.
Q115310.img: Catholic Church in San José de las Lajas.jpg

Q115325.name: Artemisa Province
Q115325.about: Artemisa Province is one of the two new provinces created from the former La Habana Province, whose creation was approved by the Cuban National Assembly on August 1, 2010, the other being Mayabeque Province. The new provinces came into existence on January 1, 2011.

Q1016698.name: Municipality of Prebold
Q1016698.about: The Municipality of Prebold (pronounced [ˈpɾeːbɔlt]; Slovene: Občina Prebold) is a small municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is Prebold.

Q1016805.name: Mirna Peč Municipality
Q1016805.about: The Municipality of Mirna Peč (pronounced [ˈmiːɾna ˈpeːtʃ]; Slovene: Občina Mirna Peč) is a municipality in southeast Slovenia, located in the traditional region of Lower Carniola. The seat of the municipality, which was established in 1998, is Mirna Peč.

Q1016826.name: Municipality of Starše
Q1016826.about: The Municipality of Starše (pronounced [ˈstaːɾʃɛ]; Slovene: Občina Starše) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Starše.

Q1016840.name: Municipality of Dolenjske Toplice
Q1016840.about: The Municipality of Dolenjske Toplice (Slovene: Občina Dolenjske Toplice; pronounced [ˈóːptʃina dɔˈleːnskɛ tɔˈpliːtsɛ]) is a municipality near Novo Mesto in southeastern Slovenia. Its seat is the town of Dolenjske Toplice.

Q1019067.name: Municipality of Grad
Q1019067.about: The Municipality of Grad (pronounced [ˈɡɾaːt]; Slovene: Občina Grad) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the village of Grad.

Q1034410.name: Municipality of Braslovče
Q1034410.about: The Municipality of Braslovče (pronounced [ˈbɾaːslɔu̯tʃɛ]; Slovene: Občina Braslovče) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Braslovče.

Q1048139.name: Kolubara District
Q1048139.about: The Kolubara District (Serbian: Колубарски округ, romanized: Kolubarski okrug, pronounced [kɔlǔbarskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It occupies the central part of western Serbia.

Q612098.name: Haʻapai
Q612098.about: Haʻapai is a group of islands, islets, reefs, and shoals in the central part of Tonga. It has a combined land area of 109.30 square kilometres (42.20 sq mi).
Q612098.img: Ha'apai Islands near Tonga, South Pacific - panoramio (2).jpg

Q625463.name: Roi Et
Q625463.about: Roi Et (Thai: ร้อยเอ็ด, pronounced [rɔ́ːj ʔèt]; Northeastern Thai: ร้อยเอ็ด, pronounced [lɔ᷆ːj ʔět]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) lies in central northeastern Thailand also called Isan. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Kalasin, Mukdahan, Yasothon, Sisaket, Surin, and Maha Sarakham.

Q647572.name: Municipality of Bled
Q647572.about: The Municipality of Bled (pronounced [ˈbleːt]; Slovene: Občina Bled) is a municipality in northwestern Slovenia in the Upper Carniola region. The seat of the municipality is the town of Bled, located on the shores of Lake Bled.

Q650617.name: Shefa
Q650617.about:
Shefa is one of the six provinces of Vanuatu, located in the center of the country and including the islands of Epi and Efate and the Shepherd Islands.
The province's name is derived from the initial letters of SHepherd and EFAte.

Q657004.name: Canterbury Region
Q657004.desc: region of New Zealand's South Island
Q657004.about: Canterbury (Māori: Waitaha) is a region of New Zealand, located in the central-eastern South Island. The region covers an area of 44,503.88 square kilometres (17,183.04 sq mi), making it the largest region in the country by area.

Q1184.name: Jharkhand
Q1184.about: Jharkhand (Hindi: Jhārkhaṇḍ, pronounced [d͡ʒʱaːɾkʰəɳɖ] ; lit. 'the land of forests') is a landlocked state in eastern India. The state shares borders with the states of West Bengal to the east, Chhattisgarh to the west, Uttar Pradesh to the northwest, Bihar to the north and Odisha to the south.

Q1188.name: Madhya Pradesh
Q1188.about: Madhya Pradesh (; Hindi: [ˈmədʱjə pɾəˈdeːʃ] ; lit. 'Central Province') is a state in central India. Its capital is Bhopal.

Q1553.name: Nebraska
Q1553.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1553.about: Nebraska (  nə-BRASK-ə) is a landlocked state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders South Dakota to the north; Wyoming to the west; Colorado to the southwest; Kansas to the south; and Missouri to the southeast and Iowa to the east, both across the Missouri River.
Q1553.img: Scotts Bluff Summit at Scottsbluff National Monument Nebraska (54270764782).jpg

Q995101.name: Municipality of Velika Polana
Q995101.about: The Municipality of Velika Polana (pronounced [ˈʋeːlika ˈpoːlana]; Slovene: Občina Velika Polana) is a municipality in the traditional region of Prekmurje in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Velika Polana.

Q998557.name: Municipality of Dol pri Ljubljani
Q998557.about: The Municipality of Dol pri Ljubljani (pronounced [ˈdoːl pɾi ljuˈbljaːni]; Slovene: Občina Dol pri Ljubljani) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the settlement of Dol pri Ljubljani.

Q999559.name: Municipality of Trnovska Vas
Q999559.about: The Municipality of Trnovska Vas (pronounced [ˈtəɾnɔu̯ska ˈʋaːs]; Slovene: Občina Trnovska vas) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the settlement of Trnovska Vas.

Q999563.name: Municipality of Križevci
Q999563.about: The Municipality of Križevci (pronounced [ˈkɾiːʒɛu̯tsi]; Slovene: Občina Križevci) is a municipality in the Prlekija region in eastern Slovenia. It gets its name from the largest settlement and administrative seat of the municipality, Križevci pri Ljutomeru.

Q999579.name: Municipality of Dobrna
Q999579.about: The Municipality of Dobrna (pronounced [ˈdoːbəɾna]; Slovene: Občina Dobrna) is a municipality in Slovenia. It is best known for the spa town of Dobrna, which is also the seat of the municipality.

Q999589.name: Municipality of Duplek
Q999589.about: The Municipality of Duplek (pronounced [ˈduːplɛk]; Slovene: Občina Duplek) is a small municipality in northeastern Slovenia. Its seat is Spodnji Duplek.

Q1563.name: Havana
Q1563.desc: capital and largest city of Cuba
Q1563.about: Havana (, US also ; Spanish: La Habana [la‿aˈβana] ) is the capital and largest city of Cuba. The heart of La Habana Province, Havana is the country's main port and commercial center.

Q666142.name: Tasman District
Q666142.desc: region in the northwest of New Zealand's South Island
Q666142.about: Tasman District (Māori: Te Tai o Aorere) is a local government district in the northwest of the South Island of New Zealand. It borders the Canterbury Region, West Coast Region, Marlborough District and Nelson City.

Q668171.name: Ermera Municipality
Q668171.about: Ermera (Portuguese: Município Ermera, Tetun: Munisípiu Ermera) is one of the municipalities (formerly districts) of Timor-Leste, located in the west-central part of the country. It has a population of 117,064 (Census 2010) and an area of 756.5 km2.

Q669648.name: Municipality of Luče
Q669648.about: The Municipality of Luče (pronounced [ˈluːtʃɛ], Slovene: Občina Luče) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. It gets its name from the largest settlement and administrative seat of the municipality, Luče.
Q669648.img: Luče Village and Savinja River Savinja and Šalek Valley Slovenia.JPG

Q670975.name: Municipality of Mozirje
Q670975.about: The Municipality of Mozirje (pronounced [mɔˈziːɾjɛ]; Slovene: Občina Mozirje) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Mozirje.

Q692912.name: Otago Region
Q692912.desc: region in the southeast of New Zealand's South Island
Q692912.about: Otago is a region of New Zealand located in the southern half of the South Island and administered by the Otago Regional Council. It has an area of approximately 32,000 square kilometres (12,000 sq mi), making it the country's second largest local government region.
Q692912.img: Mount Aspiring, Otago, New Zealand, 22 July 2005.jpg

Q722501.name: Chiradzulu District
Q722501.about: Chiradzulu is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Chiradzulu.

Q726548.name: Municipality of Gornji Grad
Q726548.about: The Municipality of Gornji Grad (pronounced [ˈɡoːɾnji ˈɡɾaːt] ; Slovene: Občina Gornji Grad) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Gornji Grad.

Q1053789.name: Central Division
Q1053789.about: The Central Division (Fiji Hindi: केंद्रीय प्रभाग) is one of Fiji's four divisions.  It consists of five provinces - Naitasiri, Namosi, Rewa, Serua and Tailevu.

Q1059262.name: Blantyre District
Q1059262.about: Blantyre is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Blantyre, a commercial city where most Malawian industrial and business offices are.

Q1061076.name: Nišava District
Q1061076.about: The Nišava District (Serbian: Нишавски округ, romanized: Nišavski okrug, pronounced [nîʃaʋskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It lies in the southeastern parts of Serbia.

Q1062430.name: Northern Division
Q1062430.about: The Northern Division is one of four Divisions into which Fiji's fourteen Provinces are grouped for local government purposes. The administrative centre of the Division, where main governmental departments are located, is Labasa.

Q1062451.name: Western Division
Q1062451.about: The Western Division is one of Fiji's four divisions. It consists of three provinces in western and northern Viti Levu, namely Ba Province, Nadroga-Navosa Province, and Ra Province.

Q1070180.name: Ngchesar
Q1070180.about: Ngchesar, also known as Oldiais, is one of the sixteen states of the nation of Palau in Oceania.

Q1070185.name: Ngarchelong
Q1070185.about: Ngarchelong is a state in Palau, and the northernmost state on the island of Babeldaob, being at the northernmost tip of the island. Only the state of Kayangel is farther north.

Q388274.name: Ibb Governorate
Q388274.about: Ibb (Arabic: إِبّ ʾIbb) is a governorate of Yemen. It is located in the inland south of the country with Ta'izz Governorate to the southwest, Ad Dali' Governorate to the southeast, Dhamar Governorate to the north, and short borders with Al Bayda' Governorate to the east and Al Hudaydah Governorate to the west.

Q388280.name: Al Mahwit Governorate
Q388280.about: Al Mahwit (Arabic: ٱلْمَحْوِيْت Al-Maḥwīt) is one of the governorates of Yemen.

Q391800.name: Municipality of Škocjan
Q391800.about: The Municipality of Škocjan (pronounced [ˈʃkɔːtsjan]; Slovene: Občina Škocjan), established in October 1994, is a municipality in the traditional region of Lower Carniola in southeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is Škocjan.

Q392103.name: Municipality of Škofljica
Q392103.about: The Municipality of Škofljica (pronounced [ˈʃkoːfljitsa]; Slovene: Občina Škofljica) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Škofljica.

Q392173.name: Municipality of Šmarje pri Jelšah
Q392173.about: The Municipality of Šmarje pri Jelšah (pronounced [ˈʃmaːɾjɛ pɾi ˈjeːlʃax]; Slovene: Občina Šmarje pri Jelšah) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Šmarje pri Jelšah.

Q392188.name: Municipality of Šmartno ob Paki
Q392188.about: The Municipality of Šmartno ob Paki (pronounced [ˈʃmaːɾtnɔ ɔp ˈpaːki]; Slovene: Občina Šmartno ob Paki) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Šmartno ob Paki.

Q392192.name: Šmartno pri Litiji
Q392192.about: Šmartno pri Litiji (pronounced [ˈʃmaːɾtnɔ pɾi liˈtiːji]; German: Sankt Martin) is a town in the Litija Basin in central Slovenia. It is part of the traditional region of Lower Carniola and is now included in the Central Slovenia Statistical Region.

Q726917.name: Auckland Region
Q726917.desc: region of New Zealand's North Island
Q726917.about: Auckland (Māori: Tāmaki Makaurau) is one of the 16 regions of New Zealand, which takes its name from the eponymous urban area. The region encompasses the Auckland metropolitan area, smaller towns, rural areas, and the islands of the Hauraki Gulf.

Q731093.name: Municipality of Rače–Fram
Q731093.about: The Municipality of Rače–Fram (pronounced [ˈɾaːtʃɛ ˈfɾaːm]; Slovene: Občina Rače - Fram) is a municipality south of Maribor in northeastern Slovenia. Its administrative seat is the settlement of Rače.

Q740640.name: Sanma
Q740640.about: Sanma is a province located in the Northern part of the nation of Vanuatu, occupying the nation's largest island, Espiritu Santo. The province spans an area of 4,248 square kilometres (1,640 sq mi) and has its capital in Luganville, Vanuatu's second-largest city.

Q740656.name: Malampa
Q740656.about:
Malampa is one of the six provinces of Vanuatu, located in the center of the country. It consists of three main islands:

Malakula
Ambrym
Paama
Malampa takes its name from the first syllable of their names, being MALakula, AMbrym, and PAama.

Q769224.name: Anenii Noi District
Q769224.about: Anenii Noi District (Romanian: Raionul Anenii Noi, pronunciation: [aˈnenij ˈnoj])  is a district (raion) in the central part of Moldova. As of 2024, its population was 57,687.

Q773659.name: Municipality of Ljubno
Q773659.about: The Municipality of Ljubno (pronounced [ˈljuːbnɔ]; Slovene: Občina Ljubno) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Ljubno ob Savinji.

Q776770.name: Municipality of Kidričevo
Q776770.about: The Municipality of Kidričevo (pronounced [ˈkiːdɾitʃɛʋɔ]; Slovene: Občina Kidričevo) is a municipality near Ptuj in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Kidričevo.

Q498465.name: Marib Governorate
Q498465.about: Marib (Arabic: مَأْرِب, romanized: Maʾrib) is a governorate of Yemen. It is located 173 kilometers to the northeast of Yemen's capital, Sanaa.

Q506598.name: Yasothon
Q506598.about: Yasothon province (Thai: ยโสธร, pronounced [já.sǒː.tʰɔ̄ːn], one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat), lies in central northeastern Thailand also called Isan. The province was established by the revolutionary council of Field Marshal Thanom Kittikachorn, after its Announcement No.
Q506598.img: พุทธอุทยานภูสูง.jpg

Q510040.name: Vransko
Q510040.about: Vransko (pronounced [ˈwɾaːnskɔ]; German: Franz) is a small town in central Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Vransko.

Q528953.name: Capital Governorate
Q528953.about: The Capital Governorate (Arabic: محافظة العاصمة, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat al-ʿĀṣimah) is one of the four governorates of Bahrain. The governorate includes Manama, the capital of Bahrain.

Q530813.name: Angaur
Q530813.about: Angaur (Japanese: アンガウル, Hepburn: Angauru), or Ngeaur in Palauan, is an island and state in the island nation of Palau.

Q539864.name: Municipality of Preddvor
Q539864.about: The Municipality of Preddvor (pronounced [pɾɛˈdʋɔɾ]; Slovene: Občina Preddvor) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Preddvor.

Q541468.name: West Coast Region
Q541468.desc: region of New Zealand's South Island
Q541468.about: The West Coast (Māori: Te Tai Poutini, lit. 'The Coast of Poutini, the Taniwha') is a region of New Zealand on the west coast of the South Island. It is administered by the West Coast Regional Council, and is known co-officially as Te Tai Poutini.

Q544118.name: Šumadija District
Q544118.about: The Šumadija District (Serbian: Шумадијски округ, romanized: Šumadijski okrug, pronounced [ʃumǎdijskiː ôkruːɡ]) is one of administrative districts of Serbia. It is located in the geographical region of Šumadija.

Q557216.name: Municipality of Divača
Q557216.about: The Municipality of Divača (pronounced [diˈʋaːtʃa]; Slovene: Občina Divača) is a municipality in the Littoral region of Slovenia, near the Italian border. The seat of the municipality is the town of Divača.

Q570618.name: Municipality of Destrnik
Q570618.about: The Municipality of Destrnik (pronounced [ˈdeːstəɾnik]; Slovene: Občina Destrnik) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the settlement of Destrnik.
Q570618.img: Janežovski Vrh in Destrnik - cerkev sv. Urbana.jpg

Q576417.name: Tafea
Q576417.about: Tafea is the southernmost of the six provinces of Vanuatu. The name is an acronym for the five main islands that make up the province: Tanna, Aneityum, Futuna, Erromango and Aniwa.

Q599448.name: Chimbu Province
Q599448.about: Chimbu, also spelled Simbu, is a province in the Highlands Region of Papua New Guinea. The province has an area of 6,112 km2 and a population of 376,473 (2011 census).

Q483195.name: Tokat Province
Q483195.about: Tokat Province (Turkish: Tokat ili) is a province in northern Turkey. Its area is 10,042 km2, and its population is 596,454 (2022).

Q491096.name: Lakes
Q491096.about: Lakes is a state in South Sudan. It has an area of 43,595.08 km2.
Q491096.img: Cattle Herders at Cattle Camp in Rumbek, South Sudan.jpg

Q491138.name: Warrap
Q491138.about: Warrap is a state in South Sudan. Warrap is located in the Bahr el Ghazal region of northwestern South Sudan.

Q492791.name: Capital District
Q492791.desc: federal district of Venezuela, containing the national capital city, Caracas
Q492791.about: The Capital District (Spanish: Distrito Capital) is a federal district of Venezuela. It has an area of 433 km2 (167 sq mi) and there is only one administrative division (municipio), Libertador, which contains about half of Caracas, the Venezuelan capital city, which is also the seat of the three branches of the federal government of Venezuela.

Q497981.name: Peleliu
Q497981.about: Peleliu (or Beliliou) is an island in the island nation of Palau. Peleliu, along with two small islands to its northeast, forms one of the sixteen states of Palau.

Q392468.name: Municipality of Štore
Q392468.about: The Municipality of Štore (pronounced [ˈʃtoːɾɛ]; Slovene: Občina Štore) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Štore.

Q394087.name: Municipality of Žiri
Q394087.about: The Municipality of Žiri (pronounced [ʒiˈɾiː]  or [ˈʒiːɾi]; Slovene: Občina Žiri) is a municipality in northwestern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Žiri.

Q394340.name: Žužemberk
Q394340.about: Žužemberk (pronounced [ˈʒuːʒɛmbɛɾk]; German: Seisenberg), is a town located southeast of the Slovenian capital of Ljubljana. It is the seat of the Municipality of Žužemberk.

Q399063.name: Choiseul Province
Q399063.about: Choiseul Province is one of the nine provinces of Solomon Islands. It lies southeast of Bougainville (part of Papua New Guinea), west of Santa Isabel Island, and north of Vella Lavella, Kolombangara & New Georgia.

Q405100.name: Aileu municipality
Q405100.about: Aileu (Portuguese: Município Aileu, Tetun: Munisípiu Aileu) is a municipality, and was formerly a district, of Timor-Leste. It has a population of 48,554 (Census 2015) and an area of 737 km2.

Q405589.name: Aimeliik
Q405589.about: Aimeliik is an administrative division of the island country of Palau.  It is one of the Republic of Palau's 16 states.

Q407967.name: Airai
Q407967.about: Airai, located on the southern coast of Babeldaob island, is the second-most populous state of Palau, and the most populous on Babeldaob. It contains the country's chief airport, Roman Tmetuchl International Airport, and is connected by the Koror–Babeldaob Bridge to nearby Koror Island.

Q185309.name: Buzău County
Q185309.about: Buzău County (Romanian pronunciation: [buˈzəw] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in the historical region Muntenia, with the capital city at Buzău.

Q186838.name: Vâlcea County
Q186838.about: Vâlcea County (also spelt Vîlcea; Romanian pronunciation: [ˈvɨlt͡ʃe̯a]) is a county (județ) that lies in south-central Romania. Located in the historical regions of Oltenia and Muntenia (which are separated by the Olt River), it is also part of the wider Wallachia region.

Q188661.name: Neamț County
Q188661.about: Neamț County (Romanian pronunciation: [ne̯amt͡s] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in the historic region of Western Moldavia, with the county seat at Piatra Neamț. The county takes its name from the Neamț River.

Q188665.name: Prahova County
Q188665.about: Prahova County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈprahova]) is a county (județ) of Romania, in the historical region Muntenia, with the capital city at Ploiești.

Q188797.name: Dâmbovița County
Q188797.about: Dâmbovița County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈdɨmbovitsa] ; also spelt Dîmbovița) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Muntenia, with the capital city at Târgoviște, the most important economic, political, administrative, and cultural center of the county. It is a traditional administrative unit, first attested in 1512.

Q188959.name: Covasna County
Q188959.about: Covasna County (Romanian pronunciation: [koˈvasna] , Hungarian: Kovászna megye, Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈkovaːsnɒ]) is a county (județ) of Romania, in eastern Transylvania, with the county seat at Sfântu Gheorghe.

Q189426.name: Koror
Q189426.about: Koror is the state comprising the main commercial centre of the Republic of Palau. It consists of several islands, the most prominent being Koror Island (also Oreor Island).

Q190406.name: Gorj County
Q190406.about: Gorj County (Romanian pronunciation: [ɡorʒ] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Oltenia, with its capital city at Târgu Jiu. Gorj comes from the Slavic Gornji Jiu ("upper Jiu"), in contrast with Dolnji ("lower Jiu").

Q190690.name: Sălaj County
Q190690.about: Sălaj County (Romanian pronunciation: [səˈlaʒ]; Hungarian: Szilágy megye) (also known as Land of Silvania, silva, -ae meaning "forest") is a county (județ) of Romania, located in the north-west of the country, in the historical regions of Crișana and Transylvania. It is bordered to the north by Satu Mare and Maramureș counties, to the west and south-west by Bihor County, and to the south-east by Cluj County.

Q115334.name: Las Tunas Province
Q115334.about: Las Tunas is one of the provinces of Cuba. Major towns include Puerto Padre, Amancio, and the capital city, Las Tunas (historically Victoria de Las Tunas).

Q115444.name: Cienfuegos Province
Q115444.about: Cienfuegos (Spanish pronunciation: [sjeɱˈfweɣos]) is one of the provinces of Cuba. The capital city of the province is also called Cienfuegos and was founded by French settlers in 1819.

Q115497.name: Pinar del Río Province
Q115497.about: The Pinar del Río Province is one of the 15 provinces of Cuba.  It is at the western end of the island of Cuba.

Q133083.name: Gauteng
Q133083.about:
Gauteng ( khow-TENG, Sotho: [xɑ́.úˈtʼèŋ̀]; Sotho-Tswana for 'place of gold'; Zulu: eGoli or iGoli [îːˈɡóːlì]) is one of the nine provinces of South Africa.
Situated on the Highveld, Gauteng is the smallest province by land area in South Africa.

Q1002229.name: Municipality of Vipava
Q1002229.about: The Municipality of Vipava (pronounced [ʋiˈpaːʋa]; Slovene: Občina Vipava) is a municipality in western Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Vipava.

Q1002371.name: Municipality of Majšperk
Q1002371.about: The Municipality of Majšperk (Slovene: Občina Majšperk; pronounced [ˈóːptʃina ˈmaːi̯ʃpɛɾk]) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is Majšperk.

Q1003969.name: Municipality of Dornava
Q1003969.about: The Municipality of Dornava (pronounced [ˈdoːɾnaʋa]; Slovene: Občina Dornava) is a small municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It lies east of Ptuj, partly on the Pesnica River and partly in the Slovene Hills (Slovene: Slovenske gorice).

Q1003984.name: Municipality of Juršinci
Q1003984.about: The Municipality of Juršinci (pronounced [ˈjuːɾʃintsi]; Slovene: Občina Juršinci) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Juršinci.

Q1005165.name: Municipality of Miklavž na Dravskem Polju
Q1005165.about: The Municipality of Miklavž na Dravskem Polju (Slovene: Občina Miklavž na Dravskem polju) is a small municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It lies on the right bank of the Drava River southeast of Maribor.
Q1005165.wiki: Municipality of Miklavž na Dravskem Polju

Q1005185.name: Municipality of Horjul
Q1005185.about: The Municipality of Horjul (pronounced [xɔˈɾjuːl]; Slovene: Občina Horjul) is a municipality in the Inner Carniola region of Slovenia. Its administrative center is the town of Horjul.

Q139907.name: Manawatū-Whanganui Region
Q139907.desc: region in New Zealand's North Island
Q139907.about: Manawatū-Whanganui ([manawaˈtʉː ˈˀwaŋanʉi]; spelled Manawatu-Wanganui prior to 2019) is a region in the lower half of the North Island of New Zealand, whose main population centres are the cities of Palmerston North and Whanganui. It is administered by the Manawatū-Whanganui Regional Council, which operates under the name Horizons Regional Council.

Q139918.name: Waikato Region
Q139918.desc: region in North Island, New Zealand
Q139918.about: The Waikato (, Māori pronunciation: [ˈwaikato]) is a region of the upper North Island of New Zealand. It covers the Waikato District, Waipā District, Matamata-Piako District, South Waikato District and Hamilton City, as well as Hauraki, Coromandel Peninsula, the northern King Country, much of the Taupō District, and parts of the Rotorua Lakes District.

Q140083.name: Marlborough District
Q140083.desc: region and district in the north of New Zealand's South Island
Q140083.about: Marlborough District or the Marlborough Region (Māori: Te Tauihu-o-te-waka, or Tauihu), commonly known simply as Marlborough, is one of the 16 regions of New Zealand, located on the northeast of the South Island. It is administered by Marlborough District Council, a unitary authority, performing the functions of both a territorial authority and a regional council.

Q140207.name: Taranaki Region
Q140207.desc: region on the west coast of New Zealand's North Island
Q140207.about: Taranaki is a region in the west of New Zealand's North Island. It is named after its main geographical feature, the stratovolcano Mount Taranaki.

Q140246.name: Gisborne District
Q140246.desc: region on the east coast of New Zealand's North Island
Q140246.about: Gisborne District or the Gisborne Region (Māori: Te Tairāwhiti or Te Tai Rāwhiti) is a local government area of northeastern New Zealand. It is governed by Gisborne District Council, a unitary authority (with the combined powers of a district and regional council).

Q146726.name: Zanjan Province
Q146726.about: Zanjan province (Persian: استان زنجان) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Zanjan.

Q1581.name: Missouri
Q1581.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1581.about: Missouri (see pronunciation) is a landlocked state in the Midwestern region of the United States. Ranking 21st in land area, it borders Iowa to the north, Illinois, Kentucky and Tennessee to the east, Arkansas to the south and Oklahoma, Kansas, and Nebraska to the west.

Q1649.name: Oklahoma
Q1649.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1649.about: Oklahoma (  OH-klə-HOH-mə; Choctaw: Oklahumma, pronounced [oklahómma]), is a landlocked state in the South Central, Southern, and Southwestern regions of the United States. It borders Texas to the southwest, Kansas to the north, Missouri to the northeast, Arkansas to the southeast, New Mexico to the west, and Colorado to the northwest.
Q1649.img: Downtown Oklahoma City skyline at twilight.jpg

Q1105411.name: Al-Qassim
Q1105411.about: Al-Qassim Province, is a province in central Saudi Arabia, located at the heart of the country near the geographic center of the Arabian Peninsula. Its administrative seat is Buraydah, the largest city in the province.

Q1105893.name: Qazvin Province
Q1105893.about: Qazvin province (Persian: استان قزوین; IPA: [ɢæzˈviːn] ) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. It is in the northwest of the country, with the city of Qazvin as its capital.

Q1140891.name: Para District
Q1140891.about: Para is a district of northern Suriname. Para's capital city is Onverwacht, with other towns including Paranam, and Zanderij.

Q1144482.name: Tuamasaga
Q1144482.about: Tuamāsaga is a district of Samoa, with a population (2016 census) of 95,907. This makes it the most populous district in Samoa.

Q1144488.name: Aiga-i-le-Tai
Q1144488.about:
Aiga-i-le-Tai is a district of Samoa which includes the small islands of Manono, Apolima and tiny uninhabited Nu'ulopa lying in the Apolima Strait between the country's two main islands of Upolu and Savai'i.
The district includes part of the mainland at the western end of Upolu and surrounds an exclave of A'ana district, namely Satuimalufilufi village.

Q1144496.name: Ngardmau
Q1144496.about: Ngardmau is one of Palau's sixteen states and is located on the west side of Babeldaob between the states of Ngaraard and Ngeremlengui.

Q1154101.name: Ngiwal
Q1154101.about: Ngiwal is one of the sixteen states of Palau. It has a population of 282 (census 2015) and an area of 26 km2.

Q180981.name: Kirovohrad Oblast
Q180981.about: Kirovohrad Oblast (Ukrainian: Кіровоградська область, romanized: Kirovohradska oblast), also known as Kirovohradshchyna (Ukrainian: Кіровоградщина), is an oblast (province) in central Ukraine. The administrative center of the oblast is the city of Kropyvnytskyi.

Q181513.name: Bistrița-Năsăud County
Q181513.about: Bistrița-Năsăud (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈbistritsa nəsəˈud] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Transylvania, with its capital city at Bistrița.

Q1211.name: South Dakota
Q1211.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1211.about: South Dakota (  də-KOH-tə; Dakota: Dakȟóta itókaga, pronounced [daˈkˣota iˈtokaga]) is a landlocked state in the North Central region of the United States. It is also part of the Great Plains.

Q1214.name: Wyoming
Q1214.desc: state of the United States of America
