Q1214.about: Wyoming (  wy-OH-ming) is a landlocked state in the Mountain West subregion of the Western United States. It borders Montana to the north and northwest, South Dakota and Nebraska to the east, Idaho to the west, Utah to the southwest, and Colorado to the south.
Q1214.img: From Chittenden Road, Mt. Washburn, Yellowstone NP - panoramio - Aaron Zhu.jpg

Q1569014.name: Municipality of Naklo
Q1569014.about: The Municipality of Naklo (pronounced [ˈnaːklɔ]; Slovene: Občina Naklo) is one of the municipalities in northwestern Slovenia. Its seat is Naklo.

Q1587261.name: Municipality of Oplotnica
Q1587261.about: The Municipality of Oplotnica (pronounced [ɔˈploːtnitsa]; Slovene: Občina Oplotnica) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Oplotnica.

Q1587704.name: Municipality of Semič
Q1587704.about: The Municipality of Semič (pronounced [ˈseːmitʃ]; Slovene: Občina Semič) is a municipality in Slovenia in the traditional region of White Carniola in southeastern Slovenia. The municipality is included in the Southeast Slovenia Statistical Region.

Q1771681.name: Spanish Wells
Q1771681.about: Spanish Wells is a district of the Bahamas. The settlement consists of a medium-sized town on the island of St.

Q1774848.name: Valverde Province
Q1774848.about: Valverde (Spanish pronunciation: [balˈβeɾðe]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It was split from Santiago Province in 1959.

Q1809612.name: Vitanje
Q1809612.about: Vitanje (pronounced [ˈʋiːtanjɛ], formerly Vitanje trg, sometimes Vitanjski trg, German: (Markt) Weitenstein) is a small town in northeastern Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Vitanje.

Q778542.name: Municipality of Beltinci
Q778542.about: The Municipality of Beltinci (pronounced [ˈbeːltintsi]; Slovene: Občina Beltinci) is a municipality in the Prekmurje region of northeastern Slovenia. Its seat is the settlement of Beltinci.

Q779018.name: Municipality of Benedikt
Q779018.about: The Municipality of Benedikt (pronounced [bɛnɛˈdiːkt]; Slovene: Občina Benedikt) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. Its seat is the settlement of Benedikt.

Q798235.name: Ntchisi District
Q798235.about: Ntchisi is a district in the Central Region of Malawi. The district covers an area of 1,655 km.² and has a population of 317,069.

Q822514.name: Torba
Q822514.about:
Torba (or TorBa) is the northernmost and least populous province of Vanuatu.
It consists of the Banks Islands and the Torres Islands.

Q836649.name: Penama
Q836649.about: Penama is one of the six provinces of Vanuatu, located in the northeast of the country. It consists of three major islands:Ambae (or Aoba), Maewo, and Pentecost.

Q838532.name: Southern Governorate
Q838532.about: The Southern Governorate (Arabic: المحافظة الجنوبية, romanized: Al-Muḥāfaẓat al-Janūbīyah) has the largest area of the four governorates of Bahrain. It includes parts of Bahrain's old municipalities – Al Mintaqah al Gharbiyah, Ar Rifa' wa al Mintaqah al Janubiyah, and Juzur Hawar (the Hawar Islands).

Q840445.name: Northern Governorate
Q840445.about: The Northern Governorate (Arabic: المحافظة الشمالية, romanized: Al-Muḥāfaẓat aš-Šamālīyah) is one of the four governorates of Bahrain. It includes parts of the former municipalities of Al Mintaqah al Gharbiyah, Al Mintaqah al Wusta, Al Mintaqah al Shamaliyah, Jidd Haffs and Madinat Hamad.

Q847680.name: Brokopondo District
Q847680.about: Brokopondo (Eastern Maroon Creole: Bokopondo or Bookopondo) is a district of Suriname. Its capital city is Brokopondo; other towns include Brownsweg and Kwakoegron.

Q190702.name: Harghita County
Q190702.about: Harghita County (Romanian: Județul Harghita, Romanian pronunciation: [harˈɡita]  and Hungarian: Hargita megye, pronounced [ˈhɒrɡitɒ]) is a county (județ) in the center of Romania, in eastern Transylvania, with the county seat at Miercurea Ciuc.

Q190711.name: Mureș County
Q190711.about: Mureș County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈmureʃ], Romanian: Județul Mureș, Hungarian: Maros megye) is a county (județ) of Romania, in the historical region of Transylvania, with the administrative centre in Târgu Mureș. The county was established in 1968, after the administrative reorganization that re-introduced the historical județ (county) system, still used today.
Q190711.img: Biserica fortificată din Saschiz vazuta de la Cetatea Taraneasca 3.jpg

Q191071.name: Hunedoara County
Q191071.about: Hunedoara County (Romanian pronunciation: [huneˈdo̯ara] ) is a county (județ) of Romania. Hunedoara County is located in the Transylvania region with a few divisions in the north being located in the Crișana region.

Q191670.name: Ilfov County
Q191670.about: Ilfov County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈilfov]) is the county that surrounds Bucharest, the capital of Romania. It used to be largely rural, but, after the fall of communism, many of the county's villages and communes developed into high-income commuter towns, suburbs or satellites of Bucharest.

Q1154109.name: Va'a-o-Fonoti
Q1154109.about:
Vaʻa-o-Fonoti is a district on the north east coast of Upolu Island in Samoa, with a population (2016 Census) of 1,621, making it the least populated district in the country and the Second smallest one by area after Aiga-i-le-Tai.
The district is 38 km2 and consists of a main area around Fagaloa Bay with nine villages and a small coastal exclave about 10 km further northwest, with the village of Faleāpuna (pop.

Q1154121.name: A'ana
Q1154121.about: Aʻana is a district of Samoa. It is on the western third of Upolu island, with a small exclave (Satuimalufilufi village) surrounded by Aiga-i-le-Tai.

Q1154127.name: Ngaraard
Q1154127.about: Ngaraard is one of the 16 states of the Republic of Palau, and was originally named Kerradel.

Q1154332.name: Atua
Q1154332.about: Ātua is an ancient political district of Samoa, consisting of most of the eastern section of Upolu and the island Tutuila. Within Samoa's traditional polity, Ātua is ruled by the Tui Ātua together with the group of six senior orators of Lufilufi and 13 senior matai from throughout Ātua, comprising the Fale Ātua (or parliament of Atua).
Q1154332.img: Piula Theological College, Upolu island, Samoa, 2009.jpg

Q1194516.name: Northeast Vietnam
Q1194516.desc: region at the north of the Red River Delta, Vietnam
Q1194516.about: The Northeast (Vietnamese: Đông Bắc Bộ) is a geographic subregion of Vietnam, located north of the Red River Delta, west of the Northwest and south of Vietnam's border with China. The Northeast is one of the two sub-regions which make up the Northern Midland and Mountainous Regions of Northern Vietnam.

Q1200954.name: Niuas
Q1200954.about: Niua is a division of the Kingdom of Tonga, namely the northernmost group of islands. It consists of three islands (Niuafoʻou, Niuatoputapu and Tafahi) which together have an area of 71.69 km2 and a population of 1,150.

Q1249255.name: Riyadh Province
Q1249255.about: Riyadh Province is a province in central Saudi Arabia, covering much of the historic Najd region in the heart of the Arabian Peninsula. Its administrative seat is Riyadh, the capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia.

Q1252438.name: Municipality of Cerkvenjak
Q1252438.about: The Municipality of Cerkvenjak (pronounced [tsɛɾkʋɛˈnjaːk]; Slovene: Občina Cerkvenjak) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the settlement of Cerkvenjak.

Q1532634.name: Ragged Island
Q1532634.about: Ragged Island is a 23 km2 (8.9 mi2) island and district in the southern Bahamas. Ragged Island is part of the Jumentos Cays and Ragged Island Chain.

Q1353.name: Delhi
Q1353.desc: megacity and union territory of India
Q1353.about: Delhi, officially the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi, is a megacity and a union territory of India containing New Delhi, the capital of India. Straddling the Yamuna river, but spread chiefly to the west, or beyond its right bank, Delhi shares borders with the state of Uttar Pradesh in the east and with the state of Haryana in the remaining directions.

Q1546.name: Iowa
Q1546.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1546.about: Iowa (  EYE-ə-wə) is a landlocked state in the upper Midwestern region of the United States. It borders the Mississippi River to the east and the Missouri River and Big Sioux River to the west; Wisconsin to the northeast, Illinois to the east and southeast, Missouri to the south, Nebraska to the west, South Dakota to the northwest, and Minnesota to the north.

Q193250.name: Bulawayo
Q193250.about: Bulawayo (, ; Northern Ndebele: Bulawayo) is the second largest city in Zimbabwe, and the largest city in the country's Matabeleland region. The city's population is disputed; the 2022 census listed it at 665,940, while the Bulawayo City Council claimed it to be about 1.2 million.

Q195356.name: Dowa District
Q195356.about: Dowa is a district in the Central Region of Malawi. The capital is Dowa.

Q198525.name: Penghu County
Q198525.about: The Penghu ( PUNG-HOO, Hokkien POJ: Phîⁿ-ô͘  or Phêⁿ-ô͘ ) or Pescadores Islands are an archipelago of 90 islands and islets in the Taiwan Strait, about 50 kilometres (25 nautical miles) west of the main island of Taiwan across the Penghu Channel, covering an area of 141 km2 (54 sq mi). The archipelago collectively forms Penghu County.

Q201074.name: Municipality of Turnišče
Q201074.about: The Municipality of Turnišče (pronounced [ˈtuːɾniʃtʃɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Turnišče) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Turnišče.

Q202075.name: Guárico
Q202075.about: Guárico State (Spanish: Estado Guárico, IPA: [esˈtaðo ˈɣwaɾiko]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. Located in the central region of the country, in the Los Llanos region, it is bordered to the north by Carabobo, Aragua, and Miranda; to the east by Anzoátegui; to the south by Bolívar and Apure; and to the west by Barinas and Cojedes.

Q849320.name: Municipality of Brezovica
Q849320.about: The Municipality of Brezovica (Slovene: Občina Brezovica) is a municipality in central Slovenia, just south of its capital Ljubljana. It has approximately 9,300 inhabitants.

Q849801.name: Southern Highlands Province
Q849801.about: Southern Highlands is a province in Papua New Guinea. Its provincial capital is the town of Mendi.

Q849807.name: Western Highlands Province
Q849807.about: Western Highlands is a province of Papua New Guinea. The provincial capital is Mount Hagen.

Q849812.name: Eastern Highlands Province
Q849812.about: Eastern Highlands  is a highlands province of Papua New Guinea. The provincial capital is Goroka.

Q852774.name: Al-Baha Province
Q852774.about: Al-Baha Province, also known as Al-Baha Region (Arabic: ٱلْبَاحَة‎, romanized: al-Bāḥa, pronounced [alˈbaːħa], lit. 'open space'), also spelled as Al-Bahah, is a province in Saudi Arabia. It is the smallest Saudi province in terms of both area and population.

Q205460.name: Cojedes
Q205460.about: Cojedes State (Spanish: Estado Cojedes, IPA: [esˈtaðo koˈxeðes]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. Located in the Central Region of Venezuela, its capital is San Carlos.

Q205784.name: Portuguesa
Q205784.about: Portuguesa State (Spanish: Estado Portuguesa, IPA: [esˈtaðo poɾtuˈɣesa]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. Located in the west of the Republic, it is often considered the "breadbasket of Venezuela" for the large amount of agricultural products produced there.

Q205796.name: Lara
Q205796.about: Lara State (Spanish: Estado Lara, IPA: [esˈtaðo ˈlaɾa]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. Lara is located in the Central-Western Region, Venezuela.

Q460435.name: Lavalleja Department
Q460435.about: Lavalleja (Spanish pronunciation: [laβaˈʝexa]; locally [laβaˈʒexa, -ʃexa]) is a department of Uruguay. Its capital is Minas.

Q466212.name: Nakhon Nayok
Q466212.about:
Nakhon Nayok (Thai: นครนายก, pronounced [ná(ʔ).kʰɔ̄ːn nāː.jók]) is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand, established by the Act Establishing Changwat Samut Prakan, Changwat Nonthaburi, Changwat Samut Sakhon, and Changwat Nakhon Nayok, Buddhist Era 2489 (1946), which came into force on 9 May 1946.
Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Saraburi, Nakhon Ratchasima, Prachinburi, Chachoengsao, and Pathum Thani.
Q466212.img: Hin Tung, Mueang Nakhon Nayok District, Nakhon Nayok 26000, Thailand - panoramio (11).jpg

Q468554.name: Maha Sarakham
Q468554.about: Maha Sarakham province, also written Maha Sarakham or Mahasarakham (Thai: มหาสารคาม, pronounced [mā.hǎː sǎː.rā.kʰāːm]; Northeastern Thai: มหาสารคาม, pronounced [mā.hǎː sǎː.lāː.kʰâːm]), known locally and simply as Sarakham (Thai: สารคาม, pronounced [sǎː.rā.kʰāːm]; Northeastern Thai: สารคาม, pronounced [sǎː.lā.kʰâːm]), is one of the 76 provinces (changwat) of Thailand. It lies in central northeastern Thailand, also called Isan.

Q475033.name: Raymah Governorate
Q475033.about: Raymah (Arabic: ريمة Raymah) is a governorate of Yemen. Its capital is Al Jabin.

Q476222.name: Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya
Q476222.about: Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, or locally and simply  Ayutthaya (historically Iudea, Iudiad, Iudia, Juthia or Judia), is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Ang Thong, Lopburi, Saraburi, Pathum Thani, Nonthaburi, Nakhon Pathom and Suphan Buri.

Q1867.name: Taipei
Q1867.desc: special municipality and capital city of Taiwan
Q1867.about: Taipei ( ), officially Taipei City, is the capital and a special municipality of Taiwan. Located in Northern Taiwan, Taipei City is an enclave of the municipality of New Taipei City that sits about 25 kilometres (16 mi) southwest of the northern port city of Keelung.

Q2471.name: Sanaa
Q2471.about: Sanaa, officially the Sanaa Municipality, is the capital and largest city of Yemen. The city is the capital of the Sanaa Governorate, but is not part of the governorate, as it forms a separate administrative unit.

Q3441823.name: City Municipality of Celje
Q3441823.about: The Urban Municipality of Celje (pronounced [ˈtsɛ̀ːljɛ] ; Slovene: Mestna občina Celje) is one of twelve urban municipalities in Slovenia. Its seat is the city of Celje, a regional center of Styria.

Q3441842.name: Municipality of Idrija
Q3441842.about: The Municipality of Idrija (pronounced [ˈiːdrija]; Slovene: Občina Idrija) is a municipality in the Gorizia region of western Slovenia. Located in the traditional region of the Slovenian Littoral and in the Gorizia Statistical Region, the municipality covers 293.7 km2 of mostly forested terrain at the meeting point of the Dinaric and Alpine mountain chains.

Q3441849.name: City Municipality of Velenje
Q3441849.about: The Urban Municipality of Velenje (pronounced [ʋɛˈlɛːnjɛ]; Slovene: Mestna občina Velenje) is one of twelve urban municipalities of Slovenia. It lies in eastern Slovenia and was established in 1994.

Q3503153.name: Municipality of Kamnik
Q3503153.about: The Municipality of Kamnik (pronounced [ˈkaːmnik] ; Slovene: Občina Kamnik) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Kamnik.

Q3516752.name: Hatohobei
Q3516752.desc: southernmost state of Palau, consisting of Tobi Island and uninhabited Helen Reef
Q3516752.about: Tobi, or Hatohobei (Tobian), is the southernmost of Palau's sixteen states, consisting of Tobi Island and Helen Reef. The total land area is about 0.88 km².

Q3661628.name: Bohinj Municipality
Q3661628.about: The Municipality of Bohinj (Slovene: Občina Bohinj) is a municipality in the Upper Carniola region of northwest Slovenia. Its seat is the settlement of Bohinjska Bistrica.

Q1858.name: Hanoi
Q1858.about: Hanoi ( ha-NOY; Vietnamese: Hà Nội, pronounced [haː˨˩ noj˧˨ʔ] ) is the capital and second-most populous centrally-governed city of Vietnam. It covers an area of 3,358.6 km2 (1,296.8 mi2), and as of 2026 has a population of 8.7 million.

Q853861.name: Kaunas County
Q853861.about: Kaunas County (Lithuanian: Kauno apskritis) is one of ten counties of Lithuania. It is in the centre of the country, and its capital is Kaunas.

Q856010.name: Wellington Region
Q856010.desc: region at the southern end of New Zealand's North Island
Q856010.about: The  Wellington Region, also known as Greater Wellington (Māori: Te Upoko o te Ika), is one of sixteen regions of New Zealand, the southernmost one on the North Island. The local government region covers an area of 8,049 square kilometres (3,108 sq mi), and has a population of 543,400 (June 2025).
Q856010.img: Pencarrow Head, Wellington, New Zealand from Santa Regina, 24 Feb. 2007.jpg

Q856261.name: Diourbel Region
Q856261.about: The Diourbel region (Serer and Cangin: Jurbel) is a region of Senegal with 2,080,811 inhabitants (2023).  The regional capital is the city of Diourbel, and the largest city is Touba.

Q856539.name: Central Governorate
Q856539.about: The Central Governorate (Arabic: المحافظة الوسطى, romanized: Al-Muḥāfaẓat al-Wusṭā) was one of the five governorates of Bahrain until September 2014. It included parts of the former municipalities of  Jid Ali, Madinat 'Isa, Sitrah and A'ali.

Q859679.name: Municipality of Cerklje na Gorenjskem
Q859679.about: The Municipality of Cerklje na Gorenjskem (pronounced [tsɛɾˈklɛ na ɡɔˈɾeːnskɛm]; Slovene: Občina Cerklje na Gorenjskem) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Cerklje na Gorenjskem.

Q862584.name: Enga Province
Q862584.about: Enga is one of the provinces in Papua New Guinea (PNG). Enga is geographically situated in the northern region of Papua New Guinea and was separated from the adjacent Western Highlands at the time of national independence in 1975.

Q863476.name: Bimini
Q863476.about: Bimini () is the westernmost district of the Bahamas and comprises a chain of islands located about 80 kilometres (50 mi) due east of Miami. Bimini is the closest point in the Bahamas to the mainland United States and approximately 210 km (130 mi) west-northwest of Nassau.

Q249995.name: Chiayi City
Q249995.about:
Chiayi (), officially known as Chiayi City, is a city located in Chianan Plain in southwestern Taiwan, surrounded by Chiayi County with a population of 263,188 inhabitants as of January 2023.
The Hoanya people inhabited present-day Chiayi under its historical name of Tirosen prior to the arrival of Han Chinese in Taiwan and was ruled by the Dutch and the Kingdom of Tungning under various names.

Q251825.name: Hawke's Bay Region
Q251825.desc: region on the east coast of New Zealand's North Island
Q251825.about: Hawke's Bay (Māori: Te Matau-a-Māui) is a region on the east coast of New Zealand's North Island. The region is named after Hawke Bay, which was named in honour of Edward Hawke.

Q252154.name: Municipality of Pivka
Q252154.about: The Municipality of Pivka (pronounced [ˈpiːu̯ka]; Slovene: Občina Pivka) is a municipality in Slovenia in the Pivka Basin in the Littoral–Inner Carniola Statistical Region. Its seat is the town of Pivka.

Q261241.name: Nong Bua Lamphu
Q261241.about: Nong Bua Lamphu (sometimes rendered Nongbua Lamphu and Nong Bua Lam Phu) (Thai: หนองบัวลำภู, RTGS: Nong Bua Lam Phu, pronounced [nɔ̌ːŋ būa lām pʰūː]; Northeastern Thai: หนองบัวลำภู, pronounced [nɔ̌ːŋ bùa lâm pʰûː]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat). It lies in upper northeastern Thailand, a region also known as Isan.
Q261241.img: ภูมิศาสตร์ตำบลนาเหล่า.png

Q271737.name: Nakhon Ratchasima
Q271737.about: Nakhon Ratchasima (Thai: นครราชสีมา, pronounced [ná(ʔ).kʰɔ̄ːn râːt.tɕʰā.sǐː.māː]; Northeastern Thai: นครราชสีมา, pronounced [nà(ʔ).kʰɔ̂ːn lâːt.sā.sǐː.mâː], often called Khorat ((alternate spelling Korat; Thai: โคราช, pronounced [kʰōː.râːt]; Northeastern Thai: โคราช, pronounced [kʰôː.lâːt]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) and lies in lower northeastern Thailand also called Isan. At 20,736 square kilometres (8,006 sq mi) it is the country's second largest province by area, has a population of approximately 2.6 million, and generates about 250 billion baht in GDP, the highest in Isan.

Q1917707.name: Mislinja
Q1917707.about: Mislinja (pronounced [miˈsliːnja]; German: Missling) is a settlement in northern Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Mislinja.

Q1996432.name: Laamu Atoll
Q1996432.about: Laamu Atoll (Dhivehi: ލ. އަތޮޅު), historically known as Haddhunmathi Atoll (Dhivehi: ހައްދުންމަތި އަތޮޅު), is an administrative division of the Maldives.

Q2068600.name: Vodice
Q2068600.about: Vodice (pronounced [ʋɔˈdiːtsɛ]; German: Woditz) is a settlement in the Municipality of Vodice in the Upper Carniola region of Slovenia, just north of Ljubljana. In addition to the main population center of Vodice, the settlement includes the hamlets of Gornji Konec, Na Vasi (Slovene: Na vasi), Lokarje, Jegriše (or Jegrše), Mesto, Zaprice (German: Sapretz), and Pusence.

Q2112462.name: Orhei District
Q2112462.about: Orhei (Romanian pronunciation: [orˈhej]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in central Moldova, with its administrative center in the city of Orhei. As of the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 79,242.

Q2128862.name: Criuleni District
Q2128862.about:
Criuleni (Romanian pronunciation: [kri.uˈlenʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the central part of Moldova, with the administrative center at Criuleni.
As of the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 52,926.

Q2128964.name: Ialoveni District
Q2128964.about: Ialoveni (Romanian pronunciation: [jaloˈvenʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the central part of Moldova, with the administrative center at Ialoveni. As of the 2024 Moldovan census, its population was 74,458.

Q2129025.name: Telenești District
Q2129025.about: Telenești (Romanian pronunciation: [teleˈneʃtʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in central Moldova, with the administrative center at Telenești. In the 2024 Moldovan census, the district's population was 41,452.

Q11922.name: Canton of Glarus
Q11922.about: The canton of Glarus (German: Kanton Glarus [ˈɡlaːrʊs] ; Romansh: Chantun Glaruna; French: Canton de Glaris; Italian: Canton Glarona) is a canton in east-central Switzerland. The capital is Glarus.

Q11933.name: Canton of Zug
Q11933.about: The canton of Zug or canton of Zoug (German: Kanton Zug, Standard German: [tsuːk] , Alemannic German: [tsuːɡ̊]; Romansh: Chantun Zug; French: Canton de Zoug; Italian: Canton Zugo) is one of the 26 cantons of Switzerland. It is located in central Switzerland and its capital is Zug.

Q12079.name: Canton of Appenzell Ausserrhoden
Q12079.about: Canton of Appenzell Ausserrhoden (German: Kanton Appenzell Ausserrhoden [ˈapn̩tsɛl ˈaʊsərˌroːdn̩] ; Romansh: Chantun Appenzell Dadora; French: Canton d'Appenzell Rhodes-Extérieures; Italian: Canton Appenzello Esterno), in English sometimes Appenzell Outer Rhodes, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of twenty municipalities.

Q12094.name: Canton of Appenzell Innerrhoden
Q12094.about: Canton of Appenzell Innerrhoden (German: Kanton Appenzell Innerrhoden [ˈapn̩tsɛl ˈɪnərˌroːdn̩] ; Romansh: Chantun Appenzell Dadens; French: Canton d'Appenzell Rhodes-Intérieures; Italian: Canton Appenzello Interno), in English sometimes Appenzell Inner-Rhodes, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of five districts.

Q206687.name: Nelson
Q206687.desc: Urban area on the South Island of New Zealand; "City of Nelson" prior to 1989 local government reforms
Q206687.about: Nelson (Māori: Whakatū) is a city and unitary authority on the eastern shores of the Tasman Bay at the top of the South Island of New Zealand. It is the oldest city in the South Island and the second-oldest settled city in the country; it was established in 1841 and became a city by British royal charter in 1858.

Q208668.name: Rodrigues
Q208668.about: Rodrigues (French: Île Rodrigues [il ʁɔdʁiɡ]; Kreol rodrig: Rodrig) is an  autonomous outer island of the Republic of Mauritius, of approximately 108 km2 (42 mi2) and about 560 km (350 mi) east of the main island of Mauritius. Along with the French overseas department of Réunion, Rodrigues and Mauritius  are part of the Mascarene Islands.

Q213268.name: Dodoma Region
Q213268.about: Dodoma Region  (Mkoa wa Dodoma in Swahili) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The regional capital is the city of Dodoma, which is also the capital of Tanzania.
Q213268.img: Drought in the Kongwa District, Dodoma Region, Tanzania, East Africa.jpg

Q216075.name: Cần Thơ
Q216075.about: Cần Thơ (Vietnamese pronunciation: [kən˨˩ tʰɤ˧] ) is the third largest centrally-governed city in Vietnam and is in the Mekong Delta region. It is noted for its floating markets, Bánh tráng-making village, and rural canals.
Q216075.img: Can Tho City - Stadt aus Sicht vom Boot.jpg

Q1005208.name: Municipality of Dobrova–Polhov Gradec
Q1005208.about: The Municipality of Dobrova–Polhov Gradec (pronounced [ˈdoːbɾɔʋa ˈpou̯ːxou̯ ˈɡɾaːdəts]; Slovene: Občina Dobrova - Polhov Gradec) is a municipality in Slovenia. Its administrative seat is Dobrova.

Q1005224.name: Municipality of Gorenja Vas-Poljane
Q1005224.about: The Municipality of Gorenja Vas–Poljane (pronounced [ɡɔˈɾeːnja ˈʋaːs pɔˈljaːnɛ]; Slovene: Občina Gorenja vas - Poljane) is a municipality in Slovenia. Its administrative seat is Gorenja Vas.

Q1008048.name: Municipality of Ivančna Gorica
Q1008048.about: The Municipality of Ivančna Gorica (pronounced [iˈʋaːntʃna ɡɔˈɾiːtsa]; Slovene: Občina Ivančna Gorica) is a municipality in the traditional region of Lower Carniola in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Ivančna Gorica.

Q1008079.name: Municipality of Sodražica
Q1008079.about: The Municipality of Sodražica (pronounced [ˈsoːdɾaʒitsa]; Slovene: Občina Sodražica) is a municipality in the Lower Carniola region of Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Sodražica.

Q1008086.name: Municipality of Veržej
Q1008086.about: The Municipality of Veržej (pronounced [ʋɛɾˈʒeːi̯]; Slovene: Občina Veržej) is a small municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Veržej.

Q1008095.name: Municipality of Markovci
Q1008095.about: The Municipality of Markovci (pronounced [ˈmaːɾkɔu̯tsi]; Slovene: Občina Markovci) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Markovci.

Q12573.name: Canton of Obwalden
Q12573.about: Canton of Obwalden or Obwald (German: Kanton Obwalden [ˈɔpˌvaldn̩] ; Romansh: Chantun Sursilvania; French: Canton d'Obwald; Italian: Canton Obvaldo) is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of seven municipalities and the seat of the government and parliament is in Sarnen.

Q12592.name: Canton of Nidwalden
Q12592.about: Canton of Nidwalden or Nidwald (German: Kanton Nidwalden [ˈniːtˌvaldn̩] ; Romansh: Chantun Sutsilvania; French: Canton de Nidwald [ni.dwal]; Italian: Canton Nidvaldo) is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of eleven municipalities and the seat of the government and parliament is in Stans.

Q12640.name: Canton of Fribourg
Q12640.about: The canton of Fribourg, also canton of Freiburg, is located in western Switzerland. The canton is bilingual, with French spoken by more than two thirds of the citizens and German by a little more than a quarter.

Q1008102.name: Municipality of Hoče-Slivnica
Q1008102.about: The Municipality of Hoče–Slivnica (pronounced [ˈxòːtʃɛ ˈslíːwnitsa, ˈxóː-]; Slovene: Občina Hoče - Slivnica) is a municipality south of Maribor in northeastern Slovenia. Its administrative seat is Spodnje Hoče.

Q1008179.name: Municipality of Dobje
Q1008179.about: The Municipality of Dobje (pronounced [ˈdoːbjɛ]; Slovene: Občina Dobje) is a municipality in eastern Slovenia. The area is part of the traditional region of Styria.

Q1009409.name: Municipality of Dobrepolje
Q1009409.about: The Municipality of Dobrepolje (pronounced [dɔˈbɾeːpɔljɛ]; Slovene: Občina Dobrepolje) is a municipality in Slovenia. It lies in a karst valley approximately 35 km (21.75 mi) south of the Slovenian capital Ljubljana.

Q1009413.name: Municipality of Ribnica na Pohorju
Q1009413.about: The Municipality of Ribnica na Pohorju (Slovene: Občina Ribnica na Pohorju) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. It is also part of the larger Carinthia Statistical Region.

Q1009421.name: Municipality of Kozje
Q1009421.about: The Municipality of Kozje (pronounced [ˈkoːzjɛ]; Slovene: Občina Kozje) is a municipality in the traditional region of Styria in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Kozje.

Q1012761.name: Municipality of Moravče
Q1012761.about: The Municipality of Moravče (pronounced [mɔˈɾaːu̯tʃɛ]; Slovene: Občina Moravče) is a municipality in the traditional region of Upper Carniola in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Moravče.

Q182378.name: Putrajaya
Q182378.desc: seat of government and administrative centre of Malaysia
Q182378.about: Putrajaya (Malay pronunciation: [ˌputraˈd͡ʒaja, ˌputrəˈd͡ʒajə] ), officially the Federal Territory of Putrajaya (Malay: Wilayah Persekutuan Putrajaya), is the administrative centre of Malaysia. The seat of the federal government of Malaysia was shifted in 1999 from Kuala Lumpur to Putrajaya because of overcrowding and congestion in the capital, followed by the seat of the national judiciary in 2003.

Q182614.name: Brașov County
Q182614.about: Brașov County (Romanian pronunciation: [braˈʃov] ) is a county (județ) of Transylvania, Romania. Its capital city is Brașov.

Q182624.name: Cluj County
Q182624.about: Cluj County (Romanian pronunciation: [kluʒ] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Transylvania. Its seat is Cluj-Napoca.

Q182778.name: Vrancea County
Q182778.about: Vrancea (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈvrant͡ʃe̯a]) is a county (județ) in Romania, with its seat at Focșani. It is mostly in the historical region of Moldavia but the southern part, below the Milcov River, is in Muntenia.

Q184797.name: Sibiu County
Q184797.about: Sibiu County (Romanian pronunciation: [siˈbiw]) is a county (Romanian: județ) of Romania, in the historical region of Transylvania. Its county seat (Romanian: reședință de județ) is the namesake town of Sibiu (German: Hermannstadt).

Q171331.name: Khmelnytskyi Oblast
Q171331.about: Khmelnytskyi Oblast (Ukrainian: Хмельницька область, romanized: Khmelnytska oblast), also known as Khmelnychchyna (Ukrainian: Хмельниччина), is an oblast (province) in western Ukraine covering portions of the historical regions of western Podolia and southern Volhynia. The administrative center of the oblast is the city of Khmelnytskyi.

Q173407.name: Ternopil Oblast
Q173407.about: Ternopil Oblast (Ukrainian: Тернопільська область, romanized: Ternópilʹsʹka óblastʹ), also referred to as Ternopilshchyna (Ukrainian: Тернопільщина, romanized: Ternópilʹščyna) or Ternopillia (Ukrainian: Тернопілля, romanized: Ternopíllja), is an oblast (province) of Ukraine. Its administrative center is Ternopil, through which flows the Seret, a tributary of the Dniester.
Q173407.img: Будівля Тернопільської ОДА та обласної ради - 08062225.jpg

Q179567.name: Argeș County
Q179567.about: Argeș County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈardʒeʃ] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Muntenia, with the county seat at Pitești.

Q179779.name: Bacău County
Q179779.about: Bacău County (Romanian pronunciation: [baˈkəw] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Western Moldavia, with its capital city at Bacău. It has one commune, Ghimeș-Făget, in Transylvania.

Q864093.name: North Kordofan
Q864093.about: North Kordofan (Arabic: شمال كردفان, romanized: Šamāl Kurdufān) is one of the 18 wilayat or states of Sudan. It has an area of 185,302 km2 and an estimated population of 3,174,029 people (2018 est).

Q864971.name: Southland Region
Q864971.about: Southland (Māori: Murihiku, lit. 'the last joint of the tail') is New Zealand's southernmost region. It consists of the southwestern portion of the South Island and includes Stewart Island.

Q865639.name: Șoldănești District
Q865639.about: Șoldănești (Romanian pronunciation: [ʃoldəˈneʃtʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the northeast of Moldova, with the administrative center at Șoldănești. As of the 2024 Moldovan census, the district population was 25,394.

Q865726.name: Florești District
Q865726.about: Florești (Romanian pronunciation: [floˈreʃtʲ]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the north-east of Moldova, with the administrative center at Florești. The other major cities are Ghindeşti and Mărculeşti.

Q870044.name: Balaka District
Q870044.about: Balaka is a district in the Southern Region of Malawi. The capital is Balaka.

Q878308.name: Strășeni District
Q878308.about: Strășeni (pronunciation: [strəˈʃenʲ]) is an administrative district and the largest city (Romanian: raion) in the central part of Moldova. The other principal town is Bucovăț, 26 km (16 mi) to the north of the Moldovan capital.

Q430385.name: Ngatpang
Q430385.about: Ngatpang is one of Palau's sixteen states.  It comprises an area of around 47 square kilometers in the west of Palau's largest island, Babeldaob, facing onto Ngeremeduu Bay.

Q456556.name: Midlands Province
Q456556.about: Midlands is a province of Zimbabwe. It has an area of 49,166 square kilometres (18,983 mi2) and a population of 1,811,905 (2022).

Q458388.name: Morogoro Region
Q458388.about: Morogoro Region (Mkoa wa Morogoro in Swahili) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. It covers an area of 70,624 km2 (27,268 sq mi).

Q459748.name: Pathum Thani
Q459748.about: Pathum Thani (Thai: ปทุมธานี, pronounced [pā.tʰūm tʰāːnīː]) is a province (changwat) in Central Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise): Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Saraburi, Nakhon Nayok, Chachoengsao, Bangkok, and Nonthaburi.
Q459748.img: 004 Barge on Chao Phraya River (Menam) in Pathum Thani province, Thailand.jpg

Q459759.name: Chai Nat
Q459759.about: Chai Nat (Thai: ชัยนาท, pronounced [tɕʰāj nâːt]) is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Nakhon Sawan, Sing Buri, Suphan Buri, and Uthai Thani.

Q459763.name: Rotuma
Q459763.about: Rotuma () is a self-governing heptarchy, generally designated a dependency of Fiji. Rotuma commonly refers to the Rotuma Island, the only permanently inhabited and by far the largest of all the islands in the Rotuma Group.

Q483053.name: Eskişehir Province
Q483053.about: Eskişehir Province (Turkish: Eskişehir ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in northwestern Turkey. Its area is 13,960 km2, and its population is 906,617 (2022).

Q483100.name: Sivas Province
Q483100.about: Sivas Province (Turkish: Sivas ili) is a province of Turkey. It is located in the eastern part of the Central Anatolia region of Turkey.

Q483168.name: Karabük Province
Q483168.about: Karabük Province (Turkish: Karabük ili) is a landlocked province in the northern part of Anatolia (northern central Turkey), located about 200 km (124 mi) north of Ankara, 115 km (71 mi) away from Zonguldak and 113 km (70 mi) away from Kastamonu. Its area is 4,142 km2, and its population is 252,058 (2022).

Q1558.name: Kansas
Q1558.desc: state of the United States of America
Q1558.about: Kansas (  KAN-zəss) is a landlocked state in the Midwestern region of the United States. It borders Nebraska to the north, Colorado to the west, Oklahoma to the south, and Missouri to the east.

Q2134561.name: Municipality of Vojnik
Q2134561.about: The Municipality of Vojnik (pronounced [ˈʋoːi̯nik]; Slovene: Občina Vojnik) is a municipality in eastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Vojnik.

Q2192924.name: Bay of Plenty Region
Q2192924.desc: region in New Zealand's North Island
Q2192924.about: The Bay of Plenty Region is a local government region in the North Island of New Zealand. Also called just the Bay of Plenty (BOP), it is situated around the marine bight of that same name.

Q2242799.name: Municipality of Postojna
Q2242799.about: The Municipality of Postojna (pronounced [pɔˈstoːi̯na] ; Slovene: Občina Postojna) is a municipality in the traditional region  of Inner Carniola in southwestern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Postojna.

Q2297724.name: Ankara Province
Q2297724.about: Ankara Province (Turkish: Ankara ili, pronounced [ˈaŋkaɾa iˈli]) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey with the capital city Ankara. Its area is 25,632 km2, and its population is 5,782,285 (2022).

Q2318898.name: Municipality of Škofja Loka
Q2318898.about: The Municipality of Škofja Loka (pronounced [ˈʃkoːfja ˈloːka] ; Slovene: Občina Škofja Loka) is a municipality in the Upper Carniola region of Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Škofja Loka.

Q14773.name: Macau
Q14773.desc: city and special administrative region of China
Q14773.about: Macau or Macao is a special administrative region of China. It consists of the Macau Peninsula, the islands of Taipa and Coloane, the Cotai reclamation zone between Taipa and Coloane, and several smaller islets.

Q15887.name: Laško Municipality
Q15887.about: The Municipality of Laško (pronounced [ˈlaːʃkɔ] ; Slovene: Občina Laško)  is a municipality in eastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Laško.

Q15891.name: Municipality of Litija
Q15891.about: The Municipality of Litija (pronounced [liˈtiːja] ; Slovene: Občina Litija) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Litija.

Q15894.name: Municipality of Medvode
Q15894.about: The Municipality of Medvode (pronounced [mɛˈdʋoːdɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Medvode) is a municipality in the traditional region of Upper Carniola in north-central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Medvode.

Q15895.name: Municipality of Mengeš
Q15895.about: The Municipality of Mengeš (pronounced [ˈmeːŋɡəʃ] ; Slovene: Občina Mengeš) is a municipality in the eastern part of the traditional region of Upper Carniola in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Mengeš.

Q15893.name: Municipality of Logatec
Q15893.about: The Municipality of Logatec (pronounced [lɔˈɡaːtəts] ; Slovene: Občina Logatec) is a municipality in Slovenia. The administrative seat of the municipality is the town of Logatec.

Q15906.name: Ptuj
Q15906.about: Ptuj (Slovene: [ˈptùːj] ; German: Pettau, pronounced [ˈpɛtaʊ̯] ; Latin: Poetovium/Poetovio) is the eighth-largest town of Slovenia, located in the traditional region of Styria (northeastern Slovenia). It is the seat of the Municipality of Ptuj.

Q15910.name: Municipality of Radovljica
Q15910.about: The Municipality of Radovljica (pronounced [ɾaˈdoːu̯ljitsa] ; Slovene: Občina Radovljica) is a municipality in the Upper Carniola region of northern Slovenia. The administrative seat of the municipality is the town of Radovljica.

Q15908.name: Radeče
Q15908.about: Radeče (pronounced [ˈɾàːdɛtʃɛ] ; German: Ratschach) is a small town in the Lower Sava Valley in eastern Slovenia. It is located in the Sava Hills (Slovene: Posavsko hribovje) on the right bank of the Sava River at the confluence with Sopota Creek.

Q15912.name: Municipality of Ribnica
Q15912.about: The Municipality of Ribnica (pronounced [ˈɾiːbnitsa] ; Slovene: Občina Ribnica) is a municipality in southern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Ribnica.

Q15919.name: Slovenske Konjice
Q15919.about: Slovenske Konjice (pronounced [slɔˈʋèːnskɛ kɔˈnjìːtsɛ] ; German: Gonobitz, in older sources also Gannobitz; locally Konjice or Kujince) is a town in northeastern Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Slovenske Konjice.

Q15917.name: Slovenska Bistrica
Q15917.about: Slovenska Bistrica (pronounced [slɔˈʋèːnska ˈbíːstɾitsa] ; German: Windisch-Feistritz) is a town south of Maribor in eastern Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Slovenska Bistrica, one of the largest municipalities in Slovenia.

Q36721.name: Lâm Đồng
Q36721.desc: Province in South Central Coast and Central Highlands region of Vietnam.
Q36721.about: Lâm Đồng is a province of Vietnam located in the south of the South Central Coast and Central Highlands. It borders Khánh Hòa to the east, Đồng Nai and Hồ Chí Minh City to the southwest, the South China Sea to the southeast, Đắk Lắk to the north, and Cambodia to the northwest.

Q36729.name: Hải Dương
Q36729.about: Hải Dương was a former province in the Red River Delta of northern Vietnam. Its name derives from the Sino-Vietnamese 海陽 phrase "ocean sun", though the modern province is in fact landlocked.

Q36866.name: Bình Dương
Q36866.about: Bình Dương is a former province of Vietnam. It was located in the Southeast region of the country and the Southern Key Economic Zone, bordering Bình Phước province to the north, Ho Chi Minh City (Sài Gòn) to the south and southwest, Tây Ninh province to the west, and Đồng Nai province to the east.

Q43271.name: Barinas
Q43271.about: Barinas State (Spanish: Estado Barinas, IPA: [esˈtaðo βaˈɾinas]) is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. The state capital is Barinas.

Q43296.name: Wake Island
Q43296.desc: coral atoll in the North Pacific Ocean administered by the US and also claimed by the Marshall Islands
Q43296.about: Wake Island (Marshallese: Ānen Kio, lit. 'island of the kio flower'), also known as Wake Atoll (Chamorro: Islan Wake), is a coral atoll which is an unincorporated territory of the United States in the Micronesia subregion of the Pacific Ocean. The atoll is composed of three islets – Wake, Wilkes, and Peale Islands – surrounding a lagoon encircled by a coral reef.
Q43296.img: Aerial view of Wake Island in July 2014.JPG

Q43433.name: Chandigarh
Q43433.desc: capital of Punjab and Haryana states, Union Territory of India
Q43433.about: Chandigarh is a city and union territory in northwestern India, serving as a shared capital for the states of Punjab and Haryana. Situated near the foothills of the Shivalik range of Himalayas, it borders Haryana to the east and Punjab in the remaining directions.
Q43433.img: Open Hand Monument and a Rose.jpeg

Q221212.name: Al Bayda' Governorate
Q221212.about: Al Bayda Governorate (Arabic: مُحَافَظَة ٱلْبَيْضَاء Muḥāfaẓat Al-Bayḍāʾ), also spelt Al-Baidhah or Beida, is one of the governorates (muhafazat) of Yemen. It is located near the centre of the country, around the town of Al Bayda.

Q227163.name: Zreče Municipality
Q227163.about: The Municipality of Zreče (pronounced [ˈzɾeːtʃɛ]; Slovene: Občina Zreče) is a municipality below the slopes of Pohorje in northeastern Slovenia. Its seat is the town of Zreče.

Q232355.name: Hama Governorate
Q232355.about: Hama Governorate (Arabic: مُحافظة حماة, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat Ḥamāh) is one of the fourteen governorates of Syria. It is situated in western-central Syria, bordering Idlib and Aleppo Governorates to the north, Raqqa Governorate to the east, Homs Governorate to the south, and Tartus and Latakia Governorates to the west.

Q234200.name: Santiago de Cuba Province
Q234200.about: Santiago de Cuba Province is the second most populated province in the island of Cuba. The largest city Santiago de Cuba is the main administrative center.

Q5727.name: La Rioja
Q5727.desc: autonomous community and province of Spain
Q5727.about: La Rioja (Spanish: [la ˈrjoxa]) is an autonomous community and province in Spain. Its capital and largest city is Logroño.

Q12121.name: Canton of Lucerne
Q12121.about: The canton of Lucerne is a canton of Switzerland. It is located in the country's central, German-speaking part.

Q12404.name: Canton of Uri
Q12404.about: The canton of Uri (German: Kanton Uri [ˈuːri] ; Romansh: Chantun Uri; French: Canton d'Uri; Italian: Canton Uri) is one of the 26 cantons of Switzerland and a founding member of the Swiss Confederation. It is located in Central Switzerland.

Q12433.name: Canton of Schwyz
Q12433.about:
The canton of Schwyz is a canton in central Switzerland between the Alps in the south, Lake Lucerne to the west and Lake Zürich in the north, centred on and named after the town of Schwyz.
It is one of the founding cantons of Switzerland; Switzerland's name is derived from the name of the canton, and the flag of Switzerland from its coat of arms.

Q272247.name: Suphan Buri
Q272247.about: Suphan Buri (Thai: สุพรรณบุรี, pronounced [sù.pʰān būrīː]) is a province (จังหวัด, changwat) in central Thailand, one of the country's 76 first-level administrative divisions. Its neighbours, clockwise from the north, are Uthai Thani, Chai Nat, Sing Buri, Ang Thong, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Nakhon Pathom and Kanchanaburi.
Q272247.img: ศาลหลักเมืองสุพรรณบุรี.jpg

Q272662.name: Çankırı Province
Q272662.about: Çankırı Province (Turkish: Çankırı ili) is a province of Turkey, which lies close to the capital, Ankara. The provincial capital is Çankırı.

Q1865.name: Kuala Lumpur
Q1865.desc: federal territory and capital city of Malaysia
Q1865.about: Kuala Lumpur (KL), officially the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, is the capital city and a federal territory of Malaysia. It is the most populous city in the country, covering an area of 243 km2 (94 sq mi) with a population of 2,111,536 as of 2026.

Q15923.name: Municipality of Šoštanj
Q15923.about: The Municipality of Šoštanj (pronounced [ˈʃoːʃtan] ; Slovene: Občina Šoštanj) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Šoštanj.

Q15925.name: Municipality of Trbovlje
Q15925.about: The Municipality of Trbovlje (pronounced [təɾˈbɔ̀u̯ːljɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Trbovlje) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Trbovlje.

Q15931.name: Municipality of Žalec
Q15931.about: The Municipality of Žalec (pronounced [ˈʒaːləts] ; Slovene: Občina Žalec) is a municipality in Slovenia in the traditional region of Styria. The seat of the municipality is the town of Žalec.

Q15932.name: Železniki Municipality
Q15932.about: The Municipality of Železniki (pronounced [ʒɛˈleːzniki] ; Slovene: Občina Železniki) is a municipality in the Upper Carniola region of Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Železniki.

Q16578.name: Flores Department
Q16578.about: Flores (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈfloɾes]) is a department of Uruguay, positioned in the southwest of the central part of the country. Its capital is Trinidad.

Q237874.name: Phichit
Q237874.about: Phichit (Thai: พิจิตร, pronounced [pʰí(ʔ).t͡ɕìt], lit. 'beautiful') is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat). It lies in lower northern Thailand and 330 km due north of Bangkok.

Q239844.name: Nakhon Sawan
Q239844.about: Nakhon Sawan province (Thai: จังหวัดนครสวรรค์, pronounced [ná(ʔ).kʰɔ̄ːn sā.wǎn], lit. 'Heavenly City') is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat). It lies in lower northern Thailand, neighbouring the provinces of Kamphaeng Phet, Phichit, Phetchabun, Lopburi, Sing Buri, Chai Nat, Uthai Thani, and Tak (clockwise from north).
Q239844.img: บึงบอระเพ็ด.jpg

Q240495.name: Lampang
Q240495.about: Lampang (Thai: ลำปาง, pronounced [lām.pāːŋ]; Northern Thai: ᩃᩣᩴᨻᩣ᩠ᨦ) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat), situated in upper northern Thailand. The old name of Lampang was Khelang Nakhon.
Q240495.img: วัดพระธาตุลำปางหลวง - panoramio (1).jpg

Q240520.name: Phetchabun
Q240520.about: Phetchabun (Thai: เพชรบูรณ์, pronounced [pʰét.tɕʰā.būːn]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) and lies in lower northern Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Loei, Khon Kaen, Chaiyaphum, Lopburi, Nakhon Sawan, Phichit and Phitsanulok.

Q240540.name: Lamphun
Q240540.about: Lamphun (Thai: ลำพูน, pronounced [lām.pʰūːn]; Northern Thai: ᩃᨻᩪᩁ, pronounced [lǎʔ pūːn]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat), and lies in upper northern Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Chiang Mai, Lampang, and Tak.
Q240540.img: Doi Khun Tan peak, Thailand - panoramio.jpg

Q33408.name: Bắc Ninh
Q33408.about: Bắc Ninh (Vietnamese pronunciation: [ɓɐ̌k˧˥ nīɲ]) is a centrally-governed city in Vietnam, located in the Red River Delta region. It borders Hanoi, Hải Phòng, Quảng Ninh cities, Hưng Yên province, Lạng Sơn province, and Thái Nguyên province.

Q36015.name: Hòa Bình
Q36015.about: Hòa Bình or Hoà Bình (Vietnamese pronunciation: [hʷà ɓìɲ]) was a former mountainous province of Vietnam, located in the nation's Northwest region. It bordered Phú Thọ province and Sơn La province to the northwest, Hanoi to the northeast, Hà Nam province to the east, Ninh Bình province to the southeast and Thanh Hóa province to the south.
Q36015.img: Hòa Bình Province, Kim Bôi District.jpg

Q36349.name: Yên Bái
Q36349.about: Yên Bái was a former province (1900 – 1975; 1991 – 2025) located in Northwest Vietnam. It shared borders with six provinces which are Hà Giang province, Lào Cai province, Lai Châu province, Sơn La province, Phú Thọ province, and Tuyên Quang province.

Q36367.name: Bắc Giang
Q36367.about:
Bắc Giang was a former province in the Northeast region of Vietnam.
On June 12, 2025, Bắc Giang was incorporated into Bắc Ninh province (now Bắc Ninh city).

Q36413.name: Hà Nam
Q36413.about: Hà Nam was a former province of northern Vietnam, in the Red River Delta. It was dissolved and merged with Ninh Bình province on 12 June 2025.

Q36610.name: Phú Thọ
Q36610.about: Phú Thọ (Vietnamese pronunciation: [fǔ t̺ʰɔ̂ˀ]) is a province in northern Vietnam. Its administration center Việt Trì ward is located 80 kilometres (50 mi) from Hanoi and 50 kilometres (31 mi) from Nội Bài International Airport.

Q9347.name: Malé
Q9347.about: Malé is the capital and most populous city of the Maldives. With a population of 211,908 in 2022 within its administrative area and coterminous geographical area of 1.9 square kilometres (0.73 sq mi), Malé is one of the most densely populated cities in the world.

Q11911.name: Canton of Berne
Q11911.about: The canton of Bern or Berne is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. Its capital city, Bern, is also the de facto capital of Switzerland.

Q16587.name: Tacuarembó Department
Q16587.about: Tacuarembó (Spanish pronunciation: [takwaɾemˈbo]) is the largest department of Uruguay and it is part of its northern region. Its capital is Tacuarembó.

Q16591.name: Durazno Department
Q16591.about: Durazno (Spanish pronunciation: [duˈɾasno]; Uruguayan Spanish: [duˈɾahno]) is a department of Uruguay. Its capital is Durazno.
Q16591.img: AMANECER DE LA IGLESIA DE SAN PEDRO.jpg

Q16593.name: Florida Department
Q16593.about: Florida (Spanish pronunciation: [floˈɾiða]) is a department of Uruguay. Its capital is Florida.
Q16593.img: Monumento a la Independencia Nacional - Florida.jpg

Q16635.name: Guam
Q16635.desc: unincorporated territory of the United States of America
Q16635.about: Guam (  GWAHM; Chamorro: Guåhan [ˈɡʷɑhɑn]) is an organized, unincorporated territory of the United States in the Micronesia subregion of Oceania, in the western Pacific Ocean. Guam's capital is Hagåtña, and the most populous village is Dededo.

Q272947.name: Çorum Province
Q272947.about: Çorum Province (Turkish: Çorum İli) is a province in the Black Sea Region of Turkey, but lying inland and having more characteristics of Central Anatolia than the Black Sea coast. Its area is 12,428 km2, and its population is 524,130 (2022).

Q273807.name: Kamphaeng Phet
Q273807.about: Kamphaeng Phet (Thai: กำแพงเพชร, pronounced [kām.pʰɛ̄ːŋ pʰét]) is a province in upper central Thailand. Kamphaeng Phet is known for its natural environment and has a long history.
Q273807.img: บริเวณฝายกั้นแม่น้ำปิง - panoramio.jpg

Q275377.name: Chaiyaphum
Q275377.about: Chaiyaphum (Thai: ชัยภูมิ, pronounced [tɕʰāj.jā.pʰūːm]; Northeastern Thai: ไซยภูมิ, pronounced [sa᷇j.jā.pʰu᷇ːm]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat), located in central northeastern Thailand, also called Isan. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Khon Kaen, Nakhon Ratchasima, Lopburi, and Phetchabun.

Q275720.name: 'Amran Governorate
Q275720.about: ʽAmran (Arabic: عمران, romanized: ʽAmrān) is one of the governorates of Yemen. Located in the northwestern side of the country, it is controlled by the Houthi movement in the Yemeni civil war (2014–present).

Q276574.name: Kairouan Governorate
Q276574.about: Kairouan Governorate (Tunisian Arabic: ولاية قيروان Wilāyat Qiyrwān; French: Gouvernorat de Kairouan) is one of the twenty-four governorates of Tunisia. It is landlocked and in the centre-east of the country.
Q276574.img: View of Kairouan from the Minaret of the Great Mosque - Tunisia - 1899.jpg

Q309469.name: Gezira
Q309469.about: Gezira (Arabic: ولاية الجزيرة, romanized: Wilāyat Al Ǧazīra), also spelt Al Jazirah, Al Jazeera and Al Jazira, is one of the 18 states of Sudan. The state lies between the Blue Nile and the White Nile river in the east-central region of the country.

Q310385.name: Khartoum
Q310385.about: Khartoum State (Arabic: ولاية الخرطوم, romanized: Wilāyat al-Kharṭūm) is one of the eighteen states of Sudan. Although it is the smallest state by area (22,142 km2), it is the most populous state in Sudan—5,274,321 in the 2008 census, and officially estimated at 7,993,900 in 2018.

Q2332060.name: Tuyên Quang
Q2332060.about: Tuyên Quang (Vietnamese: [tʷiə̄n kʷāːŋ]) is a province in the northeastern part of Vietnam, at the centre of Lô River valley, a tributary of the Red River. Its capital is Minh Xuân Ward.

Q2346638.name: Municipality of Šenčur
Q2346638.about: The Municipality of Šenčur (pronounced [ʃɛnˈtʃuːɾ]; Slovene: Občina Šenčur) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the settlement of Šenčur.

Q2672913.name: Tabor
Q2672913.about: Tabor (pronounced [ˈtaːbɔɾ]) is a settlement in the Municipality of Tabor in central Slovenia. It lies on the edge of the Lower Savinja Valley at the northern edge of the Sava Hills.

Q3346841.name: Ruše Municipality
Q3346841.about: The Municipality of Ruše (pronounced [ˈɾuːʃɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Ruše) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Ruše.

Q3434113.name: Ljubljana City Municipality
Q3434113.about: The Urban Municipality of Ljubljana (pronounced [ljuˈbljaːna]), also the City of Ljubljana (Slovene: Mestna občina Ljubljana, acronym MOL) is one of twelve city and metropolitan municipalities in Slovenia. Its seat is Ljubljana, the largest and capital city of Slovenia.

Q3441817.name: City Municipality of Slovenj Gradec
Q3441817.about: The Urban Municipality of Slovenj Gradec (pronounced [slɔˈʋeːŋ ˈɡɾaːdəts]; Slovene: Mestna občina Slovenj Gradec) is a municipality in northern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Slovenj Gradec.

Q45868.name: Alba County
Q45868.about: Alba County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈalba]) is a county (județ) of Romania located in the historic region of Transylvania. Its capital is Alba Iulia, a city with a population of 63,536.

Q242932.name: Nonthaburi
Q242932.about:
Nonthaburi is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand, established by the Act Establishing Changwat Samut Prakan, Changwat Nonthaburi, Changwat Samut Sakhon and Changwat Nakhon Nayok, Buddhist Era 2489 (1946), which came into force on 9 May 1946 (Thursday).
Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, Pathum Thani, Bangkok, and Nakhon Pathom.

Q243656.name: Ḥaʼil Province
Q243656.about:
Hail Province
is a province in Saudi Arabia, located in the north-central part of the country in the Najd region. It is named after its seat, Hail, and is known for the twin mountain ranges of Aja and Salma, as well as for being the homeland of the historic symbol of generosity and curiosity, Hatim al-Tai.
Q243656.img: تنوع الغطاء النباتي بين جبال أجا بمنطقة حائل.jpg

Q243795.name: Ang Thong
Q243795.about: Ang Thong (Thai: อ่างทอง, pronounced [ʔàːŋ tʰɔ̄ːŋ]) or Angthong is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. The name "Ang Thong" means 'gold basin', thought to have derived from the basin-like geography of the area, and the golden color of the rice grown in the region.
Q243795.img: Ang Thong - Chaiyo (2024) - Wat Chaiyo Worawihan วัดไชโยวรวิหาร - img 14.jpg

Q244649.name: Uthai Thani
Q244649.about: Uthai Thani (Thai: อุทัยธานี, pronounced [ʔù.tʰāj tʰāː.nīː]), one of Thailand's seventy-six provinces (changwat) lies in lower northern Thailand. Neighbouring provinces are (from north clockwise) Nakhon Sawan, Chai Nat, Suphan Buri, Kanchanaburi and Tak.

Q244652.name: Phrae
Q244652.about: Phrae (Thai: แพร่, pronounced [pʰrɛ̂ː]; Northern Thai:  ᨻᩯᩖ᩵, pronounced [pɛ̂ː]) is one of Thailand's seventy-six Provinces (changwat) and lies in upper northern Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (clockwise from north) Phayao, Nan, Uttaradit, Sukhothai, and Lampang.

Q46763.name: Bilecik Province
Q46763.about: Bilecik Province (Turkish: Bilecik ili) is a province in midwest Turkey, neighboring Bursa to the west, Kocaeli and Sakarya to the north, Bolu to the east, Eskişehir to the southeast and Kütahya to the south. Its area is 4,179 km2, and its population is 228,673 (2022).

Q50617.name: Oppland
Q50617.about: Oppland [ˈɔ̂plɑn]  is a former county in Norway which existed from 1781 until its dissolution on 1 January 2020. The old Oppland county bordered the counties of Trøndelag, Møre og Romsdal, Sogn og Fjordane, Buskerud, Akershus, Oslo and Hedmark.

Q54888.name: Cuenca Province
Q54888.about: Cuenca (Spanish: [ˈkweŋka] ) is a province of Spain, in the eastern part of the autonomous community of Castilla-La Mancha. Its capital is the city of Cuenca.

Q54889.name: Albacete Province
Q54889.about: The Province of Albacete (Spanish: Provincia de Albacete [albaˈθete] ) is a province of central Spain, in the southern part of the autonomous community of Castile–La Mancha. Its capital, the homonymous city of Albacete, is 262 kilometres (163 mi) by road southeast of Madrid.

Q54929.name: Toledo Province
Q54929.about: The Province of Toledo (UK:  tol-AY-doh; Spanish: Provincia de Toledo [toˈleðo] ) is a province of central Spain, in the western part of the autonomous community of Castile–La Mancha. It is bordered by the provinces of Madrid, Cuenca, Ciudad Real, Badajoz, Cáceres, and Ávila.
Q54929.img: Alcázar and its reflection in the Tagus. Toledo, Spain.jpg

Q16644.name: Northern Mariana Islands
Q16644.desc: unincorporated territory of the United States of America, located in the Pacific Ocean
Q16644.about: The Northern Mariana Islands, officially the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI), is an unincorporated territory and commonwealth of the United States consisting of the 14 northern islands of the Mariana Archipelago in the northwestern Pacific Ocean. The southernmost, Guam, is a separate U.S. territory.

Q21197.name: Chișinău
Q21197.about: Chișinău (  KIH-shih-NOW; Romanian: [kiʃiˈnəw] ; also known by its english exonym Kishinev) is the capital and largest city of Moldova by area and population. The city is Moldova's main industrial and commercial centre.
Q21197.img: Arch of Triumph, Chisinau, Republic of Moldova (51160304626 cropped).jpg

Q321324.name: Prachin Buri
Q321324.about: Prachinburi province (Thai: ปราจีนบุรี, RTGS: Prachin Buri, pronounced [prāː.tɕīːn bū.rīː], lit. 'City of the East') is one of Thailand's seventy-seven provinces (changwat), it lies in eastern Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Nakhon Ratchasima, Sa Kaeo, Chachoengsao, and Nakhon Nayok.

Q327097.name: Sidi Bouzid Governorate
Q327097.about: Sidi Bouzid Governorate (Tunisian Arabic: ولاية سيدي بوزيد; French: Gouvernorat de Sidi Bouzid), sometimes spelt Sidi Bou Zid, is one of the 24 governorates (provinces) of Tunisia. It is in central Tunisia and landlocked.

Q327533.name: Khon Kaen
Q327533.about: Khon Kaen (Thai: ขอนแก่น, pronounced [kʰɔ̌ːn kɛ̀n]; Northeastern Thai: ขอนแก่น, pronounced [kʰɔ̌ːn kɛ́n]) is one of Thailand's 76 provinces (changwat). It is a triply-landlocked province in central northeastern Thailand.
Q327533.img: อุทยานแห่งชาติน้ำพอง จ.ขอนแก่น.jpg

Q328115.name: Siliana Governorate
Q328115.about: Siliana Governorate (Tunisian Arabic: ولاية سليانة Wilāyat Silyānah pronounced [sɪ̈lˈje̞ːnə]; French: Gouvernorat de Siliana) is one of the twenty-four governorates (provinces) of Tunisia, is landlocked and is in the north of the country. It covers an area of 4,631 km2 and has a population of 223,087 (2014 census).

Q328187.name: Dhale Governorate
Q328187.about: Dhale (Arabic: الضالع, romanized: aḍ-Ḍāliʿ) is one of the Yemeni governorates that was created after the unification of Yemen. The population of the province accounts for 2% of the total population of the republic.

Q7903676.name: Uvea
Q7903676.desc: customary kingdom in Wallis and Futuna, France
Q7903676.about: ʻUvea (Wallisian: ʻUvea, French: Royaume coutumier de Uvea) is one of the three official chiefdoms (Royaume coutumier, lit. 'customary kingdom') of the French territory of Wallis and Futuna (the other two being Sigave and Alo) in Oceania in the South Pacific Ocean.

Q9014817.name: Municipality of Vrhnika
Q9014817.about: The Municipality of Vrhnika (pronounced [ˈʋəɾxnika] ; Slovene: Občina Vrhnika) is a municipality in Slovenia. The administrative seat of the municipality is the town of Vrhnika.

Q9273677.name: City Municipality of Murska Sobota
Q9273677.about: The Urban Municipality of Murska Sobota (pronounced [ˈmuːɾska ˈsoːbɔta]; Slovene: Mestna občina Murska Sobota) is one of twelve urban municipalities of Slovenia. It lies in northeastern Slovenia and was established in 1994.

Q328193.name: Dhamar Governorate
Q328193.about: Dhamar (Arabic: ذَمَار, romanized: Ḏamār), also spelt Thamar, is a governorate of Yemen located in the central highlands.

Q331117.name: Manyara Region
Q331117.about: Manyara Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Manyara) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The regional capital is the town of Babati.

Q331701.name: Ajdovščina Municipality
Q331701.about: The Municipality of Ajdovščina (pronounced [ˈaːi̯dɔu̯ʃtʃina]; Slovene: Občina Ajdovščina) is a municipality with a population of a little over 19,000 located in the Vipava Valley, southwestern Slovenia. The municipality was established in 1994.

Q334836.name: Sing Buri
Q334836.about: Sing Buri (Thai: สิงห์บุรี, pronounced [sǐŋ būrīː]) is one of the central provinces (changwat) of Thailand. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Nakhon Sawan, Lopburi, Ang Thong, Suphan Buri, and Chai Nat.

Q54955.name: Teruel Province
Q54955.about: The Province of Teruel (Spanish: Provincia de Teruel; Catalan: Província de Terol, [təˈɾɔl]) is a province of the autonomous community of Aragon in northeast Spain. The capital is the city of Teruel.

Q55180.name: Zaragoza Province
Q55180.about: The Province of Zaragoza (Spanish: Provincia de Zaragoza [θaɾaˈɣoθa])(Catalan: Província de Saragossa), also called Saragossa in English, is a province of northern Spain, in the central part of the autonomous community of Aragon. Its capital is the city of Zaragoza, which is also the capital of the autonomous community.

Q55271.name: Province of Burgos
Q55271.desc: province in Castile and León, Spain
Q55271.about: The Province of Burgos (Spanish: Provincia de Burgos [ˈbuɾɣos] )  is a province of northern Spain, in the northeastern part of the autonomous community of Castile and León. It has a population of 362,663 in an area of 14,288.63 square kilometres (5,516.87 sq mi) across its 371 municipalities—the highest number of municipalities of any Spanish province.
Q55271.img: Hoyos del Tozo - Inicio del Cañón del Rudrón 2.jpg

Q55276.name: Soria Province
Q55276.about: The Province of Soria (Spanish: Provincia de Soria) is a province of north-central Spain, in the autonomous community of Castile-Leon, whose capital is Soria. It is the least populous province of Spain and among the least densely populated territories in the European Union, with a population of 90,183 in an area of 10,306.98 square kilometres (3,979.55 sq mi).

Q25110.name: Municipality of Lovrenc na Pohorju
Q25110.about: The Municipality of Lovrenc na Pohorju is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It lies in the Pohorje Hills to the west of Maribor.

Q26575.name: Thái Nguyên
Q26575.about: Thái Nguyên (Vietnamese pronunciation: [t̺ʰǎj ŋʷiə̄n]) is a province in the Northeast region of Vietnam. It is a mountainous inland province.

Q27566.name: Vĩnh Phúc
Q27566.about: Vĩnh Phúc was a former province in the Red River Delta of Northern Vietnam. It was dissolved and merged with Phú Thọ province on 1 July 2025.

Q27916.name: Zaghouan Governorate
Q27916.about: Zaghouan Governorate (Arabic: ولاية زغوان Wilāyat Zaghwān pronounced [zɑʁˈwe̞ːn]; French: Gouvernorat de Zaghouan) is one of the twenty-four governorates (provinces) of Tunisia and is in north-eastern Tunisia. It covers an area of 2,768 square kilometres (1,069 sq mi) and its population was 176,945 at the 2014 census.

Q11214302.name: Sevnica Municipality
Q11214302.about: The Municipality of Sevnica (Slovene: Občina Sevnica) is a municipality along the Sava and the Mirna Rivers in southeastern Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Sevnica.

Q11342951.name: Yap State
Q11342951.desc: state of the Federated States of Micronesia
Q11342951.about: Yap State is one of the four states of the Federated States of Micronesia, located in the westernmost portion of the country. The state borders Palau to the southwest, Guam to the north, and Chuuk State to the east.

Q12898552.name: Melekeok
Q12898552.about: Melekeok is a state of the Republic of Palau located on the central east coast of Babeldaob Island. The seat of government of the country, Ngerulmud, is located in the state.

Q13107298.name: Municipality of Cerknica
Q13107298.about: The Municipality of Cerknica (pronounced [ˈtseːɾknitsa] ; Slovene: Občina Cerknica) is a municipality in the Karst region of southwestern Slovenia, with a population of 11,879 in 2024. The seat of the municipality is the town of Cerknica.
Q13107298.img: Cerknica Slovenia - John the Baptist Church.JPG

Q55288.name: Province of Ávila
Q55288.desc: province in Castile and León, Spain
Q55288.about: The Province of Ávila (Spanish: Provincia de Ávila [ˈaβila] ) is a province of central-western Spain, in the southern part of the autonomous community of Castile and León. Its capital is the city of Ávila.

Q59596.name: Northland Region
Q59596.desc: region at the northern end of New Zealand's North Island
Q59596.about: Northland (Māori: Te Tai Tokerau), officially the Northland Region, is the northernmost of New Zealand's 16 local government regions. The region is known for its warm weather.

Q13220435.name: municipality of Cerkno
Q13220435.about:
The Municipality of Cerkno (Slovene: Občina Cerkno) is a municipality in the Littoral region of Slovenia.
The seat of the municipality is the town of Cerkno.

Q13365883.name: Municipality of Lenart
Q13365883.about: The Municipality of Lenart (pronounced [ˈleːnaɾt]; Slovene: Občina Lenart) is a municipality in northeastern Slovenia. It has just over 11,000 inhabitants.

Q13377747.name: Municipality of Borovnica
Q13377747.about: The Municipality of Borovnica (Slovene: Občina Borovnica) is a municipality in the Inner Carniola region of Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the settlement of Borovnica.

Q13377763.name: Municipality of Domžale
Q13377763.about: The Municipality of Domžale (Slovene: Občina Domžale, pronounced [ˈóːptʃina dɔmˈʒàːlɛ]) is a municipality in the Ljubljana Basin in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Domžale.

Q13377778.name: Municipality of Grosuplje
Q13377778.about: The Municipality of Grosuplje (pronounced [ɡɾɔˈsùːpljɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Grosuplje) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Grosuplje.

Q13377780.name: Hrastnik Municipality
Q13377780.about: The Municipality of Hrastnik (pronounced [ˈxɾaːstnik] ; Slovene: Občina Hrastnik) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Hrastnik.

Q13378243.name: Trebnje Municipality
Q13378243.about: The Municipality of Trebnje (pronounced [ˈtɾeːbnjɛ] ; Slovene: Občina Trebnje) is a municipality in Slovenia in the traditional region of Lower Carniola. The seat of the municipality is the town of Trebnje.

Q13378281.name: Municipality of Velike Lašče
Q13378281.about: The Municipality of Velike Lašče (pronounced [ˈʋeːlikɛ ˈlaːʃtʃɛ]; Slovene: Občina Velike Lašče) is a municipality in Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Velike Lašče.

Q13378328.name: Zagorje ob Savi Municipality
Q13378328.about: The Municipality of Zagorje ob Savi (pronounced [zaˈɡoːɾjɛ ɔp ˈsaːʋi]; Slovene: Občina Zagorje ob Savi) is a municipality in central Slovenia. The seat of the municipality is the town of Zagorje ob Savi.

Q13378384.name: Šentjur Municipality
Q13378384.about: The Municipality of Šentjur (Slovene: Občina Šentjur), named Municipality of Šentjur pri Celju (Občina Šentjur pri Celju) until 2002, is a municipality in eastern Slovenia. The town of Šentjur is the seat of the municipality.

Q14468504.name: Trzin
Q14468504.desc: settlement in the municipality of Trzin, Slovenia
Q14468504.about: Trzin (pronounced [təɾˈzin]  or [təɾˈziːn]; German: Tersain) is a town in the eastern part of the Upper Carniola region of Slovenia. It is the seat of the Municipality of Trzin and also the only settlement in the municipality.

Q16928358.name: Harare Province
Q16928358.about: Harare Metropolitan Province () is a province in northeastern Zimbabwe that comprises Harare, the country's capital and largest city, and three other municipalities, Chitungwiza, Epworth and Ruwa. At independence in 1980, it was originally part of Mashonaland Province which in 1983 was divided into three large provinces, Mashonaland Central, Mashonaland East, and Mashonaland West - at this point, the city of Harare became part of Mashonaland East.

Q249293.name: Zardab District
Q249293.about: Zardab District (Azerbaijani: Zərdab rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country and belongs to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q253661.name: Lélouma Prefecture
Q253661.about: Lélouma (Pular: 𞤂𞤫𞥅𞤤𞤵𞤥𞤢𞥄) is a prefecture located in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Lélouma.

Q258405.name: Granada Department
Q258405.desc: Department in western Nicaragua centered on the colonial city of Granada on Lake Nicaragua
Q258405.about: Granada is an administrative division and department in northwestern Nicaragua. The city of Granada serves as the capital of the department.

Q261165.name: Bolívar Province
Q261165.about: Bolívar (Spanish pronunciation: [boˈliβaɾ]) is a province in Ecuador. The capital is Guaranda.

Q266411.name: Bordj Bou Arréridj Province
Q266411.about: Bordj Bou Arréridj Province (Arabic: ولاية برج بوعريريج) is a province (wilaya) in northern Algeria, around 200 km from the capital Algiers. It is considered as a crossroads between the east and west, the north and south.

Q305257.name: Logone Occidental Region
Q305257.about: Logone Occidental is one of the 23 regions of Chad, which is located in the southwest of the country. Its capital is Moundou.

Q318666.name: Central Province
Q318666.about: The Central Province (Swahili: Kati, Gikuyu: Gichigo gia Gatagati) was a region in central Kenya until 2013, when Kenya's provinces were replaced by a system of counties. It covered an area of 11,449 km2 (4,420 sq mi) and was located to the north of Nairobi and west of Mount Kenya (see maps).

Q321863.name: Imbabura Province
Q321863.about: Imbabura (Spanish pronunciation: [imbaˈβuɾa]) is a province located in the Andes of northern Ecuador.  The capital is Ibarra.

Q330790.name: Khojaly District
Q330790.about: Khojaly District (Azerbaijani: Xocalı rayonu) is the district of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country in the Karabakh Economic Region.
Q330790.img: Landscape of Xocalı District with Qarqar river in the foreground.jpg

Q330800.name: Agsu District
Q330800.about: Agsu District (Azerbaijani: Ağsu rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the east of the country, in the Mountainous Shirvan Economic Region.

Q330813.name: Khojavend District
Q330813.about: Khojavend District (Azerbaijani: Xocavənd rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country in the Karabakh Economic Region.

Q330818.name: Aghjabadi District
Q330818.about: Aghjabadi District (Azerbaijani: Ağcabədi rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country and belongs to the Karabakh Economic Region.

Q330839.name: Shamakhi District
Q330839.about: Shamakhi District (Azerbaijani: Şamaxı rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the east of the country and belongs to the Mountainous Shirvan Economic Region.

Q330843.name: Goranboy District
Q330843.about: Goranboy District (Azerbaijani: Goranboy rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the western part of the country within the Ganja-Dashkasan Economic Region, it borders the districts of Aghdara, Kalbajar, Tartar, Yevlakh, Barda, Samukh, Goygol, and completely surrounds the enclave city of Naftalan.

Q330857.name: Barda District
Q330857.about: Barda District (Azerbaijani: Bərdə rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the center of the country in the Karabakh Economic Region.

Q335471.name: Cañar Province
Q335471.about: Cañar (Spanish pronunciation: [kaˈɲaɾ]) is a province in Ecuador. The capital is Azogues.

Q344252.name: Ismayilli District
Q344252.about: Ismayilli District (Azerbaijani: İsmayıllı rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the north of the country, in the Mountainous Shirvan Economic Region.

Q382132.name: Sabirabad District
Q382132.about: Sabirabad District (Azerbaijani: Sabirabad rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the centre of the country, it belongs to the Mil-Mughan Economic Region.

Q388087.name: Goygol District
Q388087.about: Goygol District (Azerbaijani: Göygöl rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan, situated in the western part of the country within the  Ganja-Dashkasan Economic Region. The district is bordered by districts of Goranboy, Kalbajar, Dashkasan, Shamkir, Samukh, and the city of Ganja.

Q389734.name: Mongar District
Q389734.about: Mongar District (Dzongkha: མོང་སྒར་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Mong-sgar rdzong-khag) is one of the 20 dzongkhags (districts) comprising Bhutan. Mongar is the fastest-developing dzongkhag in eastern Bhutan.

Q395166.name: Agnéby
Q395166.about: Agnéby Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q398417.name: Ashanti Region
Q398417.about: The Ashanti Region is located in the southern part of Ghana and is the third largest of 16 administrative regions, occupying a total land surface of 24,389 km2 (9,417 sq mi) and making up 10.2% of the total land area of Ghana. It is the most populated region in Ghana, with a population of 5,440,463 according to the 2021 census, accounting for around one-sixth of Ghana's total population.

Q865682.name: Koknese Municipality
Q865682.about: Koknese Municipality (Latvian: Kokneses novads) was a municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed on 1 July 2009 by merging Bebri parish, Irši Parish and Koknese Parish the administrative centre being Koknese.

Q865717.name: Brocēni Municipality
Q865717.about: Brocēni Municipality (Latvian: Brocēnu novads) was a municipality in Courland, Latvia. As of 2020, the population was 5,633.

Q867126.name: Francisco Morazán Department
Q867126.about:
Francisco Morazán (Spanish pronunciation: [fɾanˈsisko moɾaˈsan], abbreviated FMO) is one of the departments of Honduras.
It is located in the central part of the nation.
Q867126.img: Centro historico de Tegucigalpa y Comayagüela.jpg

Q867856.name: Tandjilé Region
Q867856.about: Tandjilé (Arabic: تانجلي, romanised: Tānjīlī) is one of the 23 regions of Chad, located in the south-west of the country. Its capital is Laï.
Q867856.img: Georges Bruel - grenier à Mil à Laï - btv1b7702185n (032 of 230).jpg

Q877468.name: Kampong Chhnang Province
Q877468.about: Kampong Chhnang Province (Khmer: ខេត្តកំពង់ឆ្នាំង, Khaêt Kâmpǒng Chhnăng; [kɑm.pɔŋ cʰnaŋ], lit. 'pottery port') is one of the central provinces of Cambodia. Neighboring provinces are (from north clockwise) Kampong Thom, Kampong Cham, Kandal, Kampong Speu, and Pursat.

Q880399.name: Caaguazú Department
Q880399.about: Caaguazú (Spanish pronunciation: [ka(a)ɣwaˈsu]) is a department in Paraguay. The capital is the city of Coronel Oviedo.

Q881839.name: Caazapá Department
Q881839.about: Caazapá (Spanish pronunciation: [ka(a)saˈpa]) is a department in Paraguay, with its capital in the city of the same name. The eastern region of Caazapá is relatively undeveloped, characterized by rolling hills and large areas of Brazilian Atlantic Forest situated between the San Rafael mountains to the south and the Ybytyruzú mountains to the north.

Q885644.name: Totonicapán Department
Q885644.about: Totonicapán is one of the 22 departments of Guatemala. The capital is the city of Totonicapán.

Q891962.name: Mubende District
Q891962.about: Mubende is a district in the Central Region of Uganda. The town of Mubende is the site of the district headquarters.

Q892064.name: Kiboga District
Q892064.about: Kiboga District is a district in the Buganda Region of Uganda. The town of Kiboga is the site of the district headquarters.

Q922545.name: Télimélé Prefecture
Q922545.about: Télimélé is a prefecture located in the Kindia Region of Guinea. The capital is Télimélé.

Q926417.name: Kampala District
Q926417.about: Kampala (UK: , US:  ) is the capital and largest city of Uganda. The city proper has a population of 1,797,722 (2024 census) and is divided into the five political divisions of Kampala Central, Kawempe, Makindye, Nakawa, and Rubaga.

Q962654.name: Kérouané Prefecture
Q962654.about: Kérouané is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Kérouané.

Q976848.name: Wakiso District
Q976848.desc: district in the Central Region of Uganda
Q976848.about: Wakiso District is a district in the Central Region of Uganda that partly encircles Kampala, Uganda's capital city. Formed in 2000 out of Mpigi District, the district was created after merging the six major counties of Busiro, Kyaddondo, Entebbe Municipality, Nansana Municipality, Kira Municipality and Makindye-Sabagabo Municipality.

Q976859.name: Nakasongola District
Q976859.about: Nakasongola District is the northernmost district of the Central Region of Uganda. The town of Nakasongola is the site of the district's administrative headquarters.

Q272586.name: Pichincha Province
Q272586.about: Pichincha (Spanish pronunciation: [piˈtʃintʃa]) is a province of Ecuador located in the northern Sierra region; its capital and largest city is Quito. It is bordered by Imbabura and Esmeraldas to the north, Cotopaxi and Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas to the south, Napo and Sucumbíos to the east, and Esmeraldas and Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas to the west.

Q272885.name: Guaviare Department
Q272885.about: Guaviare (Spanish pronunciation: [ɡwaˈβjaɾe]) is a department of Colombia. It is in the southern central region of the country.

Q273525.name: Viseu
Q273525.about: The District of Viseu (Portuguese: Distrito de Viseu [viˈzew] ) is located in the Central Inland of Portugal. It is the only Portuguese district without a border with Spain or a coastline.

Q275784.name: Aghdash District
Q275784.about: Agdash District (Azerbaijani: Ağdaş rayonu) is one of the 67 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country, in the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q279004.name: Lielvārde Municipality
