Q279004.about: Lielvārde Municipality (Latvian: Lielvārdes novads) was a municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2004 by reorganization of Lielvārde town with its countryside territory.

Q280973.name: Boaco Department
Q280973.about: Boaco (Spanish pronunciation: [boˈa.ko]) is an administrative division and a department in Nicaragua. It was formed in 1935.

Q1199.name: Hesse
Q1199.desc: state in the center of Germany
Q1199.about: Hesse or Hessen (German pronunciation: [ˈhɛsn̩]), officially the State of Hesse (German: Land Hessen), is a landlocked state in Germany. Its capital city is Wiesbaden, and the largest urban area is Frankfurt am Main, which is also the country's principal financial centre.
Q1199.img: Stadtschloss der Herzöge von Nassau, Wiesbaden.jpg

Q587062.name: Punakha District
Q587062.about: Punakha District (Dzongkha: སྤུ་ན་ཁ་རྫོང་ཁག་; Wylie: spu-na-kha rdzong-khag) is one of the 20 dzongkhags (districts) comprising Bhutan. It is bordered by Thimphu, Gasa, and Wangdue Phodrang Districts.

Q590802.name: Moyen-Ogooué Province
Q590802.about: Moyen-Ogooué is one of Gabon's nine provinces. It covers an area of 18,535 km2 (7,156 sq mi).

Q594405.name: La Vega Province
Q594405.about: La Vega (Spanish pronunciation: [la ˈβeɣa]) is one of the 32 provinces of the Dominican Republic. It is located in the Cibao Valley, the north-central region of the country, and is divided into 4 municipalities with its capital city being the namesake of La Vega.

Q976883.name: Ssembabule District
Q976883.about: Sembabule District is a district in the Central Region of Uganda. The town of Sembabule is the site of the district headquarters.

Q983748.name: Jinja District
Q983748.about: Jinja District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Jinja is the district's main municipal and commercial center.

Q990414.name: Umm Salal Municipality
Q990414.about:
Umm Salal (Arabic: أم صلال, romanized: Umm Ṣalāl, lit. 'mother of rocks'; also spelled Umm Slal) is a municipality in the State of Qatar.
Historic landmarks such as the  Barzan Tower are located in Umm Salal.The municipal headquarters  is located in Umm Salal Ali, about 10 km from the coast and 15 km north of Doha, the Qatari capital.

Q1023757.name: Vārkava Municipality
Q1023757.about: Vārkava Municipality (Latvian: Vārkavas novads) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2002 by merging Rožkalni Parish and Upmala Parish.

Q1028215.name: Gulu District
Q1028215.about: Gulu is a district in the Northern Region of Uganda. The regional headquarters are located in the city of Gulu, which is also the administrative capital of Northern Uganda.

Q1032238.name: Masindi District
Q1032238.about: Masindi District is a district in Western Uganda. Like many other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town' of Masindi, the location of the district headquarters.

Q1050621.name: Bahr el Gazel
Q1050621.about: Barh El Gazel (Arabic: منطقة بحر الغزال, French: Province du Barh El Gazel) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad. The province's name may also be written as Barh El Gazal or Bahr el Gazel.

Q1072757.name: Farwaniya Governorate
Q1072757.about: Farwaniya Governorate (Arabic: محافظة الفروانية Muḥāfaẓat al-Farwānīyah) is the most populous of the six governorates of Kuwait, and is the country's only landlocked governorate. It is Kuwait's main residential area and also forms an important part of Kuwait's commercial activities.

Q405670.name: Eastern Region
Q405670.about: The Eastern Region is located in the eastern part of Ghana and is one of the sixteen administrative regions of Ghana. Eastern Region is bordered to the east by the Lake Volta, to the north by Bono East Region and Ashanti region, to the west by Ashanti Region, to the south by Central Region and Greater Accra Region.

Q432438.name: Nakaseke District
Q432438.about: Nakaseke District is a district in Central Uganda. It is named after Nakaseke, the largest town in the district.

Q457499.name: Guba District
Q457499.about: Quba District (Azerbaijani: Quba rayonu, lit. 'Guba District'; Azerbaijani: Quba rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Its position in the northeastern part of the country puts it within the borders of Europe.
Q457499.img: Bridge between Quba and Krasnaya Sloboda.jpg

Q457508.name: Gobustan District
Q457508.about: Gobustan District (Azerbaijani: Qobustan rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the east of the country, in the Mountainous Shirvan Economic Region.

Q458402.name: Biskra Province
Q458402.about: Biskra (Arabic: ولاية بسكرة, Berber: ⴱⴻⵙⴽⵔⴰ) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria with its capital at Biskra. It is located on the northern edge of the Algerian Sahara, south of the Atlas Mountains.
Q458402.img: Dattes de Deglet nour à Tolga (Wilaya de Biskra).jpg

Q458524.name: Yevlakh District
Q458524.about: Yevlakh District (Azerbaijani: Yevlax rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country and belongs to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q467491.name: Shamkir District
Q467491.about: Shamkir District (Azerbaijani: Şəmkir rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the north-west of the country and belongs to the Gazakh-Tovuz Economic Region.

Q476690.name: Hajigabul District
Q476690.about: Hajigabul District (Azerbaijani: Hacıqabul rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the east of the country, in the Shirvan-Salyan Economic Region.

Q476703.name: Ujar District
Q476703.about: Ujar District (Azerbaijani: Ucar rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country and belongs to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q477163.name: Goychay District
Q477163.about: Goychay District (Azerbaijani: Göyçay rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the centre of the country, it belongs to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q477168.name: Tartar District
Q477168.about: Tartar District (Azerbaijani: Tərtər rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country and belongs to the Karabakh Economic Region.

Q477942.name: Tadla-Azilal
Q477942.about: Tadla-Azilal (Arabic: تادلة أزيلال) was formerly one of the sixteen regions of Morocco from 1997 to 2015. It was situated in central Morocco.

Q707.name: Flevoland
Q707.about: Flevoland (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈfleːvoːlɑnt] ) is the twelfth and newest province of the Netherlands, established in 1986, when the southern and eastern Flevopolders, together with the Noordoostpolder, were merged into one provincial entity. It is in the centre of the country in the former Zuiderzee, which was turned into the freshwater IJsselmeer by the closure of the Afsluitdijk in 1932.

Q776.name: Utrecht
Q776.about: Utrecht (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈytrɛxt] ), officially the Province of Utrecht (Dutch: Provincie Utrecht), is a province of the Netherlands. It is located in the centre of the country, bordering the Eemmeer in the north-east, the province of Gelderland in the east and south-east, the province of South Holland in the west and south-west and the province of North Holland in the north-west and north.

Q506658.name: Ajloun Governorate
Q506658.about: Ajloun Governorate (alternative spelling Ajlun Governorate) (Arabic: محافظة عجلون) is one of the governorates of Jordan, located north of Amman the capital of Jordan. Ajloun Governorate has the fourth highest population density in Jordan (after Irbid, Jerash, and Balqa Governorates) with a population density of 350.1 people/km2 (2012 estimate).

Q508804.name: Sacatepéquez Department
Q508804.about: Sacatepéquez (Spanish pronunciation: [sakateˈpekes]) is one of the 22 departments of Guatemala. The name comes from Sacatepéquez, a city from 21 November 1542, until 29 July 1773, when it was destroyed by the 1773 Guatemala earthquake.
Q508804.img: Cerro de la Cruz, Antigua Guatemala 04.jpg

Q526176.name: San Pedro Department
Q526176.about: San Pedro (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsam‿ˈpe.ðɾo]) is a department of Paraguay. The capital is the city of San Pedro de Ycuamandiyú.

Q534203.name: Kyankwanzi District
Q534203.about: Kyankwanzi District is the westernmost district in the Central Region of Uganda and Buganda Kingdom, bordering Bunyoro. The district headquarters are in Butemba Town.

Q549386.name: Hermanas Mirabal Province
Q549386.about: Hermanas Mirabal (Spanish pronunciation: [eɾˈmanas miɾaˈβal]; named after the Mirabal sisters) is a province of the Dominican Republic. It was split from Espaillat Province in 1952 and was originally called Salcedo, the name of its capital city; it is still referred to by this name sometimes.

Q569468.name: Anseba Region
Q569468.about: Anseba region (Tigrinya: ዞባ ዓንሰባ, Arabic: إقليم عنسبا) is an administrative region of Eritrea, located in northern Eritrea. The capital and the most populous city in the region is Keren.

Q570358.name: Masaya Department
Q570358.about: Masaya (Formerly Masayan), (Spanish pronunciation: [maˈsaʝa]), (Nahuatl languages: Masāyān) is a department in Nicaragua. It is the country's smallest department by area (611 km2) and has a population of 397,632 (2021 estimate).
Q570358.img: Masaya church in the Central Park.jpg

Q688589.name: Kurdamir District
Q688589.about: Kurdamir district (Azerbaijani: Kürdəmir rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the centre of the country, it belongs to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q695660.name: Guatemala Department
Q695660.about: Guatemala Department is one of the 22 departments of Guatemala.  The capital is Guatemala City, which also serves as the national capital.

Q728015.name: Estelí Department
Q728015.about: Esteli is an administrative division and department in northern Nicaragua. The city of Estelí serves as the capital of the department.

Q1091595.name: Mbarara District
Q1091595.about: Mbarara District is a district in South Western Uganda. In 2019, the Ugandan Cabinet approved part of Mbarara District, the then-Mbarara municipality, to be upgraded to city status effective July 2020.

Q1114938.name: Buyende District
Q1114938.about: Buyende District is a district in Eastern Uganda. It is named after Buyende, the 'chief town' in the district and the location of the district headquarters.

Q1114954.name: Lwengo District
Q1114954.about: Lwengo District is a district in the Central Region of Uganda. Kyazanga Town council  is the largest town in the district and the location of the district headquarters.

Q1114977.name: Luuka District
Q1114977.about: Luuka District is a district in Eastern Uganda.

Q1123208.name: Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas Province
Q1123208.about: Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas (Spanish pronunciation: [ˌsanto ðoˈmiŋgo ðe los ˈtsatʃilas]) is a province in the Republic of Ecuador, created in October 2007 from territory previously in the province of Pichincha.
Q1123208.wiki: Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas Province

Q1123380.name: Yoro Department
Q1123380.about: Yoro is one of the 18 departments into which Honduras is divided. The department contains rich agricultural lands, concentrated mainly on the valley of the Aguan River and the Sula Valley, on opposite ends.

Q1130677.name: Cuscatlán Department
Q1130677.about: Cuscatlán (Spanish pronunciation: [kuskaˈtlan]) is a department of El Salvador, located in the center of the country. With a surface area of 756.19 square kilometres (291.97 mi2), it is El Salvador's smallest department.

Q1953.name: Yerevan
Q1953.desc: capital and largest city of Armenia
Q1953.about: Yerevan (UK:  YERR-ə-VAN, US: , -⁠VAHN; Armenian: Երևան [jɛɾɛˈvɑn] ; sometimes spelled Erevan) is the capital and largest city of Armenia, as well as one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities. Situated along the Hrazdan River, Yerevan is the administrative, cultural, and industrial centre of the country, as its primate city.
Q1953.img: Mount Ararat and the Yerevan skyline in spring (28mm).jpg

Q2841.name: Bogotá
Q2841.about: Bogotá (, also UK: , US: , Spanish pronunciation: [boɣoˈta] ) is the capital and largest city of Colombia. The city is administered as the Capital District, as well as the capital of, though not politically part of, the surrounding department of Cundinamarca.

Q596885.name: Blaenau Gwent
Q596885.about: Blaenau Gwent (; Welsh: [ˈbləi.nai]) is a county borough in the south-east of Wales. It borders Monmouthshire and Torfaen to the east, Caerphilly to the west and Powys to the north.

Q601105.name: Saatly District
Q601105.about: Saatly District (Azerbaijani: Saatlı rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. It is located in the centre of the country, belonging to the Central Aran Economic Region.

Q604966.name: Kibaale District
Q604966.about: Kibaale District is a district in the Western Region of Uganda. The district headquarters are in the town of Kibaale.

Q623302.name: Dalaba Prefecture
Q623302.about: Dalaba (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤁𞤢𞤤𞤢𞤦𞤢𞥄) is a prefecture located in the Mamou Region of Guinea. The capital is Dalaba.

Q647808.name: San José Province
Q647808.about: San José (Spanish pronunciation: [saŋ xoˈse]) is a province of Costa Rica. It is located in the central part of the country, and borders (clockwise beginning in the north) the provinces of Alajuela, Heredia, Limón, Cartago and Puntarenas.

Q648249.name: Fès-méknas-boulmane
Q648249.about: Fès-Boulemane (Arabic: فاس بولمان) was formerly one of the sixteen regions of Morocco from 1997 to 2015. It was situated in an agricultural region of northern Morocco, and borders Rif Mountains to the north.

Q652867.name: Kampong Speu Province
Q652867.about: Kampong Speu (Khmer: កំពង់ស្ពឺ, Kâmpóng Spœ [kɑmpɔŋ spɨː]; lit. 'port of star fruit') is a province of Cambodia. It borders the provinces of Pursat and Kampong Chhnang to the north, Kandal to the east, Takéo to the southeast, Kampot to the south and Koh Kong to the west.

Q1741.name: Vienna
Q1741.desc: capital of and state in Austria
Q1741.about: Vienna (  vee-EN-ə; German: Wien [viːn] ; Austro-Bavarian: Wean [veɐ̯n]) is the capital, most populous city, and one of the nine states of Austria. It is Austria's primate city, with just over two million inhabitants.
Q1741.img: Wien katedra sw Szczepana widok z wiezy 6.jpg

Q11725.name: Chongqing
Q11725.about: Chongqing is a provincial-level direct-administered municipality in Southwestern China. It is one of the four direct-administered municipalities of China and the only one located inland.

Q128186.name: Saitama Prefecture
Q128186.about: Saitama Prefecture (埼玉県, Saitama-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [sä́ì.tä̀.mä̀, sä̀í.tä́.mä́(.kè̞ɴ̀)]) is an inland prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Saitama Prefecture has a population of 7,338,536 (January 1, 2020) and has a geographic area of 3,797 km2 (1,466 sq mi).
Q128186.img: Aerial photograph of 2019 Typhoon Hagibis flood in Saitama prefecture - GSI 5720.jpg

Q129499.name: Gunma Prefecture
Q129499.about: Gunma Prefecture (群馬県, Gunma-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɡɯ̈́m̀.mä̀, ɡɯ̈̀ḿ.mä́.kè̞ɴ̀, ɡɯ̈́ḿ.mä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is an inland prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Gunma Prefecture has a population of 1,937,626 (1 October 2019) and has a geographic area of 6,362 square kilometres (2,456 sq mi).

Q489821.name: Antananarivo Province
Q489821.about: Antananarivo Province is a former province of Madagascar with an area of 58,283 square kilometres (22,503 mi2). It had a population of 5,370,900 in 2004.

Q498443.name: Chontales Department
Q498443.about: Chontales (Spanish: Departamento de Chontales) (Spanish pronunciation: [tʃonˈtales]) is a department in Nicaragua. It covers an area of 6,481 km2 (2,502 sq mi) and has a population of 191,856.

Q502148.name: Kampong Thom Province
Q502148.about: Kampong Thom (Khmer: កំពង់ធំ, UNGEGN: Kâmpóng Thum [kɑmpɔŋ tʰom]; lit. 'Great Port') is a province (khaet) of Cambodia.

Q1850.name: Phnom Penh
Q1850.about: Phnom Penh is the capital and most populous city of Cambodia. It has been the national capital since 1865 and has grown to become the nation's primate city and its political, economic, industrial, and cultural centre.

Q1207391.name: Kayunga District
Q1207391.about: Kayunga District is a district in Central Uganda. It is named after its chief town, Kayunga.

Q1229750.name: Apac District
Q1229750.about: Apac District is a district in the Northern Region of Uganda. The Town of Apac hosts the district headquarters.
Q1229750.img: Inspection of rice fields in Apac, Uganda.jpg

Q1229869.name: Iganga District
Q1229869.about: Iganga District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Iganga is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1229906.name: Kaberamaido District
Q1229906.about: Kaberamaido is a district in Eastern Uganda. Like most other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Kaberamaido, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1229930.name: Katakwi District
Q1229930.about: Katakwi District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Katakwi is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1230005.name: Mityana District
Q1230005.about: The Mityana District is a district in the Central Region of Uganda. The district was created in 2005, by taking the Mityana and Busujju counties from Mubende District.

Q1230035.name: Pader District
Q1230035.about: Pader District is a district in Northern Uganda. It is named after Pader, the chief municipal, administrative and commercial town in the district, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1262745.name: Duarte Province
Q1262745.about: Duarte (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈdwaɾte]) is a northeastern province which comprises one of the 32 provinces of the Dominican Republic. It is divided into 7 municipalities and its capital city is San Francisco de Macorís.

Q956.name: Beijing
Q956.about: Beijing, previously romanized as Peking, is the capital city of China. With more than 21.8 million residents, it is the world's most populous national capital city, as well as China's second-largest city by urban area, after Shanghai.
Q956.img: Skyline of Beijing CBD with B-5906 approaching (20211016171955).jpg

Q64.name: Berlin
Q64.desc: federated state, capital and largest city of Germany
Q64.about: Berlin is the capital and largest city of Germany. With 3.7 million inhabitants, it has the highest population within its city limits of any city in the European Union (EU).

Q130566.name: Maniema
Q130566.desc: province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q130566.about: Maniema Province (Mkoa wa Maniema, in Swahili) is one of 26 provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Its capital is Kindu.

Q131277.name: Gifu Prefecture
Q131277.about: Gifu Prefecture (岐阜県, Gifu-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɡ̟ʲì.ɸɯ̈́, -ɸɯ̥̈.kè̞ɴ̀, -ké̞ɴ̀]) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. Gifu Prefecture has a population of 2,040,000 (as of April 1, 2025) and has a geographic area of 10,621 square kilometres (4,101 sq mi).

Q131287.name: Nara Prefecture
Q131287.about: Nara Prefecture (奈良県, Nara-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [nä́.ɾä̀, nä̀.ɾä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is an inland prefecture of Japan located in the Kansai region of Honshu. As of 2020, Nara Prefecture has a population of 1,321,805 and has a geographic area of 3,691 square kilometres (1,425 sq mi).

Q131290.name: Ganja
Q131290.about: Ganja (; Azerbaijani: Gəncə [ɟænˈdʒæ] ) is Azerbaijan's third largest city, with a population of around 335,600. The city has been a historic and cultural center throughout most of its existence.

Q13721.name: Agusan del Sur
Q13721.about: Agusan del Sur, officially the Province of Agusan del Sur (lit. 'Southern Agusan'; Cebuano: Habagatang Agusan; Butuanon: Probinsya hong Agusan del Sur; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Agusan del Sur); is a landlocked province in Caraga region, Mindanao, Philippines. Its capital is the municipality of Prosperidad.

Q13753.name: Bukidnon
Q13753.about: Bukidnon (), officially the Province of Bukidnon (Cebuano: Lalawigan sa Bukidnon; Filipino: Lalawigan ng Bukidnon; Hiligaynon: Kapuoran sang Bukidnon; Binukid and Higaonon: Probinsya ta Bukidnon), is a landlocked province in the Philippines located in the Northern Mindanao region. Its capital is the city of Malaybalay while Valencia is the largest city.

Q13882.name: South Cotabato
Q13882.about: South Cotabato, officially the Province of South Cotabato, is a province in the Philippines located in the Soccsksargen region in Mindanao. Its capital is Koronadal (also the regional center of Soccsksargen), and it borders Sultan Kudarat to the north and west, Sarangani to the south and northeast, and Davao del Sur to the far northeast.

Q13984.name: Casanare Department
Q13984.about: Casanare (Spanish pronunciation: [kasaˈnaɾe], Spanish: Departamento de Casanare) is a department located in the central eastern of Colombia. It is famous for its oil and natural gas production as well as its livestock and extensive plains.

Q13985.name: Caquetá Department
Q13985.about: Caquetá Department (Spanish pronunciation: [kakeˈta]) is one of the 32 departments of Colombia. It is located within the country's Amazon natural region and the Amazon rainforest.

Q13995.name: Quindío Department
Q13995.about: Quindío (Spanish pronunciation: [kinˈdi.o]) is a department of Colombia. It is located in the western central of the country, specifically in the Andean region.

Q13993.name: Risaralda Department
Q13993.about: Risaralda (Spanish pronunciation: [risaˈɾalda]) is a department of Colombia. It is located in the western central of the country, in the Andean region, It is part of the Coffee axis with Caldas and Quindío.

Q502181.name: Cartago Province
Q502181.about: Cartago (Spanish pronunciation: [kaɾˈtaɣo]), which means Carthage in Spanish, is a province of central Costa Rica. It is one of the smallest provinces, however probably the richest of the Spanish Colonial era sites and traditions.

Q504252.name: Tungurahua Province
Q504252.about: Tungurahua (Spanish: Provincia del Tungurahua, literally Province of the Tungurahua; pronounced [tuŋɡuˈɾawa]) is one of the twenty-four provinces of Ecuador. Its capital is Ambato.

Q504260.name: Los Ríos Province
Q504260.about: Los Ríos (Spanish pronunciation: [los ˈri.os]) is a province in Ecuador. The province's capital is Babahoyo.

Q504647.name: Baja Verapaz Department
Q504647.about: Baja Verapaz (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈbaxa βeɾaˈpas]) is a department in Guatemala. In 2018, the population of the department was 299,476.

Q505220.name: Huancavelica Department
Q505220.about: Huancavelica (Spanish pronunciation: [waŋkaβeˈlika] ; Quechua: Wankawillka) is a department of Peru. It is bordered by the departments of Lima and Ica in the west, Junín in the north, and Ayacucho in the east.

Q1295496.name: Monseñor Nouel Province
Q1295496.about: Monseñor Nouel (Spanish pronunciation: [monseˈɲoɾ noˈwel]) is a province in the central region of the Dominican Republic. It was split from La Vega province in 1982.
Q1295496.img: Monseñor Nouel Province, 42000, Dominican Republic - panoramio (1).jpg

Q1318806.name: Kamwenge District
Q1318806.about: Kamwenge District is a district in Western Uganda. It is named after its 'chief town', Kamwenge, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1318815.name: Kyenjojo District
Q1318815.about: Kyenjojo District is a district in the Western Region of Uganda. Kyenjojo town is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1318822.name: Amolatar District
Q1318822.about: Amolatar District is a district in Northern Uganda. Like many other Ugandan districts, it is named after its main municipal and administrative centre, Amolatar Town.The district is divided into two constituencies which include Kioga South and Kioga North.

Q1318833.name: Oyam District
Q1318833.about: Oyam District is a district in Northern Uganda. Like most Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Oyam, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1318843.name: Kotido District
Q1318843.about: Kotido District is a district in Northern Uganda. It is named after its 'chief town', Kotido, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1318872.name: Dokolo District
Q1318872.about: Dokolo District is a district in the Northern Region of Uganda. The town of Dokolo is its main municipal, administrative, and commercial centre.

Q1206.name: Saxony-Anhalt
Q1206.about: Saxony-Anhalt (  ... AHN-hahlt; German: Sachsen-Anhalt [ˌzaksn̩ ˈʔanhalt] ; Low German: Sassen-Anholt) is a landlocked state of Germany.

Q1205.name: Thuringia
Q1205.desc: federated state in the center of Germany
Q1205.about: Thuringia (English: ; German: Thüringen [ˈtyːʁɪŋən]  officially the Free State of Thuringia, Freistaat Thüringen [ˈfʁaɪʃtaːt ˈtyːʁɪŋən]) is a landlocked state in central Germany. With 2.1 million people, it is 12th-largest by population, and with 16,171 square kilometers, it is 11th-largest in area.

Q1435.name: Zagreb
Q1435.about: Zagreb ( ZAH-greb; Croatian: [zǎːɡreb] ) is the capital and largest city of Croatia. It is in the north of the country, along the Sava River, at the southern slopes of the Medvednica mountain.

Q131358.name: Shiga Prefecture
Q131358.about: Shiga Prefecture (滋賀県, Shiga-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [ɕí.ɡä̀, -ŋä̀, ɕì.ɡä́.kè̞ɴ̀, -ŋä́.kè̞ɴ̀]) is an inland prefecture of Japan in the Kansai region of Honshu. Shiga Prefecture has a population of 1,398,972 as of 1 February 2025 and has a geographic area of 4,017 km2 (1,551 sq mi).

Q132720.name: Yamanashi Prefecture
Q132720.about: Yamanashi Prefecture (山梨県, Yamanashi-ken) is a prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. Yamanashi Prefecture has a population of 787,592 (1 February 2025) and has a geographic area of 4,465 km2 (1,724 sq mi).

Q1318877.name: Ibanda District
Q1318877.about: Ibanda District is a district in the Western Region of Uganda. The town of Ibanda is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1362109.name: Mpigi District
Q1362109.about: Mpigi District is a district in Central Uganda. Like most other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'main town', Mpigi.
Q1362109.img: Cleaning of a fishpond in Mbazzi, Mpigi district, Uganda.jpg

Q1364817.name: Luwero District
Q1364817.about: Luweero District (also spelled as Luwero) is a district in the Central Region of Uganda. Luweero is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1375762.name: Amuria District
Q1375762.about: Amuria District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Amuria serves as the district headquarters.

Q1375780.name: Abim District
Q1375780.about: Abim District is a district in Northern Uganda. It is named after its 'chief town', Abim, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1375859.name: Kaliro District
Q1375859.about: Kaliro District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. It was created out of the eastern part of Kamuli District in 2006.

Q186220.name: County Longford
Q186220.about: County Longford (Irish: Contae an Longfoirt) is a county in Ireland. It is in the province of Leinster.

Q186392.name: Ghor Province
Q186392.about: Ghōr (Pashto, Dari: غور) also known as Ghowr or Ghur, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan. It is located in the western Hindu Kush in central Afghanistan, towards the northwest.

Q188068.name: Järva County
Q188068.about: Järva County (Estonian: Järva maakond or Järvamaa; German: Jerwen; Latin: Jervia) is one of 15 counties of Estonia. It is located in the central part of the country, and it borders Lääne-Viru County to the east, Jõgeva County to the southeast, Viljandi County to the south, Pärnu County to the southwest, Rapla County to the west, and Harju County to the north.

Q188157.name: Parwan Province
Q188157.about: Parwan is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan. It is the largest province of the Greater Parwan region, and has a population of about 751,000.

Q164474.name: Kamuli District
Q164474.about: Kamuli District  is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Kamuli is the site of the district headquarters.

Q165784.name: West
Q165784.about: The West Region (French: Région de l'Ouest) is 14,000 km2 of territory located in the central-western portion of the Republic of Cameroon. It borders the Northwest Region to the northwest, the Adamawa Region to the northeast, the Centre Region to the southeast, the Littoral Region to the southwest, and the Southwest Region to the west.

Q165954.name: Jwaneng
Q165954.about: Jwaneng is a town located in the Southern District of Botswana, but it is not part of this, being a separate district, with its own Town Council.

Q167279.name: Pemagatshel District
Q167279.about:
Pemagatshel District (Dzongkha: པདྨ་དགའ་ཚལ་་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Pema-gatshel rdzong-khag) is one of the 20 Dzongkhags (districts) in Bhutan.
Until 1970 the district was known as Khoi Dung.

Q168953.name: Aïn Defla Province
Q168953.about: Aïn Defla (Arabic: ولاية عين الدفلى, is a wilaya (province) in northern Algeria, located to the southwest of Algiers, the capital. Localities in Ain Delfa include Aïn Defla, Miliana, El Attaf, Djelida and Djendel.

Q170309.name: Baghlan Province
Q170309.about: Baghlan (Dari: ولایت بغلان, romanized: Wilāyat-e Baghlān and Pashto: د بغلان ولایت, romanized: Da Baghlān Wilāyat) is one of the northern provinces of Afghanistan. It is bordered by Samangan to the west, Kunduz to the northeast, Takhar to the east, Bamyan to the southwest, and Parwan and Panjshir to the south.

Q171382.name: Bamyan Province
Q171382.about:
Bamyan (Pashto, Dari: بامیان), also spelled Bamiyan, Bāmīān or Bāmyān, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan with the city of Bamyan as its center, located in central parts of Afghanistan.
The terrain in Bamyan is mountainous or semi-mountainous, at the western end of the Hindu Kush mountains concurrent with the Himalayas.

Q173332.name: County Kildare
Q173332.about: County Kildare (Irish: Contae Chill Dara) is a county in Ireland. It is in the province of Leinster and is part of the Eastern and Midland Region.

Q173816.name: Kapisa Province
Q173816.about: Kapisa is the smallest of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the northeastern part of the country. It has an estimated population of 523,201 people and an area of 1,842 km2 (711 sq mi), making it the most densely populated province apart from Kabul Province.

Q184445.name: County Offaly
Q184445.about: County Offaly (; Irish: Contae Uíbh Fhailí) is a county in Ireland. It is part of the Eastern and Midland Region and the province of Leinster.

Q184618.name: County Tipperary
Q184618.about: County Tipperary (Irish: Contae Thiobraid Árann) is a county in Ireland. It is in the province of Munster and the Southern Region.

Q185442.name: Laghman Province
Q185442.about: Laghmān (Pashto, Dari: لغمان), historically known as Lamghan, or Lamghanat, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the eastern part of the country. It has a population of about 502,148, which is multi-ethnic and mostly a rural society.

Q180379.name: Rēzekne
Q180379.about: Rēzekne (Latvian: [ˈrɛːzekne] , Latgalian: Rēzne pronounced [rʲæːzʲnʲæ] or Rēzekne pronounced [ˈrʲæːzʲækʲnʲæ], Russian: Резекне) is a state city in the Rēzekne River valley in the Latgale region of eastern Latvia. It is called The Heart of Latgale (Latvian: Latgales sirds, Latgalian: Latgolys sirds).

Q180414.name: Batha Region
Q180414.about: Batha (Arabic: البطحة, romanized: al-Baṭḥā) is one of the 23 regions of Chad, located in the centre of the country. It is composed of what was formerly Batha Prefecture with some slight boundary adjustments.

Q180415.name: Ghazni Province
Q180415.about: Ghazni (Pashto: غزني, Pashto pronunciation: [ɣaz.ni]; Dari: غزنی, Dari pronunciation: [ɣäz.níː]) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in southeastern Afghanistan. The province contains 19 districts, encompassing over a thousand villages and roughly 1.3 million people, making it the 5th most populous province.

Q181882.name: County Carlow
Q181882.about: County Carlow (  KAR-loh; Irish: Contae Cheatharlach) is a county located in the Southern Region of Ireland, within the province of Leinster. Carlow is the second smallest and the third least populous of Ireland's 32 traditional counties.

Q182487.name: Sar-e Pol Province
Q182487.about: Sar-e-Pol (Pashto, Dari: سر پل; lit. 'bridge head'), also spelled Sari Pul, is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the north of the country.

Q1772983.name: Santiago Province
Q1772983.about: Santiago (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo]) is one of the 32 provinces of the Dominican Republic. It is divided into 10 municipalities and its capital city is Santiago de los Caballeros.
Q1772983.img: Monument to the Heroes of the Restoration1.JPG

Q1781303.name: Labé Prefecture
Q1781303.about: Labé (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤂𞤢𞤦𞤫) is a prefecture in the Labé Region of Guinea. The capital is Labé.

Q1796621.name: Sîngerei District
Q1796621.about:
Sîngerei (Romanian pronunciation: [sɨndʒerej]) is a district (Romanian: raion) in the north of Moldova, with the administrative center at Sîngerei.
The other major city is Biruința.
Q1796621.img: AIRM - Museum of History and Ethnography of Sîngerei - sep 2015.jpg

Q1836903.name: Sánchez Ramírez Province
Q1836903.about:
Sánchez Ramírez (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsantʃes ɾaˈmiɾes]) 
It is spread over an area of 1,185.3 km2 (457.6 sq mi), and has its capital at Cotuí. It was established in 1952.

Q1837354.name: Rugāji Municipality
Q1837354.about: Rugāji Municipality (Latvian: Rugāju novads; Latgalian: Ruguoju nūvods) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Rugāji Parish and Lazdukalns Parish, the administrative centre being Rugāji.

Q1995769.name: Alsunga Municipality
Q1995769.about: Alsunga Municipality (Latvian: Alsungas novads) was a municipality in the historical region of Courland in Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 from Alsunga Parish.

Q2001793.name: San Juan Province
Q2001793.about: San Juan (Spanish pronunciation: [saŋ ˈxwan]) is a province of the Dominican Republic. Established as Benefactor during the Age of Trujillo in 1938, it was renamed San Juan in 1961.

Q2017517.name: Kosovska Mitrovica District
Q2017517.about: The Kosovska Mitrovica District (Serbian: Косовскомитровачки округ, romanized: Kosovskomitrovački okrug) was an administrative district of Serbia between 1992 and the end of the Kosovo War in 1999. The administrative center of the Kosovska Mitrovica District was the city of Kosovska Mitrovica.

Q845706.name: Lacs Region
Q845706.about: Lacs Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q845709.name: Haut-Sassandra
Q845709.about: Haut-Sassandra Region is one of the 31 regions of Ivory Coast and is one of two regions in Sassandra-Marahoué District. The region's seat is Daloa.
Q845709.img: CENTRE CULTUREL DE DALOA COTE D'IVOIRE.jpg

Q845721.name: Vallée du Bandama Region
Q845721.about: Vallée du Bandama Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q846056.name: Worodougou
Q846056.about: Worodougou Region is one of the 31 regions of Ivory Coast and is currently one of three regions of Woroba District. The region's seat is Séguéla.

Q848613.name: Islamabad Capital Territory
Q848613.about: The Islamabad Capital Territory is a federal territory of Pakistan, centred around Islamabad, the capital of Pakistan. It is located on the northern edge of the Pothohar Plateau, at the foot of the Margalla Hills, in the northwestern Punjab region.
Q848613.img: Islamabad top view from margala hills.jpg

Q856227.name: Nana-Grébizi Economic Prefecture
Q856227.desc: economic prefecture of the Central African Republic
Q856227.about: Nana-Grébizi is one of the 20 prefectures of the Central African Republic. It covers an area of 19,996 km2 and has a population of 117,816 (2003 census).

Q865594.name: Drochia District
Q865594.about: Drochia district (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈdroki.a]) is a district in the north of Moldova. Its administrative center is the city of Drochia.
Q865594.img: Дрокия, дом культуры Casa raionala de cultura din Drochia Drochia House of Culture (43533051121).jpg

Q865649.name: Pļaviņas Municipality
Q865649.about: Pļaviņas Municipality (Latvian: Pļaviņu novads) is a former municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Aiviekste parish, Klintaine parish, Vietalva parish and Pļaviņas town the administrative centre being Pļaviņas.

Q2021942.name: Santiago Rodríguez Province
Q2021942.about: Santiago Rodríguez (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo roˈðɾiɣes]) is a province in the northwest region of the Dominican Republic. It was split from Monte Cristi in 1948.

Q2024643.name: Kandava Municipality
Q2024643.about: Kandava Municipality (Latvian: Kandavas novads) is a former municipality in Courland, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 1999 by merging Cēre Parish and Kandava town with its countryside territory.

Q2030886.name: Baldone Municipality
Q2030886.about: Baldone Municipality (Latvian: Baldones novads) is a former Latvian municipality situated partly in the province of Semigallia and partly in Vidzeme. The municipality was formed in 2008 by merging Baldone town and its countryside territory, with the administrative centre being Baldone.

Q2045300.name: Aglona Municipality
Q2045300.about: Aglona Municipality (Latvian: Aglonas novads) was a municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The administrative centre was Aglona.

Q2072154.name: Jaunpils Municipality
Q2072154.about: Jaunpils Municipality (Latvian: Jaunpils novads) is a former Latvian municipality situated partly in the region of  Semigallia and partly in Courland. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Jaunpils Parish and Viesati Parish, the administrative centre being Jaunpils.

Q2072209.name: Ķegums Municipality
Q2072209.about: Ķegums Municipality (Latvian: Ķeguma novads) is a former municipality in Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2002 by merging Rembate parish and Ķegums town with its countryside territory.

Q2079353.name: Babīte Municipality
Q2079353.about: Babīte Municipality (Latvian: Babītes novads) was a municipality in Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 when Babīte Parish and Sala Parish of the dissolved Riga district were merged.

Q2106159.name: Riebiņi Municipality
Q2106159.about: Riebiņi Municipality (Latvian: Riebiņu novads, Latgalian: Ribinišku nūvods) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2004 by merging Galēni Parish, Riebiņi Parish, Rušona Parish, Silajāņi Parish, Sīļukalns Parish and Stabulnieki Parish.

Q2140753.name: Salaspils Municipality
Q2140753.about: Salaspils Municipality (Latvian: Salaspils novads) is a municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2004 by reorganization of Salaspils town and its rural territory, the administrative centre being Salaspils.

Q2171669.name: Garkalne Municipality
Q2171669.about: Garkalne Municipality (Latvian: Garkalnes novads) was a municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2007 by reorganization of Garkalne Parish of Riga district.
Q2171669.img: Garkalne, piemineklis represētajiem Ropažu stacijā 2000-07-02 - panoramio.jpg

Q191120.name: Jēkabpils
Q191120.desc: state city of Latvia in Jēkabpils Municipality, municipal center
Q191120.about: Jēkabpils (Latvian: [ˈjeːkapːils] ) is a state city in Jēkabpils Municipality in southeastern Latvia, located roughly halfway between the capital Riga and Daugavpils, and spanning the Daugava River. It is a state city (although without a separate municipal government), and is the seat of Jēkabpils Municipality.

Q192352.name: Rapla County
Q192352.about: Rapla County (Estonian: Rapla maakond or Raplamaa) is one of the fifteen counties of Estonia. It is located in the northwestern part of the country and borders Järva County to the east, Pärnu County to the south, Lääne County to the west, and Harju County to the north.

Q192959.name: Minsk region
Q192959.about: Minsk region, also known as Minsk oblast or Minsk voblasts, is one of the six regions of Belarus. Its administrative center is Minsk, although it is a separate administrative territorial entity of Belarus.

Q193044.name: Ialomița County
Q193044.about: Ialomița County (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈjalomitsa] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Muntenia, with the capital city at Slobozia.

Q3919.name: Gaborone
Q3919.about: Gaborone (UK:  GAB-ə-ROH-nee, HAB-, US:  GAH-bə-ROH-nee, -⁠nay, Tswana: [χabʊˈrʊnɛ]) is the capital and largest city of Botswana. It was formerly spelled as Gaberones during the colonial era, a name occasionally used in older English texts and maps.

Q4511.name: Kotayk Province
Q4511.about: Kotayk (Armenian: Կոտայք, Armenian pronunciation: [kɔˈtɑjkʰ] ), is a province (marz) of Armenia. It is located at the central part of the country.

Q9361.name: Bishkek
Q9361.about: Bishkek, formerly known as Pishpek (until 1926), and then Frunze (1926–1991), is the capital and largest city of Kyrgyzstan, and the capital of the Chüy Region. It is situated near the border with Kazakhstan and has a population of around 1,200,000 people as of 2024.

Q80953.name: Kasaï-Oriental
Q80953.desc: former province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Q80953.about:
Kasaï-Oriental (French for "East Kasai") was one of the eleven provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo between 1966 and 2015, when it was split into the new, smaller Kasai-Oriental province, the Lomami and the Sankuru provinces.
It borders the provinces of Kasaï-Occidental to the west, Équateur to the northwest, Orientale to the northeast, Maniema to the east, and Katanga to the south.

Q119158.name: Federal District
Q119158.desc: federal district of Brazil, a federative unit in the Central-West Region of Brazil
Q119158.about: The Federal District (Portuguese: Distrito Federal [dʒisˈtɾitu fedeˈɾaw] ) is one of 27 federative units of Brazil. Located in the Center-West Region, it is the smallest Brazilian federal unit and the only one that has no municipalities, being divided into 35 administrative regions.

Q127877.name: Nagano Prefecture
Q127877.about: Nagano Prefecture (長野県, Nagano-ken; Japanese pronunciation: [nä́.ɡä̀.nò̞, -ŋä̀.nò̞, nä̀.ɡä́.nó̞.kè̞ɴ̀, -ŋä́.nó̞-], locally [nä̀.ŋä́.nó̞]) is a landlocked prefecture of Japan located in the Chūbu region of Honshu. It has a population of 2,007,682 as of 1 July 2023 and a geographic area of 13,561.56 square kilometres (5,236.15 sq mi).

Q201647.name: Aghdam
Q201647.about: Aghdam District (Azerbaijani: Ağdam rayonu) is one of the 66 administrative divisions of Azerbaijan. It is located in the west of the country and belongs to the Karabakh Economic Region.

Q205057.name: Cusco Department
Q205057.about: Cusco,  also spelled Cuzco (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkusko]; Aymara and Quechua: Qusqu [ˈqɔsqɔ]), is a department of Peru. It is the fourth-largest in the country, after Madre de Dios, Ucayali, and Loreto, and borders the departments of Ucayali on the north; Madre de Dios and Puno on the east; Arequipa on the south; and Apurímac, Ayacucho and Junín on the west.

Q205112.name: Ayacucho Department
Q205112.about: Ayacucho (Spanish pronunciation: [aʝaˈkutʃo] ; Quechua: Ayakuchu), known as Huamanga (Quechua: Wamanqa) from its creation in 1822 until 1825, is a department of Peru. It is located in the south-central Andes of the country.

Q206519.name: Lira District
Q206519.about: Lira District is a district in Northern Uganda. Like many other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Lira.

Q207973.name: Junín Department
Q207973.about: Junín (Spanish pronunciation: [xuˈnin]; Quechua: Sunin) is a department of Peru. It is located in the central highlands and westernmost Peruvian Amazon.

Q3258.name: Australian Capital Territory
Q3258.desc: federal governing territory of Australia, containing the capital city, Canberra
Q3258.about: The Australian Capital Territory (ACT), known as the Federal Capital Territory until 1938, is an internal territory of Australia. Canberra, the capital city of Australia, is situated within the territory and is the territory's primate city.

Q208185.name: Apurímac Department
Q208185.about: Apurímac (Spanish pronunciation: [apuˈɾimak])  is a department of Peru. Located in the southern-central part of the country, it is bordered on the east by Cuzco, on the west by Ayacucho, and on the south by the Arequipa and Ayacucho.

Q209187.name: Gulbene Municipality
Q209187.about: Gulbene Municipality (Latvian: Gulbenes novads) is a municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Beļava parish, Dauksti parish, Druviena parish, Galgauska parish, Jaungulbene parish, Lejasciems parish, Litene parish, Lizums parish, Līgo parish, Ranka parish, Stāmeriena parish, Stradi parish, Tirza parish and Gulbene town the administrative centre being Gulbene.

Q211208.name: Pasco Department
Q211208.about: Pasco (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpasko]; Quechua: Pasqu) is a department of Peru. It is located in the country's central highlands.

Q211793.name: San Martin Department
Q211793.about: San Martín (Spanish pronunciation: [sam maɾˈtin]) is a department of Peru. Located in the country's north, most of the department is located in the upper part of the Peruvian Amazon rainforest.

Q211900.name: Napo Province
Q211900.about: Napo (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈnapo]) is a province of Ecuador. Its capital is Tena.

Q213950.name: Khenchela Province
Q213950.about: Khenchela Province (Arabic: ولاية خنشلة) is a province (wilaya) in the Aurès region in Algeria.

Q17601.name: Ghardaïa Province
Q17601.about: Ghardaïa (Arabic: ولاية غرداية) is an Algerian province located in the north of the Algerian desert. Its administrative center is the city of Ghardaia, located 600 km (370 mi) south of the capital Algiers.

Q19770.name: Sichuan
Q19770.desc: province of China, previously inclusive of the present Chongqing Municipality
Q19770.about: Sichuan is an inland province in Southwestern China. It is located in the Sichuan Basin and Tibetan Plateau—between the Jinsha River to the west, the Daba Mountains to the north, and the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau to the south.

Q29965.name: Asyut Governorate
Q29965.about: Asyūṭ (Arabic: محافظة أسيوط) is one of the 27 governorates of Egypt. It stretches across a section of the Nile River.

Q30656.name: Faiyum Governorate
Q30656.about: Faiyum (Arabic: محافظة الفيوم Muḥāfāzah Al Fayyūm) is one of the governorates of Egypt in the middle of the country. Its capital is the city of Faiyum, located about 81 mi (130 km) south west of Cairo.

Q182633.name: County Westmeath
Q182633.about: County Westmeath (; Irish: Contae na hIarmhí or simply An Iarmhí) is a county in Ireland. It is in the province of Leinster and is part of the Eastern and Midland Region.
Q182633.img: Bilingual GA EN sign at Mullingar Train Station (2022).jpg

Q183015.name: Samangan Province
Q183015.about: Samangan (Pashto, Dari: سمنگان) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located north of the Hindu Kush mountains in the central part of the country. The province covers 11,218 square kilometres (4,331 mi2), and is surrounded by Sar-e Pol Province in the west, Balkh in the north, Baghlan in the east and Bamyan in the south.

Q183028.name: Uruzgan Province
Q183028.about: Uruzgan (Pashto and Dari: اروزگان) is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan. It has a population of 436,079, and the province is mostly a tribal society.

Q183056.name: Maidan Wardak Province
Q183056.about: Maidan Wardak, (Pashto; Dari: میدان وردک) simply Wardak or Wardag (Pashto; Dari: وردگ), is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the central region of Afghanistan. It is divided into eight districts and has a population of approximately 500,000.

Q30669.name: Sohag Governorate
Q30669.about: Sohag (Arabic: محافظة سوهاج) is one of the governorates of Egypt. It is located in the southern part of the country (Upper Egypt), and covers a stretch of the Nile Valley.

Q30675.name: Minya Governorate
Q30675.about: Minya (Arabic: محافظة المنيا Muḥāfẓet El Minya) is one of the governorates of Upper Egypt. Its capital city, Minya, is located on the left bank of the Nile River.

Q30683.name: Beni Suef Governorate
Q30683.about: Beni Suef (Arabic: محافظة بني سويف‎ Muḥāfāzah Banī Suwīf) is one of the governorates of Egypt. It is situated in the center of the country and is located in northern Upper Egypt.

Q30786.name: Monufia Governorate
Q30786.about: Monufia or Menoufia (Arabic: محافظة المنوفية, romanized: Muḥāfaẓat al-Munūfiyya, IPA: [elmenoˈfejjæ, -mon-]) is one of the governorates of Egypt. Monufia’s name was derived from the Ancient Egyptian word Nafr, which means "The Good Land".

Q30805.name: Cairo Governorate
Q30805.about: Cairo (Arabic: محافظة القاهرة) is one of the 27 governorates of Egypt. It consists of the city of Cairo, both the capital city of Egypt and the governorate capital, in addition to six satellite cities: The New Capital, which became the official seat of national government in April 2024, New Cairo, a suburban satellite city built in the 2000s, El Shorouk, Badr, Capital Gardens, and 15th of May.

Q748065.name: Caerphilly County Borough
Q748065.desc: principal area in south-east Wales, United Kingdom
Q748065.about: Caerphilly County Borough (Welsh: Bwrdeistref Sirol Caerffili) is a county borough in the south-east of Wales. It is governed by Caerphilly County Borough Council.
Q748065.img: Recreation ground and play area, Church Street, Bedwas - geograph.org.uk - 1162202.jpg

Q750270.name: Jerash Governorate
Q750270.about: Jerash Governorate (Arabic: محافظة جرش) is one of 12 governorates in Jordan. It is located in the northwestern side of the country.
Q750270.img: Tulul adh-Dhahab and Jabbok in spring.jpg

Q755116.name: Guairá Department
Q755116.about: Guairá Department (Spanish pronunciation: [gwajˈɾa]) is one of the seventeen departments of Paraguay. Its capital and most populous city is Villarrica.

Q755121.name: Cordillera Department
Q755121.about: Cordillera (Spanish pronunciation: [koɾðiˈʎeɾa]) is a department in Paraguay. The capital is the city of Caacupé.

Q765975.name: Chimaltenango Department
Q765975.about: Chimaltenango is a department of Guatemala. The capital is Chimaltenango.

Q795441.name: Jalapa Department
Q795441.about: Jalapa is a department of Guatemala. It is located in the south east of the country with the seat and capital at the city of Jalapa.

Q795591.name: El Progreso Department
Q795591.about: El Progreso (Spanish pronunciation: [el pɾoˈɣɾeso]) is a department in Guatemala. The departmental capital is Guastatoya.

Q728099.name: Matagalpa Department
Q728099.about: Matagalpa (Spanish pronunciation: [mataˈɣalpa]) is an administrative division and department in Nicaragua. It covers an area of 6,804 km2 (2,627 sq mi) and has a population of 613,262 in 2023.

Q728922.name: Tsirang District
Q728922.about: Tsirang District (Dzongkha: རྩི་རང་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: tsi-rang rdzong-khag; previously Chirang) is one of the 20 dzongkhags (districts) of Bhutan. The administrative center of the district is Damphu.

Q728933.name: Wangdue Phodrang District
Q728933.about: Wangdue Phodrang District (Dzongkha: དབང་འདུས་ཕོ་བྲང་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: Dbang-'dus Pho-brang rdzong-khag; previously spelled "Wangdi Phodrang") is a Thromde and dzongkhag (district) of central Bhutan. This is also the name of the dzong (built in 1638) which dominates the district.
Q728933.img: The households in the midst of green paddy field embraced by beautiful rainbow.JPG

Q728938.name: Trongsa District
Q728938.about: Trongsa District (Dzongkha: ཀྲོང་གསར་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie transliteration: Krong-gsar rdzong-khag) is one of the districts of Bhutan. It is the most central district of Bhutan and the geographic centre of Bhutan is located within it at Trongsa Dzong.

Q735146.name: Dagana District
Q735146.about: Dagana District (Dzongkha: དར་དཀར་ནང་རྫོང་ཁག།; Wylie: dar-dkar-nang rzong-khag; also དར་དཀར་ན་རྫོང་ཁག།) is one of the 20 districts of Bhutan. Covering an area of 1,713 km2 (661 sq mi), it is located in the lower foothills of the mid-Himalayan ranges.

Q736507.name: Pita Prefecture
Q736507.about: Pita (Pular: 𞤍𞤢𞤤𞤭𞥅𞤪𞤫 𞤆𞤭𞤼𞤢) is a prefecture located in the Mamou Region of Guinea. The capital is Pita.

Q739951.name: Centre
Q739951.about: The Centre Region (French: région du Centre) occupies 69,000 km2 of the central plains of the Republic of Cameroon. It is bordered to the north by the Adamawa Region, to the south by the South Region, to the east by the East Region, and to the West by the Littoral and West Regions.

Q2277478.name: Krustpils Municipality
Q2277478.about: Krustpils Municipality (Latvian: Krustpils novads) is a former municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Atašiene parish, Krustpils parish, Kūkas parish, Mežāre parish, Varieši parish and Vīpe parish.

Q2277489.name: Līvāni Municipality
Q2277489.about: Līvāni Municipality (Latvian: Līvānu novads, Latgalian: Leivuona nūvods) is a municipality in Latgale, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 1999 by merging Rožupe Parish, Turki Parish and Līvāni town.

Q2286864.name: Skrīveri Municipality
Q2286864.about: Skrīveri Municipality (Latvian: Skrīveru novads) is a former municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was created in 2009 by the reorganization of Skrīveri Parish of the Aizkraukle district.

Q2299214.name: Stopiņi Municipality
Q2299214.about: Stopiņi Municipality (Latvian: Stopiņu novads) is a former municipality in the historical region of Vidzeme, and the Riga Planning Region in Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2005 through the reorganization of Stopiņi Parish, the administrative centre being Ulbroka.

Q2299239.name: Skrunda Municipality
Q2299239.about: Skrunda Municipality (Latvian: Skrundas novads) was a municipality in Courland, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Skrunda town with its countryside territory, Raņķi parish, Nīkrāce parish and Rudbārži parish; the administrative centre being Skrunda.

Q30835.name: Gharbia Governorate
Q30835.about: Gharbia (Egyptian Arabic: محافظة الغربية Muḥāfaẓat al-Gharbiyya, IPA: [elɣɑɾˈbejjɑ, -jæ], "the western governorate") is one of the governorates of Egypt. It is located in the north of the country, south of Kafr El Sheikh Governorate, and north of Monufia Governorate.

Q30832.name: Giza Governorate
Q30832.about: Giza (Arabic: محافظة الجيزة Muḥāfaẓah Al Gizah) is one of the governorates of Egypt. It is in the center of the country, situated mostly on the west bank of the Nile River opposite Cairo.

Q31065.name: Qena Governorate
Q31065.about: Qena (Arabic: محافظة قنا) is one of the governorates of Egypt. It is located in Upper Egypt, the southern part of the country.

Q31075.name: Qalyubia Governorate
Q31075.about: Qalyubia (Arabic: محافظة القليوبية Moḥāfaẓat El Qalyubiyya  Egyptian Arabic pronunciation: [elʔæljoˈbejjæ]) is one of the governorates of Egypt, located in Lower Egypt. It is situated north of Cairo in the Nile Delta region.

Q175706.name: Guéra Region
Q175706.about: Guéra (Arabic: قيرا, romanised: Qīrā) is one of the 23 provinces of Chad, created in 2002 from the former Guéra prefecture. The province's capital is Mongo.

Q178136.name: Sololá Department
Q178136.about: Sololá is a department in the west of Guatemala. The capital is the city of Sololá.

Q179437.name: County Roscommon
Q179437.about: County Roscommon (Irish: Contae Ros Comáin) is a county in Ireland. It is part of the province of Connacht and the Northern and Western Region.

Q179538.name: Absheron District
Q179538.about: Absheron District (Azerbaijani: Abşeron rayonu) is one of the 66 districts of Azerbaijan. Located in the east of the country, it belongs to the Absheron-Khizi Economic Region.

Q213977.name: Bié Province
Q213977.about: Bié is a province of Angola located on the Bié Plateau in central part of country. Its capital is Kuito, which was called Silva Porto until independence from Portugal in 1975.

Q214572.name: Huíla Province
Q214572.about: Huíla is a province of Angola. It has an area of 79,023 square kilometres (30,511 mi2) and a population of 3,302,866 (2024 census).

Q215221.name: Huanuco Department
Q215221.about: Huánuco (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈwanuko]; Quechua: Wanuku) is a department of Peru. It is bordered by the La Libertad, San Martín, Loreto and Ucayali departments in the north, Ucayali to the east, Pasco to the south and Lima and Ancash to the west.

Q215452.name: Batna Province
Q215452.about: Batna Province (Arabic: ولاية باتنة, romanized: Wilāyat Bātnah) is a province of Algeria, in the region of Aurès. The capital is Batna.

Q216834.name: Cuanza Norte Province
Q216834.about: Cuanza Norte Province (English: North Cuanza; Umbundu: Konano Kwanza Volupale) is a province of Angola. N'dalatando is the capital and the province has an area of 24,110 km2 and a population of 659,097 (2024 census).
Q216834.img: Casa da Juventude na província do Kwanza Norte.jpg

Q218848.name: Huambo Province
Q218848.about: Huambo is a province of Angola. With an area of 34,270 km2, it is one of the geographically smaller provinces, situated in the Central Region approximately 450 km south east of the capital, Luanda.

Q1424391.name: San José de Ocoa Province
Q1424391.about: San José de Ocoa (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsaŋ xoˈse ðe oˈko.a]) is a province in the Dominican Republic. It is spread over an area of 853.4 km2 (329.5 sq mi), and has its capital at San José de Ocoa.

Q1456055.name: Fria Prefecture
Q1456055.about: Fria is a prefecture located in the Boké Region of Guinea. The capital is Fria.

Q1470920.name: Kissidougou Prefecture
Q1470920.about: Kissidougou (N'Ko: ߞߛߌ߬ߘߎ߯ ߡߙߊ߬ߓߊ߰ߘߊ߮) is a prefecture located in the Faranah Region of Guinea. The capital is Kissidougou.

Q1471573.name: Kouroussa Prefecture
Q1471573.about: Kouroussa is a prefecture located in the Kankan Region of Guinea. The capital is Kouroussa.

Q1543219.name: San Salvador Department
Q1543219.about: San Salvador (Spanish pronunciation: [san salβaˈðoɾ]) is a department of El Salvador in the west central part of the country. The capital is San Salvador, which is also the national capital.

Q1647432.name: Saint Thomas
Q1647432.about: The landlocked parish of St. Thomas is in the centre of Barbados.

Q1772745.name: Monte Plata Province
Q1772745.about: Monte Plata (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmonte ˈplata]) is an eastern province of the Dominican Republic, and also the name of its capital city. It was split from San Cristóbal in 1992.

Q3870.name: Nairobi
Q3870.about: Nairobi (  ny-ROH-bee) (Jiji kuu la Nairobi, in Swahili),  is the capital and largest city of Kenya, located in the south-central part of the country. As of 2026, it has a population of 5.6 million and a metropolitan population of 15.95 million, making it the 8th most populous city in Africa and the 4th most populous metropolitan area.

Q188503.name: Brăila County
Q188503.about: Brăila County (Romanian pronunciation: [brəˈila] ) is a county (județ) of Romania, in Muntenia, with the capital city at Brăila.

Q188933.name: Kabul Province
Q188933.about: Kabul is one of the thirty-four provinces of Afghanistan, situated in the east of the country. The capital of the province is Kabul city, which is Afghanistan's capital and largest city.

Q189296.name: Berat County
Q189296.about: Berat County (Albanian pronunciation: [beɽat]; Albanian: Qarku Berat), officially the County of Berat (Albanian: Qarku i Beratit), is a county in the Southern Region of the Republic of Albania. It is the ninth largest by area and the ninth most populous of the twelve counties, with around 140,956 people within an area of 1,798 km2 (694 sq mi).

Q807079.name: Baoruco Province
Q807079.about: Baoruco, alternatively spelt Bahoruco (Spanish pronunciation: [baoˈɾuko]), is a province of the Dominican Republic. It is spread over an area of 1,284.9 km2 (496.1 sq mi), and has its capital at Neiba.

Q817960.name: Rhondda Cynon Taf
Q817960.desc: principal area in south-east Wales, United Kingdom
Q817960.about: Rhondda Cynon Taf (Welsh pronunciation: [ˈr̥ɔnða ˈkənɔn ˈtaːv]; RhCT; also spelt as Rhondda Cynon Taff) is a county borough in the south-east of Wales. It consists of five valleys: the Rhondda Fawr, Rhondda Fach, Cynon, Taff (Welsh: Taf) and Ely valleys, plus several towns and villages away from the valleys.

Q818774.name: Fromager
Q818774.about: Fromager Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 2000 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q823443.name: Comayagua Department
Q823443.about: Comayagua (Spanish pronunciation: [komaˈʝaɣwa]) is one of the 18 departments (departamentos) into which Honduras is divided. The departmental capital is Comayagua.

Q839083.name: Marahoué Region
Q839083.about: Marahoué Region is one of the 31 regions of Ivory Coast and is one of two regions in Sassandra-Marahoué District. The region's seat is Bouaflé.

Q842491.name: N'zi-Comoé
Q842491.about: N'Zi-Comoé Region is a defunct region of Ivory Coast. From 1997 to 2011, it was a first-level subdivision region.

Q844502.name: Quetzaltenango Department
Q844502.about: Quetzaltenango is a department in the western highlands of Guatemala. The capital is the city of Quetzaltenango, the second largest city in Guatemala.

Q220451.name: Azuay Province
Q220451.about: Azuay (English: , Spanish: [aˈswaj] ), Province of Azuay is a province of Ecuador, created on 25 June 1824. It encompasses an area of 8,171 square kilometres (3,155 sq mi).

Q230104.name: Nakhchivan
Q230104.desc: capital of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic of Azerbaijan
Q230104.about: Nakhchivan (Azerbaijani: Naxçıvan Azerbaijani pronunciation: [nɑxtʃɯˈvɑn]; Armenian: Նախիջևան, romanized: Naxijevan Armenian pronunciation: [naχidʒevˈan]) is the capital and largest city of the eponymous Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, a true exclave of Azerbaijan, located 450 km (280 mi) west of Baku. The municipality of Nakhchivan consists of the city of Nakhchivan, the settlement of Əliabad and the villages of Başbaşı, Bulqan, Haciniyyət, Qaraçuq, Qaraxanbəyli, Tumbul, Qarağalıq, and Daşduz.

Q230607.name: Caldas Department
Q230607.about: Caldas (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkaldas]) is a department of Colombia named after Colombian patriotic figure Francisco José de Caldas. It is part of the Paisa Region and its capital is Manizales.

Q230932.name: Mingachevir
Q230932.about: Mingachevir (Azerbaijani: Mingəçevir ) is the fifth largest city in Azerbaijan with a population of about 106,000. It is often called the "city of lights" because of its hydroelectric power station on the Kura River, which divides the city down the middle.

Q41587.name: Goiás
Q41587.desc: state in the Central-West Region of Brazil
Q41587.about: Goiás (English: , UK also ; Brazilian Portuguese: [ɡo(j)ˈjas] ) is a Brazilian state located in the Central-West region. Goiás borders the Federal District and the states of (from north clockwise) Tocantins, Bahia, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso do Sul and Mato Grosso.
Q41587.img: Morro cabeludo - Parque dos Pireneus - Pirenópolis - Goiás 01.jpg

Q236758.name: Relizane Province
Q236758.about: Relizane (Arabic: ولاية غليزان) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria. Relizane is the capital.

Q236776.name: Mascara Province
Q236776.about: Mascara (Arabic: معسكر Muʿaskar, Berber languages: ⵎⵄⴻⵙⴽⴻⵔ Mɛesker) is a province (wilaya) in Algeria, named after its capital, whose name is Arabic for "military garrison". It is uncertain whether the place's name is related to "mascara", the cosmetic.

Q237164.name: Sétif Province
Q237164.about: Sétif Province (Arabic: ولاية سطيف, Kabyle: ⴰⴳⴻⵣⴷⵓ ⵙⵟⵉⴼ) is a province (wilaya) in north-eastern Algeria. Its capital and largest city is Sétif and the next largest city is El Eulma.

Q238492.name: Chimborazo Province
Q238492.about: Chimborazo (Spanish pronunciation: [tʃimboˈɾaso]) is a province in the central Ecuadorian Andes. It is a home to a section of Sangay National Park.

Q238629.name: Meta
Q238629.about: Meta Department (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmeta]) is one of the 32 departments that compose the Republic of Colombia. Largely located within the country's Orinoquía natural region and covered by the Llanos, it is close to the geographic center of the country, east of the Andes mountains.

Q240014.name: Paraguarí Department
Q240014.about: Paraguarí (Spanish pronunciation: [pa.ɾa.ɣwaˈɾi]; Guaraní: Paraguari) is a departament in Paraguay. At the 2002 census it had a population of 221,932.

Q240870.name: M'Sila Province
Q240870.about: M'sila (Berber languages: ⵎⵙⵉⵍⴰ Msila) is a province (wilaya) of northern Algeria. It has a population of 958,361 people and an area of 18,718 square kilometres (7,227 sq mi), with a density of 74/square kilometer, while its capital, also called M'sila, home to M'sila University, has a population of about 100,000.
Q240870.img: La porte du désert « Bou ssada ».jpg

Q241116.name: Shirvan
Q241116.about: Shirvan (Azerbaijani: Şirvan) is a city in Azerbaijan, located on the Kura River. It was called Zubovka until 1938 and Ali Bayramli until 2008.

Q241140.name: Cotopaxi Province
Q241140.about: Cotopaxi (Spanish pronunciation: [kotoˈpaɣsi]) is one of the provinces of Ecuador. The capital is Latacunga.

Q45761.name: Hunan
Q45761.about: Hunan is an inland province in Central China. Located in the middle reaches of the Yangtze watershed, it borders the province-level divisions of Hubei to the north, Jiangxi to the east, Guangdong and Guangxi to the south, and Guizhou and Chongqing to the northwest.

Q45833.name: Qinghai
Q45833.about: Qinghai is an inland province in Northwestern China. It is the largest province of China (excluding autonomous regions) by area and has the third-smallest population, with its capital and largest city being Xining.

Q37801.name: Bălți
Q37801.about: Bălți (Romanian pronunciation: [ˈbəltsʲ] ) is a city in Moldova. It is the third-largest city in terms of population, area and economic importance, after Chișinău and Tiraspol.

Q39109.name: Minas Gerais
Q39109.desc: state in the Southeast Region of Brazil
Q39109.about: Minas Gerais (English: , MIN-əs zhə-RYS; Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈminɐz ʒeˈɾajs] ; lit. 'General Mines') is one of the 27 federative units of Brazil, being the fourth largest state by area and the second largest in number of inhabitants with a population of 20,539,989 according to the 2022 census. Located in the Southeast Region of the country, it is bordered by São Paulo in the south and southwest; Mato Grosso do Sul to the west; Goiás and the Federal District to the northwest; Bahia to the north and northeast; Espírito Santo to the east; and Rio de Janeiro to the southeast.

Q40956.name: Anhui
Q40956.about: Anhui is an inland province located in East China. Its provincial capital and largest city is Hefei.

Q47097.name: Guizhou
Q47097.desc: landlocked province of the People's Republic of China
Q47097.about: Guizhou is an inland province in Southwestern China with its capital and largest city as Guiyang, located in the center of the province. Guizhou borders the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region to the south, Yunnan to the west, Sichuan to the northwest, the municipality of Chongqing to the north, and Hunan to the east.
Q47097.img: Five hundred meter Aperture Spherical Telescope, China (ASTER).jpg

Q47974.name: Shaanxi
Q47974.desc: province of central China with its capital Xi'an, the ancient homeland of the Zhou and center of several major dynasty
Q47974.about: Shaanxi is a province in Northwestern China. It borders the province-level divisions of Inner Mongolia to the north; Shanxi and Henan to the east; Hubei, Chongqing, and Sichuan to the south; and Gansu and Ningxia to the west.

Q55299.name: County Laois
Q55299.about: County Laois ( LEESH; Irish: Contae Laoise) is a county in Ireland. It is part of the Eastern and Midland Region and in the province of Leinster.

Q44818.name: San Luis Province
Q44818.about: San Luis (Spanish pronunciation: [san ˈlwis]) is a province of Argentina located near the geographical center of the country (on the 32° South parallel). Neighboring provinces are, from the north clockwise, La Rioja, Córdoba, La Pampa, Mendoza and San Juan.

Q44823.name: Santa Fe Province
Q44823.about: Santa Fe, officially Province of Santa Fe (Spanish: Provincia  de Santa Fe, Spanish pronunciation: [ˈsanta ˈfe], lit. "Holy Faith") is a province of Argentina, located in the center-east of the country.
Q44823.img: Casa de Gobierno de Santa Fe.jpg

Q44827.name: Santiago del Estero Province
Q44827.about: Santiago del Estero (Spanish pronunciation: [sanˈtjaɣo ðel esˈteɾo]), also known simply as Santiago, is a province in the north of Argentina. Neighboring provinces, clockwise from the north, are Salta, Chaco, Santa Fe, Córdoba, Catamarca and Tucumán.

Q43684.name: Henan
Q43684.desc: province of the People's Republic of China (1949-)
Q43684.about: Henan is a province in Central China. Henan is China's third-most populous province and the most populous among inland provinces, with a population of over 99 million as of 2020.

Q43695.name: Tocantins
Q43695.desc: state in the North Region of Brazil
Q43695.about: Tocantins (Brazilian Portuguese: [tokɐ̃ˈtʃĩs] ) is one of the 26 states of Brazil. It is the newest state, formed in 1988 and encompassing what had formerly been the northern two-fifths of the state of Goiás.

Q44759.name: Córdoba Province
Q44759.about: Córdoba (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkoɾðoβa]) is a province of Argentina, located in the center of the country. Its neighboring provinces are (clockwise from the north) Santiago del Estero, Santa Fe, Buenos Aires, La Pampa, San Luis, La Rioja, and Catamarca.

Q44795.name: La Pampa Province
Q44795.about: La Pampa (Spanish pronunciation: [la ˈpampa]) is a sparsely populated province of Argentina, located in the Pampas in the center of the country. Neighboring provinces are from the north clockwise San Luis, Córdoba, Buenos Aires, Río Negro, Neuquén and Mendoza.

Q44829.name: Tucumán Province
Q44829.about:
Tucumán (Spanish pronunciation: [tukuˈman]) is the most densely populated, and the second-smallest by land area, of the provinces of Argentina.
Located in the northwest of the country, the province has the capital of San Miguel de Tucumán, often shortened to Tucumán.

Q44843.name: Tochigi Prefecture
Q44843.about: Tochigi Prefecture (栃木県, Tochigi-ken) is an inland prefecture of Japan located in the Kantō region of Honshu. Tochigi Prefecture has a population of 1,897,649 (1 June 2023) and has a geographic area of 6,408 km2 (2,474 sq mi).

Q2299447.name: Sēja Municipality
Q2299447.about: Sēja Municipality (Latvian: Sējas novads) was a former municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2006 by reorganization of Sēja Parish; the administrative centre being Loja.

Q2302998.name: Krimulda Municipality
Q2302998.about: Krimulda Municipality (Latvian: Krimuldas novads) is a former municipality in Vidzeme, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Krimulda Parish and Lēdurga Parish.

Q2304926.name: Ozolnieki Municipality
Q2304926.about: Ozolnieki Municipality (Latvian: Ozolnieku novads) is a former municipality in Semigallia, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2003 by merging Ozolnieki Parish and Cena Parish; the administrative centre was Ozolnieki.

Q2337266.name: Iecava Municipality
Q2337266.about: Iecava Municipality (Latvian: Iecavas novads) is a former municipality in the historical region of Semigallia, and the Zemgale Planning Region in Latvia. The municipality was formed 2003 by a reorganization of Iecava Parish.

Q2375848.name: Sala Municipality
Q2375848.about: Sala Municipality (Latvian: Salas novads) is a former municipality in Selonia, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Sala parish and Sēlpils parish with the administrative centre being Sala.

Q2451375.name: Olaine Municipality
Q2451375.about: Olaine Municipality (Latvian: Olaines novads) is a municipality in Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Olaine parish and Olaine town the administrative centre being Olaine.

Q2485015.name: Aizpute Municipality
Q2485015.about: Aizpute Municipality (Latvian: Aizputes novads) was a municipality in Courland, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Aizpute town, Aizpute parish, Cīrava parish, Kalvene parish, Kazdanga parish and Laža parish.

Q46862.name: Hubei
Q46862.about: Hubei is a province in Central China. It has the seventh-largest economy among Chinese provinces, the second-largest within Central China, and the third-largest among inland provinces.

Q46913.name: Shanxi
Q46913.desc: province of central China with its capital at Taoyuan, the supposed original home of the prehistoric Huaxia
Q46913.about: Shanxi is a province in North China. Its capital and largest city is Taiyuan, and its next most populated prefecture-level cities are Changzhi and Datong.
Q46913.img: Great Wall of China, Satellite image.jpeg

Q231748.name: Laghouat Province
Q231748.about: Laghouat (Arabic: ولاية الأغواط) is one of the fifty-eight provinces (wilaya) of Algeria. It is located in the north central part of Algeria.

Q232043.name: Constantine Province
Q232043.about: Constantine (Arabic: ولاية قسنطينة) is one of the 58 provinces (wilayas) of Algeria, whose capital is the city of the same name, with 969,934 inhabitants, with a density of 424/km2 (1,908/sq mi).

Q232564.name: Cundinamarca Department
Q232564.about: Cundinamarca  (Spanish pronunciation: [kundinaˈmaɾka]) is a department of Colombia. Its area covers 22,623 square kilometres (8,735 sq mi) (not including the Capital District) and it has a population of 2,919,060 as of 2018 (3,445,300, DANE 2023 projections).

Q233233.name: Djelfa Province
Q233233.about:
Djelfa (Arabic: ولاية الجلفة) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria and its capital is Djelfa.
It was first established by the administrative reorganization of 1974, and is home to over 1,595,794 inhabitants.
Q233233.img: Statue du mouton, Wilaya de Djelfa (Algérie).jpg

Q233258.name: Tiaret Province
Q233258.about:
Tiaret (Arabic: ولاية تيارت) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria and its capital is Tiaret.
The National Stud Farm of Chaouchaoua is located in the province of Tiaret.

Q233637.name: Blida Province
Q233637.about: Blida (Arabic: ولاية البليدة) is a province (wilaya) in Algeria. Its capital is Blida.

Q233640.name: Saïda Province
Q233640.about: Saïda (Arabic: ولاية سعيدة) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria, named after its capital.

Q233655.name: Bouira Province
Q233655.about: Bouïra (Arabic: ولاية البويرة) is a province (wilaya) in Algeria.

Q233917.name: Cochabamba Department
Q233917.about: Cochabamba (Aymara: Quchapampa Jach'a Suyu, Spanish: Departamento de Cochabamba pronounced [kotʃaˈβamba] , Quechua: Quchapampa Suyu), from Quechua qucha or qhucha, meaning "lake", pampa meaning "plain", is one of the nine departments of Bolivia. It is known to be the breadbasket of the country because of its variety of agricultural products from its geographical position.

Q2880128.name: Jaunjelgava Municipality
Q2880128.about: Jaunjelgava Municipality (Latvian: Jaunjelgavas novads) is a former municipality in Selonia, Latvia. The municipality was formed in 2009 by merging Sece parish, Sērene parish, Staburags parish, Sunākste parish and Jaunjelgava town with its countryside territory, with the administrative centre being Jaunjelgava.

Q234501.name: Tolima Department
Q234501.about: Tolima (Spanish pronunciation: [toˈlima]) is one of the 32 departments of Colombia, located in the Andean region, in the center-west of the country. It is bordered on the north and the west by the department of Caldas; on the east by the department of Cundinamarca; on the south by the department of Huila, and on the west by the departments of Cauca, Valle del Cauca, Quindío and Risaralda.

Q234920.name: Huila Department
Q234920.about: Huila (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈwila]) is one of the departments of Colombia. It is located in the southwest of the country, and its capital is Neiva.

Q235166.name: Santander Department
Q235166.about: Santander (Spanish pronunciation: [santanˈdeɾ]) is a department of Colombia. It is located in the central northern part of the country, and borders the Magdalena River to the east, Boyacá to the south and southeast, Norte de Santander to the northeast, Cesar to the north, and the Bolivar and Antioquia Departments to the west.

Q235703.name: El Bayadh Province
Q235703.about: El Bayadh (Arabic: ولاية البيض) is a province (wilaya) in Algeria, named after its capital El Bayadh. It is surrounded by mountains from the South, North, and Northeast of the state.
Q235703.img: El bayadh, centre ville , moment de la neige.jpg

Q235705.name: Oum El Bouaghi Province
Q235705.about: Oum El Bouaghi or Oum el-Bouaghi (Arabic: ولاية أم البواقي) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria in the Aures region. The capital is Oum el-Bouaghi, which was named Can Robert (during French occupation).

Q235714.name: Sidi Bel Abbès Province
Q235714.about: Sidi Bel Abbès (Arabic: ولاية سيدي بلعباس) is one of the provinces (wilayas) of Algeria, situated in the northwestern part of the country. Its name is derived from the name of its capital, the city of Sidi Bel Abbès.

Q235723.name: Mila Province
Q235723.about: Mila (Arabic: ولاية ميلة, wilāya mīla) is a province (wilayah) of Algeria, whose capital is Mila. Other localities include Teleghma, Grarem Gouga, Hamala and Rouached.
Q235723.img: Une mangnific land scap a Wlad L kayam Mila - Algeria.jpg

Q235727.name: Guelma Province
Q235727.about: Guelma Province (Arabic: ولاية قالمة) is a province (wilaya) in eastern Algeria. Its namesake is its seat and most populous municipality: Guelma.

Q235805.name: Tissemsilt Province
Q235805.about: Tissemsilt (Arabic: ولاية تسمسيلت) is the 38th province of Algeria with the capital being Tissemsilt. Théniet El Haâd National Park is located there.

Q235810.name: Médéa Province
Q235810.about: Médéa (Arabic: ولاية المدية) is a province (wilaya) of Algeria, with a population of  1 062 134 inhabitants in 2019and Médéa as its capital.
Q235810.img: Autoroute Chiffa Berrouaghia الطريق السريع شفة البرواقية (48216292872).jpg

Q3299782.name: Mojkovac Municipality
Q3299782.about: Mojkovac Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Mojkovac / Општина Мојковац) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. The municipality is located in northern Montenegro.

Q3303233.name: Kolašin Municipality
Q3303233.about: Kolašin Municipality is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. Located in Northern Montenegro, municipality is part and unofficial centre of Morača region, named after Morača river.

Q3305075.name: Old Royal Capital Cetinje
Q3305075.about: The Old Royal Capital Cetinje (Montenegrin: Prijestonica Cetinje / Пријестоница Цетиње) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. Due to its former status as the capital of the old Kingdom of Montenegro, it is known as the "Old Royal Capital" (Prijestonica / Пријестоница), which is also translated in English as "Royal Town".

Q3321599.name: Bukomansimbi District
Q3321599.about: Bukomansimbi District is a district in Central Uganda. The district is named after its main municipal center, Bukomansimbi, the location of the district headquarters.

Q58060.name: Bjelovar-Bilogora County
Q58060.about:
Bjelovar-Bilogora County (pronounced [bjêloʋaːr-bîloɡora]; Croatian: Bjelovarsko-bilogorska županija [bjêloʋaːrsko-bîloɡorskaː ʒupǎnija]) is a county in central Croatia.
The central city of Bjelovar was first mentioned in 1413, and it only gained importance when a new fort was built in 1756 to defend against the Ottoman invasions.

Q58111.name: Požega-Slavonia County
