Q58111.about: Požega-Slavonia County (Croatian: Požeško-slavonska županija [pôʒeʃko-slǎʋoːnskaː ʒupǎnija]) is a Croatian county in western Slavonia. Its capital is Požega.

Q3321614.name: Kalungu District
Q3321614.about: Kalungu District is a district in Central Uganda. It is named after the main town of the district, Kalungu, where the district headquarters are located.

Q3321622.name: Butambala District
Q3321622.about: Butambala District is a district in the Central Region of Uganda.

Q3321637.name: Gomba District
Q3321637.about: Gomba is a district in Central Uganda.

Q3536053.name: Agago District
Q3536053.about: The Agago District is a Ugandan district located in the Northern Region of Uganda.

Q3536082.name: Alebtong District
Q3536082.about: Alebtong District is a district in the Northern Region of Uganda. The town of Alebtong serves as the district headquarters.

Q3539116.name: Kiryandongo District
Q3539116.about: Kiryandongo District is a district in Western Uganda. Like many other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Kiryandongo, where the district headquarters are located.

Q3539151.name: Kole District
Q3539151.about: Kole District is a district in Northern Uganda. Like most other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Kole, where the district headquarters are located.

Q3539256.name: Kyegegwa District
Q3539256.about: Kyegegwa District is a district in Western Region of Uganda. The town of Kyegegwa hosts the district headquarters.

Q57052.name: Jiangxi
Q57052.desc: province of central China, located around the Gan River south of the Yangtze
Q57052.about: Jiangxi is an inland province in east China. Spanning from the banks of the Yangtze river in the north into hillier areas in the south and east, it borders Anhui to the north, Zhejiang to the northeast, Fujian to the east, Guangdong to the south, Hunan to the west, and Hubei to the northwest.

Q57448.name: Ningxia
Q57448.about: Ningxia, officially the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region (NHAR), is an autonomous region in Northwestern China. Formerly a province, Ningxia was incorporated into Gansu in 1954 but was later separated from Gansu in 1958 and reconstituted as an autonomous region for the Hui people, one of the 56 officially recognised ethnicities in China.

Q57599.name: Kweneng District
Q57599.about: Kweneng is one of the districts of Botswana and is the recent historical homeland of the Bakwena people, the first group in Botswana converted to Christianity by famed missionary David Livingstone.  Various landmarks, including Livingstone's Cave, allude to this history.

Q3539602.name: Otuke District
Q3539602.about: Otuke District is a district in Northern Uganda. Like many other Ugandan districts, Otuke district is named after its 'chief town', Otuke, where the district headquarters are located.

Q3741507.name: Danilovgrad Municipality
Q3741507.about: The Danilovgrad Municipality is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. Its administrative center is the town of Danilovgrad and it is located in the central part of Montenegro, in the valley of the Zeta river, also called the Bjelopavlići plain.

Q6667298.name: Logar Province
Q6667298.about: Logar is one of the 34 provinces of Afghanistan, located in the eastern section of the country. It is divided into 7 districts and contains hundreds of villages.

Q13365880.name: Šavnik Municipality
Q13365880.about: Šavnik Municipality (Montenegrin: Opština Šavnik / Општина Шавник) is one of the municipalities of Montenegro. The municipality is located in Northern Montenegro.

Q2015.name: Vologda Oblast
Q2015.about: Vologda Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is Vologda.
Q2015.img: Andoma Mountains by the lake Onega in Vologda oblast 01.jpg

Q2073.name: Komi Republic
Q2073.about: The Komi Republic, sometimes simply referred to as Komi, is a republic of Russia situated in the northeast of European Russia. Its capital is the city of Syktyvkar.

Q2240.name: Novgorod Oblast
Q2240.about: Novgorod Oblast (Russian: Новгоро́дская о́бласть, romanized: Novgorodskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Veliky Novgorod.

Q2246.name: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast
Q2246.about: Nizhny Novgorod Oblast (Russian: Нижегоро́дская о́бласть, romanized: Nizhegorodskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center and largest city is the city of Nizhny Novgorod.

Q2292.name: Tver Oblast
Q2292.about: Tver Oblast (Russian: Тверская область, romanized: Tvierskaja oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Tver.

Q2448.name: Yaroslavl Oblast
Q2448.about:
Yaroslavl Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), which is located in the Central Federal District, surrounded by the Tver, Moscow, Ivanovo, Vladimir, Kostroma, and Vologda oblasts. 
This geographic location gives the oblast the advantages of proximity to Moscow and Saint Petersburg.

Q2596.name: Kostroma Oblast
Q2596.about: Kostroma Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Kostroma and its population as of the 2021 Census is 580,976.

Q2654.name: Ivanovo Oblast
Q2654.about: Ivanovo Oblast (Russian: Ива́новская о́бласть, romanized: Ivanovskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). It had a population of 927,828 as of the 2021 Russian Census.
Q2654.img: View of Plyos from Cathedral Mountain P5251847 2350.jpg

Q2702.name: Vladimir Oblast
Q2702.about: Vladimir Oblast (Russian: Влади́мирская о́бласть, romanized: Vladimirskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Vladimir, which is located 190 kilometers (120 mi) east of Moscow.

Q482788.name: Gümüşhane Province
Q482788.about: Gümüşhane Province (Turkish: Gümüşhane ili) is a province in northern Turkey, bordering Bayburt to the east, Trabzon to the north, Giresun and Erzincan to the west. Its area is 6,668 km2, and its population is 144,544 (2022).

Q482825.name: Siirt Province
Q482825.about: Siirt Province, (Turkish: Siirt ili, Kurdish: Parêzgeha Sêrtê; is a province of Turkey, located in the southeast. The province borders Bitlis to the north, Batman to the west, Mardin to the southwest, Şırnak to the south, and Van to the east.

Q482834.name: Kahramanmaraş Province
Q482834.about: Kahramanmaraş Province (Turkish: Kahramanmaraş ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey. Its area is 14,520 km2, and its population is 1,177,436 (2022).

Q79952.name: Aguascalientes
Q79952.about: Aguascalientes, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Aguascalientes, is one of the 32 states which comprise the federated entities of Mexico. At 22°N and with an average altitude of 1,950 m (6,400 ft) above sea level it is predominantly of semi-arid climate (Bhs and Bhk).

Q80088.name: Burdur Province
Q80088.about: Burdur Province (Turkish: Burdur ili) is a province of Turkey, located in the southwest and bordering Muğla and Antalya to the south, Denizli to the west, Afyon to the north, and Isparta to the east. Its area is 7,175 km2, and its population is 273,799 (2022).

Q80269.name: Zacatecas
Q80269.about: Zacatecas, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Zacatecas, is one of the 31 states of Mexico. It is divided into 58 municipalities and its capital city is Zacatecas.

Q79760.name: Bingöl Province
Q79760.about: Bingöl Province (Turkish: Bingöl ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Çewlîg; Zazaki: Wîlayetî Çewlîg; Armenian: Ճապաղջուր զավառ) is a province of Turkey. The province was known as Çapakçur Province (Armenian: Ճապաղջուր, lit. 'spread out water') before 1945 when it was renamed as Bingöl Province.

Q79918.name: Durango
Q79918.about: Durango, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Durango, is one of the states which make up the 32 federal entities of Mexico, situated in the northwest portion of the country. With a population of 1,832,650, the eighth lowest of Mexico's states, Durango has Mexico's second-lowest population density, after Baja California Sur.

Q79923.name: Puebla
Q79923.about: Puebla, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Puebla, is one of the 31 states that, along with Mexico City, comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 217 municipalities and its capital is Puebla City.

Q66117.name: Morelos
Q66117.about: Morelos, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Morelos, is a landlocked state located in south-central Mexico. It is one of the 32 states which comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico.

Q75445.name: Yozgat Province
Q75445.about: Yozgat Province (Turkish: Yozgat ili) is a province in central Turkey. Its area is 13,690 km2, and its population is 418,442 (2022).

Q78980.name: San Luis Potosí
Q78980.about: San Luis Potosí, officially the Free and Sovereign State of San Luis Potosí, is one of the 32 states which compose the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided in 59 municipalities and is named after its capital city, San Luis Potosí.

Q79754.name: Querétaro
Q79754.about: Querétaro, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Querétaro, is one of the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is divided into 18 municipalities.

Q83081.name: Diyarbakır Province
Q83081.about: Diyarbakır Province (Turkish: Diyarbakır ili; Zazaki: Suke Dîyarbekîr; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Amedê) is a province and metropolitan municipality in southeastern Turkey. Its area is 15,101 km2, and its population is 1,804,880 (2022).

Q83239.name: Bitlis Province
Q83239.about: Bitlis Province (Turkish: Bitlis ili; Armenian: Բաղեշի մարզ, romanized: Bagheshi marz; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Bidlîsê) is a province of eastern Turkey, located to the west of Lake Van. It takes its name from the central city, Bitlis.

Q102397.name: Miskolc
Q102397.about: Miskolc (UK:  MEESH-kolts, US:  MISH-kohlts; Hungarian: [ˈmiʃkolt͡s] ; Czech and Slovak: Miškovec; German: Mischkolz; Yiddish: Mishkoltz; Romanian: Mișcolț) is a city in northeastern Hungary, known for its heavy industry. With a population of 143,502 as of 2024, Miskolc is the fourth largest city in Hungary, behind Budapest, Debrecen, and Szeged.

Q117714.name: Anambra State
Q117714.about: Anambra ( Igbo: Alaọha Anambra) is a state in the Southeastern region of Nigeria bordered by Delta to the west, Imo and Rivers to the south, Abia to the southeast, Enugu to the east and Kogi to the north. Awka is the state's capital while Onitsha is its most populous city.

Q276195.name: Töv Province
Q276195.about: Töv Province (from Mongolian төв [tʰөw̜] 'centre') is one of the 21 provinces of Mongolia. The national capital Ulaanbaatar is located roughly at its center, but the city itself is administered as an independent municipality.

Q281206.name: Osmaniye Province
Q281206.about: Osmaniye Province (Turkish: Osmaniye ili) is a province in south-central Turkey. It was named Cebel-i Bereket (lit. 'Fertile Mountain') in the early republic until 1933, when it was incorporated into Adana Province.

Q281898.name: Češinovo-Obleševo Municipality
Q281898.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q281898.about: Češinovo-Obleševo (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in the eastern part of North Macedonia. The seat of the municipality is the village of Obleševo.

Q309352.name: Iringa Region
Q309352.about: Iringa Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Iringa)  is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers an area of 35,503 km2 (13,708 sq mi).

Q320378.name: London Borough of Sutton
Q320378.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q320378.about: The London Borough of Sutton () is an Outer London borough in south London, England. It covers an area of 43 km2 (17 sq mi) and is the 80th largest local authority in England by population.

Q130553.name: Manisa Province
Q130553.about: Manisa Province (Turkish: Manisa ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in western Turkey. Its area is 13,339 km2, and its population is 1,468,279 (2022).

Q131387.name: Muş Province
Q131387.about: Muş Province (Turkish: Muş ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Mûşê; Armenian: Մուշի մարզ, romanized: Mushi marz) is a province in the east Anatolia region of Turkey (Türkiye). Its area is 8,718 km2, and its population is 399,202 (2022), down from 453,654 in 2000.

Q131384.name: Malatya Province
Q131384.about: Malatya Province (Turkish: Malatya ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey. Its area is 12,259 km2, and its population is 812,580 (2022).

Q131664.name: Qom Province
Q131664.about: Qom Province (Persian: استان قم) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran with 11,237 km², covering 0.89% of the total area of the country. Its capital is the city of Qom.

Q1141767.name: Kouritenga Province
Q1141767.about: Kouritenga (sometimes spelt Kourittenga) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Est Region. In 2019, the province had a population of 479,930.

Q1141776.name: Nayala Province
Q1141776.about:
Nayala is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Boucle du Mouhoun Region.
Its capital is Toma.

Q1142008.name: Passoré Province
Q1142008.about: Passoré (French pronunciation: [pasɔʁe]) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in the Nord Region. Its capital city is Yako.

Q1142014.name: Sanguié Province
Q1142014.about: Sanguié is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Ouest Region. In 2019 the population was 391,520.

Q1142026.name: Oubritenga Province
Q1142026.about:
Bassitegna (known as Oubritenga until 2025) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Plateau-Central Region.
Its capital is Ziniaré.

Q1142039.name: Sanmatenga Province
Q1142039.about:
Sandbondtenga (known as Sanmatenga before 2025) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Nord Region.
Its capital is Kaya.

Q1142044.name: Namentenga Province
Q1142044.about:
Namentenga is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Nord Region.
Its capital is Boulsa.

Q1142050.name: Mouhoun
Q1142050.about: Mouhoun ([mu.un], "Black Volta") is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso. It is in the Boucle du Mouhoun region.
Q1142050.img: 2015.03-427-032app monument(for politician and writer Nazi BONI),reading Dédougou,BF thu05mar2015-1032h.jpg

Q1151062.name: Kumi District
Q1151062.about: Kumi District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The district is named after its main town, Kumi, which also hosts the district headquarters.
Q1151062.img: Green Vegetation at a swamp in Kumi District.jpg

Q1151066.name: Mukono District
Q1151066.about: Mukono is one of the districts in the Central Region of Uganda. The town of Mukono serves as the district headquarters and is home to the district's main commercial center.

Q376241.name: Gombe State
Q376241.about: Gombe State (; Fula: 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤣𞤭 𞤺𞤮𞤥𞥆𞤦𞤫 Lesdi Gommbe; Tangale: Kwambe) is a state in northeastern Nigeria, bordered to the north and northeast by the states of Borno in the vicinity of Gongola River and Lake Dadin Kowa and Yobe in the vicinity of Gongola River, to the south by Taraba State, to the southeast by Adamawa State, and to the west by Bauchi State. Gombe is the state capital of Gombe state and it was formed from a part of Bauchi State on 1 October 1996.

Q376797.name: Erzurum Province
Q376797.about: Erzurum Province (Turkish: Erzurum ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in the Eastern Anatolia Region of Turkey. Its area is 25,006 km2, and its population is 749,754 (2022).

Q191604.name: Heves County
Q191604.about: Heves county (Hungarian: Heves megye, pronounced [ˈhɛvɛʃ]) lies in northern Hungary, between the right bank of the river Tisza and the Mátra and Bükk mountains. It shares borders with the Hungarian counties Pest, Nógrád, Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén and Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok.

Q191625.name: Tolna County
Q191625.desc: administrative county (comitatus or megye) in Hungary
Q191625.about: Tolna (Hungarian: Tolna megye, pronounced [ˈtolnɒ]; German: Komitat Tolnau) is an administrative county (comitatus or megye) in present-day Hungary as it was in the former Kingdom of Hungary. It lies in central Hungary, on the west bank of the river Danube.

Q193050.name: Érd
Q193050.about: Érd (Hungarian: [eːrd]; Ottoman Turkish: Hamzabey Palankası; German: Hanselbeck, Croatian: Andzabeg) is a town in Pest County, Budapest metropolitan area, Hungary. It is a city with county rights.

Q124375.name: Hódmezővásárhely
Q124375.about: Hódmezővásárhely (Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈhoːdmɛzøːvaːʃaːrhɛj] ; also known by other alternative names) is a city with county rights in southeast Hungary, on the Great Hungarian Plain, at the meeting point of the Békés-Csanádi Ridge and the clay grassland surrounding the river Tisza. In 2017, it had a population of 44,009.

Q126874.name: Kütahya Province
Q126874.about: Kütahya Province (Turkish: Kütahya ili) is a province in the Aegean region of Turkey. Its area is 11,634 km2, and its population is 580,701 (2022).

Q1074530.name: Kadiogo Province
Q1074530.about: Kadiogo is a province of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre Region. Its area is of 2,805 km2, containing six departments and a population of 3,032,668 (2019).

Q1781.name: Budapest
Q1781.desc: capital and largest city of Hungary
Q1781.about: Budapest is the capital and largest city of Hungary. It is Hungary's primate city with 1.7 million inhabitants and its greater metro area has a population of about 3.3 million, representing one-third of the country's population and producing more than 40% of the country's economic output.

Q1168.name: Chhattisgarh
Q1168.about: Chhattisgarh (; Hindi: [ˈtʃʰət̪ːiːsgəɽʱ]) is a landlocked state in east-central India. It is the ninth largest state by area, and with a population of roughly 30 million, the seventeenth most populous.
Q1168.img: Flora of Chaiturgarh forest hills Korba , Chhattisgarh.jpg

Q1174.name: Haryana
Q1174.about: Haryana is a state located in the northwestern part of India. It is bordered by Punjab and Himachal Pradesh to the north, by Rajasthan to the west and south, by Delhi to the southeast, while river Yamuna forms its eastern border with Uttar Pradesh.

Q1489.name: Mexico City
Q1489.desc: capital and largest city of Mexico
Q1489.about: Mexico City is the capital and  largest city of Mexico, as well as the most populous city in North America. It is one of the world's leading cultural and financial centers and, according to the Globalization and World Cities Research Network's 2024 ranking, is classified as an Alpha world city.

Q2753.name: Ryazan Oblast
Q2753.about: Ryazan Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Ryazan, which is also the oblast's largest city.

Q2792.name: Tula Oblast
Q2792.about: Tula Oblast (Russian: Ту́льская о́бласть, romanized: Tulʹskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject (an oblast) of Russia. It is geographically located in European Russia and is administratively part of the Central Federal District, covering an area of 25,700 square kilometers (9,900 sq mi).

Q2842.name: Kaluga Oblast
Q2842.about: Kaluga Oblast (Russian: Калу́жская о́бласть, romanized: Kaluzhskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Kaluga.

Q482975.name: Karaman Province
Q482975.about: Karaman Province (Turkish: Karaman ili) is a province of south-central Turkey. Its area is 8,678 km2, and its population is 260,838 (2022).

Q483063.name: Bayburt Province
Q483063.about: Bayburt Province (Turkish: Bayburt ili) is a province of Turkey. Located in the Northeast Anatolia region of the country, the capital city is Bayburt.

Q483078.name: Uşak Province
Q483078.about: Uşak (Turkish: Uşak ili) is a province in western Turkey. Its adjacent provinces are Manisa to the west, Denizli to the south, Afyon to the east, and Kütahya to the north.

Q1091337.name: Soroti District
Q1091337.about: Soroti District is a district in Eastern Uganda. It is named after its chief municipal, administrative and commercial headquarters, Soroti, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1114868.name: Bulambuli District
Q1114868.about: Bulambuli District is a district in Eastern Uganda. The district is named after 'chief town', Bulambuli, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1114885.name: Kibuku District
Q1114885.about: Kibuku District is a district in Eastern Uganda. It is named after its 'chief town', Kibuku, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1114903.name: Ngora District
Q1114903.about: Ngora District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Ngora is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1114927.name: Serere District
Q1114927.about: Serere District is a district in Eastern Uganda. It is named after its 'chief town', Serere, which serves as the district headquarters.

Q1131727.name: Lorestan Province
Q1131727.about: Lorestan province (Persian: استان لرستان) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Khorramabad.

Q3624.name: Addis Ababa
Q3624.about: Addis Ababa (  AD-iss AB-ə-bə; Amharic: አዲስ አበባ [adˈdis ˈaβəβa] , lit. 'new flower'; Oromo: Finfinnee, lit. 'fountain of hot mineral water') is the capital and largest city of Ethiopia. With an estimated population of 6,287,000 inhabitants as of 2025, it is the tenth largest city in Africa.

Q181276.name: Szolnok
Q181276.desc: county seat of Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok county in central Hungary
Q181276.about: Szolnok (Hungarian pronunciation: [ˈsolnok]; also known by alternative names) is the county seat of Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok county in central Hungary. A city with county rights, it is located on the banks of the Tisza river, in the heart of the Great Hungarian Plain, which has made it an important cultural and economic crossroads for centuries.

Q182889.name: Ganzourgou Province
Q182889.about: Ganzourgou (Mossi: Gãnzurgu) is a province of Burkina Faso and is in Plateau-Central Region. The capital of Ganzourgou is Zorgho, which is along the road between Ouagadougou and Niamey, Niger.

Q187373.name: Hamadan Province
Q187373.about: Hamadan Province (Persian: استان همدان) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Hamadan.

Q155219.name: Niğde Province
Q155219.about: Niğde Province (Turkish: Niğde ili) is a province in the southern part of Central Anatolia, Turkey. Its area is 7,234 km2, and its population is 365,419 (2022) of which 170,511 live in the city of Niğde.

Q161491.name: Reading
Q161491.desc: historic market town in the English county of Berkshire
Q161491.about: Reading (  RED-ing) is a town and borough in Berkshire, England, and the county town of Berkshire. It is Berkshire's largest town, with a total population of 203,795 in its built-up area as of 2021.

Q165352.name: Kerman Province
Q165352.about: Kerman province (Persian: استان کرمان; [kʲeɾˈmɒːn] )) is the largest of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Kerman.
Q165352.img: Caravanserai in desert Dasht-e Lut, Kerman Province, Iran 04.JPG

Q167109.name: Eger
Q167109.about: Eger (UK:  EG-ər, US:  AY-gər; Hungarian: [ˈɛɡɛr] ; also known by other alternative names) is the county seat of Heves County, and the second largest city in Northern Hungary (after Miskolc). A city with county rights, Eger is best known for its medieval castle, thermal baths, baroque buildings, the northernmost Ottoman minaret, and red wines.

Q1171024.name: Darlington
Q1171024.desc: unitary authority in County Durham, United Kingdom
Q1171024.about: The Borough of Darlington is a unitary authority area with borough status in County Durham, England. Since 1997 Darlington Borough Council has been a unitary authority; it is independent from Durham County Council.

Q1198482.name: Magherafelt District Council
Q1198482.desc: administrative territorial entity of the United Kingdom
Q1198482.about: Magherafelt District Council was a district council in County Londonderry in Northern Ireland. It was merged with Cookstown District Council and Dungannon and South Tyrone Borough Council on 1 April 2015 under local government reorganisation in Northern Ireland becoming Mid-Ulster District Council.

Q1229798.name: Bugiri District
Q1229798.about: Bugiri District is a district in Eastern Uganda. Like most other Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Bugiri, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1229797.name: Bushenyi District
Q1229797.about: Bushenyi District is a district in Western Uganda. Like many other Ugandan districts, it is named after its chief town, Bushenyi, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1346554.name: Karbinci Municipality
Q1346554.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1346554.about: Karbinci (Macedonian: ; Turkish: Karbinci Belediyesi) is a municipality in the eastern part of North Macedonia. Karbinci is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is located.

Q1362085.name: Budaka District
Q1362085.about: Budaka District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Budaka serves as the district headquarters.

Q1367759.name: Isfahan Province
Q1367759.about: Isfahan province (Persian: استان اصفهان) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Isfahan.

Q484392.name: Kırıkkale Province
Q484392.about: Kırıkkale Province (Turkish: Kırıkkale ili) is a province of Turkey. It is located on the crossroads of major highways east of Ankara leading east to the Black Sea region.

Q485056.name: Akmola Region
Q485056.about: Akmola Region is a centrally located region of Kazakhstan. It was known as Tselinograd Oblast during Soviet rule.

Q485429.name: Karaganda Region
Q485429.about: Karaganda Region is a region of Kazakhstan. Its capital is Karaganda.

Q503928.name: Plateau State
Q503928.about: Plateau () is a Nigerian state located in the North Central geopolitical zone. Its capital city is Jos.

Q320852.name: Abia State
Q320852.about: Abia  (Igbo: Alaọha Abia) is a state in the Southeastern region of Nigeria. The state's capital is Umuahia and its most populous city is Aba.

Q329060.name: Jafara
Q329060.about: Jafara or Al Jfara (Arabic: الجفارة Al Jifārah) is one of the districts of Libya, in the historical region of Tripolitania. Its capital and largest city is 'Aziziya.

Q331153.name: Mwanza Region
Q331153.about: Mwanza Region  (Mkoa wa Mwanza in Swahili) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions,  covering a total land area of 25,233 km2 (9,743 sq mi). Mwanza Region is bordered to the north through Lake Victoria by the Kagera Region and Mara Region, to the east by Simiyu Region, to the south by the Shinyanga Region and to the west by Geita Region.

Q620742.name: Tunceli Province
Q620742.about: Tunceli Province (Turkish: Tunceli ili), formerly Dersim Province (Kurdish: Parêzgeha Dêrsim; Zazaki: Dêsim wilayet; Armenian: Տէրսիմի մարզ), is a province in the Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey. Its central city is Tunceli.

Q627844.name: Tuy Province
Q627844.about: Tuy (or Tui) is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Hauts-Bassins Region. Its capital is Houndé.

Q643919.name: Torfaen
Q643919.about: Torfaen (; [tɔrˈvaɪn]) is a county borough in the south-east of Wales. Torfaen is bordered by the county of Monmouthshire to the east, the city of Newport to the south, and the county boroughs of Caerphilly and Blaenau Gwent to the south-west and north-west.

Q657754.name: Ilinden Municipality
Q657754.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q657754.about: Ilinden (Macedonian: ) is a municipality part of North Macedonia. Ilinden is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is found.

Q661376.name: Kourwéogo Province
Q661376.desc: province of Plateau-Central region, Burkina Faso
Q661376.about: Kourwéogo is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Plateau-Central Region. It has a population of 181,202 (2019 census).

Q671086.name: Muramvya Province
Q671086.about: Muramvya Province was one of the provinces of Burundi. The capital city was Muramvya.

Q676641.name: Bougouriba Province
Q676641.about: Bougouriba is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Sud-Ouest Region. In 2019 the population of Bougouriba was 153,606.

Q134187.name: Kırşehir Province
Q134187.about: Kırşehir Province (Turkish: Kırşehir ili) is a province in central Turkey, forming part of the Central Anatolia Region. Its area is 6,584 km2, and its population is 244,519 (2022).

Q134417.name: Markazi Province
Q134417.about: Markazi province (Persian: استان مرکزی) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Arak.

Q503936.name: Bauchi State
Q503936.about: Bauchi (Hausa: Jihar Bauchi / Fula: Leydi Bauchi 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤣𞤭 𞤦𞤢𞤵𞤷𞥅𞤭) is a state located in northeastern Nigeria. It is bordered by Jigawa to the north, Yobe to the north-east, Gombe to the east, Taraba and Plateau to the south, Kaduna to the west and Kano to the northwest respectfully.
Q503936.img: Water buck (Kobus ellipsiprymnus) -Yankari game reserve, Bauchi State (1).jpg

Q505691.name: Omagh District Council
Q505691.desc: administrative territorial entity of the United Kingdom
Q505691.about: Omagh District Council  was a local council in Northern Ireland. It merged with Fermanagh District Council in April 2015 under local government reorganisation to become Fermanagh and Omagh District Council.

Q506808.name: Ebonyi State
Q506808.about: Ebonyi (Igbo: Alaọha Ebonyi) is a state in the South-East geopolitical zone of Nigeria, bordered to the north and northeast by Benue State, Enugu State to the west, Cross River State to the east and southeast, and Abia State to the southwest. Named after the Abonyi (Aboine) River—a large part of which is in the state's south—Ebonyi State was formed from parts of Abia and Enugu state in 1996 and has its capital in Abakaliki.

Q509300.name: Federal Capital Territory
Q509300.desc: capital territory of Nigeria, which contains the capital city, Abuja
Q509300.about: The Federal Capital Territory (FCT) is a federal territory in central Nigeria. Abuja, the capital city of Nigeria, is located in this territory.

Q527980.name: Vavuniya District
Q527980.about: Vavuniya District (Tamil: வவுனியா மாவட்டம் Vavuṉiyā Māvaṭṭam; Sinhala: වවුනියා දිස්ත්‍රික්කය) is one of the 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country. The district is administered by a District Secretariat headed by a District Secretary (previously known as a Government Agent) appointed by the central government of Sri Lanka.

Q534528.name: Oshana Region
Q534528.about: Oshana is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia; its capital is Oshakati. The towns of Oshakati, Ongwediva , and Ondangwa, all situated with this region, form an urban cluster with the second largest population concentration in Namibia after the capital Windhoek.

Q534917.name: Ekiti State
Q534917.about: Ekiti () (Yoruba: Ìpínlẹ̀ Èkìtì) is a state in southwestern Nigeria, bordered to the North by Kwara State for 61 km, to the Northeast by Kogi State for 92 km, to the South and Southeast by Ondo State for 132 km, and to the West by Osun State for 84 km. Named for the Ekiti people—the Yoruba subgroup that makes up the majority of the state's population—Ekiti State was carved out from a part of Ondo State in 1996 and has its capital as the city of Ado-Ekiti.

Q677037.name: Telangana
Q677037.about: Telangana is a state in southern India on the Deccan Plateau bordering Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh to the north and Andhra Pradesh and Karnataka to the south. It is the eleventh largest and the twelfth most populated state of India.

Q682571.name: Kano State
Q682571.about:
Kano State 
(Hausa: Jihar Kano جِهَرْ كَنُوَ) is one of the 36 states of Nigeria, located in the northern region of the country. According to the 2006 national census, Kano State was the most populous state in Nigeria.

Q682704.name: Edo State
Q682704.about: Edo is a state in Nigeria located in the South-South geopolitical zone of Nigeria. As of 2024, the state was ranked as the 20th most populous state (5,250,000) in Nigeria.

Q187693.name: Fejér County
Q187693.about: Fejér (Hungarian: Fejér megye, pronounced [ˈfɛjeːr]) is an administrative county in central Hungary. It lies on the west bank of the river Danube and nearly touches the eastern shore of Lake Balaton.

Q187812.name: Dunaújváros
Q187812.about: Dunaújváros (pronounced [ˈdunɒuːjvaːroʃ]; also known by alternative names) is an industrial city with county rights in Fejér County, Central Hungary. Situated 70 kilometres (43 miles) south of Budapest along the Danube, the city is best known for its steelworks, the largest in the country.
Q187812.img: Dunaújváros, Városháza tér a bíróság épülete felé nézve, mögötte az Október 23. tér, 1 szám .jpg

Q187821.name: Tatabánya
Q187821.about: Tatabánya (Hungarian: [ˈtɒtɒbaːɲɒ] ; German: Totiserkolonie; Slovak: Banská Stará) is a city with county rights of 64,305 inhabitants in northwestern Hungary, in the Central Transdanubian region. It is the capital of Komárom-Esztergom County.
Q187821.img: Kilátás délkelet felé a Kőhegyről, 2008 Tatabánya.jpg

Q83065.name: Leicester
Q83065.desc: city in Leicestershire, East Midlands, England
Q83065.about: Leicester (  LES-tər) is a city, unitary authority area, and the county town of Leicestershire, in the East Midlands of England. It is the largest city in the East Midlands, with a population of 383,116 in 2025.

Q83073.name: Aksaray Province
Q83073.about: Aksaray Province (Turkish: Aksaray ili) is a province in central Turkey. Its adjacent provinces are Konya along the west and south, Ankara to the northwest, Niğde to the southeast, Nevşehir to the east, and Kırşehir to the north.

Q387745.name: Kogi State
Q387745.about: Kogi State is a state in the North Central region of Nigeria, bordered to the west by the states of Ekiti and Kwara, to the north by the Federal Capital Territory, to the northeast by Nasarawa State, to the northwest by Niger State, to the southwest by the states of Edo and Ondo, to the southeast by the states of Anambra and Enugu, and to the east by Benue State. It is the only state in Nigeria to border ten other states.

Q392522.name: Alborz Province
Q392522.about: Alborz province (Persian: استان البرز) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. Its capital is the city of Karaj, which lies 40 km west of Tehran, at the foothills of the Alborz mountains.
Q392522.img: Iran - Alborz Province - Taleghan Lake - panoramio.jpg

Q427201.name: Craigavon Borough Council
Q427201.desc: local council in counties Armagh, Down and Antrim, in Northern Ireland
Q427201.about: Craigavon Borough Council was a local council in counties Armagh, Down and Antrim, in Northern Ireland. It merged with Armagh City and District Council and Banbridge District Council in May 2015 under local government reorganisation in Northern Ireland to become Armagh, Banbridge and Craigavon District Council.

Q430693.name: Nevşehir Province
Q430693.about: Nevşehir Province (Turkish: Nevşehir ili) is a province in central Turkey with its capital in Nevşehir. Its area is 5,485 km2, and its population is 317,952 (2024).

Q432317.name: Gourma Province
Q432317.about: Gourma is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, in Est Region. The capital of Gourma is Fada N’Gourma.

Q80370.name: Batman Province
Q80370.about: Batman Province (Turkish: Batman ili; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Êlihê, transl. "Province of Êlih";") is a province in the Southeastern Anatolia Region of Turkey. It was created in May 1990 with Law No.

Q80903.name: Hidalgo
Q80903.about: Hidalgo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Hidalgo, is one of the 31 states which, along with Mexico City, constitute the 32 federal entities of Mexico. It is divided into 84 municipalities and its capital city is Pachuca de Soto.
Q80903.img: Casa en Real del Monte, Hidalgo, México, 2013-10-10, DD 01.JPG

Q171866.name: Middlesbrough
Q171866.desc: town in North Yorkshire, north-east England
Q171866.about: Middlesbrough (  MID-əlz-brə), colloquially known as Boro, is a port town and unitary authority of North Yorkshire, located in North East England.  Situated on the southern bank of the River Tees, Middlesbrough forms part of the Borough of Middlesbrough, the Teesside built-up area and the Tees Valley.

Q172438.name: Peterborough
Q172438.about: Peterborough (  PEE-tər-bər-ə, -⁠burr-ə) is a cathedral city in the City of Peterborough district in the ceremonial county of Cambridgeshire, England. The city is 74 miles (119 km) north of London, on the River Nene.

Q179351.name: City of Westminster
Q179351.about: The City of Westminster () is a London borough with city status in Greater London, England. It is the site of the United Kingdom's Houses of Parliament and much of the British government.

Q180068.name: Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad Province
Q180068.about: Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad province (Persian: استان کهگیلویه و بویراحمد) is one of the 31 provinces of Iran. It is in the southwest of the country, in Iran's Region 2.

Q134902.name: Stoke-on-Trent
Q134902.about: Stoke-on-Trent, often known as Stoke, is a city and unitary authority area in Staffordshire, England. It had an estimated population of 259,965 in 2022, making it the largest settlement in Staffordshire and one of the largest cities of the Midlands.

Q151048.name: London Borough of Barnet
Q151048.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q151048.about: The London Borough of Barnet ( ) is a suburban London borough in north London, England. Forming part of Outer London, the borough was formed in 1965 from parts of the ceremonial counties of Middlesex and Hertfordshire.

Q153326.name: Singida Region
Q153326.about: Singida Region (Swahili: Mkoa wa Singida) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. It covers a land area of 49,340 km2 (19,050 sq mi), comparable in size to the nation of Slovakia.

Q153335.name: Tabora Region
Q153335.about: Tabora Region  (Swahili: Mkoa wa Tabora) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions located in mid-western part of Tanzania. The regional capital is the municipality of Tabora.

Q153339.name: Shinyanga Region
Q153339.about: Shinyanga Region (Mkoa wa Shinyanga in Swahili) is one of Tanzania's 31 administrative regions. The region covers a land area of 18,555 km2 (7,164 sq mi).

Q1473780.name: West Berkshire
Q1473780.desc: unitary authority area in Berkshire, England
Q1473780.about: West Berkshire is a unitary authority area in Berkshire, England. It comprises the part of the ceremonial county west of Reading.

Q1583950.name: Nuwara Eliya District
Q1583950.about: Nuwara Eliya District (Tamil: நுவரெலியா மாவட்டம், romanized: Nuvareliyā Māvaṭṭam; Sinhala: නුවරඑළිය දිස්ත්‍රික්කය, romanized: Nuvaraeḷiya Distrikkaya) is a district in Central Province, Sri Lanka, centered on the tourist city of Nuwara Eliya.

Q1587175.name: Ratnapura district
Q1587175.desc: Administrative District in Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka
Q1587175.about:
Ratnapura (Sinhala: රත්නපුර දිස්ත්‍රික්කය, Tamil: இரத்தினபுரம் மாவட்டம்) is a district of Sri Lanka in the Sabaragamuwa Province.
This gem-mining centre of Sri Lanka is also a major crossroads between southern plains and the hill country to the east.

Q1737803.name: Kegalle District
Q1737803.desc: administrative district in Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka
Q1737803.about: Kegalle is a district in Sabaragamuwa Province, Sri Lanka. It is one of 25 districts of Sri Lanka, the second level administrative division of the country.

Q1752424.name: Stockport
Q1752424.desc: metropolitan borough of Greater Manchester in North West England
Q1752424.about: The Metropolitan Borough of Stockport is a metropolitan borough of Greater Manchester, England. It lies south-east of central Manchester and south of Tameside.

Q1758432.name: Wokingham
Q1758432.desc: unitary authority area in Berkshire, England, UK
Q1758432.about: Wokingham, or the Borough of Wokingham, is a local government district with borough status in Berkshire, England. Since 1998 its council has been a unitary authority, having taken on county-level functions when Berkshire County Council was abolished.

Q1779775.name: Bosilovo Municipality
Q1779775.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1779775.about: Bosilovo (Macedonian: Општина Босилово, Opština Bosilovo) is a municipality in the southeast of North Macedonia. The village of Bosilovo is the municipal seat.

Q1819289.name: Kočani Municipality
Q1819289.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1819289.about: Kočani (Macedonian: Кочани [ˈkɔtʃani] ) is a municipality in the eastern part of North Macedonia. Kočani is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is located.

Q1839369.name: Mogila Municipality
Q1839369.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1839369.about: Mogila (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in south-central North Macedonia. Mogila is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is located.

Q1368496.name: Windsor and Maidenhead
Q1368496.about: The Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead is a unitary authority area with royal borough status in Berkshire, England. The borough is named after its two largest towns of Maidenhead (where the council is based) and Windsor.
Q1368496.wiki: Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead

Q1375755.name: Butaleja District
Q1375755.about: Butaleja District is a district in Eastern Uganda. It is named after its main town, Butaleja, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1375812.name: Bukedea District
Q1375812.about: Bukedea District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The town of Bukedea is the site of the district headquarters.

Q1375819.name: Namutumba District
Q1375819.about: Namutumba District, sometimes referred to as Busiki District is a district in Eastern Uganda. It is named after its 'chief town', Namutumba, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1375835.name: Sironko District
Q1375835.about: Sironko District is a district in the Eastern Region of Uganda. The district was created in 2000 and had previously been part of Mbale District.

Q1375843.name: Pallisa District
Q1375843.about: Pallisa District is a district in Eastern Uganda which was carved out of Tororo district in 1991. Like most other Ugandan districts, it is named after its main town, Pallisa, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1375853.name: Nakapiripirit District
Q1375853.about: Nakapiripirit District  is a district in Northern Uganda. Like many Ugandan districts, it is named after its 'chief town', Nakapiripirit, where the district headquarters are located.

Q1697.name: Moscow Oblast
Q1697.about: Moscow Oblast, informally known as Podmoskovye is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). With a population of 8,524,665 (2021 Census) living in an area of 44,300 square kilometers (17,100 sq mi), it is one of the most densely populated regions in the country and is the second most populous federal subject.
Q1697.img: Moscow Urban Agglomeration, Russia, LandSat-7 image.jpg

Q1727.name: Samara Oblast
Q1727.about: Samara Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Samara.

Q805427.name: Ballymoney
Q805427.desc: administrative territorial entity of the United Kingdom
Q805427.about: Ballymoney was a local government district with borough status in Northern Ireland. It was headquartered in Ballymoney.

Q805913.name: Balé Province
Q805913.about: Balé is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso, located in its Boucle du Mouhoun Region with Boromo as capital. Its area is 4,596 km2 (1,775 sq mi), and had a population of 297,367 in 2019.

Q806141.name: Banbridge
Q806141.desc: administrative territorial entity of the United Kingdom
Q806141.about: Banbridge was a local government district in Northern Ireland. The district was one of 26 council areas formed on 1 October 1973, following the implementation of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972.

Q810793.name: Bath and North East Somerset
Q810793.about: Bath and North East Somerset (B&NES) is a unitary authority area in the ceremonial county of Somerset, South West England. As its name suggests, it comprises the north-east part of Somerset including  the city of Bath, which is its administrative headquarters.
Q810793.img: View from Bath Skyline walk near Bathwick Hill - geograph.org.uk - 4877693.jpg

Q812064.name: Bay
Q812064.about: Bay (Somali: Baay, Arabic: باي,) is an administrative region (gobol) in southern Somalia within the Southwest state.

Q833013.name: Magway Region
Q833013.about: Magway Region (Burmese: မကွေးတိုင်းဒေသကြီး, pronounced [məɡwé táiɰ̃ dèθa̰ dʑí]; formerly Magway Division) is a first-level administrative division in central Myanmar. It is the second largest of Myanmar's seven regions, with an area of 44,820 km2 (17,306 square miles).

Q834508.name: Khomas Region
Q834508.about: Khomas is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia. Its name refers to the Khomas Highland, a high plateau landscape that dominates this administrative subdivision.

Q836645.name: Nasarawa State
Q836645.about: Nasarawa   is a state in the North Central region of Nigeria, bordered to the east by the states of Taraba and Plateau, to the north by Kaduna State, to the south by the states of Benue and Kogi, and to the west by the Federal Capital Territory. Named for the historic Nassarawa Emirate, the state was formed from the west of Plateau State on 1 October 1996.

Q842939.name: Imo State
Q842939.about: Imo (Igbo: Alaọha Imo) is a state in the South-East geopolitical zone of Nigeria, bordered to the north by Anambra State, Rivers State to the west and south, and Abia State to the east. It takes its name from the Imo River which flows along the state's eastern border.
Q842939.img: Wonder masquerade, Oguta, Imo State, Nigeria.jpg

Q682721.name: Osun State
Q682721.about: Osun ( OH-shoon; Yoruba: Ìpínlẹ̀ Ọ̀ṣun [ìk͡pĩ́lɛ̀ ɔ̀ʃũ̄] ), is a state in southwestern Nigeria; bounded to the east by Ekiti and Ondo states for 84 km (52.20 mi) and 78 km (48.47 mi) respectively, to the north by Kwara State for 73 km (45.36 mi), to the south by Ogun State for 84 km (52.2 mi) and to the west by Oyo State, mostly across the Osun River. Named after the River Osun—a vital river which flows through the state—the state was formed from the southeast of Oyo State on 27 August 1991 and has its capital as the city of Osogbo.

Q684307.name: Wigan
Q684307.desc: metropolitan borough of Greater Manchester, in North West England
Q684307.about: The Metropolitan Borough of Wigan is a metropolitan borough of Greater Manchester, England. It is named after its largest town, Wigan, but covers a far larger area which includes the towns of Atherton, Ashton-in-Makerfield, Golborne, Hindley, Ince-in-Makerfield, Leigh and Tyldesley.

Q693450.name: Royal Borough of Greenwich
Q693450.desc: royal borough in the London Region in England
Q693450.about: The Royal Borough of Greenwich ( , ,  or ) is a London borough in southeast Greater London, England. It forms part of Inner London.

Q720843.name: Gitega Province
Q720843.about: Gitega is one of the five provinces of Burundi. Its capital is Gitega, which is also the political capital of the country.

Q483091.name: Elazığ Province
Q483091.about: Elazığ Province (Turkish: Elazığ ili; Zazaki: Suke Xarpêt; Kurdish: Parêzgeha Xarpêtê) is a province of Turkey with its seat in the city of Elazığ. Its area is 9,383 km2, and its population is 591,497 (2022).

Q483173.name: Erzincan Province
Q483173.about: Erzincan Province (Turkish: Erzincan ili); is a province in the Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey. In Turkey, its capital is also called Erzincan.

Q483472.name: Kayseri Province
Q483472.about: Kayseri Province (Turkish: Kayseri ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in central Turkey. Its area is 16,970 km2, and its population is 1,441,523 (2022).

Q203889.name: Luton
Q203889.about: Luton ( ) is a town and borough in Bedfordshire, England. The borough had a population of 225,262 at the 2021 census.

Q205358.name: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
Q205358.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q205358.about: The London Borough of Barking and Dagenham () is a London borough in East London. The borough was created in 1965 as the London Borough of Barking; the name was changed in 1980.
Q205358.wiki: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham

Q205679.name: London Borough of Hackney
Q205679.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q205679.about: The London Borough of Hackney (  HAK-nee) is a London borough in Inner London, England. The historical and administrative heart of Hackney is Mare Street.

Q205690.name: London Borough of Hillingdon
Q205690.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q205690.about: The London Borough of Hillingdon () is a London borough in Greater London, England. It forms part of outer London and West London, being the westernmost London borough.

Q205817.name: London Borough of Islington
Q205817.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q205817.about: The London Borough of Islington (  IZ-ling-tən) is a borough in North London, England. Forming part of Inner London, Islington has an estimated population of 215,667.

Q206019.name: Ziro Province
Q206019.about:
For the town in India, see Ziro.

Ziro is a province of Burkina Faso, located in its Centre-Ouest Region.

Q207111.name: North Lanarkshire
Q207111.about: North Lanarkshire (Scots: North Lanrikshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Lannraig a Tuath) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland. It borders the north-east of Glasgow and contains many of the wider Greater Glasgow settlements and areas.

Q207201.name: London Borough of Brent
Q207201.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q207201.about: Brent ( ) is a borough in west and north-west London, England; it forms part of Outer London. It is known for landmarks such as Wembley Stadium, the Swaminarayan Temple and the Kiln Theatre.

Q207208.name: London Borough of Bexley
Q207208.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q207208.hog: Teresa O'Neill, Baroness O’Neill of Bexley
Q207208.about: The London Borough of Bexley ( ) is a London borough in south-east London, forming part of Outer London. It has a population of 248,287.

Q207218.name: London Borough of Ealing
Q207218.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q207218.about: The London Borough of Ealing ( ) is a London borough in London, England. It comprises the districts of Acton, Ealing, Greenford, Hanwell, Northolt, Perivale and Southall.

Q207809.name: Arkhangai Province
Q207809.about: Arkhangai Province (Mongolian: Архангай аймаг) is one of the 21 provinces of Mongolia, located slightly west of the country's center, on the northern slopes of the Khangai Mountains. It is composed of 19 districts.

Q5207.name: Stavropol Krai
Q5207.about: Stavropol Krai, also known as Stavropolye, is a federal subject (a krai) of Russia. It is geographically located in the North Caucasus region in Southern Russia, and is administratively part of the North Caucasian Federal District.

Q5340.name: Mordovia
Q5340.about: Mordovia ( mor-DOH-vee-ə), officially the Republic of Mordovia, is a republic of Russia, situated in Eastern Europe. Its capital is the city of Saransk.

Q5387.name: Kirov Oblast
Q5387.desc: administrative division (oblast) in the Volga federal district of Russia
Q5387.about: Kirov Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast) located in Eastern Europe. Its administrative centre is the city of Kirov.

Q193486.name: Dire Dawa
Q193486.about: Dire Dawa (Oromo: Dirree Dhawaa, lit. 'Place of Remedy'; Somali: Diridhaba, meaning "where the Dir hit his spear into the ground" or "The true Dir", Amharic: ድሬዳዋ, Harari: ዲርሬዳዋ, lit. "Plain of Medicine") is a city in eastern Ethiopia near the Oromia Region and Oromo border and one of two chartered cities in Ethiopia (the other being Addis Ababa, the capital).

Q200045.name: Imereti
Q200045.about: Imereti (Georgian: იმერეთი, pronounced [imeɾetʰi]) is a region of Georgia situated in the central-western part of the republic along the middle and upper reaches of the Rioni River. Imereti is the most populous region in Georgia.
Q200045.img: Zestaponi. View from Shorapani fortress (Photo A. Muhranoff).jpg

Q202059.name: London Borough of Lambeth
Q202059.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q202059.about: Lambeth ( ) is a London borough in South London, England, which forms part of Inner London. Its name was recorded in 1062 as Lambehitha ("landing place for lambs") and in 1255 as Lambeth.

Q202088.name: London Borough of Camden
Q202088.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q202088.about: The London Borough of Camden ( ) is a borough in Inner London, England. Camden Town Hall, on Euston Road, lies 2 mi (3.2 km) north of Charing Cross.

Q384.name: Skopje
Q384.about: Skopje is the capital and largest city of North Macedonia. It lies in the northern part of the country, in the Skopje Valley along the Vardar River, and is the political, economic, and cultural centre of the country.

Q649.name: Moscow
Q649.desc: capital and most populous city of Russia
Q649.about: Moscow is the capital and largest city of Russia, situated on the Moskva River in Central Russia. The city has a population estimated at more than 13 million residents within city limits, more than 19.1 million residents in the urban area, and more than 21.5 million residents in the metropolitan area.
Q649.img: Saint Basil's Cathedral and the Red Square.jpg

Q209142.name: South Lanarkshire

Q210476.name: London Borough of Harrow

Q210531.name: London Borough of Enfield

Q210531.about: The London Borough of Enfield () is a London borough in Greater London, England. The main communities in the borough are Edmonton, Enfield, Southgate and Palmers Green.

Q210563.name: London Borough of Wandsworth

Q210563.about: Wandsworth ( ) is a London borough in South West London, England. It forms part of Inner London and has an estimated population of 329,677 inhabitants.

Q210647.name: Lisburn

Q211835.name: Dundgovi Province

Q188890.name: Veszprém County

Q191075.name: Baghdad Governorate

Q208201.name: London Borough of Bromley

Q856278.about: Demir Hisar (Macedonian: Демир Хисар [dɛˈmir‿xisar] ) is a municipality in the southwestern part of North Macedonia. Demir Hisar, which means "iron fortress" in Turkish, is also the name of the town where the municipal seat is located.

Q876512.name: Oshikoto Region
Q876512.about: Oshikoto is one of the fourteen regions of Namibia, named after Lake Otjikoto. Its capital is Omuthiya.

Q878284.name: Kaduna State
Q878284.about: Kaduna  (Hausa: Jihar Kaduna, جىِهَر كَدُنا; مدينة كدونا; Fula: Leydi Kaduna, 𞤤𞤫𞤴𞤣𞤭 𞤳𞤢𞤣𞤵𞤲𞤢; Tyap: A̱byin Ka̱duna) is a state in the northwest geopolitical zone of Nigeria. The state capital is its namesake, the city of Kaduna, which was the 8th largest city in the country as of 2006.

Q3734.name: Adygea
Q3734.desc: republic of Russia; federal subject of Russia
Q3734.about: Adygea ( AH-dig-AY-ə), officially the Republic of Adygea or the Adygean Republic, is a republic of Russia. It is situated in the North Caucasus of Eastern Europe.

Q4093.name: Glasgow
Q4093.about: Glasgow is the most populous city in Scotland, located on the banks of the River Clyde in west central Scotland. It is the third-most populous city in the United Kingdom and comprises 23 wards which represent the areas within the city boundaries.

Q13892.name: Tarlac
Q13892.about: Tarlac, officially the Province of Tarlac (Kapampangan: Lalawigan ning Tarlac; Pangasinan: Luyag na Tarlac; Ilocano: Probinsia ti Tarlac; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Tarlac; [tɐɾˈlak]), is a landlocked province in the Philippines located in the Central Luzon region. It had a population of 1,503,456 people according to the 2020 census.

Q18808.name: Pyongyang
Q18808.about: Pyongyang (Korean: 평양) is the capital and largest city of North Korea. According to the 2008 population census, it has a population of 3,255,288.

Q5462.name: Sverdlovsk Oblast
Q5462.desc: oblast and federal subject in Ural Federal District, Russia
Q5462.about: Sverdlovsk Oblast is a federal subject (an oblast) of Russia located in the Ural Federal District. Its administrative center is the city of Yekaterinburg, formerly known as Sverdlovsk.
Q5462.img: Regional border sign in Sverdlovsk Oblast.jpg

Q5466.name: Chuvashia
Q5466.about: Chuvashia, officially known as Chuvash Republic — Chuvashia, is a republic of Russia located in Eastern Europe. It is the homeland of the Chuvash people.

Q5481.name: Tatarstan
Q5481.about: Tatarstan, officially the Republic of Tatarstan, sometimes also called Tataria, is a republic of Russia located in Eastern Europe. It is a part of the Volga Federal District; and its capital and largest city is Kazan, an important cultural centre in Russia.
Q5481.img: Yelabuga. The confluence of the river Toyma and Kama P6211077 2575.jpg

Q2018939.name: Zajas Municipality
Q2018939.about:
Zajas (Macedonian: , Albanian: Zajaz) is a former municipality located in what is now western North Macedonia, created in a 1996 territorial reorganization and dissolved following a new 2013 Macedonian territorial reorganization, after which it was merged with Kičevo Municipality.

Zajas is also the name of the village where the municipal seat was found.

Q2018957.name: Kičevo Municipality
Q2018957.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2018957.about: Kičevo Municipality (Macedonian: Кичево; Albanian: Kërçovë) is a municipality in the western part of North Macedonia. The municipal seat is the city of Kičevo.

Q2018980.name: Vasilevo Municipality
Q2018980.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2018980.about: Vasilevo (Macedonian: ; Turkish: Vasilevo Belediyesi) is a municipality in the eastern part of North Macedonia. Vasilevo is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2019836.name: Gazi Baba Municipality
Q2019836.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia, one of the ten municipalities of the City of Skopje administrative unit
Q2019836.about: Gazi Baba (Macedonian: , Albanian: Gazi Babë) is one of the ten municipalities that make up the City of Skopje, the capital of North Macedonia. The municipality administration consists of a council and mayor.

Q2088034.name: Studeničani Municipality
Q2088034.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2088034.about: Studeničani Municipality (Macedonian: , Albanian: Studeniçan) is a municipality in central North Macedonia. Studeničani is the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2088561.name: Veles Municipality
Q2088561.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2088561.about: Veles (Macedonian: Велес [ˈvɛːlɛs] ) is a municipality in central part of North Macedonia. Veles is also the name of the city where the municipal seat is found.

Q2088585.name: Rosoman Municipality
Q2088585.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2088585.about: Rosoman (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in central North Macedonia. Rosoman is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q1996410.name: Želino Municipality
Q1996410.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1996410.about: Želino (Macedonian: , Albanian: Zhelinë) is a municipality in the northwestern part of North Macedonia. Želino is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q1996439.name: Drugovo Municipality
Q1996439.about:
Drugovo (Macedonian: ) is a former municipality in western North Macedonia, created in the 1996 territorial organisation and dissolved following the 2013 Macedonian new territorial organisation, after it was merged with Kičevo Municipality.

Drugovo is also the name of the village where the municipal seat was found.

Q1996470.name: Lozovo Municipality
Q1996470.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q1996470.about: Lozovo (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in eastern North Macedonia. Lozovo is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q1998500.name: Vraneštica Municipality
Q1998500.about: Vraneštica (Macedonian: ) is a former municipality in western North Macedonia, created in the 1996 territorial organisation and dissolved following the 2013 Macedonian new territorial organisation, after it was merged with Kičevo Municipality. Vraneštica is also the name of the village where the municipal seat was found.

Q2001785.name: Oslomej Municipality
Q2001785.about:
Oslomej (Macedonian: , Albanian: Osllomej) is a former municipality in western Republic of North Macedonia, created in 1996 territorial organisation and dissolved following the 2013 Macedonian new territorial organisation, after it was merged with Kičevo Municipality.

Oslomej is also the name of the village where the municipal seat was found.

Q2018921.name: Plasnica Municipality
Q2018921.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2018921.about: Plasnica (Macedonian: , Turkish: Plasniça) is a municipality in western North Macedonia. Plasnica is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is found.

Q2018930.name: Krivogaštani Municipality
Q2018930.desc: local administrative unit (opština) in North Macedonia
Q2018930.about: Krivogaštani Municipality (Macedonian: ) is a municipality in the western part of North Macedonia. Krivogaštani is also the name of the village where the municipal seat is located.

Q5701.name: Pirkanmaa
Q5701.about: Pirkanmaa (Finnish: [ˈpirkɑmˌmɑː]; Swedish: Birkaland; Latin: Birkaria), also known as Tampere Region in government documents, is a region of Finland. It borders the regions of Satakunta, South Ostrobothnia, Central Finland, Päijät-Häme, Kanta-Häme and Southwest Finland.

Q5706.name: North Savo
Q5706.about: North Savo (or Northern Savonia; Finnish: Pohjois-Savo; Swedish: Norra Savolax) is a region in eastern Finland. It borders the regions of South Savo, Central Finland, North Ostrobothnia, Kainuu, and North Karelia.

Q5708.name: Päijät-Häme
Q5708.about: Päijät-Häme (Finnish pronunciation: [ˈpæi̯j(ː)æt̪ˌhæme̞(ʔ)]; Swedish: Päijänne-Tavastland) is a region in Southern Finland south of the lake Päijänne. It borders the regions of Uusimaa, Kanta-Häme, Pirkanmaa, Central Finland, South Savo and Kymenlaakso.

Q6585.name: Irkutsk Oblast
Q6585.desc: oblast and federal subject in central Siberia, Russia
Q6585.about: Irkutsk Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast), located in southeastern Siberia in the basins of the Angara, Lena, and Nizhnyaya Tunguska Rivers. The administrative center is the city of Irkutsk.
Q6585.img: Baikal, Cape Burhan, Olkhon Island, Lake Baikal, Russia.jpg

Q8684.name: Seoul
Q8684.desc: capital and largest city of South Korea
Q8684.about: Seoul, officially Seoul Special Metropolitan City, is the capital and largest city of South Korea, and the largest city in the whole of Korea. The broader Seoul Metropolitan Area, encompassing Seoul, Gyeonggi Province and Incheon, emerged as the world's sixth largest metropolitan economy in 2022, behind New York, Tokyo, Los Angeles, Paris, and London, and hosts more than half of South Korea's population.

Q730706.name: London Borough of Southwark
Q730706.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q730706.about: The London Borough of Southwark (  SUDH-ərk) in South London forms part of Inner London and is connected by bridges across the River Thames to the City of London and the London Borough of Tower Hamlets. It was created in 1965 when three smaller council areas were amalgamated under the London Government Act 1963.

Q735463.name: Karuzi Province
Q735463.about: Karuzi Province was one of the provinces of Burundi. In 2025, it was merged into Gitega Province.

Q745073.name: Kurunegala District
Q745073.about: Kurunegala is a district in North Western Province, Sri Lanka. The district is 4,812.7 km2 (1,858.2 sq mi).

Q787421.name: Matale District
Q787421.desc: Administrative District in Central Province, Sri Lanka
Q787421.about: Matale District (Sinhala: මාතලේ දිස්ත්‍රික්කය, Tamil: மாத்தளை மாவட்டம்) is a district in the Central Province of Sri Lanka. It is one of 25 districts of Sri Lanka.

Q792550.name: Ad Dakhiliyah Governorate
Q792550.about: Ad Dakhiliyah (Arabic: الداخلية, romanized: Ad-Dāḫilīyah, lit. 'The Interior') is one of the eleven governorates (muhafazah) of Oman with Nizwa town as the regional center. It was previously a region (mintaqah).

Q799713.name: Badulla District
Q799713.desc: Administrative District in Uva Province, Sri Lanka
Q799713.about: Badulla District (Sinhala: බදුල්ල දිස්ත්‍රික්කය badūlla distrikkaya; Tamil: பதுளை மாவட்டம் Patuḷai māvaṭṭam) is a district in Uva Province, Sri Lanka. The entire land area of the Badulla district is 2,861 km2 (1,105 sq mi) and has a total population of 871763 as of 2024.

Q805424.name: Ballymena Borough
Q805424.desc: local government district in Northern Ireland
Q805424.about: Ballymena is a former local government district with borough status in Northern Ireland. It was one of twenty-six districts created on 1 October 1973 and covered the town of Ballymena and the surrounding area which includes small towns including Broughshane, Cullybackey, Galgorm, Ahoghill and Portglenone.

Q211889.name: East Dunbartonshire
Q211889.about: East Dunbartonshire (Scots: Aest Dunbartanshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Dhùn Bhreatann an Ear, pronounced [ˈʃirˠəxk ɣun ˈvɾʲɛht̪ən̪ˠ ə ˈɲɛɾ]) is one of the 32 council areas of Scotland. It borders Glasgow City Council Area to the south, North Lanarkshire to the east, Stirling to the north, and West Dunbartonshire to the west.

Q211907.name: Slough
Q211907.about: Slough () is a town in Berkshire, England, in the Thames Valley, 20 miles (32 km) west of central London and 19 miles (31 km) north-east of Reading, at the intersection of the M4, M40 and M25 motorways. It is part of the historic county of Buckinghamshire.

Q211925.name: East Renfrewshire
Q211925.about: East Renfrewshire (Scots: Aest Renfrewshire; Scottish Gaelic: Siorrachd Rinn Friù an Ear) is one of 32 council areas of Scotland. It was formed in 1996, as a successor to the Eastwood district of the Strathclyde region.

Q213560.name: London Borough of Haringey
Q213560.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q213560.about: The London Borough of Haringey (  HARR-ing-gay, same as Harringay) is a London borough in north London, classified by some definitions as part of Inner London, and by others as part of Outer London. It was created in 1965 by the amalgamation of three former boroughs.

Q214104.name: Karbala Governorate
Q214104.about: Karbala Governorate (Arabic: محافظة كربلاء, Muḥāfażat Karbalāʾ) is a governorate in central Iraq. Its administrative center is the city of Karbala, a holy city for Shia Muslims for housing the shrine of the revered Imam Hussein.

Q214162.name: London Borough of Hounslow
Q214162.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q214162.about: The London Borough of Hounslow (  HOWNZ-loh) is a London borough in west London, England, forming part of Outer London. It is governed by Hounslow London Borough Council.

Q215030.name: London Borough of Lewisham
Q215030.desc: borough in the London Region in England
Q215030.about: Lewisham (  LOO-ish-əm) is a London borough in south-east London, England. It forms part of Inner London.

Q5545.name: Penza Oblast
Q5545.about: Penza Oblast (Russian: Пензенская область, IPA: [ˈpʲenzʲɪnskəjə ˈobɫəsʲtʲ]) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Its administrative center is the city of Penza.

Q5634.name: Ulyanovsk Oblast
Q5634.about: Ulyanovsk Oblast is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). It is located in the Volga Federal District.

Q5710.name: Bashkortostan
Q5710.about: Bashkortostan, officially the Republic of Bashkortostan, sometimes also called Bashkiria, is a republic of Russia between the Volga river and the Ural Mountains in Eastern Europe. The republic borders Perm Krai to the north, Sverdlovsk Oblast to the northeast, Chelyabinsk Oblast to the east, Orenburg Oblast to the south, Tatarstan to the west and Udmurtia to the northwest.

Q5884.name: Tomsk Oblast
Q5884.about: Tomsk Oblast (Russian: То́мская о́бласть, romanized: Tomskaya oblastʹ) is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). It lies in the southeastern West Siberian Plain, in the southwest of the Siberian Federal District.
Q5884.img: Tomsk city and vicinities, Russia, LandSat-5 near natural colors satellite image, 2011-09-27.jpg

Q6076.name: Kemerovo Oblast
Q6076.about: Kemerovo Oblast, also known as Kuzbass, after the Kuznetsk Basin, is a federal subject of Russia (an oblast). Kemerovo is the administrative center and largest city of the oblast.

Q23106.name: Leicestershire
Q23106.about: Leicestershire (  LEST-ər-sheer, -⁠shər) is a ceremonial county in the East Midlands of England. It is bordered by Derbyshire, Nottinghamshire and Lincolnshire to the north, Rutland to the east, Northamptonshire to the south-east, Warwickshire to the south-west, and Staffordshire to the west.

Q23107.name: Rutland
Q23107.desc: county and unitary authority area in the East Midlands in England, United Kingdom
Q23107.about: Rutland is a ceremonial county in the East Midlands of England. It borders Leicestershire to the north and west, Lincolnshire to the north-east, and Northamptonshire to the south-west.

Q23112.name: Cambridgeshire
Q23112.about: Cambridgeshire (abbreviated Cambs.) is a ceremonial county in the East of England and East Anglia. It is bordered by Lincolnshire to the north, Norfolk to the north-east, Suffolk to the east, Essex and Hertfordshire to the south, Northamptonshire to the west, and Bedfordshire to the south-west.

Q81551.name: Konya Province
Q81551.about: Konya Province (Turkish: Konya ili) is a province and metropolitan municipality in southwest Central Anatolia, Turkey. Its area is 40,838 km2, making it the largest province by area, and its population is 2,296,347 (2022).

Q82096.name: Denizli Province
Q82096.about: Denizli Province (Turkish: Denizli ili) (Turkish pronunciation: [deniz'ʎi iʎi]) is a province and metropolitan municipality of Turkey in Western Anatolia, on high ground above the Aegean coast. Neighbouring provinces are Uşak to the north, Burdur, Isparta, Afyon to the east, Aydın, Manisa to the west and Muğla to the south.

Q82112.name: State of Mexico
Q82112.about: The State of Mexico, officially Mexico, is one of the 32 federal entities of the United Mexican States. Sharing its name with both the country and the national capital, Mexico City, the state is colloquially distinguished as Edomex ([eðoˈmeks], from E[sta]do [de] Méx[ico], "State of Mexico").

Q82681.name: Tlaxcala
Q82681.about: Tlaxcala, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Tlaxcala, is one of the 32 federal entities that comprise the Federal Entities of Mexico. It is divided into 60 municipalities and the capital city and the largest city is Tlaxcala de Xicohténcatl.
Q82681.img: Palacio de Gobierno de Tlaxcala - panoramio.jpg

Q880782.name: Blackburn with Darwen
Q880782.desc: unitary authority area in Lancashire, North West England
Q880782.about: Blackburn with Darwen is a unitary authority area with borough status in the ceremonial county of Lancashire, North West England. The borough includes the towns of Blackburn and Darwen plus a wider rural area which includes the villages of Lower Darwen, Feniscowles, Brownhill and Hoddlesden.

Q894077.name: Bedford
Q894077.desc: unitary authority area with the status of a borough in the ceremonial county of Bedfordshire, England, UK
Q894077.about: The Borough of Bedford, is a local government district with borough status that encompasses the northern part of Bedfordshire, England. It is administered by Bedford Borough Council, a unitary authority.

Q894090.name: City of Milton Keynes
Q894090.desc: unitary authority area with city and borough status in Buckinghamshire, England
Q894090.about: The City of Milton Keynes is a borough in Buckinghamshire, England, which has had city status since 2022. It takes its name from its main settlement, Milton Keynes.

Q894094.name: Stockton-on-Tees
Q894094.desc: unitary authority area and borough in the Tees Valley region situated in the North East of England
Q894094.about: The Borough of Stockton-on-Tees is a unitary authority area with borough status in County Durham and North Yorkshire, England. In 2021, it had a population of 196,600.

Q894093.name: Swindon
Q894093.desc: unitary authority area in Wiltshire, South West England
Q894093.about: The Borough of Swindon is a unitary authority area with borough status in Wiltshire, England. Centred on Swindon, it is the most north-easterly district of South West England.

Q895102.name: Boulkiemdé Province
Q895102.about: Boulkiemdé is one of the 45 provinces of Burkina Faso and is in Centre-Ouest Region. The capital of Boulkiemdé is Koudougou.

Q896725.name: Bracknell Forest
Q896725.desc: unitary authority in Berkshire, England, UK
Q896725.about: Bracknell Forest is a borough with unitary status in Berkshire, England, centred on the two towns of Bracknell and Sandhurst. It also includes the villages of Crowthorne and also includes the areas of North Ascot, Binfield, Warfield, and Winkfield.

Q918975.name: Kirklees
Q918975.desc: metropolitan borough in West Yorkshire, England
Q918975.about: Kirklees is a metropolitan borough of West Yorkshire, England. The borough comprises the ten towns of Batley, Birstall, Cleckheaton, Dewsbury, Heckmondwike, Holmfirth, Huddersfield, Meltham, Mirfield and Slaithwaite.

Q923420.name: Monaragala District
Q923420.desc: administrative district in Uva Province, Sri Lanka
Q923420.about: Monaragala (Sinhala: මොණරාගල දිස්ත්‍රික්කය, Tamil: மொணராகலை மாவட்டம்) is a district in Uva Province of Sri Lanka. It is the 2nd largest of the 25 districts in Sri Lanka, with an area of 5,636 km2 (2,176 sq mi).

Q929034.name: Gateshead
Q929034.desc: metropolitan borough of Tyne and Wear, in North East England
Q929034.about: The Metropolitan Borough of Gateshead is a metropolitan borough in the metropolitan county of Tyne and Wear, England. It includes Gateshead, Rowlands Gill, Whickham, Blaydon, Ryton, Felling, Birtley, Pelaw, Dunston and Low Fell.

Q54169.name: Masovian Voivodeship
Q54169.about:
Masovian Voivodeship (Polish: województwo mazowieckie, pronounced [vɔjɛˈvut͡stfɔ mazɔˈvjɛt͡skʲɛ] ) is a voivodeship, or province, in east-central Poland, containing Poland's capital, Warsaw.
Masovian Voivodeship has an area of 35,579 square kilometres (13,737 sq mi) and had a 2019 population of 5,411,446, making it Poland's largest and most populous province.

Q54183.name: Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship
Q54183.about: Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship (Polish: województwo świętokrzyskie [vɔjɛˈvut͡stfɔ ɕfjɛntɔˈkʂɨskʲɛ] ), also known as Holy Cross Voivodeship, is a voivodeship (province) in southeastern Poland, in the historical region of Lesser Poland. The province's capital and largest city is Kielce.

Q23115.name: Northamptonshire
Q23115.about: Northamptonshire ( nor-THAMP-tən-shər, -⁠sheer; abbreviated Northants.) is a ceremonial county in the East Midlands of England. It is bordered by Leicestershire, Rutland and Lincolnshire to the north; Cambridgeshire to the east; Bedfordshire and Buckinghamshire to the south; Oxfordshire to the south west; and Warwickshire to the west.

Q23135.name: Worcestershire
Q23135.desc: non-metropolitan county in the West Midlands of England
Q23135.about: Worcestershire (  WUUST-ər-shər,  -⁠sheer; written abbreviation: Worcs) is a ceremonial county in the West Midlands of England. It is bordered by Shropshire, Staffordshire, and the West Midlands county to the north, Warwickshire to the east, Gloucestershire to the south, and Herefordshire to the west.

Q23140.name: Warwickshire
Q23140.desc: ceremonial and non-metropolitan county in England, UK
Q23140.about: Warwickshire ( ;  abbreviated Warks) is a ceremonial county in the West Midlands of England. It is bordered by Staffordshire and Leicestershire to the north, Northamptonshire to the east, Oxfordshire and Gloucestershire to the south, and Worcestershire and the West Midlands county to the west.

Q23169.name: Oxfordshire
Q23169.about: Oxfordshire (  OKS-fərd-shər, -⁠sheer; abbreviated Oxon) is a ceremonial county in South East England. The county is bordered by Northamptonshire and Warwickshire to the north, Buckinghamshire to the east, Berkshire to the south, and Wiltshire and Gloucestershire to the west.

Q13812.name: Ifugao
Q13812.about: Ifugao, officially the Province of Ifugao (Ilocano: Probinsia ti Ifugao; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Ifugao), is a landlocked province of the Philippines in the Cordillera Administrative Region in Luzon. Its capital is Lagawe and it borders Benguet to the west, Mountain Province to the north, Isabela to the east, and Nueva Vizcaya to the south.

Q13827.name: Kalinga
Q13827.about: Kalinga (IPA: [ka'liŋɡa]), officially the Province of Kalinga (Ilocano: Probinsia ti Kalinga; Tagalog: Lalawigan ng Kalinga), is a landlocked province in the Philippines situated within the Cordillera Administrative Region in Luzon. Its capital (and largest city) is Tabuk and borders Mountain Province to the south, Abra to the west, Isabela to the east, Cagayan to the northeast, and Apayao to the north.

Q13840.name: Laguna
Q13840.about: Laguna [lɐˈɣuː.na], officially the Province of Laguna (Filipino: Lalawigan ng Laguna), is a province in the Philippines located in the Calabarzon region in Luzon. Its capital is Santa Cruz while its largest city is Biñan.

Q13861.name: Mountain Province
Q13861.about: Mountain Province is a landlocked province of the Philippines in the Cordillera Administrative Region in Luzon. Its capital is Bontoc while Bauko is the largest municipality.

Q23092.name: Nottinghamshire
Q23092.about: Nottinghamshire (; abbreviated Notts.) is a ceremonial county in the East Midlands of England. The county is bordered by South Yorkshire to the north-west, Lincolnshire to the east, Leicestershire to the south, and Derbyshire to the west.

Q23098.name: Derbyshire
Q23098.desc: ceremonial county in East Midlands, England
Q23098.about: Derbyshire ( DAR-bee-sheer, -⁠shər) is a ceremonial county in the East Midlands of England. It borders Greater Manchester to the north-west, West Yorkshire to the north, South Yorkshire to the north and north-east, Nottinghamshire to the east, Leicestershire to the south-east, Staffordshire to the south and west, and Cheshire to the west.

Q23105.name: Staffordshire
Q23105.about: Staffordshire (; postal abbreviation Staffs.) is a ceremonial county in the West Midlands of England. It borders Cheshire to the north-west, Derbyshire and Leicestershire to the east, Warwickshire to the south-east, the West Midlands county and Worcestershire to the south, and Shropshire to the west.

Q54187.name: Greater Poland Voivodeship
Q54187.about: Greater Poland Voivodeship (Polish: województwo wielkopolskie [vɔjɛˈvut͡stfɔ vjɛlkɔˈpɔlskʲɛ] ) is a voivodeship, or province, in west-central Poland. The province is named after the region called Greater Poland (Wielkopolska [vjɛlkɔˈpɔlska] ).

Q59202.name: Babylon Governorate
Q59202.about: Babylon Governorate or Babil Province (Arabic: محافظة بابل Muḥāfaẓa Bābil) is a governorate in central Iraq. It has an area of 5,119 square kilometres (1,976 sq mi), The population in Babil for 2023 is 1,820,700.
Q59202.img: Replicas of the Ishtar Gate in Babylone Governorate 2016 1.jpg

Q62987.name: Al-Qādisiyyah Governorate
Q62987.about: Al-Qadisiyah Governorate (Arabic: القادسية, al-Qādisiyah), also known as the Al-Diwaniyah Governorate (Arabic: ٱلدِّيوَانِيَّة, ad-Dīwānīyah), is one of the governorates of Iraq.  It is in the southern part of the center of the country.

Q13866.name: Nueva Vizcaya
